/* ISOLATED SOURCE WORKING DRAFT, NOT AN INSTALLABLE PRODUCT CANDIDATE.
 * Raw views and conditional CLEAR/last-leave/abandon are source-defined;
 * fixed T0, count/layout/capture, retained-root region rows and nineteen fixed
 * representation commits have bodies with each-site source/product checks.
 * A selected success tail drains region/outer roots using actual output edges.
 * A conditional typed final-free body drains State-owned roots synchronously.
 * Proxy-bound constructors/publication/call transport have real source bodies;
 * Actual Proxy/getter/type preparation has source bodies and real callers;
 * Three original finder callee producers now feed real State owning roles;
 * State-owned named/module/class metadata and builtin binding have raw consumers,
 * including after drain; retained and State class-source witnesses are consumed;
 * Catalog Product type/lifecycle is source-defined; actual seed remains missing;
 * Three original function getter effect ports preserve audit/NEW, STILL_UNCALLED;
 * Raw dictionary observations expose dependency; original wrappers resolve missing;
 * Final finder install/adjacency reversal and consumed F1/F2 call/cleanup
 * have bodies, with owned-resume Prepare/Invoke/Move and D05-first transport;
 * F0 method-call/argument transport and real result selection have bodies;
 * ModuleSpec original T0 roots have capture/drain/source consumers;
 * original MRO has conditional owned-bank capture/content consumers;
 * entry descriptor types/protocol slots have original owning/live consumers;
 * private native entries constrain original-base allocation/close;
 * actual primitive/CRT/no-callout/runtime admission remains UNPROVED;
 * spec and loader dictionary preparation have conditional real prefixes;
 * full COMPAT/Record installation/F0/D1/D2/provider remain incomplete.
 * Record type/prepare/GC clear/dealloc also have actual isolated bodies;
 * bound/setup/link/store/ACTIVE, success and conditional abort paths have bodies;
 * full inner exec/dictionary installation/restore and COMPAT remain incomplete.
 * Actual workspace owner/full class-dict domain and existing exec
 * remain missing; the complete installation chain is still unproved.
 * Free caller/producer/unknown proofs, Record
 * type/ALL unlink paths, consumer loans, header/build/caller/N and intermediate
 * error/NULL contracts stay open. No capture_complete/ACTIVE witness is forged.
 */

/* Original v3.12.10 function getter EFFECT ports, STILL_UNCALLED.
 * The future actual caller owns the original exact function operand across
 * audit and the returned NEW. These bodies intentionally do NOT authenticate
 * source, replace T0 raw capture, cache pre-audit fields or add fresh gates.
 * No public method/registration is added. Actual effect executions remain 0.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_effect_func_get_code(PyFunctionObject *op, void *Py_UNUSED(ignored))
{
    if (PySys_Audit("object.__getattr__", "Os", op, "__code__") < 0) {
        return NULL;
    }

    return Py_NewRef(op->func_code);
}

static PyObject *
reno_effect_func_get_defaults(PyFunctionObject *op, void *Py_UNUSED(ignored))
{
    if (PySys_Audit("object.__getattr__", "Os", op, "__defaults__") < 0) {
        return NULL;
    }
    if (op->func_defaults == NULL) {
        Py_RETURN_NONE;
    }
    return Py_NewRef(op->func_defaults);
}

static PyObject *
reno_effect_func_get_kwdefaults(PyFunctionObject *op, void *Py_UNUSED(ignored))
{
    if (PySys_Audit("object.__getattr__", "Os",
                    op, "__kwdefaults__") < 0) {
        return NULL;
    }
    if (op->func_kwdefaults == NULL) {
        Py_RETURN_NONE;
    }
    return Py_NewRef(op->func_kwdefaults);
}

static void
reno_common_state_initialize_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    size_t i;
    size_t j;
    RenoSpecSourceOwned empty_spec = {0};
    RenoLoaderSourceLayout empty_loader = {0};

    state->bootstrap_marker = RENO_BOOT_RAW_INITIALIZING;
    state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_UNENTERED;
    state->controls.arena_owner = RENO_ARENA_STATE;
    state->controls.published_arena = NULL;
    state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete = 0;
    state->controls.class_source_witness_ready = 0;
    state->controls.loader_layout = empty_loader;
    state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_EMPTY;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall = NULL;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured = 0;
    state->controls.finder_slot_index = 0;
    state->controls.finder_slot_armed = 0;
    state->controls.meta_active_count = 0;
    state->controls.record_head = NULL;
    state->controls.record_draining = 0;
    state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE;
    state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.expected = NULL;
    state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.captured = 0;
    state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.standard_matched = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        for (j = 0; j < 7; ++j) {
            state->controls.function_rows[i].raw_captured[j] = 0;
        }
        for (j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            state->controls.function_rows[i].present[j] = 0;
        }
        for (j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
            state->controls.function_rows[i].representation_ready[j] = 0;
        }
        state->controls.function_rows[i].row_ready = 0;
        state->controls.function_dispatch[i].expected = NULL;
        state->controls.function_dispatch[i].captured = 0;
        state->controls.function_dispatch[i].standard_matched = 0;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        state->controls.getters[i].expected = NULL;
        state->controls.getters[i].captured = 0;
        state->controls.getters[i].frozen = 0;
    }
    state->controls.builtin_exec.methoddef = NULL;
    state->controls.builtin_exec.function = NULL;
    state->controls.builtin_exec.flags = 0;
    state->controls.builtin_exec.vectorcall = NULL;
    for (i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        state->controls.builtin_exec.scalar_captured[i] = 0;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        state->controls.builtin_exec.payload_captured[i] = 0;
        state->controls.builtin_exec.present[i] = 0;
        state->controls.builtin_exec.anchor_ready[i] = 0;
    }
    state->controls.builtin_exec.ready = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 113; ++i) {
        state->arena.known.roots[i] = NULL;
        state->arena.known.owned[i] = 0;
        state->arena.known.order[i] = 0;
    }
    state->arena.known.order_count = 0;
    state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.factory = NULL;
    state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.kernel = NULL;
    state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.factory_vectorcall = NULL;
    state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.kernel_vectorcall = NULL;
    state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.phase = RENO_FACTORY_NEW;
    state->arena.install.bound_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.record_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.proxy_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.catalog_product_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.proxy = NULL;
    state->arena.install.find_spec = NULL;
    state->arena.install.invalidate_caches = NULL;
    state->arena.install.find_distributions = NULL;
    state->arena.install.finder_before = NULL;
    state->arena.install.finder_after = NULL;
    state->arena.class_source_witness = NULL;
    state->arena.spec_source = empty_spec;

    state->controls.arena_owner = RENO_ARENA_STATE;
    state->controls.published_arena = &state->arena;
    state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING;
    state->bootstrap_marker = RENO_BOOT_TYPED;
}

/* Precise same-TU producer operations, transported by the actual caller
 * to the source-defined completer. Address transport alone is not execution.
 */
typedef struct RenoProxyBindingOps {
    PyObject *(*new_type)(PyObject *actual_module);
    PyObject *(*prepare_bound)(PyObject *actual_type, PyObject *actual_owner,
        unsigned char role);
    PyObject *(*publish_bound)(PyObject **actual_prepared_owned);
} RenoProxyBindingOps;

/* Actual caller-owned automatic inputs; borrowed object operands must remain
 * continuously rooted until the producer has acquired its independent guards.
 * Neither this input record nor consistency checks confer source provenance.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderRecordInputs {
    PyObject *record_type;
    PyObject *actual_module;
    PyObject *retired_error_class;
    PyObject *owner_proxy;
    PyObject *original_loader;
    PyObject *loader_dict;
    PyObject *previous_value;
    RenoState *origin_state;
    unsigned char previous_present;
} RenoLoaderRecordInputs;
typedef struct RenoLoaderRecordOps {
    PyObject *(*new_type)(PyObject *actual_module);
    PyObject *(*prepare_record)(const RenoLoaderRecordInputs *actual_inputs);
    PyObject *(*track_prepared)(PyObject **actual_prepared_owned);
} RenoLoaderRecordOps;

/* Private same-translation-unit dependencies. Raw views, conditional CLEAR,
 * real Record/arena moves, last leave, abandon and conditional typed final
 * drain have source definitions under explicit lifetime/source premises.
 * Existing exec and full workspace capture/prepare bodies remain absent.
 * Bootstrap completion/reversal have bodies; complete free/unknown/producer
 * proofs stay open.
 * No public installer or placeholder-success ABI is added.
 */
static void reno_proxy_retire_raw(PyObject *actual_proxy);
static void reno_h01_restore_finder_slot_raw(RenoState *state);
static RenoState *reno_h01_bootstrap_state_raw(PyObject *module);
static RenoState *reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(PyObject *module);
static int reno_h01_bootstrap_existing(
    PyObject **module_guard_owned, RenoState *state);
static int reno_h01_capture_before_legacy(
    PyObject *module, RenoState *state, unsigned int *bootstrap_entered);
static int reno_h01_complete_bootstrap(
    PyObject *module, RenoState *state, unsigned int *bootstrap_entered,
    PyObject **factory_owned, PyObject **kernel_owned,
    const RenoProxyBindingOps *binding_ops,
    const RenoLoaderRecordOps *record_ops);
static void reno_h01_abandon_bootstrap(
    PyObject *module, RenoState *state, unsigned int *bootstrap_entered,
    PyObject **factory_owned, PyObject **kernel_owned, PyObject *first_borrowed);
static int reno_h01_clear_common_state(
    PyObject *module, RenoState *state, PyObject **first_owned);
/* Conditional TYPED-only synchronous drain, wired to the caller's private
 * owning slot. Caller classifies actual char and calls with no callback gap.
 * Never publish/save this address or consume/replace a nonNULL occurrence,
 * including an actual cleanup E2 adopted into an initially empty slot.
 * Actual no-reader/registry/ledger/retired-source premises precede this body;
 * all private workspace/OS debts must be settled by their actual owners.
 * No busy/defer return; final settle is followed by no State access.
 * Caller alone restores/discards errors. Unknown/caller/producer/W42 proofs
 * remain open; a real body does not grant full free or execution admission.
 */
static void reno_h01_finish_free(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    PyObject **first_owned);

/* Compile-time expressions only; not evaluated or ABI-verified this round.
 * Allocator alignment, raw include/alias/runtime and full platform support
 * still require the actual matching-build implementation and checks.
 */
typedef char RenoCommonStateMSizeFits[
    (sizeof(RenoState) > 0 && sizeof(RenoState) <= (size_t)PY_SSIZE_T_MAX) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char RenoCommonStateMarkerIsFirst[
    (offsetof(RenoState, bootstrap_marker) == 0) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char RenoKnownCountFitsUnsignedChar[(UCHAR_MAX >= 113) ? 1 : -1];

static PyModuleDef owner_factory_definition;
static PyMethodDef owner_factory_method;
static PyMethodDef owner_kernel_method;
static PyObject *owner_factory_call(PyObject *, PyObject *);
static PyObject *owner_kernel_call(PyObject *, PyObject *);

/* Source implementation of the selected bootstrap raw-view algorithm.
 * Legal actual module/type/MRO/full ABI and independent current allocation,
 * continuous capacity/source/caller premises still precede marker/payload
 * use. These comparisons do NOT infer N or source from a type/def identity.
 * Error construction is a failure exit after the caller's three automatic
 * getter samples; the successful view uses no normal public accessor.
 */
static RenoState *
reno_h01_bootstrap_state_raw(PyObject *module)
{
    RenoState *state;

    if (!PyModule_Check(module)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory module mismatch");
        return NULL;
    }
    if (_PyModule_GetDef(module) != &owner_factory_definition) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory definition mismatch");
        return NULL;
    }
    state = (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(module);
    if (state == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
        return NULL;
    }
    return state;
}

/* Called only by the actual module lifecycle slots on their legal module.
 * The original internal helper preserves any entry indicator, returns actual
 * md_state (including legitimate NULL), and does not certify allocation or
 * typed payload. No reference acquire or public accessor/error path here.
 * Debug assert/type-check expansion also needs the same matching ABI/domain.
 */
static RenoState *
reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(PyObject *module)
{
    return (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(module);
}

/* Preparation zone, not an assertion that public state access is callout
 * free. The caller's module guard spans every accessor/error operation.
 * Both pointer and raised indicator are classified before payload access.
 */
static RenoState *
prepare_common_state_normal(PyObject *module)
{
    PyModuleDef *definition;
    RenoState *state;

    if (!PyModule_CheckExact(module)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory module mismatch");
        return NULL;
    }
    definition = PyModule_GetDef(module);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    if (definition != &owner_factory_definition) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory definition mismatch");
        return NULL;
    }
    state = (RenoState *)PyModule_GetState(module);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    if (state == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
        return NULL;
    }
    return state;
}

/* The actual source/allocation/continuous capacity prerequisites precede this
 * view. A marker does not provide them. Normal errors/accessors are preparation;
 * this adapter is NEVER used as the bootstrap or GC raw-view dependency.
 */
static RenoOwnerFactoryState *
prepare_state(PyObject *module)
{
    RenoState *state = prepare_common_state_normal(module);

    if (state == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    if (*(const unsigned char *)state != RENO_BOOT_TYPED) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
        return NULL;
    }
    /* Typed retired storage remains valid under the original module guard;
     * the old callers retain their own READY-specific errors and guards.
     * Do not impose H01 ACTIVE/capture_complete/count on those direct calls.
     */
    return &state->arena.legacy_owner_factory;
}

/* The actual error is privately owned BEFORE any cleanup release. No
 * borrowed first, formatting replay or inspection of exception internals.
 */
static PyObject *
take_failure(void)
{
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory preparation failed");
    }
    return PyErr_GetRaisedException();
}

/* Internal checks on actual constructor products, not a way to turn an
 * arbitrary object/type/current export into an original source.
 */
static int
created_function_shape(PyObject *value, PyObject *module,
                       PyMethodDef *method, PyCFunction implementation)
{
    PyCFunctionObject *function;

    if (value == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyCFunction_Type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    function = (PyCFunctionObject *)value;
    return function->m_ml == method && function->m_self == module
        && method->ml_flags == METH_NOARGS
        && method->ml_meth == implementation && function->vectorcall != NULL;
}

/* Caller independently owns module, factory and kernel. All arguments are
 * internal original roots; scalar phase never comes from a Python caller.
 * This function only reads raw fields and returns a scalar.
 */
static int
source_fields_match(PyObject *module, RenoOwnerFactoryState *state,
                    PyObject *factory, PyObject *kernel,
                    RenoOwnerFactoryPhase phase)
{
    if (!PyModule_CheckExact(module) || state == NULL
            || factory == NULL || kernel == NULL
            || (phase != RENO_FACTORY_READY && phase != RENO_FACTORY_PUBLISHING)
            || state->phase != phase || state->factory != factory
            || state->kernel != kernel) {
        return 0;
    }
    return created_function_shape(factory, module, &owner_factory_method,
                                  owner_factory_call)
        && created_function_shape(kernel, module, &owner_kernel_method,
                                  owner_kernel_call)
        && ((PyCFunctionObject *)factory)->vectorcall == state->factory_vectorcall
        && ((PyCFunctionObject *)kernel)->vectorcall == state->kernel_vectorcall;
}

static int
exact_ascii_name(PyObject *key, const char *name, Py_ssize_t length)
{
    int kind;
    const void *data;
    Py_ssize_t index;

    if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key) || PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH(key) != length) {
        return 0;
    }
    kind = PyUnicode_KIND(key);
    data = PyUnicode_DATA(key);
    for (index = 0; index < length; ++index) {
        if (PyUnicode_READ(kind, data, index) != (unsigned char)name[index]) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* GetDict is preparation. After its result/error classification and the
 * independent dict acquire, success uses only raw reads/scalars. Reject
 * EVERY non-exact-str key, including ones after a matching alias; merely
 * skipping hostile keys cannot prove ordinary module lookup semantics.
 */
static int
verify_public_sources(PyObject *module, RenoOwnerFactoryState *state,
                      PyObject *factory, PyObject *kernel,
                      RenoOwnerFactoryPhase phase)
{
    PyObject *dictionary = NULL; /* borrowed only */
    PyObject *dict_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    unsigned int factory_found = 0, kernel_found = 0, invalid = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    dictionary = PyModule_GetDict(module);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return -1; /* do not use even a non-NULL borrowed error result */
    }
    if (dictionary == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory namespace unavailable");
        return -1;
    }
    dict_guard = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    if (!PyDict_CheckExact(dict_guard)
            || !source_fields_match(module, state, factory, kernel, phase)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory original sources changed");
        goto failed;
    }
    while (PyDict_Next(dict_guard, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key)) {
            invalid = 1;
            continue;
        }
        if (exact_ascii_name(key, "new_empty_owner",
                             (Py_ssize_t)(sizeof("new_empty_owner") - 1))) {
            if (factory_found || value != factory) {
                invalid = 1;
            }
            factory_found = 1;
        }
        if (exact_ascii_name(key, "owner_kernel_new_empty",
                             (Py_ssize_t)(sizeof("owner_kernel_new_empty") - 1))) {
            if (kernel_found || value != kernel) {
                invalid = 1;
            }
            kernel_found = 1;
        }
    }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (invalid || !factory_found || !kernel_found) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory public bindings changed");
        goto failed;
    }
    /* No callback since GetDict/acquire: actual module still independently
     * owns this dictionary. This release is nonlast without relying on the
     * dictionary retaining either function. No callout after this point.
     */
    Py_DECREF(dict_guard);
    return 0;

failed:
    first = take_failure();
    /* Error construction could have called out and detached module's dict.
     * This release may be last; hold the actual first privately through it.
     */
    Py_XDECREF(dict_guard);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return -1;
}

/* Actual per-occurrence moves for the final joint drainer. These operations
 * do NOT choose the time or cross-region order of release. The pending joint
 * clear/abandon/free bodies must consume the moves under the proven owner,
 * Record/lease/source dependencies and first/NULL contract. No fake drain.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_common_take_last_known(RenoRootArena *arena)
{
    unsigned char slot;
    PyObject *detached;

    /* Valid private-drain arena/ledger: registered ids are 0..112, each actual
     * owning occurrence appears once. A NULL absence was never ledgered.
     */
    if (arena->known.order_count == 0) {
        return NULL;
    }
    --arena->known.order_count;
    slot = arena->known.order[arena->known.order_count];
    detached = arena->known.roots[slot];
    arena->known.roots[slot] = NULL;
    arena->known.owned[slot] = 0;
    arena->known.order[arena->known.order_count] = 0;
    return detached; /* actual owned occurrence moved to drainer local */
}

static void
reno_common_take_legacy_roots(RenoRootArena *arena,
    PyObject **factory_owned, PyObject **kernel_owned)
{
    RenoOwnerFactoryState *legacy = &arena->legacy_owner_factory;

    /* Two distinct output locals must be empty; no callback/release here. */
    legacy->phase = RENO_FACTORY_RETIRED;
    *factory_owned = legacy->factory;
    *kernel_owned = legacy->kernel;
    legacy->factory = NULL;
    legacy->kernel = NULL;
    legacy->factory_vectorcall = NULL;
    legacy->kernel_vectorcall = NULL;
}

/* Caller has selected the actual private drain arena and ten empty locals.
 * Move every install occurrence before its first release; no ref/callback.
 */
static void
reno_common_take_install_roots(RenoRootArena *arena,
    PyObject **bound_type_owned, PyObject **record_type_owned,
    PyObject **proxy_type_owned, PyObject **catalog_product_type_owned,
    PyObject **proxy_owned, PyObject **find_spec_owned,
    PyObject **invalidate_caches_owned, PyObject **find_distributions_owned,
    PyObject **finder_before_owned, PyObject **finder_after_owned)
{
    *bound_type_owned = arena->install.bound_type;
    *record_type_owned = arena->install.record_type;
    *proxy_type_owned = arena->install.proxy_type;
    *catalog_product_type_owned = arena->install.catalog_product_type;
    *proxy_owned = arena->install.proxy;
    *find_spec_owned = arena->install.find_spec;
    *invalidate_caches_owned = arena->install.invalidate_caches;
    *find_distributions_owned = arena->install.find_distributions;
    *finder_before_owned = arena->install.finder_before;
    *finder_after_owned = arena->install.finder_after;
    arena->install.bound_type = NULL;
    arena->install.record_type = NULL;
    arena->install.proxy_type = NULL;
    arena->install.catalog_product_type = NULL;
    arena->install.proxy = NULL;
    arena->install.find_spec = NULL;
    arena->install.invalidate_caches = NULL;
    arena->install.find_distributions = NULL;
    arena->install.finder_before = NULL;
    arena->install.finder_after = NULL;
}

/* Actual unique arena handoff; out is empty private automatic storage.
 * Move ALL partial occurrences, irrespective of captured/acquired flags,
 * before any resource release. A history field never grants ownership.
 */
static void
reno_common_take_spec_source(RenoRootArena *arena, RenoSpecSourceOwned *out)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned empty = {0};
    *out = arena->spec_source;
    arena->spec_source = empty;
}


static void
reno_common_request_retirement(RenoState *state)
{
    unsigned char marker;

    if (state == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    marker = *(const unsigned char *)state;
    if (marker == RENO_BOOT_RAW_UNENTERED
            || marker == RENO_BOOT_RAW_INITIALIZING) {
        state->bootstrap_marker = RENO_BOOT_RAW_RETIRED;
        return; /* no typed payload or state-owned acquire in raw init */
    }
    if (marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED) {
        /* RAW_RETIRED is already terminal. An unknown marker is NOT repaired
         * or certified here; the real clear/free boundary still owns its
         * unresolved general-N4 classification without reading typed payload.
         */
        return;
    }
    /* This is a raw request, not settlement or permission to release roots.
     * In particular do not zero meta_active_count, record_head or draining.
     */
    state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR;
    state->controls.class_source_witness_ready = 0;
    if (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRED) {
        state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_RETIRING;
    }
    state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.phase = RENO_FACTORY_RETIRED;
    state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_RETIRED;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall = NULL;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured = 0;
    if (state->controls.arena_owner == RENO_ARENA_STATE
            && state->arena.install.proxy != NULL) {
        reno_proxy_retire_raw(state->arena.install.proxy);
    }
}

/* Conditional on the matching full/nondebug reference envelope and the
 * selected pending-deallocator contract, this is the r1250 finite gate:
 * install one independent duplicate, take it back, return that nonlast root.
 * The actual first remains privately rooted by the caller throughout.
 */
static void
reno_cleanup_begin_empty(PyObject *first_borrowed)
{
    PyObject *duplicate = Py_NewRef(first_borrowed);

    PyErr_SetRaisedException(duplicate);
    duplicate = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    Py_DECREF(duplicate); /* nonlast: caller still roots the same actual first */
}

/* first_slot roots an existing actual first (owned or an explicitly rooted
 * borrow). Only a NULL slot may adopt a NEW actual cleanup error. Existing
 * first is never consumed/replaced here; no exception fields are inspected.
 * An adopt requires the caller to own/finish that new occurrence. Abandon's
 * slot starts non-NULL and is only an alias of its parent's continuous root.
 */
static void
reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(PyObject **first_slot, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    *cleanup_failed = 1;
    if (*first_slot == NULL) {
        *first_slot = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
        return;
    }
    reno_cleanup_begin_empty(*first_slot);
}

static void
reno_cleanup_release_owned(PyObject **owned_slot,
    PyObject **first_slot, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    PyObject *detached;

    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    detached = *owned_slot;
    *owned_slot = NULL;
    Py_XDECREF(detached);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_slot, cleanup_failed);
}

/* Sole closer for ORIGINAL bases from native_allocate_original. The only
 * caller has drained every Python slot and closed all typed views/readers.
 * Legal normal free/actual trusted matching primitive is an explicit entry
 * premise, still unadmitted on the target build. A void return, errno or
 * missing counterexample is NOT a physical-release receipt.
 */
static void
reno_spec_mro_native_close_original(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    RenoSpecMroRegionOwned empty = {0};
    RenoSpecMroRegionOwned debt = *region;

    *region = empty; /* unique move of original base/span into private debt */
    if (debt.allocation != NULL) {
        free(debt.allocation); /* original producer return, not a view address */
        debt = empty; /* consumption under the stated legal primitive contract */
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* No resource/State access after the final settlement. Actual primitive
     * mapping, S1 and its lawful-domain postcondition remain separate gates.
     */
}


/* Real unique arena drainer owns this detached holder and stable bank.
 * Valid history/pointers/CRT/caller lifetime precede reads; no corruption
 * recovery or admission is inferred from flags or the ledger shape.
 */
static void
reno_spec_mro_region_drain(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    PyObject **slot;
    PyObject *detached = NULL;
    size_t index;

    if (region->initialized) {
        region->header->phase = RENO_SPEC_BANK_DRAINING;
        while (region->header->ledger_count != 0) {
            index = --region->header->ledger_count;
            slot = region->ledger[index].slot_address;
            region->ledger[index].slot_address = NULL;
            detached = *slot;
            *slot = NULL;
            slot = NULL;
            reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
        }
        region->header->phase = RENO_SPEC_BANK_DRAINED;
    }
    /* Header/array borrows end before the sole paired native closer. The
     * original allocation/span remain owned even for pre-bind partials.
     */
    region->header = NULL;
    region->base = NULL;
    region->entry = NULL;
    region->accessor = NULL;
    region->function = NULL;
    region->kw = NULL;
    region->cell = NULL;
    region->ledger = NULL;
    region->initialized = 0;
    reno_spec_mro_native_close_original(region, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
}


static int
reno_spec_mro_region_traverse(const RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    visitproc visit, void *arg)
{
    size_t index;

    if (!region->initialized) { return 0; }
    /* All initialized rows, including a key-only or base-only partial.
     * Capture-complete and completed-row counters never hide owning debt.
     */
    for (index = 0; index < region->header->initialized_bases; ++index) {
        Py_VISIT(region->base[index].base);
        Py_VISIT(region->base[index].dictionary);
    }
    for (index = 0; index < region->header->initialized_entries; ++index) {
        Py_VISIT(region->entry[index].key);
        Py_VISIT(region->entry[index].value);
        Py_VISIT(region->entry[index].descriptor_type);
    }
    for (index = 0; index < region->header->initialized_accessors; ++index) {
        Py_VISIT(region->accessor[index].value);
    }
    for (index = 0; index < region->header->initialized_functions; ++index) {
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].function);
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].code);
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].defaults);
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].kwdefaults);
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].closure);
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].globals);
        Py_VISIT(region->function[index].builtins);
    }
    for (index = 0; index < region->header->initialized_keywords; ++index) {
        Py_VISIT(region->kw[index].key);
        Py_VISIT(region->kw[index].value);
    }
    for (index = 0; index < region->header->initialized_cells; ++index) {
        Py_VISIT(region->cell[index].cell);
        Py_VISIT(region->cell[index].contents);
    }
    return 0;
}


/* Real binding component. Roles1/2 have actual typed call/cleanup consumers;
 * role0 and the full internal D1/D2/activation work remain incomplete.
 * This isolated draft has no complete dispatch or execution admission.
 */
enum RenoProxyBoundRole {
    RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC = 0,
    RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES = 1,
    RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS = 2
};
enum RenoProxyBoundPhase {
    RENO_PROXY_BOUND_INIT = 0,
    RENO_PROXY_BOUND_ACTIVE = 1,
    RENO_PROXY_BOUND_DEAD = 2
};
typedef struct RenoProxyBoundObject {
    PyObject_HEAD
    PyObject *owner_proxy; /* immutable after initialization until dealloc */
    vectorcallfunc vectorcall;
    unsigned char role;
    unsigned char phase;
} RenoProxyBoundObject;

/* Actual role0 method-call/cleanup body below, consumed by this wrapper.
 * The real result selector reaches a conditional spec.loader prefix; full
 * COMPAT/binding/source/D1/D2/caller qualification remain incomplete.
 * Preserve original args/nargsf/kwnames and one actual method call.
 */
static PyObject *reno_h01_proxy_dispatch(PyObject *actual_owner,
    unsigned char role, PyObject *const *args, size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames);
/* Consumed roles1/2: actual owned-resume call/cleanup, not full D1/D2.
 * Original actual_owner remains rooted by the wrapper's private guard.
 */
static PyObject *reno_h01_function_dispatch_d0(PyObject *actual_owner,
    unsigned char role, PyObject *const *args, size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames);
static PyObject *reno_proxy_bound_vectorcall(PyObject *callable,
    PyObject *const *args, size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames);

typedef char RenoProxyBoundSizeFits[
    (sizeof(RenoProxyBoundObject) <= INT_MAX
        && offsetof(RenoProxyBoundObject, vectorcall) > 0
        && offsetof(RenoProxyBoundObject, vectorcall) <= PY_SSIZE_T_MAX) ? 1 : -1];

static int
reno_proxy_bound_traverse(RenoProxyBoundObject *self, visitproc visit, void *arg)
{
    Py_VISIT(self->owner_proxy);
    Py_VISIT(Py_TYPE(self));
    return 0;
}

static void
reno_proxy_bound_dealloc(RenoProxyBoundObject *self)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    const unsigned int had_entry_first = (first != NULL);
    PyObject *type_owned = (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self);
    PyObject *owner = NULL;
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Preserve the existing implicit heap-type occurrence until after the
     * instance memory is gone; this is not an additional type acquisition.
     */
    PyObject_GC_UnTrack(self);
    self->phase = RENO_PROXY_BOUND_DEAD;
    owner = self->owner_proxy;
    self->owner_proxy = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owner, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyObject_GC_Del(self);
    /* Never read self after free, including for type, owner or error policy. */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    out = first;
    first = NULL;
    if (had_entry_first) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return;
    }
    if (out != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
    }
    PyErr_Clear();
    return;
}

static PyMemberDef reno_proxy_bound_members[] = {
    {"__vectorcalloffset__", T_PYSSIZET,
        offsetof(RenoProxyBoundObject, vectorcall), READONLY, NULL},
    {NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL}
};
static PyType_Slot reno_proxy_bound_slots[] = {
    {Py_tp_call, (void *)PyVectorcall_Call},
    {Py_tp_dealloc, (void *)reno_proxy_bound_dealloc},
    {Py_tp_traverse, (void *)reno_proxy_bound_traverse},
    {Py_tp_free, (void *)PyObject_GC_Del},
    {Py_tp_members, (void *)reno_proxy_bound_members},
    {0, NULL}
};
static PyType_Spec reno_proxy_bound_spec = {
    "_reno_handle_owner312._ProxyBoundOp",
    sizeof(RenoProxyBoundObject),
    0,
    Py_TPFLAGS_DEFAULT | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE
        | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_VECTORCALL,
    reno_proxy_bound_slots
};

/* Check actual constructor effect against static definitions. Origin is the
 * actual C constructor/owning transport, not these consistency comparisons.
 * Matching full ABI, live actual type/dict/descriptor and no-callout reference
 * premises are independent. The offset descriptor remains observable.
 */
static int
reno_proxy_bound_type_effect(PyObject *actual_type)
{
    PyTypeObject *type;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    PyObject *descriptor = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    unsigned long required = Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE
        | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_VECTORCALL;

    if (actual_type == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_type, &PyType_Type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    type = (PyTypeObject *)actual_type;
    if (type->tp_basicsize != (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(RenoProxyBoundObject)
            || type->tp_itemsize != 0 || type->tp_base != &PyBaseObject_Type
            || (type->tp_flags & required) != required
            || (type->tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_BASETYPE) != 0
            || type->tp_dictoffset != 0 || type->tp_weaklistoffset != 0
            || type->tp_new != NULL || type->tp_clear != NULL
            || type->tp_call != PyVectorcall_Call
            || type->tp_dealloc != (destructor)reno_proxy_bound_dealloc
            || type->tp_traverse != (traverseproc)reno_proxy_bound_traverse
            || type->tp_free != PyObject_GC_Del
            || type->tp_vectorcall_offset
                != (Py_ssize_t)offsetof(RenoProxyBoundObject, vectorcall)
            || type->tp_members == NULL || type->tp_members[0].name == NULL
            || strcmp(type->tp_members[0].name, "__vectorcalloffset__") != 0
            || type->tp_members[0].type != T_PYSSIZET
            || type->tp_members[0].flags != READONLY
            || type->tp_members[0].offset
                != (Py_ssize_t)offsetof(RenoProxyBoundObject, vectorcall)
            || type->tp_members[1].name != NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    dictionary = _PyType_GetDict(type);
    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) { return 0; }
    while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (exact_ascii_name(key, "__vectorcalloffset__",
                (Py_ssize_t)(sizeof("__vectorcalloffset__") - 1))) {
            if (descriptor != NULL) { return 0; }
            descriptor = value;
        }
    }
    return descriptor != NULL && Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, &PyMemberDescr_Type)
        && PyDescr_TYPE(descriptor) == type
        && ((PyMemberDescrObject *)descriptor)->d_member == type->tp_members;
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_bound_new_type(PyObject *module)
{
    PyObject *type = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Borrow the actual native module under the original continuous creation
     * module_guard; no type.ht_module edge is used to justify that caller root.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    type = PyType_FromModuleAndSpec(module, &reno_proxy_bound_spec, NULL);
    if (type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_proxy_bound_type_effect(type)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native proxy binding type mismatch");
        goto failed;
    }
    return type; /* this exact constructor's actual NEW, not a current alias */
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_bound_prepare(PyObject *actual_type, PyObject *actual_owner,
    unsigned char role)
{
    PyObject *owner_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *type_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *partial = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoProxyBoundObject *self = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Actual private getter/caller holds both original operands continuously;
     * actual_type comes from the real C producer, owner from the real Proxy.
     * This is not a Python subject/type registration or origin-by-shape API.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (actual_type == NULL || actual_owner == NULL
            || role > RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, "invalid private proxy binding inputs");
        return NULL;
    }
    owner_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_owner);
    type_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_type);
    if (!reno_proxy_bound_type_effect(type_guard)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native proxy binding type unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    self = PyObject_GC_New(RenoProxyBoundObject, (PyTypeObject *)type_guard);
    if (self == NULL) { goto failed; }
    self->owner_proxy = NULL;
    self->vectorcall = reno_proxy_bound_vectorcall;
    self->role = role;
    self->phase = RENO_PROXY_BOUND_INIT;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    self->owner_proxy = owner_guard;
    owner_guard = NULL; /* one move into the still-untracked initialized op */
    /* Nonlast only under the matching successful heap-instance type contract.
     * No further fallible action or Track here; getter must still fresh-check.
     */
    Py_DECREF(type_guard);
    type_guard = NULL;
    return (PyObject *)self;
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    partial = (PyObject *)self;
    self = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&partial, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owner_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_bound_publish(PyObject **prepared_owned)
{
    RenoProxyBoundObject *self;

    /* Future actual getter has completed source/state/Proxy fresh and all
     * extra guard cleanup, with no callback gap to this private operation.
     * The operand is its own real prepare return, never an arbitrary subject.
     * Checks below establish consistency only, not origin or eligibility.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (prepared_owned == NULL || *prepared_owned == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "missing prepared proxy binding");
        return NULL;
    }
    self = (RenoProxyBoundObject *)*prepared_owned;
    if (self->phase != RENO_PROXY_BOUND_INIT || self->owner_proxy == NULL
            || self->role > RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS
            || self->vectorcall != reno_proxy_bound_vectorcall) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "invalid prepared proxy binding");
        return NULL;
    }
    self->phase = RENO_PROXY_BOUND_ACTIVE;
    PyObject_GC_Track(self);
    *prepared_owned = NULL;
    return (PyObject *)self; /* actual owning occurrence moved to return */
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_bound_vectorcall(PyObject *callable, PyObject *const *args,
    size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames)
{
    RenoProxyBoundObject *self = (RenoProxyBoundObject *)callable;
    PyObject *owner_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *result = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    unsigned char role = 0;
    unsigned int entered = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Legal C API entry has empty indicator and a live actual callable
     * operand. The framework's operand root spans this complete C invocation.
     */
    if (Py_EnterRecursiveCall(" while calling a reno finder binding") != 0) {
        return NULL; /* no guard or successful Enter; no Leave here */
    }
    entered = 1;
    if (self->phase != RENO_PROXY_BOUND_ACTIVE || self->owner_proxy == NULL
            || self->role > RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native proxy binding is not active");
        goto failed;
    }
    role = self->role;
    owner_guard = Py_NewRef(self->owner_proxy);
    if (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
            || role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS) {
        result = reno_h01_function_dispatch_d0(owner_guard, role, args, nargsf, kwnames);
    } else {
        result = reno_h01_proxy_dispatch(owner_guard, role, args, nargsf, kwnames);
    }
    if (result == NULL) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError,
                "native proxy dispatch returned NULL without an exception");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    /* Nonlast: the persistent actual callable operand still owns this op,
     * whose immutable owner edge covers this separate call guard. Keep even
     * this independent cleanup inside the successful recursion interval.
     */
    Py_DECREF(owner_guard);
    owner_guard = NULL;
    Py_LeaveRecursiveCall();
    entered = 0;
    return result; /* same actual NEW, no iterable consumption or argument pack */
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    /* Result may be last and cleanup may re-enter: retain this layer's
     * successful recursion interval through every local resource release.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owner_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (entered) {
        Py_LeaveRecursiveCall();
        entered = 0;
    }
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static const RenoProxyBindingOps reno_proxy_binding_ops = {
    reno_proxy_bound_new_type,
    reno_proxy_bound_prepare,
    reno_proxy_bound_publish
};


/* Legal registry/layout/GIL invariant is established only by the real
 * producer and ALL exit paths. This operation does not authenticate pointers.
 * It has no acquire/release/callback and never retains next across callback.
 */
static void
reno_record_unlink_raw(RenoLoaderRecordObject *record)
{
    RenoState *owner;

    if (!record->linked) {
        return;
    }
    owner = record->registry_owner_state;
    if (record->prev != NULL) {
        record->prev->next = record->next;
    } else {
        owner->controls.record_head = record->next;
    }
    if (record->next != NULL) {
        record->next->prev = record->prev;
    }
    record->registry_owner_state = NULL;
    record->prev = NULL;
    record->next = NULL;
    record->linked = 0;
}

static void
reno_record_take_sources_raw(RenoLoaderRecordObject *record,
    RenoRecordDetachedSources *detached)
{
    /* Actual record guard is already held, all six output slots are empty. */
    record->restore_cancelled = 1;
    reno_record_unlink_raw(record);
    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
            && record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED) {
        record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRING;
    }
    detached->attribute_key = record->attribute_key;
    detached->owner_proxy = record->owner_proxy;
    detached->original_loader = record->original_loader;
    detached->loader_dict = record->loader_dict;
    detached->previous_value = record->previous_value;
    detached->installed_bound = record->installed_bound;
    record->attribute_key = NULL;
    record->owner_proxy = NULL;
    record->original_loader = NULL;
    record->loader_dict = NULL;
    record->previous_value = NULL;
    record->installed_bound = NULL;
    /* Preserve origin_state, both lifetime roots and actual presence/store/
     * effect/restore facts. CLEAR does not undo a previously observed effect.
     */
}

static void
reno_record_clear_sources(RenoLoaderRecordObject *record,
    PyObject **first_slot, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    RenoRecordDetachedSources detached = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};

    reno_record_take_sources_raw(record, &detached);
    /* The continuous record guard retains its own module/error roots. All
     * six source occurrences are already private; release never reloads one
     * from a cleared Record or writes a loader dict/external method alias.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.installed_bound, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.previous_value, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.loader_dict, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.original_loader, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.owner_proxy, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.attribute_key, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED) {
        record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED;
    }
}

/* Actual Record component for the one existing struct declaration. Producers
 * are only transported to the missing completer; no Record/type creation or
 * registration occurs until a real caller consumes these operations.
 */
typedef char RenoLoaderRecordSizeFits[
    (sizeof(RenoLoaderRecordObject) <= INT_MAX) ? 1 : -1];

static int
reno_record_traverse(RenoLoaderRecordObject *self, visitproc visit, void *arg)
{
    Py_VISIT(self->module_lifetime);
    Py_VISIT(self->retired_error_class);
    Py_VISIT(self->attribute_key);
    Py_VISIT(self->owner_proxy);
    Py_VISIT(self->original_loader);
    Py_VISIT(self->loader_dict);
    Py_VISIT(self->previous_value);
    Py_VISIT(self->installed_bound);
    Py_VISIT(Py_TYPE(self));
    return 0;
}

static int
reno_record_gc_clear(RenoLoaderRecordObject *self)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Legal GC/direct caller retains the actual receiver through this body.
     * This existing operation cancels/unlinks/detaches all six sources before
     * its first release; it does not restore a loader dictionary.
     */
    reno_record_clear_sources(self, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* No object/State access or resource release after the final settlement.
     * Helper contract: cleanup_failed implies an actual first was adopted or
     * was already privately held. Do not erase a new failure with Clear.
     */
    if (first != NULL) {
        out = first;
        first = NULL;
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return cleanup_failed ? -1 : 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void
reno_record_dealloc(RenoLoaderRecordObject *self)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    const unsigned int had_entry_first = (first != NULL);
    PyObject *type_owned = (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self);
    PyObject *module_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *error_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    RenoRecordDetachedSources detached = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Actual linked-record lifetime/registry invariant precedes this path.
     * Never acquire self at refcount-zero entry or retain a naked next over
     * callback. All payloads, including both lifetime fields, leave self
     * before the first release. Existing implicit type is not a new guard.
     */
    self->restore_cancelled = 1;
    reno_record_unlink_raw(self);
    PyObject_GC_UnTrack(self);
    reno_record_take_sources_raw(self, &detached);
    module_owned = self->module_lifetime;
    error_owned = self->retired_error_class;
    self->module_lifetime = NULL;
    self->retired_error_class = NULL;
    self->origin_state = NULL;
    if (self->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED) {
        self->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED;
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.installed_bound, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.previous_value, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.loader_dict, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.original_loader, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.owner_proxy, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached.attribute_key, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&error_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyObject_GC_Del(self);
    /* No self read after free, including origin/module/type/error policy. */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    out = first;
    first = NULL;
    if (had_entry_first) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return;
    }
    if (out != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
    }
    PyErr_Clear();
    return;
}

static PyType_Slot reno_record_slots[] = {
    {Py_tp_dealloc, (void *)reno_record_dealloc},
    {Py_tp_traverse, (void *)reno_record_traverse},
    {Py_tp_clear, (void *)reno_record_gc_clear},
    {Py_tp_free, (void *)PyObject_GC_Del},
    {0, NULL}
};
static PyType_Spec reno_record_spec = {
    "_reno_handle_owner312._LoaderRecord",
    sizeof(RenoLoaderRecordObject),
    0,
    Py_TPFLAGS_DEFAULT | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE
        | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION,
    reno_record_slots
};

/* Consistency against the static constructor definitions is separate from
 * the original actual constructor/owning transport and matching full ABI.
 */
static int
reno_record_type_effect(PyObject *actual_type)
{
    PyTypeObject *type;
    unsigned long required = Py_TPFLAGS_HEAPTYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC
        | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION;

    if (actual_type == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_type, &PyType_Type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    type = (PyTypeObject *)actual_type;
    return type->tp_basicsize == (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(RenoLoaderRecordObject)
        && type->tp_itemsize == 0 && type->tp_base == &PyBaseObject_Type
        && (type->tp_flags & required) == required
        && (type->tp_flags & (Py_TPFLAGS_BASETYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_VECTORCALL)) == 0
        && type->tp_dictoffset == 0 && type->tp_weaklistoffset == 0
        && type->tp_new == NULL && type->tp_call == NULL
        && type->tp_vectorcall_offset == 0
        && type->tp_dealloc == (destructor)reno_record_dealloc
        && type->tp_traverse == (traverseproc)reno_record_traverse
        && type->tp_clear == (inquiry)reno_record_gc_clear
        && type->tp_free == PyObject_GC_Del;
}

static PyObject *
reno_record_new_type(PyObject *actual_module)
{
    PyObject *type = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Borrow actual native module under the original continuous creation
     * module guard, independent of the future type's module field.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    type = PyType_FromModuleAndSpec(actual_module, &reno_record_spec, NULL);
    if (type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_record_type_effect(type)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader record type mismatch");
        goto failed;
    }
    return type;
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_record_prepare(const RenoLoaderRecordInputs *inputs)
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *error_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *owner_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *loader_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *dict_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *previous_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *type_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *partial = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *self = NULL;
    RenoState *origin_state = NULL;
    unsigned char previous_present = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Caller holds actual original operands continuously, and its private
     * automatic input record is live. Shape checks do not create provenance.
     * No caller input is consulted after the first possible callback below.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (inputs == NULL || inputs->record_type == NULL
            || inputs->actual_module == NULL || inputs->retired_error_class == NULL
            || inputs->owner_proxy == NULL || inputs->original_loader == NULL
            || inputs->loader_dict == NULL || !PyDict_Check(inputs->loader_dict)
            || inputs->origin_state == NULL || inputs->previous_present > 1
            || (inputs->previous_present && inputs->previous_value == NULL)
            || (!inputs->previous_present && inputs->previous_value != NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, "invalid private loader record inputs");
        return NULL;
    }
    origin_state = inputs->origin_state;
    previous_present = inputs->previous_present;
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->actual_module);
    error_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->retired_error_class);
    owner_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->owner_proxy);
    loader_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->original_loader);
    dict_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->loader_dict);
    if (previous_present) {
        previous_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->previous_value);
    }
    type_guard = Py_NewRef(inputs->record_type);
    /* All borrowed inputs are now independently held; no more inputs reads. */
    if (!reno_record_type_effect(type_guard)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader record type unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    key_guard = PyUnicode_FromString("exec_module");
    if (key_guard == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_record_type_effect(type_guard)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader record type changed");
        goto failed;
    }
    self = PyObject_GC_New(RenoLoaderRecordObject, (PyTypeObject *)type_guard);
    if (self == NULL) { goto failed; }
    self->module_lifetime = NULL;
    self->retired_error_class = NULL;
    self->attribute_key = NULL;
    self->owner_proxy = NULL;
    self->original_loader = NULL;
    self->loader_dict = NULL;
    self->previous_value = NULL;
    self->installed_bound = NULL;
    self->origin_state = NULL;
    self->registry_owner_state = NULL;
    self->prev = NULL;
    self->next = NULL;
    self->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT;
    self->created_inner_vectorcall = NULL;
    self->created_bound_vectorcall = NULL;
    self->inner_dispatch_captured = 0;
    self->bound_dispatch_captured = 0;
    self->linked = 0;
    self->restore_cancelled = 0;
    self->previous_present = 0;
    self->store_attempted = 0;
    self->store_returned = 0;
    self->effect_observed = 0;
    self->restore_attempted = 0;
    self->restore_returned = 0;
    self->restore_effect_observed = 0;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    self->module_lifetime = module_guard;
    module_guard = NULL;
    self->retired_error_class = error_guard;
    error_guard = NULL;
    self->attribute_key = key_guard;
    key_guard = NULL;
    self->owner_proxy = owner_guard;
    owner_guard = NULL;
    self->original_loader = loader_guard;
    loader_guard = NULL;
    self->loader_dict = dict_guard;
    dict_guard = NULL;
    self->previous_value = previous_guard;
    previous_guard = NULL;
    self->origin_state = origin_state;
    self->previous_present = previous_present;
    /* Actual successful heap instance owns its separate implicit type root.
     * This guard alone is nonlast; untracked INIT is not a source admission.
     */
    Py_DECREF(type_guard);
    type_guard = NULL;
    return (PyObject *)self;
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    partial = (PyObject *)self;
    self = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&partial, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&previous_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dict_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&loader_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owner_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&error_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_record_track_prepared(PyObject **prepared_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *self;

    /* Actual caller completed original module/state/Proxy/loader/dict/type
     * and generation fresh plus extra cleanup, then no callback to this op.
     * Its private owning slot holds this call's actual prepare return. These
     * checks establish consistency only; no ACTIVE/link/installation follows.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (prepared_owned == NULL || *prepared_owned == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "missing prepared loader record");
        return NULL;
    }
    self = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)*prepared_owned;
    if (self->created_inner_vectorcall != NULL || self->created_bound_vectorcall != NULL
            || self->inner_dispatch_captured || self->bound_dispatch_captured
            || self->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || self->linked
            || self->restore_cancelled || self->module_lifetime == NULL
            || self->retired_error_class == NULL || self->attribute_key == NULL
            || self->owner_proxy == NULL || self->original_loader == NULL
            || self->loader_dict == NULL || self->installed_bound != NULL
            || self->origin_state == NULL || self->registry_owner_state != NULL
            || self->prev != NULL || self->next != NULL || self->previous_present > 1
            || (self->previous_present && self->previous_value == NULL)
            || (!self->previous_present && self->previous_value != NULL)
            || self->store_attempted || self->store_returned || self->effect_observed
            || self->restore_attempted || self->restore_returned
            || self->restore_effect_observed) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "invalid prepared loader record");
        return NULL;
    }
    self->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED;
    PyObject_GC_Track(self);
    *prepared_owned = NULL;
    return (PyObject *)self;
}

static const RenoLoaderRecordOps reno_loader_record_ops = {
    reno_record_new_type,
    reno_record_prepare,
    reno_record_track_prepared
};


/* Actual finder owner and getter/creation integration. State owns the four
 * actual constructor products; business callees/metadata remain the missing
 * dispatcher's independent admission duty. PREPARED is never ACTIVE.
 */
typedef enum RenoProxyPhase {
    RENO_PROXY_INIT = 0,
    RENO_PROXY_PREPARED,
    RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE,
    RENO_PROXY_RETIRING,
    RENO_PROXY_RETIRED
} RenoProxyPhase;
typedef struct RenoProxyObject {
    PyObject_HEAD
    PyObject *module_lifetime;
    PyObject *retired_error_class;
    RenoState *origin_state;
    RenoProxyPhase phase;
} RenoProxyObject;
typedef enum RenoFinderFullnameMode {
    RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U = 0,
    RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P,
    RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K
} RenoFinderFullnameMode;

/* Automatic borrowed transport, covered by the actual dispatcher's guards
 * and the wrapper's owner_guard. No pointer to this storage may escape.
 * The scalar observation is an actual internal callback-path fact, never a
 * substitute for independently established roots, ABI or code lifetime.
 */
typedef struct RenoF0SourceContext {
    RenoProxyObject *owner;
    PyObject *module;
    RenoState *state;
    PyThreadState *tstate;
    PyObject *method;
    PyObject *function;
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *code;
    unsigned int in_method_call;
    unsigned int adapter_gate_observed;
} RenoF0SourceContext;

/* Private selection facts only; none authenticates spec/loader/caller/seed. */
typedef enum RenoFinderTargetHint {
    RENO_FINDER_TARGET_UNPROVEN = 0,
    RENO_FINDER_TARGET_CATALOG,
    RENO_FINDER_TARGET_CONTROL,
    RENO_FINDER_TARGET_SCOPE,
    RENO_FINDER_TARGET_REGISTRATION
} RenoFinderTargetHint;

/* Actual conditional spec.loader prefix is defined after the selector.
 * Parent retains the SAME actual NEW spec, P/K argument, original source roots
 * and entered/module lifetime. Inputs are BORROWED; automatic context/storage
 * cannot escape. Persistent records must acquire and manage their own roots.
 * The fixed prepared key is this project's NEW operand, not actual fullname.
 * Original capture/live checks do not prove complete getter/M/S1/ABI admission.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_spec_loader(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint);

/* Defined below: full standard spec.loader lookup for lawful UNKNOWN/
 * subclass/custom/descriptor/storage domains at this pre-getter handoff.
 * Preserve the same actual spec/fullname and one real getter's effects.
 * Full F0/COMPAT, actual binding/Record/execution and source admission remain
 * separate obligations; this definition does not certify those continuations.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_spec_loader_compat(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint);

/* Native dictionary preparation is defined below. The caller owns the SAME
 * one actual loader return; every input here is borrowed under its original
 * spec/fullname/module/source/entered roots. Full binding remains incomplete.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_actual_loader_binding(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint);

/* Existing character-only reader; no whole-key-domain or source certificate.
 * Its borrowed return must be consumed immediately in the same held raw span.
 */
static PyObject *reno_t0_ascii_value(PyObject *dictionary,
    const char *name, Py_ssize_t length);

/* Standard compatibility lookup body is defined below. Complete lawful
 * custom/subclass/source/storage selection still belongs to its existing
 * complete-selection child and is not certified by this definition.
 * prepared_dict==NULL means GenericGetDict has NOT run in this prefix.
 * A non-NULL prepared_dict is the borrowed SAME actual NEW it returned after
 * a real preparation effect, still strongly held by the prefix. It is not
 * necessarily the current backing dict or an exact/supported dictionary.
 * Preserve that effect and occurrence: do not repeat GetDict/loader getter/
 * finder, infer namespace, invent a source, or blindly succeed/reject.
 * Return 0/empty only after COMPLETE handling; -1 with actual exception.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_loader_binding_compat(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *prepared_dict, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint);

/* Pure scalar observations about the FIRST related live registry node and
 * whether another related node existed in the SAME callback-free scan.
 * They are neither complete alias selection nor an ACTIVE/source certificate.
 * A later callback may clear payloads even while the actual Record is held.
 */
typedef enum RenoLoaderRecordQueryKind {
    RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE,
    RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE
} RenoLoaderRecordQueryKind;
typedef struct RenoLoaderRecordObservation {
    RenoLoaderRecordQueryKind kind;
    RenoLoaderRecordPhase phase;
    unsigned char same_loader;
    unsigned char same_dictionary;
    unsigned char current_is_installed_bound;
    unsigned char candidate_bound_is_installed_bound; /* FIRST node only */
    unsigned char restore_cancelled;
    unsigned char store_attempted;
    unsigned char store_returned;
    unsigned char effect_observed;
    unsigned char restore_attempted;
    unsigned char restore_returned;
    unsigned char restore_effect_observed;
} RenoLoaderRecordObservation;

/* Real dictionary/current-value and registry-query prefix below. Inputs are
 * the SAME actual held occurrences, never a fresh finder/getter/GetDict call.
 * previous_present distinguishes actual current NULL absence from Py_None;
 * this current value is NOT a Record's historical restoration previous_value.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_loader_dictionary(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    unsigned char previous_present, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint);

/* Conditional source/query and pristine native setup prefix is defined below.
 * Complete alias/idempotency/install/restore remains in an UNDEFINED child;
 * this declaration does not grant full selection/binding/source completion.
 * existing_record borrows the prefix's independent actual owning (or NULL);
 * observation borrows automatic scalar storage, about its FIRST related node
 * only; MULTIPLE does not retain other nodes. Neither address may escape.
 * NONE is not permission to ignore U/external bound/late calls; phase/value
 * facts are not a complete reuse decision or a reentrancy-policy selection.
 * Callback invalidates observations and may clear any Record payload; acquire
 * independent actual payload guards and revalidate before using them. Do not
 * turn current previous into historical previous or overwrite external values.
 * Shared aliases/conditional restore/late calls/bounded reclamation and ALL
 * U/nonexact duties remain mandatory. Persistent records acquire ownings.
 * Return 0/empty ONLY after COMPLETE handling; -1 with actual exception.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_loader_record_selection(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    unsigned char previous_present, PyObject *existing_record,
    const RenoLoaderRecordObservation *observation, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint);


/* Actual result selector below; full COMPAT/loader-binding remain missing.
 * source/actual_fullname/actual_spec are BORROWED from this live dispatcher;
 * its original owning spec is neither consumed nor replaced. mode P/K has
 * the same independently retained actual argument, U has NULL; a name grants
 * no source/caller/loader/seed qualification. The automatic source address
 * and its borrowed slots never escape. Persistent records must independently
 * acquire and manage any original operands they need to retain.
 *
 * Return 0 with empty indicator only after this actual return's COMPLETE
 * branch: actual None, proven P/K exact non-target (without touching prior
 * U wrappers), or the actual spec-source/loader continuation with complete
 * selection/binding/install/effect/ACTIVE/registry and source handling.
 * Failure is -1 with actual exception; never retry finder or loader, consume
 * a parent's occurrence, return a replacement spec, or hide an unfinished
 * domain behind unconditional success / rejection. Idempotency, external
 * replacements, shared aliases, restore and late calls remain obligations.
 * This selector neither authenticates spec/loader nor grants execution.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_find_spec(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec);


typedef char RenoProxySizeFits[(sizeof(RenoProxyObject) <= INT_MAX) ? 1 : -1];
static PyObject *reno_proxy_getter(RenoProxyObject *self, void *closure);

static void
reno_proxy_retire_raw(PyObject *actual_proxy)
{
    RenoProxyObject *self;

    if (actual_proxy == NULL) { return; }
    self = (RenoProxyObject *)actual_proxy;
    if (self->phase != RENO_PROXY_RETIRED) {
        self->phase = RENO_PROXY_RETIRING;
    }
}

static int
reno_proxy_traverse(RenoProxyObject *self, visitproc visit, void *arg)
{
    Py_VISIT(self->module_lifetime);
    Py_VISIT(self->retired_error_class);
    Py_VISIT(Py_TYPE(self));
    return 0;
}

static int
reno_proxy_gc_clear(RenoProxyObject *self)
{
    /* No payload release, accessor or callback: both lifetime fields remain
     * immutable until dealloc. Preserve any actual entry error unchanged.
     */
    reno_proxy_retire_raw((PyObject *)self);
    return 0;
}

static void
reno_proxy_dealloc(RenoProxyObject *self)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    const unsigned int had_entry_first = (first != NULL);
    PyObject *type_owned = (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self);
    PyObject *module_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *error_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    PyObject_GC_UnTrack(self);
    self->phase = RENO_PROXY_RETIRED;
    module_owned = self->module_lifetime;
    error_owned = self->retired_error_class;
    self->module_lifetime = NULL;
    self->retired_error_class = NULL;
    self->origin_state = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&error_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyObject_GC_Del(self);
    /* All self fields have ceased to exist; the implicit type occurrence
     * was saved before free, without acquiring an extra reference.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    out = first;
    first = NULL;
    if (had_entry_first) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return;
    }
    if (out != NULL) { PyErr_SetRaisedException(out); }
    PyErr_Clear();
    return;
}

static const unsigned char reno_proxy_roles[3] = {
    RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC, RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES,
    RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS
};
static PyGetSetDef reno_proxy_getsets[] = {
    {"find_spec", (getter)reno_proxy_getter, NULL, NULL,
        (void *)&reno_proxy_roles[0]},
    {"invalidate_caches", (getter)reno_proxy_getter, NULL, NULL,
        (void *)&reno_proxy_roles[1]},
    {"find_distributions", (getter)reno_proxy_getter, NULL, NULL,
        (void *)&reno_proxy_roles[2]},
    {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL}
};
static PyType_Slot reno_proxy_slots[] = {
    {Py_tp_dealloc, (void *)reno_proxy_dealloc},
    {Py_tp_traverse, (void *)reno_proxy_traverse},
    {Py_tp_clear, (void *)reno_proxy_gc_clear},
    {Py_tp_free, (void *)PyObject_GC_Del},
    {Py_tp_getset, (void *)reno_proxy_getsets},
    {0, NULL}
};
static PyType_Spec reno_proxy_spec = {
    "_reno_handle_owner312._FinderProxy",
    sizeof(RenoProxyObject),
    0,
    Py_TPFLAGS_DEFAULT | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE
        | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION,
    reno_proxy_slots
};

static int
reno_proxy_type_effect(PyObject *actual_type)
{
    PyTypeObject *type;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    unsigned char found[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    unsigned int role;
    static const Py_ssize_t lengths[3] = {9, 17, 18};
    unsigned long required = Py_TPFLAGS_HEAPTYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC
        | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION;

    /* Original actual constructor/owning transport provides origin. These
     * comparisons check effect against independent static C definitions.
     */
    if (actual_type == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_type, &PyType_Type)) { return 0; }
    type = (PyTypeObject *)actual_type;
    if (type->tp_basicsize != (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(RenoProxyObject)
            || type->tp_itemsize != 0 || type->tp_base != &PyBaseObject_Type
            || (type->tp_flags & required) != required
            || (type->tp_flags & (Py_TPFLAGS_BASETYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_VECTORCALL)) != 0
            || type->tp_dictoffset != 0 || type->tp_weaklistoffset != 0
            || type->tp_new != NULL || type->tp_call != NULL
            || type->tp_vectorcall_offset != 0
            || type->tp_dealloc != (destructor)reno_proxy_dealloc
            || type->tp_traverse != (traverseproc)reno_proxy_traverse
            || type->tp_clear != (inquiry)reno_proxy_gc_clear
            || type->tp_free != PyObject_GC_Del
            || type->tp_getset != reno_proxy_getsets) { return 0; }
    dictionary = _PyType_GetDict(type);
    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) { return 0; }
    while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key)) { return 0; }
        for (role = 0; role < 3; ++role) {
            if (exact_ascii_name(key, reno_proxy_getsets[role].name, lengths[role])) {
                if (found[role] || !Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyGetSetDescr_Type)
                        || PyDescr_TYPE(value) != type
                        || ((PyGetSetDescrObject *)value)->d_getset
                            != &reno_proxy_getsets[role]
                        || reno_proxy_getsets[role].get != (getter)reno_proxy_getter
                        || reno_proxy_getsets[role].set != NULL
                        || reno_proxy_getsets[role].closure
                            != (void *)&reno_proxy_roles[role]) { return 0; }
                found[role] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return found[0] && found[1] && found[2];
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_new_type(PyObject *actual_module)
{
    PyObject *type = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    type = PyType_FromModuleAndSpec(actual_module, &reno_proxy_spec, NULL);
    if (type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_proxy_type_effect(type)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder proxy type mismatch");
        goto failed;
    }
    return type;
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_prepare(PyObject *actual_type, PyObject *actual_module,
    PyObject *actual_error, RenoState *actual_origin)
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *error_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *type_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *partial = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoProxyObject *self = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Original caller continuously roots all three actual operands and the
     * original module allocation. No source is inferred from these checks.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (actual_type == NULL || actual_module == NULL || actual_error == NULL
            || actual_origin == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, "invalid private finder proxy inputs");
        return NULL;
    }
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_module);
    error_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_error);
    type_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_type);
    if (!reno_proxy_type_effect(type_guard)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder proxy type unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    self = PyObject_GC_New(RenoProxyObject, (PyTypeObject *)type_guard);
    if (self == NULL) { goto failed; }
    self->module_lifetime = NULL;
    self->retired_error_class = NULL;
    self->origin_state = NULL;
    self->phase = RENO_PROXY_INIT;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    self->module_lifetime = module_guard;
    module_guard = NULL;
    self->retired_error_class = error_guard;
    error_guard = NULL;
    self->origin_state = actual_origin;
    /* The successful actual heap instance now holds its implicit type root. */
    Py_DECREF(type_guard);
    type_guard = NULL;
    return (PyObject *)self; /* untracked INIT, not installable or callable */
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    partial = (PyObject *)self;
    self = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&partial, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&error_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static int
reno_proxy_role(void *closure, unsigned char *role)
{
    unsigned int index;

    for (index = 0; index < 3; ++index) {
        if (closure == (void *)&reno_proxy_roles[index]) {
            *role = reno_proxy_roles[index];
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0; /* never dereference an unknown closure */
}

static int
reno_proxy_binding_fresh(RenoProxyObject *self, PyObject *actual_module,
    RenoState *actual_state)
{
