    /* Legal original receiver/module roots, continuous actual State capacity
     * and matching full internal ABI precede these raw current comparisons.
     * State's four owning roles come only from the real constructor commit.
     * This authenticates owner/type binding, NOT business callee metadata.
     */
    if (actual_module == NULL || !PyModule_CheckExact(actual_module)
            || actual_state == NULL || self->module_lifetime != actual_module
            || self->origin_state != actual_state
            || _PyModule_GetDef(actual_module) != &owner_factory_definition
            || (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(actual_module) != actual_state) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (actual_state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || actual_state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || actual_state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || !actual_state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete
            || actual_state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || actual_state->controls.published_arena != &actual_state->arena
            || self->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
            || actual_state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)self
            || actual_state->arena.install.proxy_type != (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self)
            || actual_state->arena.install.bound_type == NULL
            || actual_state->arena.install.record_type == NULL
            || actual_state->arena.install.find_spec == NULL
            || actual_state->arena.install.invalidate_caches == NULL
            || actual_state->arena.install.find_distributions == NULL
            || !actual_state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured
            || actual_state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall == NULL) { return 0; }
    return reno_proxy_type_effect(actual_state->arena.install.proxy_type)
        && reno_proxy_bound_type_effect(actual_state->arena.install.bound_type)
        && reno_record_type_effect(actual_state->arena.install.record_type);
}

static PyObject *
reno_proxy_getter(RenoProxyObject *self, void *closure)
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *prepared = NULL;
    PyObject *result = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_module = NULL; /* rooted borrow from continuous receiver */
    PyObject *bound_type = NULL; /* raw span only, then prepare owns its guard */
    RenoState *state = NULL;
    unsigned char role = 0;
    unsigned int entered = 0;
    int fresh = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (Py_EnterRecursiveCall(" while binding a reno finder operation") != 0) {
        return NULL;
    }
    entered = 1;
    if (!reno_proxy_role(closure, &role)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid native finder binding role");
        goto failed;
    }
    if (self->module_lifetime == NULL || self->retired_error_class == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder lifetime unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(self->module_lifetime);
    if (self->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE) {
        PyErr_SetString(self->retired_error_class, "native finder is not active");
        goto failed;
    }
    state = (RenoState *)PyModule_GetState(module_guard);
    /* Four combinations: actual error wins even when pointer is nonNULL. */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (state == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(self->retired_error_class, "native finder state unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    fresh = reno_proxy_binding_fresh(self, module_guard, state);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!fresh) {
        PyErr_SetString(self->retired_error_class, "native finder binding source changed");
        goto failed;
    }
    bound_type = state->arena.install.bound_type;
    /* No callback before the real prepare obtains owner/type guards. */
    prepared = reno_proxy_bound_prepare(bound_type, (PyObject *)self, role);
    bound_type = NULL;
    if (prepared == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    /* Nonlast: the actual descriptor caller still holds receiver, whose
     * immutable module_lifetime edge remains independent of this guard.
     */
    Py_DECREF(module_guard);
    module_guard = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    actual_module = self->module_lifetime;
    fresh = reno_proxy_binding_fresh(self, actual_module, state);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!fresh || (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(prepared) != state->arena.install.bound_type) {
        PyErr_SetString(self->retired_error_class, "native finder retired during binding");
        goto failed;
    }
    result = reno_proxy_bound_publish(&prepared);
    if (result == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    Py_LeaveRecursiveCall();
    entered = 0;
    return result; /* actual publish NEW; all extra owning locals are empty */
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&prepared, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (entered) {
        Py_LeaveRecursiveCall();
        entered = 0;
    }
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

/* Known94 Product lifecycle. Only new_type has an actual caller this batch.
 * prepare/leave are private future seed-producer operations, STILL UNCALLED.
 * No RHS capture, current-cell pin, ordinary lease entry, READY or publish.
 */
typedef char RenoCatalogProductSizeFits[
    (sizeof(RenoCatalogProductObject) <= INT_MAX) ? 1 : -1];

static PyObject **
reno_catalog_product_slot(RenoCatalogProductObject *self, unsigned int id)
{
    unsigned int row;

    if (id < 26) { return &self->bank.cells[id]; }
    if (id < 52) { return &self->bank.capture_expected[id - 26]; }
    switch (id) {
    case 52: return &self->module_lifetime;
    case 53: return &self->source_A;
    case 54: return &self->source_D;
    case 55: return &self->template_K;
    case 56: return &self->source_G;
    default: break;
    }
    if (id < 87) {
        row = (id - 57) / 5;
        switch ((id - 57) % 5) {
        case 0: return &self->tools[row].function;
        case 1: return &self->tools[row].code;
        case 2: return &self->tools[row].builtins;
        case 3: return &self->tools[row].closure;
        case 4: return &self->tools[row].kwdefaults;
        }
    }
    if (id >= 87 && id < 93) { return &self->make_view_defaults[id - 87]; }
    if (id == 93) { return &self->tools_tuple; }
    return NULL;
}

static void
reno_catalog_product_initialize(RenoCatalogProductObject *self)
{
    unsigned int index;

    for (index = 0; index < 94; ++index) {
        *reno_catalog_product_slot(self, index) = NULL;
        self->owned[index] = 0;
        self->order[index] = 0;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 26; ++index) {
        self->bank.compiler_cellvar_index[index] = 0;
        self->bank.capture_valid[index] = 0;
        self->bank.store_performed[index] = 0;
    }
    self->bank.mapping_ready = 0;
    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        self->tools[index].defaults_ready = 0;
        self->tools[index].defaults_present = 0;
        self->tools[index].closure_ready = 0;
        self->tools[index].closure_present = 0;
        self->tools[index].kw_ready = 0;
        self->tools[index].kw_present = 0;
        self->tools[index].b_witness_ready = 0;
        self->tools[index].metadata_ready = 0;
    }
    self->seq_count = 0;
    self->active_count = 0;
    self->phase = RENO_CATALOG_PRODUCT_INIT;
    self->payload_owner = RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_PRODUCT;
    self->bank_phase = RENO_CATALOG_BANK_INIT;
}

static void
reno_catalog_product_drain(RenoCatalogProductObject *self,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    size_t cursor;
    unsigned int id;
    PyObject **slot;
    PyObject *detached = NULL;

    /* Actual initialized ledger prefix and continuous Product guard/legal
     * lifecycle caller precede this body, not a sampled refcount or flag.
     * LOCAL_DRAIN cannot be stolen or restart a second cursor on reentry.
     */
    if (self->payload_owner != RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_PRODUCT
            || self->phase != RENO_CATALOG_PRODUCT_RETIRING
            || self->active_count != 0) { return; }
    self->payload_owner = RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_LOCAL_DRAIN;
    cursor = self->seq_count;
    while (cursor != 0) {
        id = self->order[--cursor];
        if (id == 52 || !self->owned[id]) { continue; }
        slot = reno_catalog_product_slot(self, id);
        detached = *slot;
        *slot = NULL;
        self->owned[id] = 0;
        slot = NULL;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    }
    self->payload_owner = RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_CLEARED;
    self->phase = RENO_CATALOG_PRODUCT_CLEARED;
    self->bank_phase = RENO_CATALOG_BANK_CLEARED;
}

static void
reno_catalog_product_request_retirement(RenoCatalogProductObject *self,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    if (self->payload_owner == RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_CLEARED
            || self->phase == RENO_CATALOG_PRODUCT_CLEARED
            || self->payload_owner == RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_LOCAL_DRAIN) { return; }
    self->phase = RENO_CATALOG_PRODUCT_RETIRING;
    self->bank_phase = RENO_CATALOG_BANK_RETIRING;
    reno_catalog_product_drain(self, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
}

static void
reno_catalog_product_leave(RenoCatalogProductObject *self,
    unsigned int *constructor_entered, PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    /* STILL UNCALLED private operation. The future actual caller holds the
     * same Product guard and its actual prepare success fact, so entered==1
     * implies this scope's still-counted lease and active_count>0. It holds
     * result/first separately and has cleared other operands/temps. The last
     * Product guard is released AFTER this body; first is restored last.
     */
    if (!*constructor_entered) { return; }
    *constructor_entered = 0;
    --self->active_count;
    reno_catalog_product_drain(self, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
}

static int
reno_catalog_product_traverse(RenoCatalogProductObject *self,
    visitproc visit, void *arg)
{
    unsigned int id;

    if (self->payload_owner == RENO_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_PRODUCT) {
        for (id = 0; id < 94; ++id) {
            if (self->owned[id]) { Py_VISIT(*reno_catalog_product_slot(self, id)); }
        }
    } else if (self->owned[52]) {
        Py_VISIT(self->module_lifetime);
    }
    Py_VISIT(Py_TYPE(self));
    return 0;
}

static int
reno_catalog_product_gc_clear(RenoCatalogProductObject *self)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* The legal GC/direct caller retains receiver. A live constructor guard
     * plus lease defers payload only, never module/State physical lifetime.
     */
    reno_catalog_product_request_retirement(self, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        out = first;
        first = NULL;
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return cleanup_failed ? -1 : 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void
reno_catalog_product_dealloc(RenoCatalogProductObject *self)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    const unsigned int had_entry_first = (first != NULL);
    PyObject *type_owned = (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self);
    PyObject *module_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Legal refcount-zero entry has no outstanding actual Product guard,
     * counted lease or LOCAL_DRAIN scope. Full future caller proof remains
     * open; do not reset active_count or INCREF zero-self to invent it.
     * This path also accepts initialized untracked partials with count zero.
     */
    PyObject_GC_UnTrack(self);
    reno_catalog_product_request_retirement(self, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    module_owned = self->module_lifetime;
    self->module_lifetime = NULL;
    self->owned[52] = 0;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyObject_GC_Del(self);
    /* No self/module/State access after free. Implicit heap type moves to
     * this original local responsibility; it is not an extra zero-entry root.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    out = first;
    first = NULL;
    if (had_entry_first) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return;
    }
    if (out != NULL) { PyErr_SetRaisedException(out); }
    PyErr_Clear();
}

static PyType_Slot reno_catalog_product_slots[] = {
    {Py_tp_dealloc, (void *)reno_catalog_product_dealloc},
    {Py_tp_traverse, (void *)reno_catalog_product_traverse},
    {Py_tp_clear, (void *)reno_catalog_product_gc_clear},
    {Py_tp_free, (void *)PyObject_GC_Del},
    {0, NULL}
};
static PyType_Spec reno_catalog_product_spec = {
    "_reno_handle_owner312._CatalogProduct",
    sizeof(RenoCatalogProductObject),
    0,
    Py_TPFLAGS_DEFAULT | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE
        | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION,
    reno_catalog_product_slots
};

static int
reno_catalog_product_type_effect(PyObject *actual_type)
{
    PyTypeObject *type;
    unsigned long required = Py_TPFLAGS_HEAPTYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC
        | Py_TPFLAGS_IMMUTABLETYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_DISALLOW_INSTANTIATION;

    if (actual_type == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_type, &PyType_Type)) { return 0; }
    type = (PyTypeObject *)actual_type;
    return type->tp_basicsize == (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(RenoCatalogProductObject)
        && type->tp_itemsize == 0 && type->tp_base == &PyBaseObject_Type
        && (type->tp_flags & required) == required
        && (type->tp_flags & (Py_TPFLAGS_BASETYPE | Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_VECTORCALL)) == 0
        && type->tp_dictoffset == 0 && type->tp_weaklistoffset == 0
        && type->tp_new == NULL && type->tp_call == NULL
        && type->tp_vectorcall_offset == 0
        && type->tp_dealloc == (destructor)reno_catalog_product_dealloc
        && type->tp_traverse == (traverseproc)reno_catalog_product_traverse
        && type->tp_clear == (inquiry)reno_catalog_product_gc_clear
        && type->tp_free == PyObject_GC_Del;
}

static PyObject *
reno_catalog_product_new_type(PyObject *actual_module)
{
    PyObject *type = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Real install preparer supplies continuous original module guard. */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    type = PyType_FromModuleAndSpec(actual_module, &reno_catalog_product_spec, NULL);
    if (type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_catalog_product_type_effect(type)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native catalog product type mismatch");
        goto failed;
    }
    return type;
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_catalog_product_prepare(const RenoCatalogProductInputs *inputs,
    unsigned int *constructor_entered)
{
    PyObject *guards[6] = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *partial = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoCatalogProductObject *self = NULL;
    unsigned int index;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* STILL UNCALLED. Actual future seed owns all six original operands and
     * this private empty output. Consistency is not A/D/K/G provenance. No
     * inputs read follows the first callback. Captures/missing stay untouched.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (inputs == NULL || constructor_entered == NULL || *constructor_entered
            || inputs->actual_type == NULL || inputs->actual_module == NULL
            || inputs->source_A == NULL || inputs->source_D == NULL
            || inputs->template_K == NULL || inputs->source_G == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, "invalid private catalog product inputs");
        return NULL;
    }
    guards[0] = Py_NewRef(inputs->actual_module);
    guards[1] = Py_NewRef(inputs->source_A);
    guards[2] = Py_NewRef(inputs->source_D);
    guards[3] = Py_NewRef(inputs->template_K);
    guards[4] = Py_NewRef(inputs->source_G);
    guards[5] = Py_NewRef(inputs->actual_type);
    if (!reno_catalog_product_type_effect(guards[5])) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native catalog product type unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    self = PyObject_GC_New(RenoCatalogProductObject, (PyTypeObject *)guards[5]);
    if (self == NULL) { goto failed; }
    reno_catalog_product_initialize(self);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        *reno_catalog_product_slot(self, 52 + index) = guards[index];
        guards[index] = NULL;
        self->owned[52 + index] = 1;
        self->order[self->seq_count++] = (unsigned char)(52 + index);
    }
    /* Actual heap instance's independent implicit type root makes this one
     * guard nonlast. No other guard/temp remains before opening the lease.
     */
    Py_DECREF(guards[5]);
    guards[5] = NULL;
    self->phase = RENO_CATALOG_PRODUCT_BUILDING;
    self->bank_phase = RENO_CATALOG_BANK_BUILDING;
    self->active_count = 1;
    *constructor_entered = 1;
    return (PyObject *)self; /* untracked owned partial, never READY/published */
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    partial = (PyObject *)self;
    self = NULL;
    /* An allocated partial has complete typed Init and no entered lease. */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&partial, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    for (index = 6; index != 0; ) {
        --index;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&guards[index], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static int
reno_install_building_fresh(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered)
{
    /* Continuous actual allocation/module/lease roots precede all payload
     * reads; current pointer/flags alone are not allocation/source proof.
     */
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && PyModule_CheckExact(module)
        && _PyModule_GetDef(module) == &owner_factory_definition
        && (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(module) == state
        && state->bootstrap_marker == RENO_BOOT_TYPED
        && *bootstrap_entered && state->controls.meta_active_count > 0
        && state->controls.phase == RENO_MODULE_PREPARING
        && state->controls.install_phase == RENO_INSTALL_BUILDING
        && state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete
        && state->controls.arena_owner == RENO_ARENA_STATE
        && state->controls.published_arena == &state->arena
        && state->arena.install.bound_type == NULL
        && state->arena.install.record_type == NULL
        && state->arena.install.proxy_type == NULL
        && state->arena.install.catalog_product_type == NULL
        && state->arena.install.proxy == NULL
        && state->arena.install.find_spec == NULL
        && state->arena.install.invalidate_caches == NULL
        && state->arena.install.find_distributions == NULL
        && state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall == NULL
        && !state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured
        && reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state);
}

/* Prepare original finder callees only. No descriptor getter or function body
 * is executed here: use the selected original branch's real C producers.
 * Source provenance is T0 private ownership plus this actual creation chain.
 */
static int
reno_finder_descriptor_matches(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    PyObject *original_function)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new;
    int matches;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || descriptor == NULL || original_function == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, builtin_type)) { return 0; }
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members;
            member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, "__func__") == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT
                    || member->flags != READONLY) { return 0; }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) { return 0; }
    /* Original exact builtin T_OBJECT branch, held descriptor and matching
     * full/nondebug reference envelope: no arbitrary getter or allocation.
     */
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new == NULL) { return 0; }
    matches = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && actual_new == original_function;
    /* Nonlast even on mismatch: the actual payload has its descriptor root
     * in this uninterrupted raw span; NULL->None uses the selected envelope.
     */
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return matches;
}

static int
reno_finder_sources_match(RenoState *state, PyObject *original_class,
    PyObject *original_dict, PyObject *const original_descriptors[3],
    PyObject *const original_functions[3])
{
    static const unsigned int function_slots[3] = {30, 39, 48};
    static const char *names[3] = {"find_spec", "invalidate_caches", "find_distributions"};
    static const Py_ssize_t lengths[3] = {9, 17, 18};
    unsigned char found[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    unsigned int role;

    /* Original State allocation/arena and historical T0 source roots precede
     * these consistency reads. This is binding provenance, not metadata/D1.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || original_class == NULL || original_dict == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || !PyDict_CheckExact(original_dict)
            || !state->arena.known.owned[6] || !state->arena.known.owned[7]
            || state->arena.known.roots[6] != original_class
            || state->arena.known.roots[7] != original_dict
            || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)original_class) != original_dict) { return 0; }
    for (role = 0; role < 3; ++role) {
        if (original_descriptors[role] == NULL || original_functions[role] == NULL
                || !state->arena.known.owned[8 + role]
                || !state->arena.known.owned[function_slots[role]]
                || state->arena.known.roots[8 + role] != original_descriptors[role]
                || state->arena.known.roots[function_slots[role]] != original_functions[role]
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(original_functions[role], &PyFunction_Type)
                || !reno_finder_descriptor_matches(original_descriptors[role],
                    role == 0 ? &PyClassMethod_Type : &PyStaticMethod_Type,
                    original_functions[role])) { return 0; }
    }
    while (PyDict_Next(original_dict, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key)) { return 0; }
        for (role = 0; role < 3; ++role) {
            if (exact_ascii_name(key, names[role], lengths[role])) {
                if (found[role] || value != original_descriptors[role]) { return 0; }
                found[role] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return found[0] && found[1] && found[2];
}

static int
reno_finder_products_match(RenoState *state, PyObject *find_spec,
    PyObject *invalidate_caches, PyObject *find_distributions,
    vectorcallfunc actual_constructor_dispatch)
{
    PyObject *original_descriptors[3];
    PyObject *original_functions[3];
    unsigned int role;

    /* Only the fixed private historical T0 slots provide expected. These
     * fields are not current Python attribute snapshots or first-use pins.
     */
    for (role = 0; role < 3; ++role) {
        original_descriptors[role] = state->arena.known.roots[8 + role];
        original_functions[role] = state->arena.known.roots[30 + 9 * role];
    }
    return reno_finder_sources_match(state, state->arena.known.roots[6],
            state->arena.known.roots[7], original_descriptors, original_functions)
        && find_spec != NULL && Py_IS_TYPE(find_spec, &PyMethod_Type)
        && PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(find_spec) == original_functions[0]
        && PyMethod_GET_SELF(find_spec) == state->arena.known.roots[6]
        && actual_constructor_dispatch != NULL
        && ((PyMethodObject *)find_spec)->vectorcall == actual_constructor_dispatch
        && invalidate_caches == original_functions[1]
        && find_distributions == original_functions[2];
}

static int
reno_h01_prepare_finder_callees(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, PyObject **find_spec_out,
    PyObject **invalidate_caches_out, PyObject **find_distributions_out,
    vectorcallfunc *method_dispatch_out)
{
    PyObject *original_class = NULL;
    PyObject *original_dict = NULL;
    PyObject *original_descriptors[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *original_functions[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *dict_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *descriptor_guards[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *function_guards[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *callees[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc method_dispatch = NULL;
    unsigned int claimed = 0;
    int role;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (module == NULL || state == NULL || bootstrap_entered == NULL || find_spec_out == NULL
            || invalidate_caches_out == NULL || find_distributions_out == NULL
            || method_dispatch_out == NULL || *find_spec_out != NULL
            || *invalidate_caches_out != NULL || *find_distributions_out != NULL
            || *method_dispatch_out != NULL
            || !reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) {
        goto rejected; /* no claim or owned inputs; never retire another build */
    }
    claimed = 1; /* actual private caller's own already-claimed BUILDING */
    original_class = state->arena.known.roots[6];
    original_dict = state->arena.known.roots[7];
    for (role = 0; role < 3; ++role) {
        original_descriptors[role] = state->arena.known.roots[8 + role];
        original_functions[role] = state->arena.known.roots[30 + 9 * role];
    }
    if (!reno_finder_sources_match(state, original_class, original_dict,
            original_descriptors, original_functions)) { goto rejected; }
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(original_class);
    dict_guard = Py_NewRef(original_dict);
    for (role = 0; role < 3; ++role) {
        descriptor_guards[role] = Py_NewRef(original_descriptors[role]);
        function_guards[role] = Py_NewRef(original_functions[role]);
    }
    /* Function/class guards are already real roots before GC_New inside the
     * original Method_New, whose own func/self roots do not exist yet.
     */
    callees[0] = PyMethod_New(function_guards[0], class_guard);
    if (callees[0] == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(callees[0], &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(callees[0]) != function_guards[0]
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(callees[0]) != class_guard) { goto rejected; }
    /* First post-constructor raw observation, before a subsequent callout.
     * This fact comes from that actual native constructor NEW; it is not
     * registration of an arbitrary subject or an invented exported standard.
     */
    method_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)callees[0])->vectorcall;
    if (method_dispatch == NULL) { goto rejected; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)
            || !reno_finder_sources_match(state, original_class, original_dict,
                original_descriptors, original_functions)) { goto rejected; }
    /* Exact staticmethod selected success branch's own actual NEW producers;
     * not a call to sm_descr_get and not a new bound method or body execution.
     */
    callees[1] = Py_NewRef(function_guards[1]);
    callees[2] = Py_NewRef(function_guards[2]);
    if (!reno_finder_products_match(state, callees[0], callees[1], callees[2],
            method_dispatch)) { goto rejected; }
    /* State's eight independently owned historical roots were just matched.
     * In the selected no-callback/full-reference envelope every release below
     * is nonlast. Original borrowed pointers remain covered by State through
     * final fresh and output move, without reading these cleared guard slots.
     */
    for (role = 2; role >= 0; --role) {
        Py_DECREF(function_guards[role]);
        function_guards[role] = NULL;
        Py_DECREF(descriptor_guards[role]);
        descriptor_guards[role] = NULL;
    }
    Py_DECREF(dict_guard);
    dict_guard = NULL;
    Py_DECREF(class_guard);
    class_guard = NULL;
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)
            || !reno_finder_sources_match(state, original_class, original_dict,
                original_descriptors, original_functions)
            || !reno_finder_products_match(state, callees[0], callees[1], callees[2],
                method_dispatch)) { goto rejected; }
    *find_spec_out = callees[0];
    callees[0] = NULL;
    *invalidate_caches_out = callees[1];
    callees[1] = NULL;
    *find_distributions_out = callees[2];
    callees[2] = NULL;
    *method_dispatch_out = method_dispatch;
    method_dispatch = NULL;
    return 0;
rejected:
    if (claimed) { reno_common_request_retirement(state); }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder callee preparation unavailable");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    if (claimed) { reno_common_request_retirement(state); }
    for (role = 2; role >= 0; --role) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&callees[role], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    for (role = 2; role >= 0; --role) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&function_guards[role], &first, &cleanup_failed);
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&descriptor_guards[role], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dict_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return -1;
}


static int
reno_h01_prepare_install_objects(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, const RenoProxyBindingOps *binding_ops,
    const RenoLoaderRecordOps *record_ops)
{
    PyObject *bound_type = NULL;
    PyObject *record_type = NULL;
    PyObject *proxy_type = NULL;
    PyObject *catalog_product_type = NULL;
    PyObject *proxy = NULL;
    PyObject *find_spec = NULL;
    PyObject *invalidate_caches = NULL;
    PyObject *find_distributions = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc method_dispatch = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *error_class = NULL; /* raw borrow, prepare acquires before callback */
    RenoProxyObject *actual_proxy = NULL;
    unsigned int claimed = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Actual owner_factory_exec supplies its original continuous module guard,
     * live State and own bootstrap lease. The real same-TU static tables are
     * transported by that C caller; equality below is consistency only.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (binding_ops != &reno_proxy_binding_ops || record_ops != &reno_loader_record_ops
            || module == NULL || !PyModule_CheckExact(module)
            || state == NULL || bootstrap_entered == NULL
            || _PyModule_GetDef(module) != &owner_factory_definition
            || (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(module) != state
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_EMPTY) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder preparation unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_BUILDING;
    claimed = 1;
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) {
        goto rejected;
    }
    bound_type = binding_ops->new_type(module);
    if (bound_type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) { goto rejected; }
    record_type = record_ops->new_type(module);
    if (record_type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) { goto rejected; }
    proxy_type = reno_proxy_new_type(module);
    if (proxy_type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) { goto rejected; }
    catalog_product_type = reno_catalog_product_new_type(module);
    if (catalog_product_type == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) { goto rejected; }
    if (!state->arena.known.owned[97] || state->arena.known.roots[97] == NULL) {
        goto rejected;
    }
    error_class = state->arena.known.roots[97];
    proxy = reno_proxy_prepare(proxy_type, module, error_class, state);
    error_class = NULL;
    if (proxy == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) { goto rejected; }
    actual_proxy = (RenoProxyObject *)proxy;
    if (reno_h01_prepare_finder_callees(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
            &find_spec, &invalidate_caches, &find_distributions, &method_dispatch) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_install_building_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered)) { goto rejected; }
    if (!reno_proxy_bound_type_effect(bound_type) || !reno_record_type_effect(record_type)
            || !reno_proxy_type_effect(proxy_type)
            || !reno_catalog_product_type_effect(catalog_product_type)
            || (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(actual_proxy) != proxy_type
            || actual_proxy->module_lifetime != module || actual_proxy->origin_state != state
            || actual_proxy->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || !state->arena.known.owned[97] || actual_proxy->phase != RENO_PROXY_INIT
            || !reno_finder_products_match(state, find_spec, invalidate_caches,
                find_distributions, method_dispatch)) {
        goto rejected;
    }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    /* Last callback is over. Move each actual constructor NEW exactly once;
     * no current attribute is used to invent an expected type or owner.
     */
    state->arena.install.bound_type = bound_type;
    bound_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.record_type = record_type;
    record_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.proxy_type = proxy_type;
    proxy_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.catalog_product_type = catalog_product_type;
    catalog_product_type = NULL;
    state->arena.install.proxy = proxy;
    proxy = NULL;
    state->arena.install.find_spec = find_spec;
    find_spec = NULL;
    state->arena.install.invalidate_caches = invalidate_caches;
    invalidate_caches = NULL;
    state->arena.install.find_distributions = find_distributions;
    find_distributions = NULL;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall = method_dispatch;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured = 1;
    method_dispatch = NULL;
    actual_proxy->phase = RENO_PROXY_PREPARED;
    state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_PREPARED;
    PyObject_GC_Track(actual_proxy);
    return 0;
rejected:
    if (claimed) { reno_common_request_retirement(state); }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder preparation retired or changed");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    if (claimed) { reno_common_request_retirement(state); }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&find_distributions, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&invalidate_caches, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&find_spec, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&proxy, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&catalog_product_type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&proxy_type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&bound_type, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return -1;
}


/* All actual metadata call-local debts must be closed before last leave;
 * the actual Record drainer must also have ended. The original module root
 * or legal lifecycle caller covers EVERY last State access in this function.
 * These two guards are obligations, not facts inferred from counter values.
 */
static void
reno_common_try_retired_arena(RenoState *state,
    PyObject **first_slot, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    RenoRootArena *arena;
    PyObject *factory = NULL;
    PyObject *kernel = NULL;
    PyObject *detached = NULL;
    PyObject *class_witness = NULL;
    PyObject *bound_type = NULL;
    PyObject *record_type = NULL;
    PyObject *proxy_type = NULL;
    PyObject *catalog_product_type = NULL;
    PyObject *proxy = NULL;
    PyObject *find_spec = NULL;
    PyObject *invalidate_caches = NULL;
    PyObject *find_distributions = NULL;
    PyObject *finder_before = NULL;
    PyObject *finder_after = NULL;
    RenoSpecSourceOwned spec_detached = {0};

    reno_h01_restore_finder_slot_raw(state);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    if ((state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRED)
            || state->controls.meta_active_count != 0
            || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_head != NULL
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE) {
        return;
    }
    arena = &state->arena;
    state->controls.published_arena = NULL;
    state->controls.arena_owner = RENO_ARENA_LOCAL_DRAIN;
    state->controls.class_source_witness_ready = 0;
    class_witness = arena->class_source_witness;
    arena->class_source_witness = NULL; /* raw detach BEFORE any release helper */
    /* No callback between the raw eligibility reads and this unique move.
     * RETIRED by itself never proved roots already clear; a still-STATE arena
     * may also settle here without moving the business phase backwards.
     * Legacy's active old calls hold their own roots and reject retired fresh;
     * retired Records retain their own error/module lifetime. The future
     * actual consumers/types must satisfy those selected contracts as well.
     */
    reno_common_take_install_roots(arena, &bound_type, &record_type,
                                   &proxy_type, &catalog_product_type, &proxy, &find_spec,
                                   &invalidate_caches, &find_distributions,
                                   &finder_before, &finder_after);
    reno_common_take_legacy_roots(arena, &factory, &kernel);
    reno_common_take_spec_source(arena, &spec_detached);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&finder_after, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&finder_before, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_witness, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&find_distributions, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&invalidate_caches, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&find_spec, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&proxy, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&catalog_product_type, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&proxy_type, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_type, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&bound_type, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&kernel, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&factory, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.prepared_loader_key, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_spec_mro_region_drain(&spec_detached.region, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.mro, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.dictionary, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.klass, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    while (arena->known.order_count != 0) {
        detached = reno_common_take_last_known(arena);
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    }
    state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_RETIRED;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall = NULL;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured = 0;
    state->controls.arena_owner = RENO_ARENA_CLEARED;
    state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_RETIRED;
}

static int
reno_h01_clear_common_state(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    PyObject **first_owned)
{
    unsigned char marker;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *record_guard = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* module is a borrowed actual root held by this caller/lifecycle span,
     * never a source chosen from a current alias. No extra acquire here.
     */
    (void)module;
    reno_common_request_retirement(state); /* CLEAR before first possible callback */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    if (state == NULL) {
        return cleanup_failed ? -1 : 0;
    }
    marker = *(const unsigned char *)state;
    if (marker == RENO_BOOT_RAW_RETIRED) {
        return cleanup_failed ? -1 : 0;
    }
    if (marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED) {
        /* No typed payload access or unknown->fresh repair. This conditional
         * failure is not proof of the full unknown/corruption/NULL N4 domain.
         */
        if (*first_owned == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        return -1;
    }
    if (state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE) {
        return cleanup_failed ? -1 : 0;
    }
    state->controls.record_draining = 1;
    while (state->controls.record_head != NULL) {
        record = state->controls.record_head;
        record_guard = Py_NewRef((PyObject *)record);
        /* Registry invariant, not a type/refcount/current-address check,
         * justifies acquiring this actually live Record. Immediately cancel/
         * unlink/detach before ANY callback; no naked next is saved.
         */
        reno_record_clear_sources(record, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
        record = NULL;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_guard, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    state->controls.record_draining = 0;
    /* Required even if count was already zero and no future leave will run. */
    reno_common_try_retired_arena(state, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    return cleanup_failed ? -1 : 0;
}

/* Actual conditional typed final drain, distinct from a deferrable m_clear.
 * Legal module_dealloc/GIL/allocation/source and complete no-reader/registry/
 * ledger premises are independent obligations, not inferred from marker,
 * phase, count or current pointer. No other private drainer may own this arena.
 * Caller has already sampled entry first and the actual TYPED char with no
 * callback gap; the raised indicator is empty. No new module root at m_free.
 */
static void
reno_h01_finish_free(PyObject *module, RenoState *state, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoRootArena *arena = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record = NULL;
    PyObject *record_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *factory = NULL;
    PyObject *kernel = NULL;
    PyObject *detached = NULL;
    PyObject *class_witness = NULL;
    PyObject *bound_type = NULL;
    PyObject *record_type = NULL;
    PyObject *proxy_type = NULL;
    PyObject *catalog_product_type = NULL;
    PyObject *proxy = NULL;
    PyObject *find_spec = NULL;
    PyObject *invalidate_caches = NULL;
    PyObject *find_distributions = NULL;
    PyObject *finder_before = NULL;
    PyObject *finder_after = NULL;
    RenoSpecSourceOwned spec_detached = {0};
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    (void)module; /* physical lifetime is the original synchronous dealloc span */
    reno_common_request_retirement(state); /* CLEAR before any release callback */
    reno_h01_restore_finder_slot_raw(state);
    if (state->controls.arena_owner == RENO_ARENA_CLEARED) {
        /* Complete terminal invariant: no State-owned roots/Record/reader or
         * private workspace debts. Enum equality alone is not that proof.
         */
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
        return;
    }
    /* Remaining legal entry is STATE, with no active metadata or drainer.
     * Do not steal LOCAL_DRAIN, reset debts or add a busy/defer success path;
     * actual caller/producer proofs must exclude such an invalid entry.
     */
    state->controls.record_draining = 1;
    while (state->controls.record_head != NULL) {
        record = state->controls.record_head;
        record_guard = Py_NewRef((PyObject *)record);
        /* Actual live head/guard, then cancel/unlink/detach before callback.
         * Retired producers cannot re-link or republish; no naked next kept.
         */
        reno_record_clear_sources(record, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
        record = NULL;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_guard, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    state->controls.record_draining = 0; /* end only this body's own interval */
    /* No callback between ending that interval and the unique arena move. */
    arena = &state->arena;
    state->controls.published_arena = NULL;
    state->controls.arena_owner = RENO_ARENA_LOCAL_DRAIN;
    state->controls.class_source_witness_ready = 0;
    class_witness = arena->class_source_witness;
    arena->class_source_witness = NULL; /* raw detach BEFORE any release helper */
    reno_common_take_install_roots(arena, &bound_type, &record_type,
                                   &proxy_type, &catalog_product_type, &proxy, &find_spec,
                                   &invalidate_caches, &find_distributions,
                                   &finder_before, &finder_after);
    reno_common_take_legacy_roots(arena, &factory, &kernel);
    reno_common_take_spec_source(arena, &spec_detached);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&finder_after, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&finder_before, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_witness, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&find_distributions, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&invalidate_caches, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&find_spec, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&proxy, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&catalog_product_type, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&proxy_type, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_type, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&bound_type, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&kernel, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&factory, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.prepared_loader_key, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_spec_mro_region_drain(&spec_detached.region, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.mro, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.dictionary, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&spec_detached.klass, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    while (arena->known.order_count != 0) {
        detached = reno_common_take_last_known(arena);
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_RETIRED;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall = NULL;
    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured = 0;
    state->controls.arena_owner = RENO_ARENA_CLEARED;
    state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_RETIRED;
    /* All local owning temps are empty. TYPED stays unchanged; the final
     * possible callback sees retired, consistent ownership. No State access
     * or resource operation follows this final indicator settlement.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    return;
}

static void
reno_common_metadata_leave(RenoState *state, unsigned int *entered,
    PyObject **first_slot, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    if (!*entered) {
        return;
    }
    /* Actual enter established count>=1 and this one private debt. Neither
     * retirement nor a new accessor/current State can cancel/redirect it.
     * All callee-local and parent temporary debts are already closed.
     */
    *entered = 0;
    --state->controls.meta_active_count;
    reno_common_try_retired_arena(state, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
}

static void
reno_h01_abandon_bootstrap(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, PyObject **factory_owned,
    PyObject **kernel_owned, PyObject *first_borrowed)
{
    PyObject *first_slot = first_borrowed; /* rooted borrow, not another owner */
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Parent already owns a non-NULL actual first throughout this call.
     * Consume only these two actual parent owning slots, before last leave.
     * Callee-owned capture/prepare scratch must already be closed or explicitly
     * transported by its real producer; their absent bodies remain debts.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(kernel_owned, &first_slot, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(factory_owned, &first_slot, &cleanup_failed);
    (void)reno_h01_clear_common_state(module, state, &first_slot);
    reno_common_metadata_leave(state, bootstrap_entered, &first_slot, &cleanup_failed);
    /* Later cleanup E2 cannot replace first_borrowed. Indicator is empty;
     * parent still owns/finishes actual first after its module_guard release.
     */
}

/* Private automatic roots only. 28/29 remain representation destinations;
 * they must not first hold raw payloads and then be acquired a second time.
 * No field is added to State, no recent result or published baseline exists.
 */
typedef struct RenoT0LocalRoots {
    PyObject *pathfinder_mro;
    PyObject *builtin_self;
    PyObject *builtin_module;
} RenoT0LocalRoots;

/* Actual C declarations from the selected r1154 schema, in its exact
 * field order. These are workspace records, not module State fields.
 * Owning payloads require typed NULL after real allocation; the layout
 * helper does not allocate, initialize objects or authorize raw capture. */
typedef struct RenoWorkspaceHeader {
    size_t requested_bytes;
    size_t C;
    size_t B;
    size_t E;
    size_t D;
    size_t F;
    size_t K;
    size_t Z;
    size_t P;
    size_t R;
    size_t dispatch_offset;
    size_t kw_offset;
    size_t cell_offset;
    size_t entry_offset;
    size_t base_offset;
    size_t class_offset;
    size_t ledger_offset;
    size_t ledger_count;
    size_t ledger_capacity;
    unsigned char capture_failed;
    unsigned char representation_started;
    unsigned char workspace_phase;
} RenoWorkspaceHeader;

typedef struct RenoLedgerEntry {
    PyObject ** slot_address;
} RenoLedgerEntry;

typedef struct RenoNamedRanges {
    size_t kw_start;
    size_t kw_count;
    size_t cell_start;
    size_t cell_count;
    unsigned char function_role;
} RenoNamedRanges;

typedef struct RenoClassRootMap {
    PyObject ** class_slot;
    PyObject ** mro_slot;
    unsigned char class_role;
} RenoClassRootMap;


/* Private scalar statuses, never serialized or accepted from Python. */
typedef enum RenoWorkspaceCountStatus {
    RENO_WS_COUNT_OK = 0,
    RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE,
    RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW,
    RENO_WS_COUNT_NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE
} RenoWorkspaceCountStatus;

enum {
    RENO_WS_PHASE_UNCOUNTED = 0,
    RENO_WS_PHASE_COUNTED = 1,
    RENO_WS_PHASE_LAYOUT_READY = 2,
    RENO_WS_PHASE_NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE = 3
};

static int
reno_ws_add(size_t left, size_t right, size_t *result)
{
    if (right > (size_t)-1 - left) {
        return 0;
    }
    *result = left + right;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_multiply(size_t count, size_t unit_size, size_t *result)
{
    if (unit_size == 0 || count > (size_t)-1 / unit_size) {
        return 0;
    }
    *result = count * unit_size;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_align(size_t cursor, size_t alignment, size_t *result)
{
    size_t remainder;
    size_t padding;

    if (alignment == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    remainder = cursor % alignment;
    padding = remainder == 0 ? 0 : alignment - remainder;
    return reno_ws_add(cursor, padding, result);
}

static int
reno_ws_reserve_array(size_t *cursor, size_t count, size_t unit_size,
    size_t alignment, size_t *offset)
{
    size_t aligned;
    size_t bytes;
    size_t end;

    if (!reno_ws_align(*cursor, alignment, &aligned)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(count, unit_size, &bytes)
            || !reno_ws_add(aligned, bytes, &end)) {
        return 0;
    }
    *offset = aligned;
    *cursor = end;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_from_ssize(Py_ssize_t value, size_t *result)
{
    size_t converted;

    if (value < 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    converted = (size_t)value;
    /* For nonnegative value, unsigned conversion cannot increase it; the
     * back-conversion is representable and detects a narrower size_t loss.
     */
    if ((Py_ssize_t)converted != value) {
        return 0;
    }
    *result = converted;
    return 1;
}

/* Current narrow source unit is MSVC-compatible Windows full API. This uses
 * the compiler's real type alignment, not a guessed pointer/page alignment.
 * No numeric sizeof/align measurement or actual provider/base proof yet.
 */
#define RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(TYPE) __alignof(TYPE)
static int
reno_workspace_layout_raw(RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    size_t cursor;
    size_t R = 0;
    size_t term;
    size_t F;

    if (layout->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_COUNTED
            || layout->C != 5 || layout->P > layout->Z
            || !reno_ws_add(6, layout->D, &F)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(layout->D, 10, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(R, term, &R)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(layout->K, 3, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(R, term, &R)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(layout->Z, 3, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(R, term, &R)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(layout->E, 3, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(R, term, &R)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(layout->B, 4, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(R, term, &R)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(layout->C, 3, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(R, term, &R)) {
        return 0;
    }
    cursor = sizeof(RenoWorkspaceHeader);
    if (!reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, layout->D, sizeof(RenoDispatchCapture),
                              RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoDispatchCapture), &layout->dispatch_offset)
            || !reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, layout->K, sizeof(RenoKwCapture),
                                     RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoKwCapture), &layout->kw_offset)
            || !reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, layout->Z, sizeof(RenoCellCapture),
                                     RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoCellCapture), &layout->cell_offset)
            || !reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, layout->E, sizeof(RenoClassEntryCapture),
                                     RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoClassEntryCapture), &layout->entry_offset)
            || !reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, layout->B, sizeof(RenoBaseCapture),
                                     RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoBaseCapture), &layout->base_offset)
            || !reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, layout->C, sizeof(RenoClassCapture),
                                     RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoClassCapture), &layout->class_offset)
            || !reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, R, sizeof(RenoLedgerEntry),
                                     RENO_WS_ALIGNOF(RenoLedgerEntry), &layout->ledger_offset)) {
        return 0;
    }
    layout->F = F;
    layout->R = R;
    layout->ledger_capacity = R;
    layout->ledger_count = 0;
    layout->requested_bytes = cursor;
    layout->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_LAYOUT_READY;
    return 1;
}
#undef RENO_WS_ALIGNOF

typedef struct RenoWorkspaceView {
    RenoWorkspaceHeader *header;
    RenoDispatchCapture *dispatch;
    RenoKwCapture *kw;
    RenoCellCapture *cell;
    RenoClassEntryCapture *entry;
    RenoBaseCapture *base;
    RenoClassCapture *klass;
    RenoLedgerEntry *ledger;
} RenoWorkspaceView;

enum {
    RENO_WS_PHASE_INITIALIZED = 4,
    RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED = 5,
    RENO_WS_PHASE_DRAINING = 6,
    RENO_WS_PHASE_DRAINED = 7
};

typedef enum RenoWorkspaceDomain {
    RENO_WS_DISPATCH = 0, RENO_WS_KW, RENO_WS_CELL,
    RENO_WS_ENTRY, RENO_WS_BASE, RENO_WS_CLASS
} RenoWorkspaceDomain;

/* Canonical private layout from this same complete source/type build, not a
 * region-header read. This check does not certify actual allocation/source.
 */
static int
reno_ws_layout_is_canonical(const RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    RenoWorkspaceHeader expected;

    if (layout->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_LAYOUT_READY
            || layout->capture_failed || layout->representation_started
            || layout->ledger_count != 0 || layout->requested_bytes == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    expected = *layout;
    expected.workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_COUNTED;
    if (!reno_workspace_layout_raw(&expected)) {
        return 0;
    }
    return layout->F == expected.F && layout->R == expected.R
        && layout->ledger_capacity == expected.ledger_capacity
        && layout->requested_bytes == expected.requested_bytes
        && layout->dispatch_offset == expected.dispatch_offset
        && layout->kw_offset == expected.kw_offset
        && layout->cell_offset == expected.cell_offset
        && layout->entry_offset == expected.entry_offset
        && layout->base_offset == expected.base_offset
        && layout->class_offset == expected.class_offset
        && layout->ledger_offset == expected.ledger_offset;
}

static int
reno_ws_array_address(unsigned char *actual_base, size_t actual_bytes,
    size_t offset, size_t count, size_t item_size, size_t alignment,
    void **address)
{
    size_t bytes;
    unsigned char *raw;

    *address = NULL;
    if (!reno_ws_multiply(count, item_size, &bytes)
            || offset > actual_bytes || bytes > actual_bytes - offset
            || alignment == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (count == 0) {
        return 1; /* no NULL arithmetic, typed array or accessible element */
    }
    raw = actual_base + offset;
    /* Data-address alignment only, never function-pointer conversion or an
     * ownership/source certificate. Actual valid allocation is independent.
     */
    if ((uintptr_t)raw % alignment != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    *address = raw;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_workspace_bind_live(RenoWorkspaceView *view, void *actual_base,
    size_t actual_bytes, const RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    unsigned char *raw = (unsigned char *)actual_base;
    void *array_address = NULL;

    /* Caller owns THIS original fresh allocation over the entire use. No
     * Python/raw-address adoption interface exists; these scalar checks do
     * not manufacture that precondition. No uninitialized header read.
     */
    view->header = NULL;
    view->dispatch = NULL;
    view->kw = NULL;
    view->cell = NULL;
    view->entry = NULL;
    view->base = NULL;
    view->klass = NULL;
    view->ledger = NULL;
    if (actual_base == NULL || !reno_ws_layout_is_canonical(layout)
            || actual_bytes < layout->requested_bytes
            || sizeof(RenoWorkspaceHeader) > actual_bytes
            || (uintptr_t)actual_base % __alignof(RenoWorkspaceHeader) != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
#define RENO_WS_BIND(MEMBER, COUNT, OFFSET, TYPE) \
    do { \
        if (!reno_ws_array_address(raw, actual_bytes, layout->OFFSET, \
                layout->COUNT, sizeof(TYPE), __alignof(TYPE), &array_address)) { \
            return 0; \
        } \
        view->MEMBER = (TYPE *)array_address; \
    } while (0)
    RENO_WS_BIND(dispatch, D, dispatch_offset, RenoDispatchCapture);
    RENO_WS_BIND(kw, K, kw_offset, RenoKwCapture);
    RENO_WS_BIND(cell, Z, cell_offset, RenoCellCapture);
    RENO_WS_BIND(entry, E, entry_offset, RenoClassEntryCapture);
    RENO_WS_BIND(base, B, base_offset, RenoBaseCapture);
    RENO_WS_BIND(klass, C, class_offset, RenoClassCapture);
    RENO_WS_BIND(ledger, R, ledger_offset, RenoLedgerEntry);
#undef RENO_WS_BIND
    view->header = (RenoWorkspaceHeader *)actual_base;
    return 1;
}

/* Generated exact record initialization and owning-field selector follow. */


static void
reno_workspace_initialize_live(RenoWorkspaceView *view, const RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    size_t index;
    RenoDispatchCapture fresh_dispatch = {0};
    RenoKwCapture fresh_kw = {0};
    RenoCellCapture fresh_cell = {0};
    RenoClassEntryCapture fresh_entry = {0};
    RenoBaseCapture fresh_base = {0};
    RenoClassCapture fresh_klass = {0};
    RenoLedgerEntry fresh_ledger = {0};

    /* Language-level aggregate initialization supplies typed NULL object
     * and function pointers. This is not OS-zero-page or byte memset.
     * Provider/compiler fresh-storage/effective-type contract precedes
     * these full corresponding-T lvalue stores; no release/callout. */
    *view->header = *layout;
    for (index = 0; index < layout->D; ++index) { view->dispatch[index] = fresh_dispatch; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->K; ++index) { view->kw[index] = fresh_kw; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->Z; ++index) { view->cell[index] = fresh_cell; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->E; ++index) { view->entry[index] = fresh_entry; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->B; ++index) { view->base[index] = fresh_base; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->C; ++index) { view->klass[index] = fresh_klass; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->R; ++index) { view->ledger[index] = fresh_ledger; }
    /* No payload read or acquisition before EVERY record was initialized. */
    view->header->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_INITIALIZED;
}

static PyObject **
reno_workspace_owned_slot(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain, size_t index, unsigned int field)
{
    switch (domain) {
    case RENO_WS_DISPATCH:
        if (index >= view->header->D) { return NULL; }
        switch (field) {
        case 0: return &view->dispatch[index].function;
        case 1: return &view->dispatch[index].code;
        case 2: return &view->dispatch[index].defaults;
        case 3: return &view->dispatch[index].kwdefaults;
        case 4: return &view->dispatch[index].closure;
        case 5: return &view->dispatch[index].globals;
        case 6: return &view->dispatch[index].builtins;
        case 7: return &view->dispatch[index].kw_entries;
        case 8: return &view->dispatch[index].cells;
        case 9: return &view->dispatch[index].row_tuple;
        default: return NULL;
        }
    case RENO_WS_KW:
        if (index >= view->header->K) { return NULL; }
        switch (field) {
        case 0: return &view->kw[index].key;
        case 1: return &view->kw[index].value;
        case 2: return &view->kw[index].pair_tuple;
        default: return NULL;
        }
    case RENO_WS_CELL:
        if (index >= view->header->Z) { return NULL; }
        switch (field) {
        case 0: return &view->cell[index].populated_contents;
        case 1: return &view->cell[index].cell_record_tuple;
        case 2: return &view->cell[index].cell_identity;
        default: return NULL;
        }
    case RENO_WS_ENTRY:
        if (index >= view->header->E) { return NULL; }
        switch (field) {
        case 0: return &view->entry[index].key;
        case 1: return &view->entry[index].value;
        case 2: return &view->entry[index].entry_pair;
        default: return NULL;
        }
    case RENO_WS_BASE:
        if (index >= view->header->B) { return NULL; }
        switch (field) {
        case 0: return &view->base[index].dict_guard;
        case 1: return &view->base[index].entries_tuple;
        case 2: return &view->base[index].base_row_tuple;
        case 3: return &view->base[index].base_identity;
        default: return NULL;
        }
    case RENO_WS_CLASS:
        if (index >= view->header->C) { return NULL; }
        switch (field) {
        case 0: return &view->klass[index].base_rows_tuple;
        case 1: return &view->klass[index].functions_tuple;
        case 2: return &view->klass[index].class_row_tuple;
        default: return NULL;
        }
    default: return NULL;
    }
}

static int
reno_ws_slot_registered(RenoWorkspaceView *view, PyObject **slot)
{
    size_t index;

    for (index = 0; index < view->header->ledger_count; ++index) {
        if (view->ledger[index].slot_address == slot) {
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static PyObject **
reno_ws_acquire_slot(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field)
{
    PyObject **slot;

    if (view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_INITIALIZED
            && view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED) {
        return NULL;
    }
    if (view->header->ledger_count >= view->header->ledger_capacity) {
        return NULL;
    }
    slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, domain, index, field);
    if (slot == NULL || *slot != NULL || reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot)) {
        return NULL;
    }
    return slot;
}

static int
reno_ws_own_borrowed(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field, PyObject *actual_borrowed)
{
    PyObject **slot;
    size_t at;

    if (actual_borrowed == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    slot = reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, domain, index, field);
    if (slot == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* Actual valid borrowed root and full/nondebug reference envelope are
     * separate preconditions. No callout between precheck/NewRef/ledger. */
    at = view->header->ledger_count;
    *slot = Py_NewRef(actual_borrowed);
    view->ledger[at].slot_address = slot;
    view->header->ledger_count = at + 1;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_move_new(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field, PyObject **actual_owned)
{
    PyObject **slot;
    size_t at;

    /* actual_owned is this caller's independent real owning automatic slot,
     * not a borrowed value, region field, fixed arena slot or Python input.
     * Its source/continuous ownership is the future real caller's obligation.
     */
    if (*actual_owned == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    slot = reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, domain, index, field);
    if (slot == NULL) {
        return 0; /* original automatic still owns this occurrence */
    }
    at = view->header->ledger_count;
    *slot = *actual_owned;
    *actual_owned = NULL;
    view->ledger[at].slot_address = slot;
    view->header->ledger_count = at + 1;
    return 1;
}

static PyObject *
reno_ws_take_owned(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field)
{
    PyObject **slot;
    PyObject *actual_owned;

    if (view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED) {
        return NULL; /* no move of raw partial-capture roots */
    }
    slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, domain, index, field);
    if (slot == NULL || !reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot)) {
        return NULL;
    }
    actual_owned = *slot;
    *slot = NULL;
    /* Keep historical slot_address: a moved NULL slot cannot be re-acquired.
     * Caller owns this actual occurrence; same identity elsewhere is separate.
     */
    return actual_owned;
}

static void
reno_workspace_drain_live(RenoWorkspaceView *view, PyObject **first_slot,
    int *cleanup_failed)
{
    PyObject **slot;
    PyObject *detached = NULL;
    size_t at;

    if (view->header == NULL
            || (view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_INITIALIZED
                && view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED)) {
        return;
    }
    view->header->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_DRAINING;
    while (view->header->ledger_count != 0) {
        at = view->header->ledger_count - 1;
        slot = view->ledger[at].slot_address;
        view->header->ledger_count = at;
        view->ledger[at].slot_address = NULL;
        /* Only this unit's domain/index/field selector created ledger slots.
         * No address range, refcount sample or arbitrary slot adoption here.
         * The allocation owner keeps original storage live over all releases.
         */
        detached = *slot;
        *slot = NULL;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached, first_slot, cleanup_failed);
    }
    view->header->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_DRAINED;
    /* Still LIVE allocation: this settles PyObject debts only. Caller must
     * finish the last view access before actual free; W42 remains unresolved.
     */
}

/* Private same-unit operations, transported directly from the actual static
 * definitions below to the required C allocation/capture owner. No public
 * operation-table registration, Python callback or late alias selection.
 * Merely receiving this table does NOT implement the still-missing owner.
 */
static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus reno_workspace_capture_raw(
    PyObject *, RenoState *, unsigned int *, RenoWorkspaceView *,
    RenoNamedRanges [6], RenoClassRootMap [5], RenoT0LocalRoots *);
static int reno_ws_known_status(RenoState *, unsigned int, int);
static int reno_ws_fixed_targets_empty(RenoState *);
static int reno_fixed_sources_match(RenoState *, PyObject *const [5], PyObject *, PyObject *);

static int reno_workspace_prepare_region_rows(
    PyObject *, RenoState *, unsigned int *, RenoWorkspaceView *,
    RenoNamedRanges [6], RenoClassRootMap [5], RenoT0LocalRoots *, PyObject **);

typedef struct RenoWorkspacePrivateOps {
    int (*bind_live)(RenoWorkspaceView *, void *, size_t, const RenoWorkspaceHeader *);
    void (*initialize_live)(RenoWorkspaceView *, const RenoWorkspaceHeader *);
    int (*own_borrowed)(RenoWorkspaceView *, RenoWorkspaceDomain, size_t, unsigned int, PyObject *);
    int (*move_new)(RenoWorkspaceView *, RenoWorkspaceDomain, size_t, unsigned int, PyObject **);
    PyObject *(*take_owned)(RenoWorkspaceView *, RenoWorkspaceDomain, size_t, unsigned int);
    void (*drain_live)(RenoWorkspaceView *, PyObject **, int *);
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus (*capture_raw)(PyObject *, RenoState *, unsigned int *,
        RenoWorkspaceView *, RenoNamedRanges [6], RenoClassRootMap [5], RenoT0LocalRoots *);
    int (*prepare_region_rows)(PyObject *, RenoState *, unsigned int *,
        RenoWorkspaceView *, RenoNamedRanges [6], RenoClassRootMap [5],
        RenoT0LocalRoots *, PyObject **);
} RenoWorkspacePrivateOps;

static const RenoWorkspacePrivateOps reno_workspace_private_ops = {
    reno_workspace_bind_live,
    reno_workspace_initialize_live,
    reno_ws_own_borrowed,
    reno_ws_move_new,
    reno_ws_take_owned,
    reno_workspace_drain_live,
    reno_workspace_capture_raw,
    reno_workspace_prepare_region_rows
};

/* Required full continuation, STILL UNDEFINED. COUNT_OK means complete known
 * exact-dict count and a real checked layout; NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE means
 * only partial scalars, requested_bytes==0 and NO usable offsets. The latter
 * must resolve the original full class-dict domain within the original T0
 * callback-free boundary, not reject it forever or call out and then re-pin.
 * Both paths must actually allocate/capture all mutable occurrences, prepare
 * representations, consume the outer three roots and settle W42/temp debts.
 */
static int reno_h01_finish_workspace_capture_prepare(
    PyObject *module, RenoState *state, unsigned int *bootstrap_entered,
    RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned, RenoWorkspaceCountStatus count_status,
    RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout, RenoNamedRanges named_ranges[6],
    RenoClassRootMap class_roots[5], const RenoWorkspacePrivateOps *workspace_ops);

static int
reno_ws_python_length(size_t count)
{
    return count <= (size_t)PY_SSIZE_T_MAX;
}

/* G/B/kwdefaults have the original exact-dict contract; class dictionaries
 * have a distinct original domain and do not reuse this as a domain proof.
 */
static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(PyObject *dictionary, size_t *entry_count)
{
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    size_t count = 0;

    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    }
    while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key)) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        }
        if (!reno_ws_add(count, 1, &count)) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
        }
    }
    *entry_count = count;
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_count_metadata(PyObject *globals, PyObject *builtins,
    PyObject *kwdefaults, PyObject *closure, RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout,
    size_t *kw_count, size_t *cell_count)
{
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    size_t unused;
    size_t K = 0;
    size_t Z = 0;
    size_t P = 0;
    size_t index;
    PyObject *cell;

    status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(globals, &unused);
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
        return status;
    }
    status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(builtins, &unused);
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
        return status;
    }
    /* NULL and actual None have the original getter-observable None result.
     * This does not rewrite raw captured/present/owning facts in State.
     */
    if (kwdefaults != NULL && kwdefaults != Py_None) {
        status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(kwdefaults, &K);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
            return status;
        }
    }
    if (closure != NULL && closure != Py_None) {
        if (!PyTuple_CheckExact(closure)
                || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyTuple_GET_SIZE(closure), &Z)) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        }
        for (index = 0; index < Z; ++index) {
            cell = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(closure, (Py_ssize_t)index);
            if (cell == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(cell, &PyCell_Type)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            /* Exact original C cell field: NULL is empty; Py_None is a real
             * populated value. No getter, ValueError creation or clear here.
             */
            if (PyCell_GET(cell) != NULL && !reno_ws_add(P, 1, &P)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_python_length(K) || !reno_ws_python_length(Z)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout->K, K, &layout->K)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout->Z, Z, &layout->Z)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout->P, P, &layout->P)) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
    }
    *kw_count = K;
    *cell_count = Z;
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_count_candidate(PyObject *candidate, RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    size_t K;
    size_t Z;

    /* Original class_row skips ALL nonexact-function expanded results. Do
     * not reject None, native descriptors or descriptor subclasses here.
     */
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(candidate, &PyFunction_Type)) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
    }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)candidate;
    status = reno_ws_count_metadata(function->func_globals,
        function->func_builtins, function->func_kwdefaults,
        function->func_closure, layout, &K, &Z);
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
        return status;
    }
    if (!reno_ws_add(layout->D, 1, &layout->D)) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
    }
    /* DispatchCapture later preserves actual original_vectorcall. Capturing
     * source facts does not certify an implementation for an actual call.
     */
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_count_accessor(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name, RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new = NULL;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;

    /* The caller has already selected this exact original builtin type. Its
     * descriptor remains continuously held by the same actual exact dict in
     * the no-callback interval. No unknown member getter or property binding.
     */
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members;
            member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT
                    || member->flags != READONLY) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    }
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new == NULL) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE; /* no NEW; preserve any actual indicator */
    }
    status = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        ? reno_ws_count_candidate(actual_new, layout) : RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    /* This actual NEW is settled on every non-NULL exit. Non-NULL original
     * payload still has its independent descriptor field root throughout;
     * NULL -> None uses the selected immortal/full-nondebug envelope. Thus
     * this release is specifically nonlast, not an arbitrary cleanup callout.
     * No reference/cursor is carried to an outer return or future allocation.
     */
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return status;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_count_entry_dispatch(PyObject *value, RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout)
{
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;

    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        status = reno_ws_count_accessor(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", layout);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
            return status;
        }
        status = reno_ws_count_accessor(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", layout);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
            return status;
        }
        return reno_ws_count_accessor(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", layout);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return reno_ws_count_accessor(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", layout);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return reno_ws_count_accessor(value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", layout);
    }
    return reno_ws_count_candidate(value, layout);
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_workspace_count_raw(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceHeader *layout,
    RenoNamedRanges named_ranges[6], RenoClassRootMap class_roots[5])
{
    unsigned int named;
    size_t class_index;
    size_t mro_index;
    size_t mro_count;
    size_t entry_count;
    size_t class_dispatch_start;
    size_t unused;
    unsigned int base_slot;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key;
    PyObject *value;
