    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;

    /* layout is this call's fresh all-integer automatic initialized below,
     * not an existing region header. Only scalar counts are changed here.
     */
    layout->C = 5;
    layout->F = 6;
    for (named = 0; named < 6; ++named) {
        base_slot = 30 + 9 * named;
        named_ranges[named].kw_start = layout->K;
        named_ranges[named].cell_start = layout->Z;
        status = reno_ws_count_metadata(state->arena.known.roots[base_slot + 7],
            state->arena.known.roots[base_slot + 8],
            state->arena.known.roots[base_slot + 3],
            state->arena.known.roots[base_slot + 5], layout,
            &named_ranges[named].kw_count, &named_ranges[named].cell_count);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
            return status;
        }
    }
    for (class_index = 0; class_index < 5; ++class_index) {
        klass = *class_roots[class_index].class_slot;
        mro = *class_roots[class_index].mro_slot;
        if (klass == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(klass, &PyType_Type)
                || mro == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro)
                || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyTuple_GET_SIZE(mro), &mro_count)) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        }
        class_dispatch_start = layout->D;
        for (mro_index = 0; mro_index < mro_count; ++mro_index) {
            base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)mro_index);
            if (base == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base);
            /* Original mappingproxy iteration/items can delegate a nonexact
             * backing dictionary. Exact metaclass does not prove this domain.
             * Do not turn this explicit conditional route into a new reject.
             */
            if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) {
                layout->requested_bytes = 0;
                layout->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE;
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE;
            }
            status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &entry_count);
            if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
                return status;
            }
            if (!reno_ws_add(layout->B, 1, &layout->B)
                    || !reno_ws_add(layout->E, entry_count, &layout->E)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
            }
            position = 0;
            key = NULL;
            value = NULL;
            while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
                status = reno_ws_count_entry_dispatch(value, layout);
                if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
                    return status;
                }
            }
        }
        /* Check each future output, not aggregate D/K/Z over many outputs. */
        unused = layout->D - class_dispatch_start;
        if (!reno_ws_python_length(unused)) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
        }
    }
    layout->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_COUNTED;
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

/* A fixed scalar traversal cursor, never a variable-sized index bank or a
 * State field. Its zero initializer contains integer scalars only. */
typedef struct RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor {
    size_t D;
    size_t K;
    size_t Z;
    size_t P;
    size_t E;
    size_t B;
} RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor;

enum {
    RENO_WS_FUNCTION_NAMED = 0, RENO_WS_FUNCTION_DISPATCH = 1,
    RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN = 0, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET = 1,
    RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET = 2, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL = 3,
    RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC = 4, RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS = 5,
    RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN = 0, RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY = 1,
    RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC = 2, RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS = 3
};

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_capture_metadata(RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor *cursor, PyObject *globals, PyObject *builtins,
    PyObject *kwdefaults, PyObject *closure, unsigned char domain,
    size_t function_index)
{
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    size_t unused;
    size_t ordinal = 0;
    size_t cell_count;
    size_t index;
    size_t at;
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    PyObject *cell;
    PyObject *contents;

    status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(globals, &unused);
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return status; }
    status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(builtins, &unused);
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return status; }
    /* NULL and actual None are both observable None for iteration. Actual
     * raw presence/identity is retained in the fixed or dispatch owning row.
     * G/B themselves are held there; the original row does not copy entries.
     */
    if (kwdefaults != NULL && kwdefaults != Py_None) {
        if (!PyDict_CheckExact(kwdefaults)) { return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE; }
        while (PyDict_Next(kwdefaults, &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key) || cursor->K >= view->header->K) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            at = cursor->K;
            if (!reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_KW, at, 0, key)
                    || !reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_KW, at, 1, value)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            view->kw[at].function_domain = domain;
            view->kw[at].function_index = function_index;
            view->kw[at].entry_ordinal = ordinal;
            ++cursor->K;
            ++ordinal; /* ordinal <= K, whose complete storage was checked */
        }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_python_length(ordinal)) { return RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW; }
    if (closure != NULL && closure != Py_None) {
        if (!PyTuple_CheckExact(closure)
                || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyTuple_GET_SIZE(closure), &cell_count)
                || cursor->Z > view->header->Z
                || cell_count > view->header->Z - cursor->Z) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        }
        for (index = 0; index < cell_count; ++index) {
            cell = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(closure, (Py_ssize_t)index);
            if (cell == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(cell, &PyCell_Type)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            at = cursor->Z;
            /* Independent original endpoint before any tuple callback. */
            if (!reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_CELL, at, 2, cell)) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            contents = PyCell_GET(cell);
            if (contents != NULL) {
                if (cursor->P >= view->header->P
                        || !reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_CELL, at, 0, contents)) {
                    return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
                }
                ++cursor->P;
            }
            view->cell[at].function_domain = domain;
            view->cell[at].function_index = function_index;
            view->cell[at].closure_index = index;
            view->cell[at].populated = contents != NULL;
            ++cursor->Z;
            /* Cell identity has its independent endpoint reference above;
             * contents is a separate occurrence. Empty/populated None differ.
             * No getter/ValueError/callback or artificial contents for empty.
             */
        }
    }
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_capture_candidate(RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor *cursor, PyObject *candidate,
    size_t base_index, size_t entry_index, unsigned char accessor_role)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyObject *fields[7]; /* fixed borrowed values, no dynamic index bank */
    RenoDispatchCapture *row;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    size_t at;
    unsigned int field;

    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(candidate, &PyFunction_Type)) { return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK; }
    if (cursor->D >= view->header->D) { return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE; }
    at = cursor->D;
    row = &view->dispatch[at];
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)candidate;
    fields[0] = candidate;
    fields[1] = function->func_code;
    fields[2] = function->func_defaults;
    fields[3] = function->func_kwdefaults;
    fields[4] = function->func_closure;
    fields[5] = function->func_globals;
    fields[6] = function->func_builtins;
    if (fields[1] == NULL || fields[5] == NULL || fields[6] == NULL) {
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    }
    for (field = 0; field < 7; ++field) {
        if (fields[field] != NULL
                && !reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, at, field, fields[field])) {
            return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        }
    }
    row->base_index = base_index;
    row->entry_index = entry_index;
    row->accessor_role = accessor_role;
    row->defaults_present = fields[2] != NULL;
    row->kw_present = fields[3] != NULL;
    row->closure_present = fields[4] != NULL;
    row->original_vectorcall = function->vectorcall;
    /* Preserve this actual pointer as a source fact. Capturing it neither
     * certifies code lifetime nor calls the saved implementation. */
    row->kw_start = cursor->K;
    row->cell_start = cursor->Z;
    status = reno_ws_capture_metadata(view, cursor, row->globals, row->builtins,
        row->kwdefaults, row->closure, RENO_WS_FUNCTION_DISPATCH, at);
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return status; }
    row->kw_count = cursor->K - row->kw_start;
    row->cell_count = cursor->Z - row->cell_start;
    ++cursor->D;
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_capture_accessor(RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor *cursor, PyObject *descriptor,
    PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *name, size_t base_index,
    size_t entry_index, unsigned char accessor_role)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new = NULL;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;

    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members;
            member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT || member->flags != READONLY) {
                return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) { return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE; }
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new == NULL) { return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE; }
    status = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        ? reno_ws_capture_candidate(view, cursor, actual_new, base_index,
            entry_index, accessor_role) : RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    /* Same original exact T_OBJECT/READONLY contract as count: descriptor's
     * field still independently owns a non-NULL payload over every exit;
     * NULL -> None is in the selected immortal/full-nondebug envelope.
     * Thus this NEW has a specifically nonlast DECREF even on partial error.
     * Capture's own NewRef occurrence, when acquired, belongs to its ledger.
     */
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return status;
}

static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_ws_capture_entry_dispatch(RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor *cursor, size_t base_index, size_t entry_index)
{
    RenoClassEntryCapture *entry = &view->entry[entry_index];
    PyObject *value = entry->value;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;

    entry->dispatch_start = cursor->D;
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        entry->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY;
        status = reno_ws_capture_accessor(view, cursor, value, &PyProperty_Type,
            "fget", base_index, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return status; }
        status = reno_ws_capture_accessor(view, cursor, value, &PyProperty_Type,
            "fset", base_index, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return status; }
        status = reno_ws_capture_accessor(view, cursor, value, &PyProperty_Type,
            "fdel", base_index, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL);
    } else if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        entry->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC;
        status = reno_ws_capture_accessor(view, cursor, value, &PyStaticMethod_Type,
            "__func__", base_index, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC);
    } else if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        entry->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS;
        status = reno_ws_capture_accessor(view, cursor, value, &PyClassMethod_Type,
            "__func__", base_index, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS);
    } else {
        entry->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN;
        status = reno_ws_capture_candidate(view, cursor, value, base_index,
            entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN);
    }
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return status; }
    entry->dispatch_count = cursor->D - entry->dispatch_start;
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;
}

/* Same T0 raw producer span AFTER this entry's real dispatch/cell capture.
 * Region ledger already independently owns wrapper/code/closure/cell/method.
 * The original owner/provider/GIL/full-API/no-callout premises precede these
 * reads; class/key/layout comparisons cannot manufacture that history.
 * Only the original FileLoader own get_filename entry captures code/G/B
 * and its original vectorcall scalar, NOT full nested metadata/call admission.
 */
static int reno_t0_own_borrowed(RenoState *, unsigned int, PyObject *);

static int
reno_ws_capture_filename_method_code(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    size_t base_index, size_t entry_index)
{
    RenoBaseCapture *base;
    RenoClassEntryCapture *entry;
    RenoDispatchCapture *row;
    RenoCellCapture *cell;
    PyCodeObject *wrapper_code;
    PyObject *names;
    PyObject *method;
    PyObject *code;
    PyObject *globals;
    PyObject *builtins;
    vectorcallfunc method_dispatch;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || state == NULL || view == NULL
            || view->header == NULL || base_index >= view->header->B
            || entry_index >= view->header->E) { return 0; }
    base = &view->base[base_index];
    entry = &view->entry[entry_index];
    if (base->class_index != 2 || base->mro_index != 0
            || !exact_ascii_name(entry->key, "get_filename", 12)) { return 1; }
    if (base->base_identity != state->arena.known.roots[14]
            || base->dict_guard != state->arena.known.roots[15]
            || entry->base_index != base_index
            || entry->descriptor_role != RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
            || entry->dispatch_count != 1
            || entry->dispatch_start >= view->header->D) { return 0; }
    row = &view->dispatch[entry->dispatch_start];
    if (row->base_index != base_index || row->entry_index != entry_index
            || row->accessor_role != RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN
            || row->function != entry->value || row->function == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(row->function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || row->code == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(row->code, &PyCode_Type)
            || row->closure == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(row->closure)
            || PyTuple_GET_SIZE(row->closure) != 1
            || row->cell_count != 1 || row->cell_start >= view->header->Z) { return 0; }
    /* This original wrapper has exactly one freevar, "method". Use its
     * independently captured code/closure, not a guessed dispatch ordinal or
     * a later current-code sample. Matching code layout is an external premise.
     */
    wrapper_code = (PyCodeObject *)row->code;
    names = wrapper_code->co_localsplusnames;
    if (wrapper_code->co_nfreevars != 1 || wrapper_code->co_nlocalsplus <= 0
            || names == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(names)
            || PyTuple_GET_SIZE(names) != wrapper_code->co_nlocalsplus
            || !exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names,
                wrapper_code->co_nlocalsplus - 1), "method", 6)) { return 0; }
    cell = &view->cell[row->cell_start];
    if (cell->function_domain != RENO_WS_FUNCTION_DISPATCH
            || cell->function_index != entry->dispatch_start
            || cell->closure_index != 0 || cell->populated != 1
            || cell->cell_identity == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(cell->cell_identity, &PyCell_Type)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row->closure, 0) != cell->cell_identity
            || PyCell_GET(cell->cell_identity) != cell->populated_contents) { return 0; }
    method = cell->populated_contents;
    if (method == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(method, &PyFunction_Type)) { return 0; }
    code = ((PyFunctionObject *)method)->func_code;
    globals = ((PyFunctionObject *)method)->func_globals;
    builtins = ((PyFunctionObject *)method)->func_builtins;
    method_dispatch = ((PyFunctionObject *)method)->vectorcall;
    if (code == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(code, &PyCode_Type)
            || globals == NULL || builtins == NULL) { return 0; }
    /* Separate actual NEW occurrences move to the known ledger in code/G/B
     * order, even if two source pointers are equal. Region references stay
     * in region. No entry copy or nested default/closure freeze is added.
     * Partial failure leaves acquired debts with their actual drain owner.
     */
    if (!reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 110, code)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 111, globals)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 112, builtins)
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    /* Original scalar history only. A NULL/custom address remains data;
     * neither it nor standard_matched calls or admits any implementation.
     */
    state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.expected = method_dispatch;
    state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.standard_matched =
        method_dispatch == &_PyFunction_Vectorcall;
    state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.captured = 1;
    return 1;
}

/* Consistency of the actual original fixed raw prefix only. Actual module,
 * State/allocation, this entered debt, original locals/maps and continuous
 * T0 count/provider/capture no-callback envelope precede every read. These
 * comparisons do not manufacture source, physical capacity or a lease.
 * The existing fixed-source helper creates/settles exact member NEWs; its
 * independent descriptor-root/nonlast/None/full-API premises remain required.
 */
static int
reno_ws_capture_prefix_matches(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned,
    RenoClassRootMap class_roots[5])
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char mros[5] = {0, 13, 16, 19, 22};
    PyObject *expected_mros[5] = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject **roots;
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    RenoFunctionRowControl *row_control;
    RenoFunctionDispatchControl *dispatch;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *builtin;
    unsigned int row;
    unsigned int field;
    unsigned int slot;
    unsigned int base;
    int expected;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || module == NULL || state == NULL
            || bootstrap_entered == NULL || locals_owned == NULL || class_roots == NULL
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(module)
            || _PyModule_GetDef(module) != &owner_factory_definition
            || reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(module) != state
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || !*bootstrap_entered || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete != 0
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 0
            || state->arena.class_source_witness != NULL
            || !reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state)) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    builtin = &state->controls.builtin_exec;
    for (row = 0; row < 6; ++row) {
        row_control = &state->controls.function_rows[row];
        dispatch = &state->controls.function_dispatch[row];
        for (field = 0; field < 7; ++field) {
            if (row_control->raw_captured[field] != 1) { return 0; }
        }
        for (field = 0; field < 3; ++field) {
            if (row_control->present[field] > 1) { return 0; }
        }
        if (row_control->representation_ready[0] != 0
                || row_control->representation_ready[1] != 0 || row_control->row_ready != 0
                || dispatch->captured != 1) { return 0; }
    }
    /* This fixed prefix covers original slots 0..109. Nested code/G/B at
     * slots110..112 are acquired by raw capture, whose entry/completion checks cover them
     * separately. Keep actual acquired positions; no sort/rebuild/dedup.
     */
    for (slot = 0; slot < 110; ++slot) {
        expected = 0;
        if (slot <= 27 || (slot >= 97 && slot <= 99)) {
            expected = 1;
        } else if (slot >= 30 && slot < 84) {
            row = (slot - 30) / 9;
            field = (slot - 30) % 9;
            row_control = &state->controls.function_rows[row];
            if (field == 2) { expected = row_control->present[0]; }
            else if (field == 3) { expected = row_control->present[1]; }
            else if (field == 5) { expected = row_control->present[2]; }
            else if (field != 4 && field != 6) { expected = 1; }
        }
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, slot, expected)) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_fixed_targets_empty(state)) { return 0; }
    for (row = 0; row < 6; ++row) {
        base = 30 + 9 * row;
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(roots[base], &PyFunction_Type)) { return 0; }
        function = (PyFunctionObject *)roots[base];
        if (function->func_code != roots[base + 1]
                || function->func_defaults != roots[base + 2]
                || function->func_kwdefaults != roots[base + 3]
                || function->func_closure != roots[base + 5]
                || function->func_globals != roots[base + 7]
                || function->func_builtins != roots[base + 8]
                || function->vectorcall != state->controls.function_dispatch[row].expected) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    for (row = 0; row < 5; ++row) {
        if (class_roots[row].class_role != row
                || class_roots[row].class_slot != &roots[classes[row]]
                || class_roots[row].mro_slot != (row == 0
                    ? &locals_owned->pathfinder_mro : &roots[mros[row]])) { return 0; }
        expected_mros[row] = *class_roots[row].mro_slot;
    }
    for (field = 0; field < 4; ++field) {
        if (builtin->scalar_captured[field] != 1) { return 0; }
    }
    for (field = 0; field < 2; ++field) {
        PyObject *payload = field == 0 ? locals_owned->builtin_self : locals_owned->builtin_module;
        if (builtin->payload_captured[field] != 1 || builtin->present[field] > 1
                || builtin->present[field] != (payload != NULL)
                || builtin->anchor_ready[field] != 0) { return 0; }
    }
    if (builtin->ready != 0) { return 0; }
    return reno_fixed_sources_match(state, expected_mros,
            locals_owned->builtin_self, locals_owned->builtin_module)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && state->bootstrap_marker == RENO_BOOT_TYPED
        && *bootstrap_entered && state->controls.meta_active_count > 0
        && state->controls.phase == RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
        && state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete == 0
        && state->controls.arena_owner == RENO_ARENA_STATE
        && state->controls.published_arena == &state->arena
        && state->controls.class_source_witness_ready == 0
        && state->arena.class_source_witness == NULL
        && reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state);
}

/* Required caller precondition: the actual module guard, this entered debt,
 * fresh initialized allocation and independent fixed original roots/locals
 * remain continuously live. Original fixed capture/count/provider/capture
 * stays in the matching full-API no-Python-callback/no-GIL-release envelope.
 * Prefix/current/count comparisons do not establish or recover that history.
 * The full owner/provider/class-domain proof remains missing. On complete
 * success this actual producer alone commits the raw preparation facts;
 * no representation, PREPARING/ACTIVE, business or install grant is made.
 */
static RenoWorkspaceCountStatus
reno_workspace_capture_raw(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoNamedRanges named_ranges[6], RenoClassRootMap class_roots[5],
    RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned)
{
    RenoWorkspaceCaptureCursor cursor = {0};
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    size_t named;
    size_t class_index;
    size_t mro_index;
    size_t mro_count;
    size_t base_at;
    size_t entry_at;
    unsigned int fixed_slot;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key;
    PyObject *value;
    RenoClassCapture *class_row;
    RenoBaseCapture *base_row;

    if (view == NULL || view->header == NULL || named_ranges == NULL
            || view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_INITIALIZED
            || view->header->ledger_count != 0 || view->header->capture_failed
            || view->header->representation_started || view->header->C != 5
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_ws_capture_prefix_matches(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                locals_owned, class_roots)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 110, 0)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 111, 0)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 112, 0)
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.expected != NULL
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.captured != 0
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.standard_matched != 0) {
        /* No region acquire or State commit. The selected source preflight
         * may create and settle its exact-member NEWs; it is not zero-ref.
         */
        return RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
    }
    for (named = 0; named < 6; ++named) {
        fixed_slot = 30 + 9 * (unsigned int)named;
        if (named_ranges[named].function_role != named
                || named_ranges[named].kw_start != cursor.K
                || named_ranges[named].cell_start != cursor.Z) {
            status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            goto failed;
        }
        status = reno_ws_capture_metadata(view, &cursor,
            state->arena.known.roots[fixed_slot + 7],
            state->arena.known.roots[fixed_slot + 8],
            state->arena.known.roots[fixed_slot + 3],
            state->arena.known.roots[fixed_slot + 5], RENO_WS_FUNCTION_NAMED, named);
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { goto failed; }
        if (cursor.K - named_ranges[named].kw_start != named_ranges[named].kw_count
                || cursor.Z - named_ranges[named].cell_start != named_ranges[named].cell_count) {
            status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            goto failed;
        }
    }
    for (class_index = 0; class_index < 5; ++class_index) {
        klass = *class_roots[class_index].class_slot;
        mro = *class_roots[class_index].mro_slot;
        if (class_roots[class_index].class_role != class_index || klass == NULL
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(klass, &PyType_Type) || mro == NULL
                || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro)
                || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyTuple_GET_SIZE(mro), &mro_count)) {
            status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
            goto failed;
        }
        class_row = &view->klass[class_index];
        class_row->class_role = (unsigned char)class_index;
        class_row->base_start = cursor.B;
        class_row->dispatch_start = cursor.D;
        for (mro_index = 0; mro_index < mro_count; ++mro_index) {
            base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)mro_index);
            if (base == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)
                    || cursor.B >= view->header->B) {
                status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
                goto failed;
            }
            dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base);
            if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) {
                status = RENO_WS_COUNT_NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE;
                goto failed; /* never re-pin after an unknown callback */
            }
            base_at = cursor.B;
            base_row = &view->base[base_at];
            if (!reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_BASE, base_at, 3, base)
                    || !reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_BASE, base_at, 0, dictionary)) {
                status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
                goto failed;
            }
            base_row->class_index = class_index;
            base_row->mro_index = mro_index;
            base_row->entry_start = cursor.E;
            base_row->dispatch_start = cursor.D;
            position = 0;
            key = NULL;
            value = NULL;
            while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
                if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(key) || cursor.E >= view->header->E) {
                    status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
                    goto failed;
                }
                entry_at = cursor.E;
                if (!reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, entry_at, 0, key)
                        || !reno_ws_own_borrowed(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, entry_at, 1, value)) {
                    status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
                    goto failed;
                }
                view->entry[entry_at].base_index = base_at;
                view->entry[entry_at].entry_ordinal = cursor.E - base_row->entry_start;
                status = reno_ws_capture_entry_dispatch(view, &cursor, base_at, entry_at);
                if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { goto failed; }
                if (!reno_ws_capture_filename_method_code(state, view, base_at, entry_at)) {
                    status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
                    goto failed;
                }
                ++cursor.E;
            }
            base_row->entry_count = cursor.E - base_row->entry_start;
            base_row->dispatch_count = cursor.D - base_row->dispatch_start;
            if (!reno_ws_python_length(base_row->entry_count)) {
                status = RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
                goto failed;
            }
            ++cursor.B;
        }
        class_row->base_count = cursor.B - class_row->base_start;
        class_row->dispatch_count = cursor.D - class_row->dispatch_start;
        if (!reno_ws_python_length(class_row->base_count)
                || !reno_ws_python_length(class_row->dispatch_count)) {
            status = RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
            goto failed;
        }
    }
    if (cursor.D != view->header->D || cursor.K != view->header->K
            || cursor.Z != view->header->Z || cursor.P != view->header->P
            || cursor.E != view->header->E || cursor.B != view->header->B
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_ws_capture_prefix_matches(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                locals_owned, class_roots)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 110, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 111, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 112, 1)
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.captured != 1
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.standard_matched > 1) {
        status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Same raw segment after actual complete capture and final prefix check.
     * This is historical raw preparation, not tuple/row/business readiness.
     * No callout lies between these three stores or before this scalar return.
     */
    view->header->workspace_phase = RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED;
    state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete = 1;
    state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_ROOTS_FROZEN;
    return RENO_WS_COUNT_OK;

failed:
    view->header->capture_failed = 1;
    /* Partial raw references stay on the actual reverse-drain ledger.
     * This body does not release, allocate an exception, free or return an
     * owner. Caller must drain before settling its last region read/free.
     * Retain actual API indicator, if any; do not manufacture first here.
     */
    return status;
}

/* Private synchronous call context only. These are references to the actual
 * outer frame's original owning slots/maps, never a registry or a new source
 * grant. The actual owner, initial T0, full ABI and lifetime premises remain.
 */
typedef struct RenoWorkspaceSourceContext {
    RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned;
    RenoNamedRanges *named_ranges;
    RenoClassRootMap *class_roots;
} RenoWorkspaceSourceContext;

typedef enum RenoWorkspacePendingKind {
    RENO_PENDING_KW_PAIR = 0, RENO_PENDING_CELL_ROW, RENO_PENDING_ENTRY_PAIR,
    RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_KW, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_CELLS,
    RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_ROW, RENO_PENDING_BASE_ENTRIES, RENO_PENDING_BASE_ROW,
    RENO_PENDING_CLASS_BASES, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_FUNCTIONS, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_ROW,
    RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS,
    RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS, RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR
} RenoWorkspacePendingKind;

typedef struct RenoWorkspacePending {
    RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind;
    size_t index;
    PyObject *actual_complete_borrowed; /* actual caller-owned filled NEW */
} RenoWorkspacePending;

/* Fixed known113 has its own acquisition history, separate from region R.
 * These checks bound the actual prefix and target id, not source/capacity
 * certificates for arbitrary State pointers. Actual owner/typed State/GIL
 * and the original source/lease premises precede every call.
 */
static int
reno_ws_known_destination(RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind, size_t index,
    unsigned int *slot)
{
    switch (kind) {
    case RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW:
    case RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS:
        if (index >= 6) { return 0; }
        *slot = 30 + 9 * (unsigned int)index
            + (kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW ? 4 : 6);
        return 1;
    case RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS:
        if (index >= 5) { return 0; }
        *slot = 103 + (unsigned int)index;
        return 1;
    case RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR:
        if (index >= 2) { return 0; }
        *slot = 28 + (unsigned int)index;
        return 1;
    default: return 0;
    }
}

static int
reno_ws_known_status(RenoState *state, unsigned int slot, int present)
{
    unsigned int index;
    unsigned int matches = 0;
    RenoKnownRoots *known = &state->arena.known;

    if (slot >= 113 || known->order_count > 113) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < known->order_count; ++index) {
        if (known->order[index] >= 113) { return 0; }
        if (known->order[index] == slot) { ++matches; }
    }
    return present ? (matches == 1 && known->owned[slot] == 1 && known->roots[slot] != NULL)
        : (matches == 0 && known->owned[slot] == 0 && known->roots[slot] == NULL);
}

static int
reno_ws_known_empty(RenoState *state, unsigned int slot)
{
    return state->arena.known.order_count < 113
        && reno_ws_known_status(state, slot, 0);
}

static int
reno_ws_fixed_targets_empty(RenoState *state)
{
    unsigned int index;

    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_empty(state, 34 + 9 * index)
                || !reno_ws_known_empty(state, 36 + 9 * index)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_empty(state, 103 + index)) { return 0; }
    }
    return reno_ws_known_empty(state, 28) && reno_ws_known_empty(state, 29);
}

static int
reno_ws_source_root(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field, int present)
{
    PyObject **slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, domain, index, field);

    if (slot == NULL) { return 0; }
    return present ? (*slot != NULL && reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot))
        : (*slot == NULL && !reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot));
}

static int
reno_ws_source_tuple(PyObject *tuple, size_t length)
{
    return tuple != NULL && PyTuple_CheckExact(tuple)
        && reno_ws_python_length(length)
        && PyTuple_GET_SIZE(tuple) == (Py_ssize_t)length;
}

/* Exact-string content equality, not pointer identity or unknown __eq__.
 * Full matching Unicode layout and the original exact-str roots precede it.
 * Used only inside this raw no-callback span; no hash/cache/API preparation.
 */
static int
reno_ws_source_text_equal(PyObject *left, PyObject *right)
{
    Py_ssize_t length;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    int left_kind;
    int right_kind;
    const void *left_data;
    const void *right_data;

    if (left == NULL || right == NULL
            || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(left) || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(right)) { return 0; }
    length = PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH(left);
    if (length != PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH(right)) { return 0; }
    left_kind = PyUnicode_KIND(left);
    right_kind = PyUnicode_KIND(right);
    left_data = PyUnicode_DATA(left);
    right_data = PyUnicode_DATA(right);
    for (index = 0; index < length; ++index) {
        if (PyUnicode_READ(left_kind, left_data, index)
                != PyUnicode_READ(right_kind, right_data, index)) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Caller has preflighted ALL keys as exact strings. Snapshot order is kept
 * in the output; freshness follows the original size/get semantics and does
 * not reject an equal-string key replacement or dictionary order change.
 */
/* Private observation, not a source certificate or module phase. Only the
 * old wrapper resolves the original default. No object borrow is returned.
 */
typedef enum RenoSourceLookupObservation {
    RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_INVALID = 0,
    RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_EXACT_MATCH = 1,
    RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_DIFFERENT_VALUE = 2,
    RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_NEED_ORIGINAL_DEFAULT = 3
} RenoSourceLookupObservation;

static RenoSourceLookupObservation
reno_ws_source_dict_observe(PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *expected_key,
    PyObject *expected_value)
{
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;

    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)
            || expected_key == NULL || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(expected_key)) {
        return RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_INVALID;
    }
    while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (reno_ws_source_text_equal(key, expected_key)) {
            return value == expected_value ? RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_EXACT_MATCH
                : RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_DIFFERENT_VALUE;
        }
    }
    /* Raw absence only. The original caller still owes its SAME actual
     * missing comparison; this nonzero enum is NOT boolean admission.
     */
    return RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_NEED_ORIGINAL_DEFAULT;
}

static int
reno_ws_source_dict_value(PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *expected_key,
    PyObject *expected_value, PyObject *original_missing_borrowed)
{
    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)
            || expected_key == NULL || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(expected_key)
            || original_missing_borrowed == NULL) { return 0; }
    switch (reno_ws_source_dict_observe(dictionary, expected_key, expected_value)) {
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_EXACT_MATCH:
        return 1;
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_NEED_ORIGINAL_DEFAULT:
        /* Original get default: absent MAY match this same actual M. */
        return expected_value == original_missing_borrowed;
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_DIFFERENT_VALUE:
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_INVALID:
    default:
        return 0;
    }
}

/* Raw state predicates only. Continuous original roots, active interpreter,
 * matching full ABI and no-native-rebind scope precede this span. NULL is
 * interpreted only for the three getter-visible nullable function fields;
 * empty containers and an empty cell are not normalized to Python None.
 */
typedef enum RenoMetadataNullableForm {
    RENO_METADATA_NATIVE_RAW = 0,
    RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE = 1
} RenoMetadataNullableForm;

static int
reno_function_metadata_matches(PyObject *actual_function, PyObject *code,
    PyObject *defaults, PyObject *keywords, PyObject *entries,
    PyObject *closure, PyObject *cells, PyObject *globals, PyObject *builtins,
    PyObject *original_missing_borrowed, RenoMetadataNullableForm form)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyObject *actual_defaults;
    PyObject *actual_keywords;
    PyObject *actual_closure;
    PyObject *entry;
    PyObject *cell;
    PyObject *populated;
    PyObject *contents;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    Py_ssize_t kw_count;
    Py_ssize_t cell_count;
    size_t count;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || actual_function == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_function, &PyFunction_Type) || code == NULL
            || original_missing_borrowed == NULL || entries == NULL || cells == NULL
            || (form != RENO_METADATA_NATIVE_RAW
                && form != RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE)) { return 0; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)actual_function;
    actual_defaults = function->func_defaults;
    actual_keywords = function->func_kwdefaults;
    actual_closure = function->func_closure;
    if (form == RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE) {
        if (actual_defaults == NULL) { actual_defaults = Py_None; }
        if (actual_keywords == NULL) { actual_keywords = Py_None; }
        if (actual_closure == NULL) { actual_closure = Py_None; }
    }
    if (function->func_code != code || actual_defaults != defaults
            || actual_keywords != keywords || actual_closure != closure
            || function->func_globals != globals || function->func_builtins != builtins
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(globals, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(builtins, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(entries) || !PyTuple_CheckExact(cells)) { return 0; }
    kw_count = PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entries);
    cell_count = PyTuple_GET_SIZE(cells);
    if (keywords == NULL || keywords == Py_None) {
        if (kw_count != 0) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(keywords, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || count != (size_t)kw_count) { return 0; }
        for (index = 0; index < kw_count; ++index) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, index);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                    || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0))
                    || !reno_ws_source_dict_value(keywords, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0),
                        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1), original_missing_borrowed)) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    if (closure == NULL || closure == Py_None) {
        if (cell_count != 0) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(closure, (size_t)cell_count)) { return 0; }
        for (index = 0; index < cell_count; ++index) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cells, index);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 3)) { return 0; }
            cell = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0);
            populated = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1);
            if (!Py_IS_TYPE(cell, &PyCell_Type)
                    || cell != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(closure, index)
                    || (populated != Py_True && populated != Py_False)) { return 0; }
            contents = PyCell_GET(cell);
            if (populated == Py_False) {
                if (contents != NULL) { return 0; }
                /* Empty original getter branch does not compare item2. */
            } else if (contents == NULL || contents != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 2)) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    /* No dispatch condition here: Python tuple9 consumption has none. */
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_function_row_metadata_matches(PyObject *row, PyObject *original_missing_borrowed)
{
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(row, 9)) { return 0; }
    return reno_function_metadata_matches(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 0),
        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 1), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 2), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 3),
        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 4), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 5), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 6),
        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 7), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 8), original_missing_borrowed,
        RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE);
}

/* S1 source-only predicate. A missing recorded key is a deliberate SOURCE
 * rejection, never the original business get(key, SAME actual M) semantics.
 * This is a consumption-time raw observation, not write-history monitoring.
 */
static int
reno_t0_source_dict_value(PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *expected_key,
    PyObject *expected_value)
{
    switch (reno_ws_source_dict_observe(dictionary, expected_key, expected_value)) {
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_EXACT_MATCH:
        return 1;
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_DIFFERENT_VALUE:
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_INVALID:
    case RENO_SOURCE_LOOKUP_NEED_ORIGINAL_DEFAULT:
    default:
        return 0;
    }
}

/* PRIVATE T0 records only: empty cells are tuple2, populated cells tuple3.
 * Nullable raw/visible fields are a separate dimension. No business row is
 * accepted by guessing a caller from shape; existing source callers select
 * this checker explicitly. It adds no getter/audit/NEW or source grant.
 */
static int
reno_t0_function_metadata_matches(PyObject *actual_function, PyObject *code,
    PyObject *defaults, PyObject *keywords, PyObject *entries,
    PyObject *closure, PyObject *cells, PyObject *globals, PyObject *builtins,
    RenoMetadataNullableForm form)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyObject *actual_defaults;
    PyObject *actual_keywords;
    PyObject *actual_closure;
    PyObject *entry;
    PyObject *cell;
    PyObject *populated;
    PyObject *contents;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    Py_ssize_t kw_count;
    Py_ssize_t cell_count;
    size_t count;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || actual_function == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_function, &PyFunction_Type) || code == NULL
            || entries == NULL || cells == NULL
            || (form != RENO_METADATA_NATIVE_RAW
                && form != RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE)) { return 0; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)actual_function;
    actual_defaults = function->func_defaults;
    actual_keywords = function->func_kwdefaults;
    actual_closure = function->func_closure;
    if (form == RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE) {
        if (actual_defaults == NULL) { actual_defaults = Py_None; }
        if (actual_keywords == NULL) { actual_keywords = Py_None; }
        if (actual_closure == NULL) { actual_closure = Py_None; }
    }
    if (function->func_code != code || actual_defaults != defaults
            || actual_keywords != keywords || actual_closure != closure
            || function->func_globals != globals || function->func_builtins != builtins
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(globals, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(builtins, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(entries) || !PyTuple_CheckExact(cells)) { return 0; }
    kw_count = PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entries);
    cell_count = PyTuple_GET_SIZE(cells);
    if (keywords == NULL || keywords == Py_None) {
        if (kw_count != 0) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(keywords, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || count != (size_t)kw_count) { return 0; }
        for (index = 0; index < kw_count; ++index) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, index);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                    || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0))
                    || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(keywords, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0),
                        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1))) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    if (closure == NULL || closure == Py_None) {
        if (cell_count != 0) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(closure, (size_t)cell_count)) { return 0; }
        for (index = 0; index < cell_count; ++index) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cells, index);
            if (entry == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(entry)
                    || PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entry) < 2) { return 0; }
            cell = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0);
            populated = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1);
            if (!Py_IS_TYPE(cell, &PyCell_Type)
                    || cell != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(closure, index)
                    || (populated != Py_True && populated != Py_False)
                    || PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entry) != (populated == Py_True ? 3 : 2)) { return 0; }
            contents = PyCell_GET(cell);
            if (populated == Py_False) {
                if (contents != NULL) { return 0; }
                /* Private empty T0 row has no item2 and no business missing. */
            } else if (contents == NULL || contents != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 2)) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    /* Snapshot consistency only; caller still owes its separate source/dispatch gates. */
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_t0_function_row_metadata_matches(PyObject *row)
{
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(row, 9)) { return 0; }
    return reno_t0_function_metadata_matches(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 0),
        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 1), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 2), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 3),
        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 4), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 5), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 6),
        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 7), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 8),
        RENO_METADATA_PYTHON_VISIBLE);
}

/* State-owned records only; no workspace/outer borrow survives into this
 * raw span. Actual module/lease/State, original T0 roots, matching full ABI
 * and no-native-rebind domain are caller obligations; no future M is needed.
 * This is a finite metadata STATE predicate, not the original getter/audit/
 * error/NEW/finally effect, full check_view, or a D1/D2 admission certificate.
 */
static int
reno_state_function_metadata_matches(RenoState *state, unsigned int row)
{
    unsigned int base;
    unsigned int field;
    int present;
    PyObject **roots;
    RenoFunctionRowControl *control;
    RenoFunctionDispatchControl *dispatch;
    PyFunctionObject *function;

    if (state == NULL || row >= 6
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    base = 30 + 9 * row;
    control = &state->controls.function_rows[row];
    dispatch = &state->controls.function_dispatch[row];
    if (control->row_ready != 1 || control->representation_ready[0] != 1
            || control->representation_ready[1] != 1) { return 0; }
    for (field = 0; field < 7; ++field) {
        if (control->raw_captured[field] != 1) { return 0; }
    }
    for (field = 0; field < 9; ++field) {
        present = field == 2 ? control->present[0]
            : (field == 3 ? control->present[1]
                : (field == 5 ? control->present[2] : 1));
        if (present > 1 || !reno_ws_known_status(state, base + field, present)) { return 0; }
    }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    if (!reno_t0_function_metadata_matches(roots[base], roots[base + 1],
            roots[base + 2], roots[base + 3], roots[base + 4], roots[base + 5],
            roots[base + 6], roots[base + 7], roots[base + 8],
            RENO_METADATA_NATIVE_RAW)) { return 0; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)roots[base]; /* common body proved exact function */
    /* Source identity only, including an actually captured NULL slot.
     * Implementation lifetime and actual-call admission remain separate;
     * no saved or current implementation is called by this predicate.
     */
    return dispatch->captured == 1
        && function->vectorcall == dispatch->expected && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_state_functions_metadata_match(RenoState *state)
{
    unsigned int row;

    for (row = 0; row < 6; ++row) {
        if (!reno_state_function_metadata_matches(state, row)) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* These expected records were captured, constructed and source/product
 * checked BEFORE region drain. State tuple/known owning edges continue here;
 * no current MRO/dictionary/function is first observed to invent expected.
 * This raw exact-backing-dict subroute is not full check_view/source/effect.
 */
static int
reno_state_module_metadata_matches(RenoState *state)
{
    static const unsigned char modules[4] = {1, 4, 23, 25};
    static const unsigned char dictionaries[4] = {2, 5, 24, 26};
    unsigned int index;
    size_t count;
    PyObject *module;
    PyObject *dictionary;

    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 4; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, modules[index], 1)
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, dictionaries[index], 1)) { return 0; }
        module = state->arena.known.roots[modules[index]];
        dictionary = state->arena.known.roots[dictionaries[index]];
        if (!PyModule_CheckExact(module)
                || ((PyModuleObject *)module)->md_dict != dictionary
                || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return 0; }
    }
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_state_class_metadata_matches(RenoState *state, unsigned int index)
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    unsigned int slot;
    Py_ssize_t base_index;
    Py_ssize_t entry_index;
    Py_ssize_t dispatch_index;
    size_t count;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *dispatch;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *entry;

    if (state == NULL || index >= 5
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    slot = 103 + index;
    if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, slot, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, classes[index], 1)) { return 0; }
    snapshot = state->arena.known.roots[slot];
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)) { return 0; }
    klass = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0);
    mro = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
    bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
    dispatch = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 3);
    if (klass != state->arena.known.roots[classes[index]]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(klass, &PyType_Type)
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro) || ((PyTypeObject *)klass)->tp_mro != mro
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(bases) || !PyTuple_CheckExact(dispatch)
            || PyTuple_GET_SIZE(bases) != PyTuple_GET_SIZE(mro)) { return 0; }
    for (base_index = 0; base_index < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(bases); ++base_index) {
        base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, base_index);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2)) { return 0; }
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0);
        entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type) || base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, base_index)
                || !PyTuple_CheckExact(entries)) { return 0; }
        dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base); /* borrowed raw active-interpreter route */
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || count != (size_t)PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entries)) { return 0; }
        for (entry_index = 0; entry_index < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entries); ++entry_index) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, entry_index);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                    || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0))
                    || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(dictionary, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0),
                        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1))) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    /* Original check_view consumes the recorded dispatch batch without
     * reconstructing descriptor links. Retained source/product checks still
     * own that distinct proof; no class dispatch vectorcall gate is added.
     */
    for (dispatch_index = 0; dispatch_index < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(dispatch); ++dispatch_index) {
        if (!reno_t0_function_row_metadata_matches(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dispatch, dispatch_index))) { return 0; }
    }
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* State holds the ORIGINAL T0 scalar facts and the two actual anchor returns.
 * Those anchors survived the separately checked outer-root drain. This body
 * never samples current fields to create expected; it does not check the exec
 * alias, grant call-ABI/D1 admission or execute a builtin/getter/audit effect.
 * Actual continuous State/module roots, active interpreter, matching full ABI
 * and the original no-native-rebind domain remain caller obligations.
 */
static int
reno_state_builtin_exec_matches(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *control;
    PyCFunctionObject *builtin;
    PyObject *anchor;
    PyObject *expected[2] = {NULL, NULL}; /* raw absence, not Python None */
    unsigned int index;

    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 27, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 28, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 29, 1)) { return 0; }
    control = &state->controls.builtin_exec;
    if (control->ready != 1) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 4; ++index) {
        if (control->scalar_captured[index] != 1) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        if (control->payload_captured[index] != 1 || control->anchor_ready[index] != 1
                || control->present[index] > 1) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(state->arena.known.roots[27], &PyCFunction_Type)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        anchor = state->arena.known.roots[28 + index];
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(anchor, control->present[index])) { return 0; }
        if (control->present[index]) {
            expected[index] = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(anchor, 0);
        }
    }
    builtin = (PyCFunctionObject *)state->arena.known.roots[27];
    /* No added non-NULL requirement for function/vectorcall: compare original
     * captured facts. Their actual call legality/ABI is a separate obligation.
     */
    return builtin->m_ml != NULL && builtin->m_ml == control->methoddef
        && builtin->m_ml->ml_meth == control->function
        && builtin->m_ml->ml_flags == control->flags
        && builtin->vectorcall == control->vectorcall
        && builtin->m_self == expected[0] && builtin->m_module == expected[1]
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_ws_source_ascii(PyObject *dictionary, const char *name,
    Py_ssize_t length, PyObject *expected_value)
{
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;

    while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (exact_ascii_name(key, name, length)) { return value == expected_value; }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Checked storage planning and original raw metadata counts only.
 * No complete getter/source/ABI or actual allocator grant.
 */
static int
reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *left,
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *right)
{
    return left->accessors == right->accessors && left->functions == right->functions
        && left->keywords == right->keywords && left->cells == right->cells
        && left->populated == right->populated && left->nullable == right->nullable;
}


/* Selected exact builtin T_OBJECT/READONLY member. A non-NULL return is
 * a real NEW, including visible None. No arbitrary descriptor binding.
 * Actual builtin/member/ABI/reference source is an independent premise.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_spec_meta_member_new(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;

    if (descriptor == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, builtin_type)) { return NULL; }
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members; member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT || member->flags != READONLY) { return NULL; }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) { return NULL; }
    return PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
}


static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_meta_count_value(PyObject *candidate, RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *counts)
{
    RenoWorkspaceHeader temporary = {0}; /* scalar counts only, not a view */
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    size_t K;
    size_t Z;
    size_t nullable;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || candidate == NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    if (!reno_ws_add(counts->accessors, 1, &counts->accessors)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(candidate, &PyFunction_Type)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)candidate;
    if (function->func_code == NULL || function->func_globals == NULL
            || function->func_builtins == NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE; }
    status = reno_ws_count_metadata(function->func_globals, function->func_builtins,
        function->func_kwdefaults, function->func_closure, &temporary, &K, &Z);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    if (status == RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE; }
    if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
    nullable = (function->func_defaults != NULL) + (function->func_kwdefaults != NULL)
        + (function->func_closure != NULL);
    if (!reno_ws_add(counts->functions, 1, &counts->functions)
            || !reno_ws_add(counts->keywords, K, &counts->keywords)
            || !reno_ws_add(counts->cells, Z, &counts->cells)
            || !reno_ws_add(counts->populated, temporary.P, &counts->populated)
            || !reno_ws_add(counts->nullable, nullable, &counts->nullable)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
    return RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT;
}


static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_meta_count_accessor(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name, RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *counts)
{
    PyObject *actual_new = reno_spec_meta_member_new(descriptor, builtin_type, name);
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus status;

    if (actual_new == NULL) {
        return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL ? RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE : RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE;
    }
    status = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL ? reno_spec_meta_count_value(actual_new, counts) : RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE;
    /* Same independently rooted member/nonlast or immortal None envelope
     * as the existing class helper. Every non-NULL NEW is settled here.
     */
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL ? status : RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE;
}


static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_meta_count_entry(PyObject *value, RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *counts)
{
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus status;

    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        status = reno_spec_meta_count_accessor(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", counts);
        if (status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT) { return status; }
        status = reno_spec_meta_count_accessor(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", counts);
        if (status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT) { return status; }
        return reno_spec_meta_count_accessor(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", counts);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return reno_spec_meta_count_accessor(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", counts);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return reno_spec_meta_count_accessor(value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", counts);
    }
    return reno_spec_meta_count_value(value, counts);
}


static int
reno_spec_mro_storage_layout(size_t bases, size_t entries,
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *metadata, RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *out)
{
    RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout layout = {0};
    size_t cursor = sizeof(RenoSpecMroCaptureHeader);
    size_t common = 0;
    size_t term;
    size_t nullable_limit;

    if (bases == 0 || !reno_ws_python_length(bases) || !reno_ws_python_length(entries)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(metadata->accessors) || !reno_ws_python_length(metadata->functions)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(metadata->keywords) || !reno_ws_python_length(metadata->cells)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(metadata->populated) || !reno_ws_python_length(metadata->nullable)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(metadata->functions, 3, &nullable_limit)
            || metadata->functions > metadata->accessors || metadata->nullable > nullable_limit
            || metadata->populated > metadata->cells
            || !reno_ws_multiply(bases, 2, &common)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(entries, 3, &term) || !reno_ws_add(common, term, &common)
            || !reno_ws_add(common, metadata->accessors, &common)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(metadata->keywords, 2, &term) || !reno_ws_add(common, term, &common)) { return 0; }
    layout.ledger_capacity = common;
    layout.expected_acquired = common;
    if (!reno_ws_multiply(metadata->functions, 7, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout.ledger_capacity, term, &layout.ledger_capacity)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(metadata->cells, 2, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout.ledger_capacity, term, &layout.ledger_capacity)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(metadata->functions, 4, &term)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout.expected_acquired, term, &layout.expected_acquired)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout.expected_acquired, metadata->nullable, &layout.expected_acquired)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout.expected_acquired, metadata->cells, &layout.expected_acquired)
            || !reno_ws_add(layout.expected_acquired, metadata->populated, &layout.expected_acquired)
            || layout.expected_acquired > layout.ledger_capacity) { return 0; }
    layout.base_count = bases;
    layout.entry_count = entries;
    layout.metadata = *metadata;
    layout.required_alignment = __alignof(RenoSpecMroCaptureHeader);
#define RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(COUNT, TYPE, OFFSET) \
    do { \
        if (__alignof(TYPE) > layout.required_alignment) { layout.required_alignment = __alignof(TYPE); } \
        if (!reno_ws_reserve_array(&cursor, (COUNT), sizeof(TYPE), __alignof(TYPE), &layout.OFFSET)) { return 0; } \
    } while (0)
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(bases, RenoSpecMroBaseCapture, base_offset);
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(entries, RenoSpecMroEntryCapture, entry_offset);
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(metadata->accessors, RenoSpecAccessorCapture, accessor_offset);
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(metadata->functions, RenoSpecFunctionCapture, function_offset);
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(metadata->keywords, RenoSpecKwCapture, kw_offset);
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(metadata->cells, RenoSpecCellCapture, cell_offset);
    RENO_SPEC_RESERVE(layout.ledger_capacity, RenoSpecMroLedgerEntry, ledger_offset);
#undef RENO_SPEC_RESERVE
    if (!reno_ws_python_length(cursor)) { return 0; }
    layout.requested_bytes = cursor;
    *out = layout;
    return 1;
}


static int
reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *left,
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *right)
{
    return left->base_count == right->base_count && left->entry_count == right->entry_count
        && reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&left->metadata, &right->metadata)
        && left->base_offset == right->base_offset && left->entry_offset == right->entry_offset
        && left->accessor_offset == right->accessor_offset && left->function_offset == right->function_offset
        && left->kw_offset == right->kw_offset && left->cell_offset == right->cell_offset
        && left->ledger_capacity == right->ledger_capacity && left->expected_acquired == right->expected_acquired
        && left->ledger_offset == right->ledger_offset && left->requested_bytes == right->requested_bytes
        && left->required_alignment == right->required_alignment;
}


static int
reno_spec_mro_inventory_empty(const RenoSpecMroInventory *inventory)
{
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout empty_layout = {0};
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts empty_metadata = {0};

    return inventory->route == RENO_SPEC_MRO_UNCAPTURED && inventory->mro_length == 0
        && inventory->base_count == 0 && inventory->entry_count == 0
        && inventory->minimum_owning_occurrences == 0 && inventory->minimum_pointer_bytes == 0
        && reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&inventory->metadata, &empty_metadata)
        && reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(&inventory->capture_layout, &empty_layout);
}


/* Counts only, conditional on the original full-API/member/reference/S1
 * envelope. Selected member NEWs are real temporary reference effects.
 */
static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_mro_inventory_raw(const RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec, RenoSpecMroInventory *out)
{
    RenoSpecMroInventory inventory = {0};
    RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout empty_layout = {0};
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts empty_metadata = {0};
    PyObject *original_mro = spec->mro;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    size_t index;
    size_t entries;
    size_t observed;
    size_t base_edges;
    size_t entry_edges;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus meta_status;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || original_mro == NULL
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(original_mro)
            || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyTuple_GET_SIZE(original_mro), &inventory.mro_length)
            || inventory.mro_length == 0
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(original_mro, 0) != spec->klass) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    for (index = 0; index < inventory.mro_length; ++index) {
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(original_mro, (Py_ssize_t)index);
        if (base == NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)) { goto needs_route; }
        dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base);
        status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &entries);
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
        if (status == RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE) { goto needs_route; }
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || !reno_ws_add(inventory.base_count, 1, &inventory.base_count)
                || !reno_ws_add(inventory.entry_count, entries, &inventory.entry_count)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
        position = 0;
        observed = 0;
        while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (key == NULL || value == NULL || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(key)) { goto needs_route; }
            meta_status = reno_spec_meta_count_entry(value, &inventory.metadata);
            if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || meta_status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
            if (meta_status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) { goto needs_route; }
            if (meta_status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT
                    || !reno_ws_add(observed, 1, &observed)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
        }
        if (observed != entries) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    }
    /* Original base/dict/key/value pointer LOWER BOUND remains separate
     * from the full metadata bank and its nullable ledger capacity.
     */
    if (!reno_ws_multiply(inventory.base_count, 2, &base_edges)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(inventory.entry_count, 2, &entry_edges)
            || !reno_ws_add(base_edges, entry_edges, &inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences, sizeof(PyObject *),
                &inventory.minimum_pointer_bytes)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(inventory.minimum_pointer_bytes)
            || !reno_spec_mro_storage_layout(inventory.base_count, inventory.entry_count,
                &inventory.metadata, &inventory.capture_layout)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    inventory.route = RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT;
    *out = inventory;
    return RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT;

needs_route:
    /* Preserve mro_length only; partial metadata/offsets are not usable. */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    inventory.base_count = 0;
    inventory.entry_count = 0;
    inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences = 0;
    inventory.minimum_pointer_bytes = 0;
    inventory.metadata = empty_metadata;
    inventory.capture_layout = empty_layout;
    inventory.route = RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE;
    *out = inventory;
    return RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE;
}


static int
reno_spec_mro_inventory_matches(const RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec)
{
    RenoSpecMroInventory actual = {0};
    const RenoSpecMroInventory *expected = &spec->inventory;
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus status;

    if (expected->route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT
            && expected->route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) { return 0; }
    status = reno_spec_mro_inventory_raw(spec, &actual);
    return (status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT || status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE)
        && actual.route == expected->route && actual.mro_length == expected->mro_length
        && actual.base_count == expected->base_count && actual.entry_count == expected->entry_count
        && actual.minimum_owning_occurrences == expected->minimum_owning_occurrences
        && actual.minimum_pointer_bytes == expected->minimum_pointer_bytes
        && reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&actual.metadata, &expected->metadata)
        && reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(&actual.capture_layout, &expected->capture_layout)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


/* Actual caller's module/State/current/GIL/owning lifetime premises precede
 * these reads. This checks independent ORIGINAL root/binding observations;
 * it does NOT qualify any actual spec, descriptor or dict materialization.
 */
static int
reno_spec_source_roots_match(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;
    PyThreadState *tstate;
    PyInterpreterState *interp;
    PyTypeObject *klass;
    PyObject **roots;
    size_t count;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || state == NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ROOTS_FROZEN
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_PREPARING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_INSTALLING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE)) { return 0; }
    spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    if (spec->acquired != 3 || spec->layout_captured != 1
            || spec->klass == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(spec->klass, &PyType_Type)
            || spec->dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(spec->dictionary)
            || spec->mro == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(spec->mro)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 0, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 23, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 24, 1)) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    tstate = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (tstate == NULL) { return 0; }
    interp = tstate->interp;
    if (interp == NULL || interp->imports.modules != roots[0]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib", 17, roots[23])
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(roots[23])
            || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[23])->md_dict != roots[24]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[24], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[24], "ModuleSpec", 10, spec->klass)) { return 0; }
    klass = (PyTypeObject *)spec->klass;
    return _PyType_GetDict(klass) == spec->dictionary && klass->tp_mro == spec->mro
        && klass->tp_getattro == spec->observed_getattro
        && klass->tp_getattr == spec->observed_getattr
        && klass->tp_basicsize == spec->observed_basicsize
        && klass->tp_itemsize == spec->observed_itemsize
        && klass->tp_dictoffset == spec->observed_dictoffset
        && klass->tp_weaklistoffset == spec->observed_weaklistoffset
        && (klass->tp_flags & RENO_SPEC_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK) == spec->observed_flags
        && reno_spec_mro_inventory_matches(spec)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


/* The complete comparator is defined before raw inventory above. */


static int
reno_spec_mro_region_empty(const RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region)
{
    return region->allocation == NULL && region->allocation_bytes == 0
        && region->header == NULL && region->base == NULL
        && region->entry == NULL && region->accessor == NULL && region->function == NULL
        && region->kw == NULL && region->cell == NULL && region->ledger == NULL
        && region->initialized == 0;
}


/* Sole native producer for this private region. Actual caller/State/module
 * lifetime and the selected trusted normal allocator/build precede entry.
 * The wrapper does not authenticate actual CRT/M/config or its S1 effects.
 */
static int
reno_spec_mro_native_allocate_original(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout canonical = {0};
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;
    RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region;

    if (!reno_spec_source_roots_match(state)
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0) { return 0; }
    spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    region = &spec->region;
    if (spec->inventory.route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT
            || !reno_spec_mro_region_empty(region)
            || !reno_spec_mro_storage_layout(spec->inventory.base_count,
                spec->inventory.entry_count, &spec->inventory.metadata, &canonical)
            || !reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(&canonical, &spec->inventory.capture_layout)
            || canonical.requested_bytes == 0) { return 0; }
    /* Actual module/entered ownership spans the allocator. Record the
     * original return, without offsets/adoption, before any later callout.
     */
    region->allocation = malloc(canonical.requested_bytes);
    region->allocation_bytes = region->allocation == NULL ? 0 : canonical.requested_bytes;
    if (region->allocation == NULL) {
        reno_common_request_retirement(state);
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { PyErr_NoMemory(); }
        return 0;
    }
    /* Rejection only. Same counts after an unadmitted callback are NOT
     * a new certificate for contents which existed before the allocator.
     */
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && reno_spec_source_roots_match(state);
}


/* Actual original malloc block and live owner precede this bind. All range
 * checks complete BEFORE any uninitialized header read or typed store.
 */
static int
reno_spec_mro_region_bind_initialize(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *layout)
{
    RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout canonical = {0};
    RenoSpecMroCaptureHeader empty_header = {0};
    RenoSpecMroBaseCapture empty_base = {0};
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture empty_entry = {0};
    RenoSpecAccessorCapture empty_accessor = {0};
    RenoSpecFunctionCapture empty_function = {0};
    RenoSpecKwCapture empty_kw = {0};
    RenoSpecCellCapture empty_cell = {0};
    void *base_address = NULL;
    void *entry_address = NULL;
    void *accessor_address = NULL;
    void *function_address = NULL;
    void *kw_address = NULL;
    void *cell_address = NULL;
    void *ledger_address = NULL;
    unsigned char *raw;
    size_t index;

    if (region->allocation == NULL || region->initialized != 0
            || region->header != NULL || region->base != NULL || region->entry != NULL
            || region->accessor != NULL || region->function != NULL
