            || region->kw != NULL || region->cell != NULL || region->ledger != NULL
            || !reno_spec_mro_storage_layout(layout->base_count, layout->entry_count, &layout->metadata, &canonical)
            || !reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(layout, &canonical)
            || region->allocation_bytes < layout->requested_bytes
            || sizeof(RenoSpecMroCaptureHeader) > region->allocation_bytes
            || layout->required_alignment == 0
            || (uintptr_t)region->allocation % layout->required_alignment != 0) { return 0; }
    raw = (unsigned char *)region->allocation;
    if (!reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->base_offset,
                layout->base_count, sizeof(RenoSpecMroBaseCapture), __alignof(RenoSpecMroBaseCapture), &base_address)
            || !reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->entry_offset,
                layout->entry_count, sizeof(RenoSpecMroEntryCapture), __alignof(RenoSpecMroEntryCapture), &entry_address)
            || !reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->accessor_offset,
                layout->metadata.accessors, sizeof(RenoSpecAccessorCapture), __alignof(RenoSpecAccessorCapture), &accessor_address)
            || !reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->function_offset,
                layout->metadata.functions, sizeof(RenoSpecFunctionCapture), __alignof(RenoSpecFunctionCapture), &function_address)
            || !reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->kw_offset,
                layout->metadata.keywords, sizeof(RenoSpecKwCapture), __alignof(RenoSpecKwCapture), &kw_address)
            || !reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->cell_offset,
                layout->metadata.cells, sizeof(RenoSpecCellCapture), __alignof(RenoSpecCellCapture), &cell_address)
            || !reno_ws_array_address(raw, region->allocation_bytes, layout->ledger_offset,
                layout->ledger_capacity, sizeof(RenoSpecMroLedgerEntry), __alignof(RenoSpecMroLedgerEntry), &ledger_address)) { return 0; }
    region->header = (RenoSpecMroCaptureHeader *)region->allocation;
    region->base = (RenoSpecMroBaseCapture *)base_address;
    region->entry = (RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *)entry_address;
    region->accessor = (RenoSpecAccessorCapture *)accessor_address;
    region->function = (RenoSpecFunctionCapture *)function_address;
    region->kw = (RenoSpecKwCapture *)kw_address;
    region->cell = (RenoSpecCellCapture *)cell_address;
    region->ledger = (RenoSpecMroLedgerEntry *)ledger_address;
    *region->header = empty_header;
    region->header->layout = *layout;
    /* Complete semantic NULL/zero initialization before any reference is
     * acquired. No callout/failure branch occurs during these loops.
     */
    for (index = 0; index < layout->base_count; ++index) {
        region->base[index] = empty_base;
        ++region->header->initialized_bases;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->entry_count; ++index) {
        region->entry[index] = empty_entry;
        ++region->header->initialized_entries;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->metadata.accessors; ++index) {
        region->accessor[index] = empty_accessor;
        ++region->header->initialized_accessors;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->metadata.functions; ++index) {
        region->function[index] = empty_function;
        ++region->header->initialized_functions;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->metadata.keywords; ++index) {
        region->kw[index] = empty_kw;
        ++region->header->initialized_keywords;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->metadata.cells; ++index) {
        region->cell[index] = empty_cell;
        ++region->header->initialized_cells;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->ledger_capacity; ++index) {
        region->ledger[index].slot_address = NULL;
    }
    region->header->phase = RENO_SPEC_BANK_INITIALIZED;
    region->initialized = 1;
    return 1;
}


/* Only the actual capture below supplies slot addresses in this stable,
 * initialized bank. Each occurrence is committed even for object aliases.
 */
static int
reno_spec_mro_region_own(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    PyObject **slot, PyObject *value)
{
    size_t index = region->header->ledger_count;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || *slot != NULL || value == NULL
            || index >= region->header->layout.ledger_capacity) { return 0; }
    *slot = Py_NewRef(value);
    region->ledger[index].slot_address = slot;
    region->header->ledger_count = index + 1;
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


static int
reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(const RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    PyObject **slot, size_t *cursor)
{
    if (*cursor >= region->header->ledger_count
            || region->ledger[*cursor].slot_address != slot) { return 0; }
    ++*cursor;
    return 1;
}


/* Original value/type roots, selected full ABI and the same trusted T0
 * reference/no-callout span precede this acquisition. These typed slots
 * are identity observations, not descriptor execution/source admission.
 */
static int
reno_spec_entry_protocol_capture(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    size_t entry_index, PyObject *value)
{
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *row;
    PyTypeObject *original_type;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || value == NULL
            || entry_index >= region->header->layout.entry_count) { return 0; }
    row = &region->entry[entry_index];
    if (row->key == NULL || row->value != value || row->descriptor_protocol_captured != 0) { return 0; }
    original_type = Py_TYPE(value);
    if (original_type == NULL
            || !reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &row->descriptor_type, (PyObject *)original_type)) { return 0; }
    row->observed_descr_get = original_type->tp_descr_get;
    row->observed_descr_set = original_type->tp_descr_set;
    row->descriptor_protocol_captured = 1; /* history only */
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


static int
reno_spec_entry_protocol_matches(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    size_t entry_index, PyObject *value, size_t *ledger_at)
{
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *row;
    PyTypeObject *actual_type;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || value == NULL
            || entry_index >= region->header->layout.entry_count) { return 0; }
    row = &region->entry[entry_index];
    actual_type = Py_TYPE(value);
    if (row->value != value || row->descriptor_protocol_captured != 1
            || row->descriptor_type == NULL || actual_type == NULL
            || (PyObject *)actual_type != row->descriptor_type
            || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &row->descriptor_type, ledger_at)) { return 0; }
    /* No exact-metaclass restriction, trampoline invocation or payload
     * inference. Same C slots do not prove the type's Python MRO/bindings.
     */
    return actual_type->tp_descr_get == row->observed_descr_get
        && actual_type->tp_descr_set == row->observed_descr_set
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


/* Fixed scalar progress only. All variable-sized owning records live in
 * the original bound bank; initialized rows cover every partial failure.
 */
static int
reno_spec_meta_capture_function(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t accessor_index, PyObject *candidate)
{
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *limit = &region->header->layout.metadata;
    RenoWorkspaceHeader counted = {0};
    RenoSpecFunctionCapture *row;
    RenoSpecKwCapture *kw;
    RenoSpecCellCapture *cell_row;
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyObject *fields[7]; /* fixed raw borrows, never a hidden D-sized bank */
    PyObject **slots[7];
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    PyObject *cell;
    PyObject *contents;
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    size_t K;
    size_t Z;
    size_t N;
    size_t index;
    size_t ordinal = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(candidate, &PyFunction_Type)
            || accessor_index >= limit->accessors || cursor->functions >= limit->functions
            || cursor->keywords > limit->keywords || cursor->cells > limit->cells
            || cursor->populated > limit->populated || cursor->nullable > limit->nullable) { return 0; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)candidate;
    fields[0] = candidate;
    fields[1] = function->func_code;
    fields[2] = function->func_defaults;
    fields[3] = function->func_kwdefaults;
    fields[4] = function->func_closure;
    fields[5] = function->func_globals;
    fields[6] = function->func_builtins;
    N = (fields[2] != NULL) + (fields[3] != NULL) + (fields[4] != NULL);
    if (fields[1] == NULL || fields[5] == NULL || fields[6] == NULL
            || reno_ws_count_metadata(fields[5], fields[6], fields[3], fields[4],
                &counted, &K, &Z) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || K > limit->keywords - cursor->keywords || Z > limit->cells - cursor->cells
            || counted.P > limit->populated - cursor->populated
            || N > limit->nullable - cursor->nullable) { return 0; }
    row = &region->function[cursor->functions];
    row->accessor_index = accessor_index;
    row->kw_start = cursor->keywords;
    row->cell_start = cursor->cells;
    row->defaults_present = fields[2] != NULL;
    row->kw_present = fields[3] != NULL;
    row->closure_present = fields[4] != NULL;
    row->original_vectorcall = function->vectorcall; /* identity only, including NULL */
    slots[0] = &row->function;
    slots[1] = &row->code;
    slots[2] = &row->defaults;
    slots[3] = &row->kwdefaults;
    slots[4] = &row->closure;
    slots[5] = &row->globals;
    slots[6] = &row->builtins;
    for (index = 0; index < 7; ++index) {
        if (fields[index] != NULL
                && !reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, slots[index], fields[index])) { return 0; }
    }
    if (fields[3] != NULL && fields[3] != Py_None) {
        while (PyDict_Next(fields[3], &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (ordinal >= K) { return 0; }
            kw = &region->kw[cursor->keywords + ordinal];
            kw->function_index = cursor->functions;
            kw->ordinal = ordinal;
            if (!reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &kw->key, key)
                    || !reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &kw->value, value)) { return 0; }
            ++row->kw_count;
            ++region->header->captured_keywords;
            ++ordinal;
        }
    }
    if (ordinal != K) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < Z; ++index) {
        cell = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(fields[4], (Py_ssize_t)index);
        if (cell == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(cell, &PyCell_Type)) { return 0; }
        cell_row = &region->cell[cursor->cells + index];
        cell_row->function_index = cursor->functions;
        cell_row->ordinal = index;
        if (!reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &cell_row->cell, cell)) { return 0; }
        contents = PyCell_GET(cell);
        if (contents != NULL) {
            if (!reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &cell_row->contents, contents)) { return 0; }
            cell_row->populated = 1;
            ++region->header->captured_populated;
        }
        ++row->cell_count;
        ++region->header->captured_cells;
    }
    cursor->keywords += K;
    cursor->cells += Z;
    cursor->populated += counted.P;
    cursor->nullable += N;
    region->header->captured_nullable += N;
    ++cursor->functions;
    ++region->header->captured_functions;
    row->captured = 1;
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, unsigned char role,
    PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *member_name)
{
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *layout = &region->header->layout;
    RenoSpecAccessorCapture *row;
    PyObject *actual_new;
    size_t ledger_at;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || entry_index >= layout->entry_count
            || cursor->accessors >= layout->metadata.accessors) { return 0; }
    row = &region->accessor[cursor->accessors];
    row->entry_index = entry_index;
    row->role = role;
    if (builtin_type == NULL) {
        if (!reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &row->value, descriptor)) { return 0; }
    } else {
        ledger_at = region->header->ledger_count;
        if (row->value != NULL || ledger_at >= layout->ledger_capacity) { return 0; }
        actual_new = reno_spec_meta_member_new(descriptor, builtin_type, member_name);
        if (actual_new == NULL) { return 0; }
        /* Transfer every returned NEW immediately, even if it carried an
         * actual error indicator. No fallible branch can orphan this debt.
         */
        row->value = actual_new;
        actual_new = NULL;
        region->ledger[ledger_at].slot_address = &row->value;
        region->header->ledger_count = ledger_at + 1;
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(row->value, &PyFunction_Type)) {
        row->has_function = 1;
        row->function_index = cursor->functions;
        if (!reno_spec_meta_capture_function(region, cursor, cursor->accessors, row->value)) { return 0; }
    }
    row->captured = 1;
    ++cursor->accessors;
    ++region->header->captured_accessors;
    ++region->entry[entry_index].accessor_count;
    return 1;
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_capture_entry(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, PyObject *value)
{
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *row;

    if (entry_index >= region->header->layout.entry_count) { return 0; }
    row = &region->entry[entry_index];
    row->accessor_start = cursor->accessors;
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        row->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY;
        return reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget")
            && reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset")
            && reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel");
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        row->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC;
        return reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC,
            value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__");
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        row->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS;
        return reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS,
            value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__");
    }
    row->descriptor_role = RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN;
    return reno_spec_meta_capture_accessor(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN,
        value, NULL, NULL);
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_function_matches(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t accessor_index, PyObject *candidate,
    size_t *ledger_at)
{
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *limit = &region->header->layout.metadata;
    RenoWorkspaceHeader counted = {0};
    RenoSpecFunctionCapture *row;
    RenoSpecKwCapture *kw;
    RenoSpecCellCapture *cell_row;
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyObject *fields[7];
    PyObject **slots[7];
    PyObject *cell;
    PyObject *contents;
    size_t K;
    size_t Z;
    size_t N;
    size_t index;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || candidate == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(candidate, &PyFunction_Type)
            || accessor_index >= limit->accessors || cursor->functions >= limit->functions
            || cursor->keywords > limit->keywords || cursor->cells > limit->cells
            || cursor->populated > limit->populated || cursor->nullable > limit->nullable) { return 0; }
    row = &region->function[cursor->functions];
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)candidate;
    fields[0] = candidate;
    fields[1] = function->func_code;
    fields[2] = function->func_defaults;
    fields[3] = function->func_kwdefaults;
    fields[4] = function->func_closure;
    fields[5] = function->func_globals;
    fields[6] = function->func_builtins;
    slots[0] = &row->function;
    slots[1] = &row->code;
    slots[2] = &row->defaults;
    slots[3] = &row->kwdefaults;
    slots[4] = &row->closure;
    slots[5] = &row->globals;
    slots[6] = &row->builtins;
    N = (fields[2] != NULL) + (fields[3] != NULL) + (fields[4] != NULL);
    if (fields[1] == NULL || fields[5] == NULL || fields[6] == NULL
            || row->captured != 1 || row->accessor_index != accessor_index
            || row->defaults_present != (fields[2] != NULL)
            || row->kw_present != (fields[3] != NULL)
            || row->closure_present != (fields[4] != NULL)
            || row->original_vectorcall != function->vectorcall
            || reno_ws_count_metadata(fields[5], fields[6], fields[3], fields[4],
                &counted, &K, &Z) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || row->kw_start != cursor->keywords || row->cell_start != cursor->cells
            || row->kw_count != K || row->cell_count != Z
            || K > limit->keywords - cursor->keywords || Z > limit->cells - cursor->cells
            || counted.P > limit->populated - cursor->populated
            || N > limit->nullable - cursor->nullable) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 7; ++index) {
        if (*slots[index] != fields[index]
                || (fields[index] != NULL && !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, slots[index], ledger_at))) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < K; ++index) {
        kw = &region->kw[cursor->keywords + index];
        if (kw->function_index != cursor->functions || kw->ordinal != index
                || kw->key == NULL || kw->value == NULL || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(kw->key)
                || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(fields[3], kw->key, kw->value)
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &kw->key, ledger_at)
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &kw->value, ledger_at)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < Z; ++index) {
        cell_row = &region->cell[cursor->cells + index];
        cell = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(fields[4], (Py_ssize_t)index);
        if (cell_row->function_index != cursor->functions || cell_row->ordinal != index
                || cell_row->cell != cell || !Py_IS_TYPE(cell, &PyCell_Type)
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &cell_row->cell, ledger_at)) { return 0; }
        contents = PyCell_GET(cell);
        if (cell_row->populated != (contents != NULL) || cell_row->contents != contents
                || (contents != NULL && !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &cell_row->contents, ledger_at))) { return 0; }
    }
    cursor->keywords += K;
    cursor->cells += Z;
    cursor->populated += counted.P;
    cursor->nullable += N;
    ++cursor->functions;
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_value_matches(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, unsigned char role,
    PyObject *actual, size_t *ledger_at)
{
    RenoSpecAccessorCapture *row;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || actual == NULL
            || entry_index >= region->header->layout.entry_count
            || cursor->accessors >= region->header->layout.metadata.accessors) { return 0; }
    row = &region->accessor[cursor->accessors];
    if (row->captured != 1 || row->entry_index != entry_index || row->role != role
            || row->value != actual
            || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &row->value, ledger_at)) { return 0; }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(actual, &PyFunction_Type)) {
        if (row->has_function != 1 || row->function_index != cursor->functions
                || !reno_spec_meta_function_matches(region, cursor, cursor->accessors, actual, ledger_at)) { return 0; }
    } else if (row->has_function != 0 || row->function_index != 0) { return 0; }
    ++cursor->accessors;
    return 1;
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, unsigned char role,
    PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *name,
    size_t *ledger_at)
{
    PyObject *actual_new;
    int matches;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    actual_new = reno_spec_meta_member_new(descriptor, builtin_type, name);
    if (actual_new == NULL) { return 0; }
    matches = reno_spec_meta_value_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, role, actual_new, ledger_at);
    /* Every returned NEW is settled, also on mismatch or actual indicator.
     * Its selected builtin/member/nonlast/ABI/S1 source remains a premise.
     */
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return matches && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_entry_matches(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, PyObject *value,
    size_t *ledger_at)
{
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *row;
    size_t expected_count = Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type) ? 3 : 1;
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *limit = &region->header->layout.metadata;

    if (entry_index >= region->header->layout.entry_count || cursor->accessors > limit->accessors
            || expected_count > limit->accessors - cursor->accessors) { return 0; }
    row = &region->entry[entry_index];
    if (row->accessor_start != cursor->accessors || row->accessor_count != expected_count) { return 0; }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", ledger_at)
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", ledger_at)
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", ledger_at);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC,
                value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", ledger_at);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS,
                value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", ledger_at);
    }
    return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
        && reno_spec_meta_value_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN,
            value, ledger_at);
}


static int
reno_spec_meta_header_matches(const RenoSpecMroCaptureHeader *header,
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *counts)
{
    return header->initialized_accessors == counts->accessors
        && header->initialized_functions == counts->functions
        && header->initialized_keywords == counts->keywords
        && header->initialized_cells == counts->cells
        && header->captured_accessors == counts->accessors
        && header->captured_functions == counts->functions
        && header->captured_keywords == counts->keywords
        && header->captured_cells == counts->cells
        && header->captured_populated == counts->populated
        && header->captured_nullable == counts->nullable;
}


/* Independent original roots/history and bank ownership precede views.
 * Checks visible accessor/raw metadata identity and ledger, without
 * complete getter/descriptor execution, CRT or no-callout admission.
 */
static int
reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;
    RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region;
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *layout;
    RenoSpecMroBaseCapture *base_row;
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *entry_row;
    PyTypeObject *base_type;
    PyObject *key;
    PyObject *value;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    size_t base_index;
    size_t entry_at = 0;
    size_t ledger_at = 0;
    size_t ordinal;
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts metadata = {0};

    if (!reno_spec_source_roots_match(state)) { return 0; }
    spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    region = &spec->region;
    if (spec->inventory.route == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) {
        return reno_spec_mro_region_empty(region); /* still-unimplemented route */
    }
    layout = &spec->inventory.capture_layout;
    if (spec->inventory.route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT || region->initialized != 1
            || region->allocation == NULL || region->header == NULL
            || region->base == NULL || region->ledger == NULL
            || (layout->entry_count != 0 && region->entry == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.accessors != 0 && region->accessor == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.functions != 0 && region->function == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.keywords != 0 && region->kw == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.cells != 0 && region->cell == NULL)
            || region->allocation_bytes != layout->requested_bytes
            || !reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(&region->header->layout, layout)
            || region->header->phase != RENO_SPEC_BANK_CAPTURED
            || region->header->failed != 0
            || region->header->initialized_bases != layout->base_count
            || region->header->initialized_entries != layout->entry_count
            || region->header->captured_bases != layout->base_count
            || region->header->captured_entries != layout->entry_count
            || !reno_spec_meta_header_matches(region->header, &layout->metadata)
            || region->header->ledger_count != layout->expected_acquired
            || region->header->ledger_count > layout->ledger_capacity) { return 0; }
    for (base_index = 0; base_index < layout->base_count; ++base_index) {
        base_row = &region->base[base_index];
        if (base_row->mro_index != base_index || base_row->entry_start != entry_at
                || base_row->base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(spec->mro, (Py_ssize_t)base_index)
                || base_row->layout_captured != 1
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &base_row->base, &ledger_at)
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &base_row->dictionary, &ledger_at)) { return 0; }
        base_type = (PyTypeObject *)base_row->base;
        if (_PyType_GetDict(base_type) != base_row->dictionary
                || base_type->tp_getattro != base_row->observed_getattro
                || base_type->tp_getattr != base_row->observed_getattr
                || base_type->tp_basicsize != base_row->observed_basicsize
                || base_type->tp_itemsize != base_row->observed_itemsize
                || base_type->tp_dictoffset != base_row->observed_dictoffset
                || base_type->tp_weaklistoffset != base_row->observed_weaklistoffset
                || (base_type->tp_flags & RENO_SPEC_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK) != base_row->observed_flags) { return 0; }
        position = 0;
        ordinal = 0;
        key = NULL;
        value = NULL;
        while (PyDict_Next(base_row->dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (entry_at >= layout->entry_count || ordinal >= base_row->entry_count) { return 0; }
            entry_row = &region->entry[entry_at];
            if (entry_row->base_index != base_index || entry_row->entry_ordinal != ordinal
                    || entry_row->key != key || entry_row->value != value
                    || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &entry_row->key, &ledger_at)
                    || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &entry_row->value, &ledger_at)
                    || !reno_spec_entry_protocol_matches(region, entry_at, value, &ledger_at)
                    || !reno_spec_meta_entry_matches(region, &metadata, entry_at, value, &ledger_at)) { return 0; }
            ++ordinal;
            ++entry_at;
        }
        if (ordinal != base_row->entry_count) { return 0; }
    }
    return entry_at == layout->entry_count && ledger_at == layout->expected_acquired
        && reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&metadata, &layout->metadata)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


/* CONDITIONAL ORIGINAL T0: independently authenticated actual CRT/config
 * and a continuously callback-free/no-GIL-release allocation+capture span
 * are REQUIRED and still unproved. Rechecking counts after malloc cannot
 * repair original content if that premise fails. No ready bit asserts it.
 */
static int
reno_spec_mro_region_capture(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region = &spec->region;
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *layout = &spec->inventory.capture_layout;
    RenoSpecMroBaseCapture *base_row;
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *entry_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key;
    PyObject *value;
    PyTypeObject *base_type;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    size_t base_index;
    size_t entry_at = 0;
    size_t dictionary_entries;
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts metadata = {0};

    if (!reno_spec_source_roots_match(state) || !reno_spec_mro_region_empty(region)
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0) { return 0; }
    if (spec->inventory.route == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) {
        return reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state);
    }
    if (spec->inventory.route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_spec_mro_native_allocate_original(state)
            || !reno_spec_mro_region_bind_initialize(region, layout)) { return 0; }
    region->header->phase = RENO_SPEC_BANK_CAPTURING;
    for (base_index = 0; base_index < layout->base_count; ++base_index) {
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(spec->mro, (Py_ssize_t)base_index);
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)) { goto failed; }
        base_type = (PyTypeObject *)base;
        dictionary = _PyType_GetDict(base_type);
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &dictionary_entries) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { goto failed; }
        base_row = &region->base[base_index];
        base_row->mro_index = base_index;
        base_row->entry_start = entry_at;
        if (!reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &base_row->base, base)
                || !reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &base_row->dictionary, dictionary)) { goto failed; }
        base_row->observed_getattro = base_type->tp_getattro;
        base_row->observed_getattr = base_type->tp_getattr;
        base_row->observed_basicsize = base_type->tp_basicsize;
        base_row->observed_itemsize = base_type->tp_itemsize;
        base_row->observed_dictoffset = base_type->tp_dictoffset;
        base_row->observed_weaklistoffset = base_type->tp_weaklistoffset;
        base_row->observed_flags = base_type->tp_flags & RENO_SPEC_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK;
        base_row->layout_captured = 1;
        position = 0;
        key = NULL;
        value = NULL;
        while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (entry_at >= layout->entry_count) { goto failed; }
            entry_row = &region->entry[entry_at];
            entry_row->base_index = base_index;
            entry_row->entry_ordinal = base_row->entry_count;
            if (!reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &entry_row->key, key)
                    || !reno_spec_mro_region_own(region, &entry_row->value, value)
                    || !reno_spec_entry_protocol_capture(region, entry_at, value)
                    || !reno_spec_meta_capture_entry(region, &metadata, entry_at, value)) { goto failed; }
            ++base_row->entry_count;
            ++region->header->captured_entries;
            ++entry_at;
        }
        if (base_row->entry_count != dictionary_entries) { goto failed; }
        ++region->header->captured_bases;
    }
    if (entry_at != layout->entry_count
            || !reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&metadata, &layout->metadata)
            || !reno_spec_meta_header_matches(region->header, &layout->metadata)
            || region->header->ledger_count != layout->expected_acquired
            || region->header->ledger_count > layout->ledger_capacity) { goto failed; }
    region->header->phase = RENO_SPEC_BANK_CAPTURED; /* acquisition history only */
    return reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state);

failed:
    region->header->failed = 1;
    return 0; /* ALL partial owning remains in State for real joint drain */
}


/* Actual caller/module/typed allocation and continuously State-owned roots
 * precede this conditional local-adjacency reversal. Runtime data may be
 * absent at legal finalization; never use the fatal modules getter here.
 * Cancellation leaves both owning anchors for the actual joint drainer.
 */
static void
reno_h01_restore_finder_slot_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    PyThreadState *thread_state;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter;
    PyObject **roots;
    PyObject *list;
    PyObject *proxy;
    PyObject *detached;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    Py_ssize_t length;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    Py_ssize_t proxy_count = 0;
    Py_ssize_t original_count = 0;
    size_t entry_count;

    if (state == NULL || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || !state->controls.finder_slot_armed
            || (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRED)) { return; }
    state->controls.finder_slot_armed = 0; /* one actual reversal decision */
    if (state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 0, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 1, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 2, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 3, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 6, 1)) { return; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    proxy = state->arena.install.proxy;
    if (proxy == NULL) { return; }
    thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (thread_state == NULL) { return; }
    interpreter = thread_state->interp;
    if (interpreter == NULL || interpreter->imports.modules == NULL
            || interpreter->imports.modules != roots[0]
            || interpreter->sysdict == NULL || interpreter->sysdict != roots[2]) { return; }
    if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &entry_count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "sys", 3, roots[1])
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(roots[1])
            || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[1])->md_dict != roots[2]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[2], &entry_count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[2], "meta_path", 9, roots[3])
            || !PyList_CheckExact(roots[3])) { return; }
    list = roots[3];
    index = state->controls.finder_slot_index;
    length = PyList_GET_SIZE(list);
    if (index < 0 || index >= length || PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index) != proxy) { return; }
    if (state->arena.install.finder_before == NULL) {
        if (index != 0) { return; }
    } else if (index == 0 || PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index - 1)
            != state->arena.install.finder_before) { return; }
    if (state->arena.install.finder_after == NULL) {
        if (index + 1 != length) { return; }
    } else if (index + 1 >= length || PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index + 1)
            != state->arena.install.finder_after) { return; }
    for (position = 0; position < length; ++position) {
        proxy_count += PyList_GET_ITEM(list, position) == proxy;
        original_count += PyList_GET_ITEM(list, position) == roots[6];
    }
    if (proxy_count != 1 || original_count != 0) { return; }
    /* Real list occurrence moves to this local; State independently owns
     * this exact proxy, so the old list reference release is nonlast.
     * Anchors remain State-owned even when this reversal is cancelled.
     */
    detached = PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index);
    PyList_SET_ITEM(list, index, Py_NewRef(roots[6]));
    Py_DECREF(detached);
}

static int
reno_ws_source_function(RenoWorkspaceView *view, PyObject *actual_function,
    PyObject *code, PyObject *defaults, PyObject *keywords, PyObject *closure,
    PyObject *globals, PyObject *builtins, vectorcallfunc expected_vectorcall,
    unsigned char domain, size_t function_index,
    size_t kw_start, size_t kw_count, size_t cell_start, size_t cell_count)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    size_t count;
    size_t index;
    RenoKwCapture *kw;
    RenoCellCapture *cell;

    if (actual_function == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || code == NULL || globals == NULL || builtins == NULL
           
            || kw_start > view->header->K || kw_count > view->header->K - kw_start
            || cell_start > view->header->Z || cell_count > view->header->Z - cell_start) { return 0; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)actual_function;
    if (function->func_code != code || function->func_defaults != defaults
            || function->func_kwdefaults != keywords || function->func_closure != closure
            || function->func_globals != globals || function->func_builtins != builtins
            || function->vectorcall != expected_vectorcall
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(globals, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(builtins, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return 0; }
    if (keywords == NULL || keywords == Py_None) {
        if (kw_count != 0) { return 0; }
    } else if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(keywords, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || count != kw_count) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < kw_count; ++index) {
        kw = &view->kw[kw_start + index];
        if (kw->function_domain != domain || kw->function_index != function_index
                || kw->entry_ordinal != index
                || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_KW, kw_start + index, 0, 1)
                || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_KW, kw_start + index, 1, 1)
                || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(keywords, kw->key, kw->value)) { return 0; }
    }
    if (closure == NULL || closure == Py_None) {
        if (cell_count != 0) { return 0; }
    } else if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(closure, cell_count)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < cell_count; ++index) {
        cell = &view->cell[cell_start + index];
        if (cell->function_domain != domain || cell->function_index != function_index
                || cell->closure_index != index || cell->populated > 1
                || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_CELL, cell_start + index, 2, 1)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(cell->cell_identity, &PyCell_Type)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(closure, (Py_ssize_t)index) != cell->cell_identity
                || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_CELL, cell_start + index, 0, cell->populated)
                || PyCell_GET(cell->cell_identity) != cell->populated_contents) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Matching exact builtin T_OBJECT/READONLY branch only. Its NEW is settled
 * on every non-NULL exit. The original live descriptor field independently
 * holds a non-NULL payload; NULL->None uses the selected immortal envelope.
 * This specifically nonlast release does not introduce a preparation callout.
 */
static int
reno_ws_source_descriptor(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name, PyObject *expected_function)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new;
    int matches;

    if (descriptor == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, builtin_type)) { return 0; }
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members;
            member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT || member->flags != READONLY) { return 0; }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) { return 0; }
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new == NULL) { return 0; }
    matches = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && actual_new == expected_function;
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return matches;
}

static int
reno_ws_source_dispatch_value(RenoWorkspaceView *view, size_t entry_index,
    unsigned char role, PyObject *actual, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    RenoDispatchCapture *dispatch;

    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(actual, &PyFunction_Type)) { return 1; }
    if (*cursor >= end) { return 0; }
    dispatch = &view->dispatch[*cursor];
    if (dispatch->function != actual || dispatch->entry_index != entry_index
            || dispatch->base_index != view->entry[entry_index].base_index
            || dispatch->accessor_role != role) { return 0; }
    ++*cursor;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_source_dispatch_accessor(RenoWorkspaceView *view, size_t entry_index,
    PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *name,
    unsigned char role, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new;
    int matches;

    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members;
            member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT || member->flags != READONLY) { return 0; }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) { return 0; }
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new == NULL) { return 0; }
    matches = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        && reno_ws_source_dispatch_value(view, entry_index, role, actual_new, end, cursor);
    Py_DECREF(actual_new); /* same independently rooted member/None envelope */
    return matches;
}

static int
reno_ws_source_dispatch_entry(RenoWorkspaceView *view, size_t entry_index)
{
    RenoClassEntryCapture *entry = &view->entry[entry_index];
    PyObject *value = entry->value;
    size_t cursor = entry->dispatch_start;
    size_t end;
    int matches;

    if (cursor > view->header->D || entry->dispatch_count > view->header->D - cursor) { return 0; }
    end = cursor + entry->dispatch_count;
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        matches = entry->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY
            && reno_ws_source_dispatch_accessor(view, entry_index, value, &PyProperty_Type,
                "fget", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET, end, &cursor)
            && reno_ws_source_dispatch_accessor(view, entry_index, value, &PyProperty_Type,
                "fset", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET, end, &cursor)
            && reno_ws_source_dispatch_accessor(view, entry_index, value, &PyProperty_Type,
                "fdel", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL, end, &cursor);
    } else if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        matches = entry->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC
            && reno_ws_source_dispatch_accessor(view, entry_index, value, &PyStaticMethod_Type,
                "__func__", RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC, end, &cursor);
    } else if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        matches = entry->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS
            && reno_ws_source_dispatch_accessor(view, entry_index, value, &PyClassMethod_Type,
                "__func__", RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS, end, &cursor);
    } else {
        matches = entry->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
            && reno_ws_source_dispatch_value(view, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN,
                value, end, &cursor);
    }
    return matches && cursor == end;
}

/* Same-process private representation, never a Python/file replay interface.
 * memcpy is fieldwise: no struct cast, pointer/integer conversion, padding
 * copy, assumed null-pointer bit pattern or saved-pointer invocation.
 */
typedef struct RenoClassSourceLayout {
    size_t count[4];
    size_t offset[4];
    size_t stride[4];
    size_t bytes;
} RenoClassSourceLayout;

typedef struct RenoClassSourceRecord {
    size_t scalar[6];
    unsigned char flag[4];
    vectorcallfunc vectorcall;
} RenoClassSourceRecord;

static int
reno_csw_layout(size_t bases, size_t entries, size_t dispatch,
    RenoClassSourceLayout *layout)
{
    size_t cursor = 8 + 3 * sizeof(size_t);
    size_t span;
    unsigned int kind;

    layout->count[0] = 5;
    layout->count[1] = bases;
    layout->count[2] = entries;
    layout->count[3] = dispatch;
    layout->stride[0] = 4 * sizeof(size_t) + 1;
    layout->stride[1] = 6 * sizeof(size_t);
    layout->stride[2] = 4 * sizeof(size_t) + 1;
    layout->stride[3] = 2 * sizeof(size_t) + 4 + sizeof(vectorcallfunc);
    for (kind = 0; kind < 4; ++kind) {
        layout->offset[kind] = cursor;
        if (!reno_ws_multiply(layout->count[kind], layout->stride[kind], &span)
                || !reno_ws_add(cursor, span, &cursor)) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_python_length(cursor) || !reno_ws_python_length(bases)) { return 0; }
    layout->bytes = cursor;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_csw_range(size_t start, size_t count, size_t total)
{
    return start <= total && count <= total - start;
}

static int
reno_csw_open(PyObject *package, RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    const char **data, PyObject **dicts)
{
    PyObject *bytes;
    size_t length;
    size_t counts[3];

    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(package, 2)) { return 0; }
    bytes = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(package, 0);
    *dicts = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(package, 1);
    if (!PyBytes_CheckExact(bytes) || !PyTuple_CheckExact(*dicts)
            || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyBytes_GET_SIZE(bytes), &length)
            || length < 8 + 3 * sizeof(size_t)) { return 0; }
    *data = PyBytes_AS_STRING(bytes);
    if (memcmp(*data, "RENOCD02", 8) != 0) { return 0; }
    memcpy(counts, *data + 8, sizeof(counts));
    return reno_csw_layout(counts[0], counts[1], counts[2], layout)
        && length == layout->bytes
        && reno_ws_source_tuple(*dicts, layout->count[1]);
}

static int
reno_csw_record(const char *data, const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    unsigned int kind, size_t index, RenoClassSourceRecord *record)
{
    static const unsigned char scalar_count[4] = {4, 6, 4, 2};
    static const unsigned char flag_count[4] = {1, 0, 1, 4};
    size_t at;
    unsigned int field;

    if (kind >= 4 || index >= layout->count[kind]) { return 0; }
    at = layout->offset[kind] + index * layout->stride[kind];
    for (field = 0; field < 6; ++field) { record->scalar[field] = 0; }
    for (field = 0; field < 4; ++field) { record->flag[field] = 0; }
    record->vectorcall = NULL;
    for (field = 0; field < scalar_count[kind]; ++field) {
        memcpy(&record->scalar[field], data + at, sizeof(size_t));
        at += sizeof(size_t);
    }
    for (field = 0; field < flag_count[kind]; ++field) {
        record->flag[field] = (unsigned char)data[at++];
    }
    if (kind == 3) {
        memcpy(&record->vectorcall, data + at, sizeof(record->vectorcall));
    }
    return 1;
}

static void
reno_csw_capture_record(RenoWorkspaceView *view, unsigned int kind,
    size_t index, RenoClassSourceRecord *record)
{
    unsigned int field;

    for (field = 0; field < 6; ++field) { record->scalar[field] = 0; }
    for (field = 0; field < 4; ++field) { record->flag[field] = 0; }
    record->vectorcall = NULL;
    if (kind == 0) {
        RenoClassCapture *row = &view->klass[index];
        record->scalar[0] = row->base_start;
        record->scalar[1] = row->base_count;
        record->scalar[2] = row->dispatch_start;
        record->scalar[3] = row->dispatch_count;
        record->flag[0] = row->class_role;
    } else if (kind == 1) {
        RenoBaseCapture *row = &view->base[index];
        record->scalar[0] = row->class_index;
        record->scalar[1] = row->mro_index;
        record->scalar[2] = row->entry_start;
        record->scalar[3] = row->entry_count;
        record->scalar[4] = row->dispatch_start;
        record->scalar[5] = row->dispatch_count;
    } else if (kind == 2) {
        RenoClassEntryCapture *row = &view->entry[index];
        record->scalar[0] = row->base_index;
        record->scalar[1] = row->entry_ordinal;
        record->scalar[2] = row->dispatch_start;
        record->scalar[3] = row->dispatch_count;
        record->flag[0] = row->descriptor_role;
    } else {
        RenoDispatchCapture *row = &view->dispatch[index];
        record->scalar[0] = row->base_index;
        record->scalar[1] = row->entry_index;
        record->flag[0] = row->accessor_role;
        record->flag[1] = row->defaults_present;
        record->flag[2] = row->kw_present;
        record->flag[3] = row->closure_present;
        record->vectorcall = row->original_vectorcall;
    }
}

static int
reno_csw_encode(PyObject *bytes, PyObject *dicts,
    const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout, RenoWorkspaceView *view)
{
    static const unsigned char scalar_count[4] = {4, 6, 4, 2};
    static const unsigned char flag_count[4] = {1, 0, 1, 4};
    RenoClassSourceRecord record;
    char *data;
    size_t index;
    size_t at;
    unsigned int kind;
    unsigned int field;

    if (!PyBytes_CheckExact(bytes) || (size_t)PyBytes_GET_SIZE(bytes) != layout->bytes
            || view->header->C != 5 || view->header->B != layout->count[1]
            || view->header->E != layout->count[2] || view->header->D != layout->count[3]
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(dicts, layout->count[1])) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout->count[1]; ++index) {
        if (PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)index) != view->base[index].dict_guard) { return 0; }
    }
    /* ONLY the unpublished NULL-input constructor buffer may be written.
     * No Python/container reference to bytes has escaped this private span.
     */
    data = PyBytes_AS_STRING(bytes);
    memcpy(data, "RENOCD02", 8);
    memcpy(data + 8, &layout->count[1], 3 * sizeof(size_t));
    for (kind = 0; kind < 4; ++kind) {
        for (index = 0; index < layout->count[kind]; ++index) {
            reno_csw_capture_record(view, kind, index, &record);
            at = layout->offset[kind] + index * layout->stride[kind];
            for (field = 0; field < scalar_count[kind]; ++field) {
                memcpy(data + at, &record.scalar[field], sizeof(size_t));
                at += sizeof(size_t);
            }
            for (field = 0; field < flag_count[kind]; ++field) {
                data[at++] = (char)record.flag[field];
            }
            if (kind == 3) { memcpy(data + at, &record.vectorcall, sizeof(record.vectorcall)); }
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_csw_region_matches(PyObject *package, RenoWorkspaceView *view)
{
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord actual;
    RenoClassSourceRecord expected;
    PyObject *dicts;
    const char *data;
    size_t index;
    unsigned int kind;
    unsigned int field;

    if (!reno_csw_open(package, &layout, &data, &dicts)
            || view->header->C != 5 || view->header->B != layout.count[1]
            || view->header->E != layout.count[2] || view->header->D != layout.count[3]) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < layout.count[1]; ++index) {
        if (PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)index) != view->base[index].dict_guard) { return 0; }
    }
    for (kind = 0; kind < 4; ++kind) {
        for (index = 0; index < layout.count[kind]; ++index) {
            if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, kind, index, &actual)) { return 0; }
            reno_csw_capture_record(view, kind, index, &expected);
            for (field = 0; field < 6; ++field) {
                if (actual.scalar[field] != expected.scalar[field]) { return 0; }
            }
            for (field = 0; field < 4; ++field) {
                if (actual.flag[field] != expected.flag[field]) { return 0; }
            }
            if (actual.vectorcall != expected.vectorcall) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_csw_source_value(const char *data, const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    PyObject *rows, size_t class_start, size_t base, size_t entry,
    unsigned char role, PyObject *actual, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    static const unsigned char nullable_at[3] = {2, 3, 5};
    RenoClassSourceRecord record;
    PyObject *row;
    PyObject *raw[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    unsigned int field;

    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(actual, &PyFunction_Type)) { return 1; }
    if (*cursor >= end || *cursor < class_start
            || *cursor - class_start >= (size_t)PyTuple_GET_SIZE(rows)
            || !reno_csw_record(data, layout, 3, *cursor, &record)
            || record.scalar[0] != base || record.scalar[1] != entry
            || record.flag[0] != role) { return 0; }
    row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(rows, (Py_ssize_t)(*cursor - class_start));
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(row, 9) || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 0) != actual) { return 0; }
    for (field = 0; field < 3; ++field) {
        if (record.flag[1 + field] > 1) { return 0; }
        if (record.flag[1 + field]) {
            raw[field] = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, nullable_at[field]);
        } else if (PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, nullable_at[field]) != Py_None) { return 0; }
    }
    if (((PyFunctionObject *)actual)->vectorcall != record.vectorcall
            || !reno_t0_function_metadata_matches(actual, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 1),
                raw[0], raw[1], PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 4), raw[2],
                PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 6), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 7),
                PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 8),
                RENO_METADATA_NATIVE_RAW)) { return 0; }
    ++*cursor;
    return 1;
}

/* Same selected member contract as the original retained source helper.
 * Even mismatch releases a NEW covered by the actual descriptor field;
 * NULL fields give immortal None. Not a claim about arbitrary getters.
 */
static int
reno_csw_source_accessor(const char *data, const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    PyObject *rows, size_t class_start, size_t base, size_t entry,
    PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *name,
    unsigned char role, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new;
    int matches;

    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, builtin_type)) { return 0; }
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members; member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT || member->flags != READONLY) { return 0; }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) { return 0; }
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new == NULL) { return 0; }
    matches = PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        && reno_csw_source_value(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
            role, actual_new, end, cursor);
    Py_DECREF(actual_new);
    return matches;
}

static int
reno_csw_source_entry(const char *data, const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    PyObject *rows, size_t class_start, size_t base, size_t entry,
    unsigned char descriptor_role, PyObject *value, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY
            && reno_csw_source_accessor(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET, end, cursor)
            && reno_csw_source_accessor(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET, end, cursor)
            && reno_csw_source_accessor(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL, end, cursor);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC
            && reno_csw_source_accessor(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC, end, cursor);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS
            && reno_csw_source_accessor(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS, end, cursor);
    }
    return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
        && reno_csw_source_value(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
            RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN, value, end, cursor);
}

/* Caller performs separate private T0 metadata consistency before this
 * source predicate. No expected operand is obtained from a current getter.
 * Actual State/module/lease, old product provenance and matching code/ABI
 * lifetime are independent of magic, ready, shape or pointer equality.
 */
static int
reno_state_class_sources_match(RenoState *state)
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord klass_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord base_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord entry_record;
    const char *data;
    PyObject *dicts;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *rows;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *entry;
    size_t class_index;
    size_t ordinal;
    size_t item;
    size_t base_cursor = 0;
    size_t entry_cursor = 0;
    size_t dispatch_cursor = 0;
    size_t entry_end;

    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1
            || !reno_csw_open(state->arena.class_source_witness, &layout, &data, &dicts)) { return 0; }
    for (class_index = 0; class_index < 5; ++class_index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 103 + (unsigned int)class_index, 1)
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, classes[class_index], 1)
                || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 0, class_index, &klass_record)
                || klass_record.flag[0] != class_index
                || klass_record.scalar[0] != base_cursor || klass_record.scalar[2] != dispatch_cursor
                || !reno_csw_range(base_cursor, klass_record.scalar[1], layout.count[1])
                || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_cursor, klass_record.scalar[3], layout.count[3])) { return 0; }
        snapshot = state->arena.known.roots[103 + class_index];
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != state->arena.known.roots[classes[class_index]]) { return 0; }
        mro = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
        bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
        rows = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 3);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, klass_record.scalar[1])
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(bases, klass_record.scalar[1])
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(rows, klass_record.scalar[3])) { return 0; }
        for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < klass_record.scalar[1]; ++ordinal) {
            if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 1, base_cursor, &base_record)
                    || base_record.scalar[0] != class_index || base_record.scalar[1] != ordinal
                    || base_record.scalar[2] != entry_cursor || base_record.scalar[4] != dispatch_cursor
                    || !reno_csw_range(entry_cursor, base_record.scalar[3], layout.count[2])
                    || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_cursor, base_record.scalar[5], layout.count[3])) { return 0; }
            base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2)) { return 0; }
            base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0);
            entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
            if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type) || base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal)
                    || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base) != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)base_cursor)
                    || !reno_ws_source_tuple(entries, base_record.scalar[3])) { return 0; }
            for (item = 0; item < base_record.scalar[3]; ++item) {
                if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 2, entry_cursor, &entry_record)
                        || entry_record.scalar[0] != base_cursor || entry_record.scalar[1] != item
                        || entry_record.scalar[2] != dispatch_cursor
                        || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_cursor, entry_record.scalar[3], layout.count[3])) { return 0; }
                entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, (Py_ssize_t)item);
                if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)) { return 0; }
                entry_end = dispatch_cursor + entry_record.scalar[3];
                if (!reno_csw_source_entry(data, &layout, rows, klass_record.scalar[2],
                        base_cursor, entry_cursor, entry_record.flag[0], PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1),
                        entry_end, &dispatch_cursor)
                        || dispatch_cursor != entry_end) { return 0; }
                ++entry_cursor;
            }
            if (dispatch_cursor - base_record.scalar[4] != base_record.scalar[5]) { return 0; }
            ++base_cursor;
        }
        if (dispatch_cursor - klass_record.scalar[2] != klass_record.scalar[3]) { return 0; }
    }
    return base_cursor == layout.count[1] && entry_cursor == layout.count[2]
        && dispatch_cursor == layout.count[3] && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}


static int
reno_fixed_sources_match(RenoState *state, PyObject *const expected_mros[5],
    PyObject *expected_self_borrowed, PyObject *expected_module_borrowed)
{
    static const unsigned char module_slots[4] = {1, 4, 23, 25};
    static const unsigned char dict_slots[4] = {2, 5, 24, 26};
    static const unsigned char class_slots[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char class_dict_slots[5] = {7, 12, 15, 18, 21};
    static const char *const class_names[5] = {
        "PathFinder", "_LoaderBasics", "FileLoader", "SourceLoader", "SourceFileLoader"
    };
    static const Py_ssize_t class_lengths[5] = {10, 13, 10, 12, 16};
    PyThreadState *thread_state;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter;
    PyObject **roots;
    PyObject *runtime_error = NULL; /* actual C data borrows, no acquire */
    PyObject *name_error = NULL;
    PyObject *type_error = NULL;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyCFunctionObject *builtin;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *control;
    size_t count;
    unsigned int index;
    unsigned int slot;

    if (state == NULL || expected_mros == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    control = &state->controls.builtin_exec;
    if (!state->controls.getters[0].captured || !state->controls.getters[0].frozen
            || !state->controls.getters[1].captured || !state->controls.getters[1].frozen
            || !state->controls.getters[2].captured || !state->controls.getters[2].frozen
            || PyBaseObject_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[0].expected
            || PyType_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[1].expected
            || PyModule_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[2].expected) { return 0; }
    /* Post-capture selected source only. Historical C owning roots are the
     * expected; these are current actual C runtime data, not builtins aliases.
     * No reference acquire/callback, exception-instance or attribute read.
     * Earlier untyped/pre-capture errors cannot use these future known slots.
     */
    runtime_error = PyExc_RuntimeError;
    name_error = PyExc_NameError;
    type_error = PyExc_TypeError;
    if (runtime_error == NULL || name_error == NULL || type_error == NULL
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 98, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 99, 1)
            || roots[97] != runtime_error || roots[98] != name_error
            || roots[99] != type_error) { return 0; }
    /* Original fixed roots only. The early retained caller does not require
     * future anchors/snapshots; the later State wrapper supplies old output
     * roots separately. No current attribute becomes an expected operand.
     */
    for (slot = 0; slot <= 27; ++slot) {
        if (roots[slot] == NULL || !state->arena.known.owned[slot]) { return 0; }
    }
    thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (thread_state == NULL) { return 0; }
    interpreter = thread_state->interp;
    if (interpreter == NULL || interpreter->imports.modules == NULL
            || interpreter->imports.modules != roots[0]
            || interpreter->sysdict == NULL || interpreter->sysdict != roots[2]) { return 0; }
    if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "sys", 3, roots[1])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib_external", 26, roots[4])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib", 17, roots[23])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "builtins", 8, roots[25])) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 4; ++index) {
        if (!PyModule_CheckExact(roots[module_slots[index]])
                || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[module_slots[index]])->md_dict != roots[dict_slots[index]]
                || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[dict_slots[index]], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!PyList_CheckExact(roots[3])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[2], "meta_path", 9, roots[3])) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        klass = roots[class_slots[index]];
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(klass, &PyType_Type)
                || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[5], class_names[index], class_lengths[index], klass)) { return 0; }
        dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)klass);
        mro = expected_mros[index];
        if (dictionary != roots[class_dict_slots[index]]
                || ((PyTypeObject *)klass)->tp_mro != mro || mro == NULL
                || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro)) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], "find_spec", 9, roots[8])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], "invalidate_caches", 17, roots[9])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], "find_distributions", 18, roots[10])
            || !reno_ws_source_descriptor(roots[8], &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", roots[30])
            || !reno_ws_source_descriptor(roots[9], &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", roots[39])
            || !reno_ws_source_descriptor(roots[10], &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", roots[48])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[18], "get_code", 8, roots[57])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[12], "exec_module", 11, roots[66])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[24], "_call_with_frames_removed", 25, roots[75])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[26], "exec", 4, roots[27])
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[27], &PyCFunction_Type)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 4; ++index) {
        if (!control->scalar_captured[index]) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        PyObject *payload = index == 0 ? expected_self_borrowed : expected_module_borrowed;
        if (!control->payload_captured[index] || control->present[index] > 1
                || control->present[index] != (payload != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    builtin = (PyCFunctionObject *)roots[27];
    return builtin->m_ml == control->methoddef && builtin->m_ml != NULL
        && builtin->m_ml->ml_meth == control->function
        && builtin->m_ml->ml_flags == control->flags
        && builtin->vectorcall == control->vectorcall
        && builtin->m_self == expected_self_borrowed
        && builtin->m_module == expected_module_borrowed;
}

/* Original retained source entry. The private mapping/outer ownership still
 * precedes every read. Future output tuples are NOT required at this stage.
 */
static int
reno_ws_source_fixed(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source)
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char mros[5] = {0, 13, 16, 19, 22};
    PyObject *expected_mros[5] = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject **roots;
    unsigned int index;

    if (state == NULL || source == NULL || source->locals_owned == NULL
            || source->named_ranges == NULL || source->class_roots == NULL) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (source->class_roots[index].class_role != index
                || source->class_roots[index].class_slot != &roots[classes[index]]
                || source->class_roots[index].mro_slot != (index == 0
                    ? &source->locals_owned->pathfinder_mro : &roots[mros[index]])) { return 0; }
        expected_mros[index] = *source->class_roots[index].mro_slot;
    }
    return reno_fixed_sources_match(state, expected_mros,
        source->locals_owned->builtin_self, source->locals_owned->builtin_module);
}

/* State-only fixed source bridge AFTER actual snapshot/anchor construction.
 * These are previously witnessed owning records, never first-read current
 * attributes. Continuous physical State/module/active-interpreter roots and
 * matching full reference/source envelope remain independent obligations.
 */
static int
reno_state_fixed_sources_match(RenoState *state)
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char mros[5] = {0, 13, 16, 19, 22};
    PyObject *expected_mros[5] = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *payloads[2] = {NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject **roots;
    unsigned int index;

    /* Includes empty indicator, all scalar/payload captured/ready flags,
     * known27/28/29 ledger, tuple0/1 shape and original raw binding match.
     */
    if (!reno_state_builtin_exec_matches(state)) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 103 + index, 1)
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, classes[index], 1)) { return 0; }
        snapshot = roots[103 + index];
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != roots[classes[index]]) { return 0; }
        expected_mros[index] = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
        if (index != 0 && (!reno_ws_known_status(state, mros[index], 1)
                || expected_mros[index] != roots[mros[index]])) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        if (state->controls.builtin_exec.present[index]) {
            payloads[index] = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(roots[28 + index], 0);
        }
    }
    /* Common descriptor helper creates and settles actual temporary NEWs;
     * it is not a pure-borrow body or a certificate for arbitrary getters.
     */
    return reno_fixed_sources_match(state, expected_mros, payloads[0], payloads[1])
        && reno_state_class_sources_match(state);
}

static int
reno_state_fixed_metadata_match(RenoState *state)
{
    unsigned int index;

    if (!reno_state_functions_metadata_match(state)) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_state_module_metadata_matches(state)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_state_class_metadata_matches(state, index)) { return 0; }
    }
    return reno_state_fixed_sources_match(state);
}

/* Actual bound-call consumer supplies the original Proxy/module allocation
 * and matching full-API source envelope. These raw comparisons cannot create
 * that provenance. Native Proxy type effect authenticates this receiver's
 * fixed code/layout, without requiring other business roles to be available.
 */
static int
reno_h01_function_owner_matches(RenoProxyObject *self, PyObject *module,
    RenoState *state, unsigned char role)
{
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || module == NULL || state == NULL
            || (role != RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
                && role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS)
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(module)
            || self->module_lifetime != module || self->origin_state != state
            || _PyModule_GetDef(module) != &owner_factory_definition
            || (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(module) != state) { return 0; }
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete != 1
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count < 0
            || self->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)self
            || state->arena.install.proxy_type != (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self)
            || (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
                ? state->arena.install.invalidate_caches
                : state->arena.install.find_distributions) == NULL) { return 0; }
    return reno_proxy_type_effect(state->arena.install.proxy_type);
}

/* Selected underlying F0/F1/F2 function origin and row only. Class0 keeps
 * the original full MRO dictionary key/value facts and dict guards, without
 * admitting unrelated dispatch functions or checking the other four classes.
 * Expected tuples/bytes come from the original source-checked constructor,
 * not this current scan. The actual lease keeps all State-owned roots live.
 */
static int
reno_h01_function_sources_match(RenoState *state, PyObject *actual_callee,
    unsigned char role)
{
    unsigned char required[7] = {0, 4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 103};
    unsigned int descriptor_slot;
    unsigned int function_slot;
    const char *source_name;
    Py_ssize_t source_length;
    PyThreadState *thread_state;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter;
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord klass_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord base_record;
    const char *data;
    PyObject **roots;
    PyObject *dicts;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *entry;
    size_t count;
    size_t ordinal;
    size_t item;
    size_t entry_cursor = 0;
    unsigned int index;

    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC
                && role != RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
                && role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS)
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1) { return 0; }
    descriptor_slot = 8u + role;
    function_slot = 30u + 9u * role;
    required[5] = (unsigned char)descriptor_slot;
    source_name = role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC ? "find_spec"
        : (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
            ? "invalidate_caches" : "find_distributions");
    source_length = role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC ? 9
        : (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES ? 17 : 18);
    for (index = 0; index < 7; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, required[index], 1)) { return 0; }
    }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, function_slot, 1)
            || actual_callee != roots[function_slot]
            || (role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC
                && (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
                    ? state->arena.install.invalidate_caches
                    : state->arena.install.find_distributions) != actual_callee)) { return 0; }
    thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (thread_state == NULL) { return 0; }
    interpreter = thread_state->interp;
    if (interpreter == NULL || interpreter->imports.modules == NULL
            || interpreter->imports.modules != roots[0]) { return 0; }
    if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib_external", 26, roots[4])
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(roots[4])
            || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[4])->md_dict != roots[5]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[5], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[5], "PathFinder", 10, roots[6])
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[6], &PyType_Type)
            || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)roots[6]) != roots[7]) { return 0; }
    snapshot = roots[103];
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != roots[6]
            || !reno_csw_open(state->arena.class_source_witness, &layout, &data, &dicts)
            || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 0, 0, &klass_record)
            || klass_record.flag[0] != 0 || klass_record.scalar[0] != 0
            || klass_record.scalar[1] == 0
            || !reno_csw_range(0, klass_record.scalar[1], layout.count[1])) { return 0; }
    mro = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
    bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, klass_record.scalar[1])
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(bases, klass_record.scalar[1])
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, 0) != roots[6]
            || ((PyTypeObject *)roots[6])->tp_mro != mro) { return 0; }
    for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < klass_record.scalar[1]; ++ordinal) {
        if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 1, ordinal, &base_record)
                || base_record.scalar[0] != 0 || base_record.scalar[1] != ordinal
                || base_record.scalar[2] != entry_cursor
                || !reno_csw_range(entry_cursor, base_record.scalar[3], layout.count[2])) { return 0; }
        base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2)) { return 0; }
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0);
        entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)
                || base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal)
                || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base)
                    != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal)
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(entries, base_record.scalar[3])) { return 0; }
        dictionary = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal);
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || count != base_record.scalar[3]) { return 0; }
        for (item = 0; item < base_record.scalar[3]; ++item) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, (Py_ssize_t)item);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                    || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1) == NULL
                    || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(dictionary, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0),
                        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1))) { return 0; }
        }
        entry_cursor += base_record.scalar[3]; /* bounded by the checked range */
    }
    return reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], source_name, source_length, roots[descriptor_slot])
        && reno_ws_source_descriptor(roots[descriptor_slot],
            role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC ? &PyClassMethod_Type : &PyStaticMethod_Type,
            "__func__", actual_callee)
        && reno_state_function_metadata_matches(state, role)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Actual F1/F2 consumer of the matching owned-resume producer. Independent
 * first-query ABI/image lifetime, attached current/GIL, stable actual caller
 * operands/argv and a conditional raw source-helper envelope are prerequisites.
