 * The private writer graph excludes READY/current/BUSY Invoke misuse; an
 * attempted value is not a substitute for those facts or a recovery grant.
 * Role0 and the full internal F1/F2 D1/D2 graphs remain incomplete. This
 * uninstalled source does not grant activation or certify those premises.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_h01_function_dispatch_d0(PyObject *actual_owner, unsigned char role,
    PyObject *const *args, size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames)
{
    enum { FUNCTION_PREPARATION, FUNCTION_LIFETIME, FUNCTION_BINDING,
           FUNCTION_SOURCE, FUNCTION_NULL_RETURN, FUNCTION_MESSAGE_COUNT };
    static const char *const messages[2][FUNCTION_MESSAGE_COUNT] = {
        {"native invalidation preparation unavailable",
         "native invalidation lifetime unavailable",
         "native invalidation binding unavailable",
         "native invalidation source unavailable",
         "native invalidation returned NULL without an exception"},
        {"native distribution preparation unavailable",
         "native distribution lifetime unavailable",
         "native distribution binding unavailable",
         "native distribution source unavailable",
         "native distribution returned NULL without an exception"}
    };
    RenoProxyObject *self = (RenoProxyObject *)actual_owner;
    RenoOwnedResumeRecordV1 resume = {0};
    RenoOwnedResumeMoveOutV1 resume_out = {0};
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *callee_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *resume_value = NULL;
    PyObject *cleanup_anchor = NULL;
    PyObject *result = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    PyObject **cleanup_error;
    RenoState *state = NULL;
    PyThreadState *prepare_thread = NULL;
    void *free_argument = NULL;
    size_t free_bytes = 0;
    uint32_t prepare_status;
    uint32_t public_attempted = 0;
    unsigned int family = 0;
    unsigned int entered = 0;
    unsigned int preparation_failed = 0;
    unsigned int no_memory_tail = 0;
    const char *failure_message = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (role != RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
            && role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, "invalid private finder function role");
        goto failed;
    }
    family = role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES ? 0u : 1u;
    failure_message = messages[family][FUNCTION_PREPARATION];
    if (self == NULL || self->module_lifetime == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, messages[family][FUNCTION_LIFETIME]);
        goto failed;
    }
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(self->module_lifetime);
    state = prepare_common_state_normal(module_guard);
    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_h01_function_owner_matches(self, module_guard, state, role)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, messages[family][FUNCTION_BINDING]);
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->controls.meta_active_count == PY_SSIZE_T_MAX) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_OverflowError, "native metadata activity capacity exceeded");
        goto failed;
    }
    ++state->controls.meta_active_count;
    entered = 1;
    callee_guard = Py_NewRef(role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
        ? state->arena.install.invalidate_caches : state->arena.install.find_distributions);
    if (!reno_h01_function_sources_match(state, callee_guard, role)
            || !reno_h01_function_owner_matches(self, module_guard, state, role)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, messages[family][FUNCTION_SOURCE]);
        }
        goto failed;
    }

    /* State's actual entered lease retains the original code root. Prepare
     * acquires its own real prefix in the original core macro environment;
     * this caller adds no guessed mirror references or frame-stack writes.
     */
    prepare_thread = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    prepare_status = RenoOwnedResumePrepareV1(&resume, callee_guard,
        state->arena.known.roots[31u + 9u * role], args, nargsf, kwnames);
    if (prepare_status == RENO_OWNED_RESUME_PREPARE_NOT_SELECTED) {
        /* Matched producer's selection-before-effects contract: all out
         * debts are empty. Close the private record before the actual call.
         * Custom/NULL-slot/numeric/available-stack domains remain ordinary.
         */
        RenoOwnedResumeMoveUnconsumedV1(&resume, &resume_out);
        result = PyObject_Vectorcall(callee_guard, args, nargsf, kwnames);
        goto ordinary_returned;
    }
    if (prepare_status == RENO_OWNED_RESUME_PREPARE_ARENA_NULL) {
        /* No source post-check, Invoke or public retry on the real NULL
         * arena return. Keep the selected final NoMemory contract below.
         */
        no_memory_tail = 1;
    } else if (prepare_status == RENO_OWNED_RESUME_PREPARE_READY) {
        /* D05 remains hidden and owned. Under the independent raw source
         * closure these predicates/current reads have no external callout.
         * No creator, DECREF, free, query or pending transport in this span.
         */
        if (!reno_h01_function_sources_match(state, callee_guard, role)
                || !reno_h01_function_owner_matches(self, module_guard, state, role)
                || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != prepare_thread) {
            preparation_failed = 1;
            failure_message = messages[family][FUNCTION_SOURCE];
        } else {
            result = RenoOwnedResumeInvokeV1(&resume, &public_attempted);
        }
    } else {
        /* The matching fresh producer's fourth normal status is ERROR,
         * before arena/Get; its actual partial prefix is still owned.
         * Private misuse is outside this normal producer/caller contract.
         */
        preparation_failed = 1;
    }

    /* Legal current/writer input excludes unchanged READY Invoke misuse.
     * Normal return is already revoked PRIVATE/DETACHED or COMMITTED; the
     * latter Move reads phase only and gives seven empty out fields.
     * No caller reads/aborts a committed old raw or uses attempted to retry.
     */
    RenoOwnedResumeMoveUnconsumedV1(&resume, &resume_out);
    cleanup_error = no_memory_tail ? &cleanup_anchor : &first;
    *cleanup_error = resume_out.pending_owned;
    resume_out.pending_owned = NULL;
    if (*cleanup_error != NULL) {
        /* D05 is the first real debt. Settle a distinct actual E2 before
         * any may-callback cleanup, even when both have the same identity.
         */
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    } else {
        *cleanup_error = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    }
    if (preparation_failed && first == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, failure_message);
        first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    }
    if (!no_memory_tail && !preparation_failed && result == NULL && first == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError,
            messages[family][FUNCTION_NULL_RETURN]);
        first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    }
    goto cleanup;

ordinary_returned:
    first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    if (result == NULL && first == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError,
            messages[family][FUNCTION_NULL_RETURN]);
        first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    }
    goto cleanup;

failed:
    /* These exits precede Prepare: the typed record/out have no acquired
     * debt. Preserve the actual guard/source helper error before cleanup.
     */
    first = take_failure();

cleanup:
    cleanup_error = no_memory_tail ? &cleanup_anchor : &first;
    if (*cleanup_error != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (resume_out.raw_to_free != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
        free_argument = resume_out.raw_to_free;
        free_bytes = resume_out.raw_bytes;
        resume_out.raw_to_free = NULL;
        resume_out.raw_bytes = 0;
        _PyRuntime.allocators.obj_arena.free(_PyRuntime.allocators.obj_arena.ctx,
            free_argument, free_bytes);
        free_argument = NULL;
        free_bytes = 0;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* Only the producer's actual acquired occurrence count is consumed.
     * Zero count does not read argv; no count is reconstructed from nargsf.
     */
    while (resume_out.values_owned_count != 0) {
        resume_value = resume_out.argv[--resume_out.values_owned_count];
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&resume_value, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    resume_out.argv = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&resume_out.locals_owned, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&resume_out.function_owned, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&callee_guard, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    if (entered) {
        reno_common_metadata_leave(state, &entered, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* No further State or old record/raw access. The wrapper's original
     * owner_guard still covers the Proxy's immutable actual module edge.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_guard, cleanup_error, &cleanup_failed);
    if (no_memory_tail) {
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&cleanup_anchor, &cleanup_failed);
        if (cleanup_anchor != NULL) {
            out = cleanup_anchor;
            cleanup_anchor = NULL;
            PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        }
        return PyErr_NoMemory(); /* exactly one terminal creator; no call retry */
    }
    if (first != NULL) {
        if (result != NULL) {
            reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        out = first;
        first = NULL;
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return NULL;
    }
    return result;
}
/* Actual role0 method-call segment. The declared finish continuation remains
 * undefined, so this full source is still unbuildable/unadmitted. Conditional
 * raw/reference/pending-deallocator and current/GIL/caller/image premises are
 * not established by these comparisons, by a callback, or by its context.
 */
static int
reno_h01_f0_owner_matches(RenoProxyObject *self, PyObject *module, RenoState *state)
{
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || self == NULL || module == NULL || state == NULL
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(module)
            || self->module_lifetime != module || self->origin_state != state
            || _PyModule_GetDef(module) != &owner_factory_definition
            || (RenoState *)_PyModule_GetState(module) != state) { return 0; }
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete != 1
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count < 0
            || self->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)self
            || state->arena.install.proxy_type != (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(self)
            || state->arena.install.find_spec == NULL) { return 0; }
    return reno_proxy_type_effect(state->arena.install.proxy_type);
}

static int
reno_h01_f0_source_check(void *opaque)
{
    RenoF0SourceContext *source = (RenoF0SourceContext *)opaque;
    if (source == NULL || source->tstate == NULL
            || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != source->tstate
            || !reno_h01_f0_owner_matches(source->owner, source->module, source->state)) {
        return 0;
    }
    RenoState *state = source->state;
    if (state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 30, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 31, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 6, 1)
            || source->method != state->arena.install.find_spec
            || source->function != state->arena.known.roots[30]
            || source->code != state->arena.known.roots[31]
            || source->klass != state->arena.known.roots[6]
            || source->method == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->method, &PyMethod_Type)
            || source->function == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || source->code == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->code, &PyCode_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(source->method) != source->function
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(source->method) != source->klass
            || ((PyFunctionObject *)source->function)->func_code != source->code
            || state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured != 1
            || ((PyMethodObject *)source->method)->vectorcall
                != state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall) { return 0; }
    /* Raw constructor-field identity is only one source fact. Actual method
     * slot selection still belongs to r1401's typeflags/offset dispatch.
     * The exact classmethod member helper and reference operations require
     * their independently proved no-external-callout envelope for F0.
     */
    if (!reno_h01_function_sources_match(state, source->function, RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC)
            || !reno_h01_f0_owner_matches(source->owner, source->module, state)
            || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != source->tstate
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    /* Only the associated generic adapter can call this fixed predicate
     * inside this actual CallMethod interval; ordinary custom/NULL slots do
     * not publish a request or invoke it. Direct caller checks run outside.
     * No name or cached result is inferred by this local path observation.
     */
    if (source->in_method_call == 1) {
        source->adapter_gate_observed = 1;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Select an argument TRANSPORT, not an allowed callable domain. Anything
 * lacking these independent binder premises still makes the same call and
 * carries U obligations. The real method-adapter path is separately observed
 * during CallMethod, before a tentative P/K may be used after normal return.
 */
static int
reno_h01_f0_can_transport_fullname(const RenoF0SourceContext *source)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyCodeObject *code;
    PyObject *names;
    PyObject *defaults;

    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(source->function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->code, &PyCode_Type)) { return 0; }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)source->function;
    code = (PyCodeObject *)source->code;
    if (function->func_code != source->code
            || function->vectorcall != _PyFunction_Vectorcall
            || code->co_argcount != 4 || code->co_posonlyargcount != 0
            || code->co_kwonlyargcount != 0
            || (code->co_flags & (CO_VARARGS | CO_VARKEYWORDS | CO_GENERATOR
                | CO_COROUTINE | CO_ASYNC_GENERATOR)) != 0) { return 0; }
    names = code->co_localsplusnames;
    defaults = function->func_defaults;
    return names != NULL && PyTuple_CheckExact(names) && PyTuple_GET_SIZE(names) >= 4
        && exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, 0), "cls", 3)
        && exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, 1), "fullname", 8)
        && exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, 2), "path", 4)
        && exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, 3), "target", 6)
        && defaults != NULL && PyTuple_CheckExact(defaults)
        && PyTuple_GET_SIZE(defaults) == 2
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(defaults, 0) == Py_None
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(defaults, 1) == Py_None;
}

/* Legal original vectorcall arguments remain stable and rooted by the actual
 * caller. NULL is the ordinary U outcome, not an allocation or missing-arg
 * error. No keyword comparison/hash/getattr or argument rewrite occurs here.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_h01_f0_take_fullname(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *const *args, size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode *mode)
{
    *mode = RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U;
    if (!reno_h01_f0_can_transport_fullname(source)) { return NULL; }
    Py_ssize_t nargs = PyVectorcall_NARGS(nargsf);
    if (nargs > 0) {
        *mode = RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P;
        return Py_NewRef(args[0]);
    }
    if (nargs != 0 || kwnames == NULL) { return NULL; }
    Py_ssize_t count = PyTuple_GET_SIZE(kwnames);
    for (Py_ssize_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        if (exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(kwnames, index), "fullname", 8)) {
            *mode = RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K;
            return Py_NewRef(args[index]);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
reno_h01_proxy_dispatch(PyObject *actual_owner, unsigned char role,
    PyObject *const *args, size_t nargsf, PyObject *kwnames)
{
    RenoProxyObject *self = (RenoProxyObject *)actual_owner;
    RenoF0SourceContext source = {0};
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode = RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U;
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *method_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *function_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *code_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *fullname_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *result = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *out = NULL;
    RenoState *state = NULL;
    unsigned int entered = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, "invalid private finder method role");
        goto failed; /* the real wrapper routes roles1/2 to their own consumer */
    }
    if (self == NULL || self->module_lifetime == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder lifetime unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(self->module_lifetime);
    state = prepare_common_state_normal(module_guard);
    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_h01_f0_owner_matches(self, module_guard, state)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder binding unavailable");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->controls.meta_active_count == PY_SSIZE_T_MAX) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_OverflowError, "native metadata activity capacity exceeded");
        goto failed;
    }
    ++state->controls.meta_active_count;
    entered = 1;
    if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 30, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 31, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 6, 1)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder roots unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    method_guard = Py_NewRef(state->arena.install.find_spec);
    function_guard = Py_NewRef(state->arena.known.roots[30]);
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(state->arena.known.roots[6]);
    code_guard = Py_NewRef(state->arena.known.roots[31]);
    source.owner = self; /* wrapper's original owner_guard stays continuously live */
    source.module = module_guard;
    source.state = state;
    source.tstate = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    source.method = method_guard;
    source.function = function_guard;
    source.klass = class_guard;
    source.code = code_guard;
    if (!reno_h01_f0_source_check(&source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder source unavailable");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    fullname_guard = reno_h01_f0_take_fullname(&source, args, nargsf, kwnames, &mode);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_h01_f0_source_check(&source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder source unavailable");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    source.in_method_call = 1;
    result = RenoOwnedResumeCallMethodV1(method_guard, code_guard, args, nargsf, kwnames,
        reno_h01_f0_source_check, &source);
    source.in_method_call = 0;
    if (result == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_h01_f0_source_check(&source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder source unavailable");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (source.adapter_gate_observed != 1) {
        mode = RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U;
    }
    /* This is the actual missing continuation, not a return-spec shortcut.
     * All roots and the same actual NEW result stay owned here throughout.
     */
    if (reno_h01_finish_find_spec(&source, mode,
            mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U ? NULL : fullname_guard, result) != 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto cleanup;

failed:
    first = take_failure();

cleanup:
    if (first != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&fullname_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&code_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&function_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&method_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (entered) {
        reno_common_metadata_leave(state, &entered, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* No further State or automatic source-context access after this leave. */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        out = first;
        first = NULL;
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out);
        return NULL;
    }
    return result;
}


/* This selector is consumed by the real F0 dispatcher. The conditional spec
 * prefix is below; complete COMPAT/binding are STILL UNDEFINED. Combined
 * source remains unbuildable/unadmitted. Parent checked its actual source
 * under all original roots/entered/current/GIL, with no callout before here.
 * No borrowed pointer comparison below can create those preconditions.
 */
static int
reno_h01_finish_find_spec(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec)
{
    RenoFinderTargetHint hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_UNPROVEN;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (source == NULL || source->in_method_call != 0 || actual_spec == NULL
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private finder result inputs");
        return -1;
    }
    if (actual_spec == Py_None) {
        return 0; /* actual None, not a namespace inferred via unknown loader */
    }
    if (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && PyUnicode_CheckExact(actual_fullname)) {
        if (exact_ascii_name(actual_fullname, "reno.personal_authority_guard_catalog", 37)) {
            hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_CATALOG;
        }
        else if (exact_ascii_name(actual_fullname, "reno.personal_authority_guard_control", 37)) {
            hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_CONTROL;
        }
        else if (exact_ascii_name(actual_fullname, "reno.personal_authority_guard_scope", 35)) {
            hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_SCOPE;
        }
        else if (exact_ascii_name(actual_fullname, "reno.personal_authority_guard_registration", 42)) {
            hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_REGISTRATION;
        }
        else {
            /* Independently transported P/K exact non-target: keep the same
             * actual result. In particular do not inspect, install, remove or
             * reclassify an earlier U wrapper on any shared loader alias.
             */
            return 0;
        }
    }
    /* Known target OR P/K nonexact OR U: actual dependency, no return-spec
     * shortcut. No spec/loader attribute, current type, eq/hash or name guess
     * precedes the ORIGINAL spec source gate below. The parent owns the
     * same spec/fullname/source for this entire call and its later cleanup.
     */
    if (!reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(source->state)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native original spec roots unavailable");
        }
        return -1;
    }
    return reno_h01_finish_spec_loader(source, mode, actual_fullname, actual_spec, hint);
}


/* Fixed new operand for this project's added C postprocessing. This is not
 * an old Python co_names operand, actual fullname, bank-ledger slot or M proof.
 * Original entered/module/State/current/GIL and callback-free T0 lifetime are
 * caller premises. Allocation can fail; every non-NULL result is immediately
 * State-owned, including incomplete history, before pending/fresh checks.
 */
static int
reno_spec_prepare_loader_key(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;

    if (!reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state)
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0) { return 0; }
    spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    if (spec->prepared_loader_key != NULL || spec->loader_key_prepared != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    spec->prepared_loader_key = PyUnicode_FromString("loader");
    if (spec->prepared_loader_key == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    /* Rejection only: a fresh snapshot cannot repair callback-lost T0 facts.
     * capture_consistent intentionally does not depend on key completion.
     */
    if (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || !reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state)
            || !exact_ascii_name(spec->prepared_loader_key, "loader", 6)) { return 0; }
    spec->loader_key_prepared = 1; /* construction history only */
    return 1;
}

typedef enum RenoSpecLoaderLookup {
    RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_UNKNOWN = 0,
    RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_ABSENT,
    RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_CLASS_VALUE,   /* get == NULL; set may be non-NULL */
    RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_DATA_GETTER,   /* get != NULL && set != NULL */
    RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_NONDATA_GETTER /* get != NULL && set == NULL */
} RenoSpecLoaderLookup;

/* Both operands are exact Unicode under the caller's held original bank and
 * the independently constructed key. Only raw characters; no hash/eq/effects.
 */
static int
reno_spec_loader_key_equal(PyObject *original, PyObject *prepared)
{
    Py_ssize_t index;
    int original_kind;
    int prepared_kind;
    const void *original_data;
    const void *prepared_data;

    if (!PyUnicode_CheckExact(original) || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(prepared)
            || PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH(original) != PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH(prepared)) {
        return 0;
    }
    original_kind = PyUnicode_KIND(original);
    prepared_kind = PyUnicode_KIND(prepared);
    original_data = PyUnicode_DATA(original);
    prepared_data = PyUnicode_DATA(prepared);
    for (index = 0; index < PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH(prepared); ++index) {
        if (PyUnicode_READ(original_kind, original_data, index)
                != PyUnicode_READ(prepared_kind, prepared_data, index)) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Raw plan is automatic and cannot escape or authorize M. Same-span full
 * capture_consistent precedes entry, so the rows are held ORIGINAL contents.
 * MRO order / first hit agrees with real lookup, but does NOT replace lookup
 * reference/cache/hash/version/effects or execute any descriptor payload.
 */
static RenoSpecLoaderLookup
reno_spec_loader_lookup_plan(const RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec)
{
    const RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region = &spec->region;
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *layout = &spec->inventory.capture_layout;
    size_t base_index;
    size_t ordinal;
    size_t entry_at;
    const RenoSpecMroBaseCapture *base;
    const RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *entry;

    if (spec->inventory.route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT) {
        return RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_UNKNOWN;
    }
    for (base_index = 0; base_index < layout->base_count; ++base_index) {
        base = &region->base[base_index];
        if (base->entry_start > layout->entry_count
                || base->entry_count > layout->entry_count - base->entry_start) {
            return RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_UNKNOWN;
        }
        for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < base->entry_count; ++ordinal) {
            entry_at = base->entry_start + ordinal;
            entry = &region->entry[entry_at];
            if (!reno_spec_loader_key_equal(entry->key, spec->prepared_loader_key)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (entry->observed_descr_get == NULL) {
                return RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_CLASS_VALUE;
            }
            if (entry->observed_descr_set != NULL) {
                return RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_DATA_GETTER;
            }
            return RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_NONDATA_GETTER;
        }
    }
    return RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_ABSENT; /* class domain only, not instance */
}

/* A local copy avoids casting away const or publishing a callback context.
 * Parent owns every root and entered debt; this makes no new lifetime/M proof.
 */
static int
reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(const RenoF0SourceContext *source)
{
    RenoF0SourceContext check;
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;

    if (source == NULL || source->in_method_call != 0) { return 0; }
    check = *source;
    if (!reno_h01_f0_source_check(&check)
            || !reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(source->state)) { return 0; }
    spec = &source->state->arena.spec_source;
    return spec->loader_key_prepared == 1 && spec->prepared_loader_key != NULL
        && exact_ascii_name(spec->prepared_loader_key, "loader", 6)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Full spec lookup compatibility at the existing pre-getter handoff.
 * The same actual spec and prepared key go through the standard attribute
 * dispatcher exactly once. Full binding/Record/execution continuations remain
 * separate obligations; this is neither a default rejection nor a success stub.
 */
static int
reno_h01_finish_spec_loader_compat(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint)
{
    PyObject *loader_key = NULL; /* borrowed only through this actual getter */
    PyObject *loader = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (actual_spec == NULL || actual_spec == Py_None
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)
            || !reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native spec loader source unavailable");
        }
        return -1;
    }
    /* The parent retains the original module/metadata lease. Retirement
     * defers arena draining; this is the existing key loan, not a new root or
     * a whole N4/source/reference certificate. Do not cache a finder read.
     */
    loader_key = source->state->arena.spec_source.prepared_loader_key;
    loader = PyObject_GetAttr(actual_spec, loader_key);
    loader_key = NULL;
    if (loader == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native spec loader source changed");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (loader == Py_None) { goto cleanup; } /* actual value after the getter */
    status = reno_h01_finish_actual_loader_binding(
        source, mode, actual_fullname, actual_spec, loader, target_hint);
    if (status < 0 || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (status != 0 || !reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader binding incomplete");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    goto cleanup;

failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* No State/context/source/key access after this potentially LAST release.
     * Parent still owns spec/fullname/module/lease; only this loader is ours.
     * Keep the actual first under the same independent primitive premises.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&loader, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* CONDITIONAL real prefix. Full source/ABI/selected code/normal primitives,
 * current GIL/caller/entered/reference/S1 and original epoch must independently
 * hold before these raw reads and effects; no pointer/flag/history makes them
 * true. UNKNOWN and reachable descriptor payloads retain complete COMPAT.
 */
static int
reno_h01_finish_spec_loader(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;
    PyTypeObject *klass;
    RenoSpecLoaderLookup plan;
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe storage;
    int instance_present = 0;
    PyObject *loader = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (actual_spec == NULL || actual_spec == Py_None
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)
            || !reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native spec loader source unavailable");
        }
        return -1;
    }
    spec = &source->state->arena.spec_source;
    klass = (PyTypeObject *)spec->klass; /* independent held ORIGINAL, not output */
    if (Py_TYPE(actual_spec) != klass
            || source->state->controls.getters[0].captured != 1
            || source->state->controls.getters[0].frozen != 1
            || source->state->controls.getters[0].expected != &PyObject_GenericGetAttr
            || spec->observed_getattro != source->state->controls.getters[0].expected
            || klass->tp_getattro != spec->observed_getattro
            || !(klass->tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_READY)) {
        return reno_h01_finish_spec_loader_compat(
            source, mode, actual_fullname, actual_spec, target_hint);
    }
    plan = reno_spec_loader_lookup_plan(spec);
    if (plan != RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_ABSENT
            && plan != RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_CLASS_VALUE
            && plan != RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_NONDATA_GETTER) {
        return reno_h01_finish_spec_loader_compat(
            source, mode, actual_fullname, actual_spec, target_hint);
    }
    storage = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_InstanceDomain(
        actual_spec, klass, spec->prepared_loader_key, &instance_present);
    if (storage == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { return -1; }
    if (storage != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            || (plan == RENO_SPEC_LOADER_LOOKUP_NONDATA_GETTER && instance_present != 1)) {
        return reno_h01_finish_spec_loader_compat(
            source, mode, actual_fullname, actual_spec, target_hint);
    }
    /* NONDATA enters only with an actual non-NULL instance slot, which
     * shadows its getter. Presence is NOT the getter result or namespace.
     * No callout between plan/storage and this actual one getter. Keep all
     * original lookup/cache/error/context/reference effects in real CPython.
     * A non-NULL NEW becomes local owning BEFORE pending or fresh checks.
     */
    loader = PyObject_GetAttr(actual_spec, spec->prepared_loader_key);
    if (loader == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native spec loader source changed");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (loader == Py_None) { goto cleanup; } /* actual namespace value only */
    status = reno_h01_finish_actual_loader_binding(
        source, mode, actual_fullname, actual_spec, loader, target_hint);
    if (status < 0 || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (status != 0 || !reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader binding incomplete");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    goto cleanup;

failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* No further State/context/plan access after this resource operation.
     * Parent retains spec/fullname/module/entered throughout and afterwards.
     * Actual first is preserved; pending deallocator/S1 remains a premise.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&loader, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Only original roots20/21/22, already acquired by the real T0 caller.
 * No owning field is added: these roots remain in the existing known ledger.
 * Actual module/State/current/GIL/reference/build and original epoch precede
 * every read. Scalar history is not source, physical layout or M admission.
 */
static int
reno_loader_layout_original_matches(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoLoaderSourceLayout *layout;
    PyTypeObject *klass;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || state == NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ROOTS_FROZEN
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_PREPARING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_INSTALLING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 21, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 22, 1)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(state->arena.known.roots[20], &PyType_Type)
            || !PyDict_CheckExact(state->arena.known.roots[21])
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(state->arena.known.roots[22])) { return 0; }
    layout = &state->controls.loader_layout;
    if (layout->captured != 1) { return 0; }
    klass = (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.known.roots[20];
    return _PyType_GetDict(klass) == state->arena.known.roots[21]
        && klass->tp_mro == state->arena.known.roots[22]
        && klass->tp_getattro == layout->getattro
        && klass->tp_getattr == layout->getattr
        && klass->tp_setattro == layout->setattro
        && klass->tp_setattr == layout->setattr
        && klass->tp_basicsize == layout->basicsize
        && klass->tp_itemsize == layout->itemsize
        && klass->tp_dictoffset == layout->dictoffset
        && klass->tp_weaklistoffset == layout->weaklistoffset
        && (klass->tp_flags & RENO_LOADER_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK) == layout->flags
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_t0_capture_loader_layout(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoLoaderSourceLayout *layout;
    PyTypeObject *klass;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || state == NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 21, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 22, 1)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(state->arena.known.roots[20], &PyType_Type)) { return 0; }
    layout = &state->controls.loader_layout;
    if (layout->captured != 0 || layout->getattro != NULL || layout->getattr != NULL
            || layout->setattro != NULL || layout->setattr != NULL
            || layout->basicsize != 0 || layout->itemsize != 0
            || layout->dictoffset != 0 || layout->weaklistoffset != 0
            || layout->flags != 0) { return 0; }
    klass = (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.known.roots[20];
    if (_PyType_GetDict(klass) != state->arena.known.roots[21]
            || klass->tp_mro != state->arena.known.roots[22]) { return 0; }
    layout->getattro = klass->tp_getattro;
    layout->getattr = klass->tp_getattr;
    layout->setattro = klass->tp_setattro;
    layout->setattr = klass->tp_setattr;
    layout->basicsize = klass->tp_basicsize;
    layout->itemsize = klass->tp_itemsize;
    layout->dictoffset = klass->tp_dictoffset;
    layout->weaklistoffset = klass->tp_weaklistoffset;
    layout->flags = klass->tp_flags & RENO_LOADER_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK;
    layout->captured = 1; /* original scalar acquisition history only */
    return reno_loader_layout_original_matches(state);
}

/* The existing full bridge includes actual temporary descriptor NEW/release
 * effects. It is not a pure scalar predicate. Its normal original primitive/
 * reference/no-external-callout envelope is an independent premise, not made
 * true by this caller or by a later recheck. All original roots stay held.
 */
static int
reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader)
{
    if (!reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)
            || !reno_loader_layout_original_matches(source->state)
            || actual_loader == NULL
            || Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20]) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (!reno_state_fixed_metadata_match(source->state)) { return 0; }
    return reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)
        && reno_loader_layout_original_matches(source->state)
        && Py_TYPE(actual_loader) == (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Real native dictionary-preparation prefix, consumed by finish_spec_loader.
 * All inputs borrow the SAME actual spec/one loader result and original F0
 * roots/lease. A new dictionary effect is never retried or rolled back here.
 * Full compatibility and complete Record installation remain dependencies.
 */
static int
reno_h01_finish_actual_loader_binding(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint)
{
    PyObject *dictionary = NULL;
    PyObject *previous = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe domain;
    int status;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (source == NULL || actual_spec == NULL || actual_spec == Py_None
            || actual_loader == NULL || actual_loader == Py_None
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader binding inputs");
        return -1;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, actual_loader)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
        return reno_h01_finish_loader_binding_compat(source, mode, actual_fullname,
            actual_spec, actual_loader, NULL, target_hint);
    }
    /* Direct selected C preparation, not a dynamic obj.__dict__ lookup.
     * Actual original M/allocator/GC/reference/S1 and valid layout/spans are
     * independent premises. It can allocate and INSTALL a backing dictionary.
     * Immediately own its actual NEW, even if a pending error accompanies it.
     */
    dictionary = PyObject_GenericGetDict(actual_loader, NULL);
    if (dictionary == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, actual_loader)) { goto changed; }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20], dictionary);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { goto failed; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) {
        /* The actual preparation already happened. COMPAT borrows its exact
         * returned occurrence; it cannot pretend the call has not happened or
         * repeat either GetDict, the loader getter or the underlying finder.
         */
        status = reno_h01_finish_loader_binding_compat(source, mode, actual_fullname,
            actual_spec, actual_loader, dictionary, target_hint);
        goto completed;
    }
    /* Full potential-key domain + backing identity have just been checked.
     * Reuse the existing raw exact-character live-entry reader; it is NOT
     * relied upon for whole-key-domain proof. A NULL borrow is actual absence,
     * while Py_None is a present previous value. Immediately acquire our NEW.
     */
    previous = Py_XNewRef(reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "exec_module", 11));
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, actual_loader)) { goto changed; }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20], dictionary);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { goto failed; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "exec_module", 11) != previous) {
        goto changed;
    }
    /* Complete alias/idempotency/external-replacement handling MUST precede
     * any new Record prepare/track/installation in this still-missing body.
     * Inputs are real held operands, not a new source or an ACTIVE certificate.
     */
    status = reno_h01_finish_loader_dictionary(source, mode, actual_fullname,
        actual_spec, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous != NULL, target_hint);
    if (status == 0 && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
            && !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, actual_loader)) { goto changed; }
completed:
    if (status != 0 || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto cleanup;

changed:
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader dictionary sources changed");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* No State/context/source/payload read after starting final cleanup.
     * Parent still roots loader/spec/module/entered. Do not restore or retry
     * the new preparation effect; preserve actual first through all releases.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&previous, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dictionary, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* This raw traversal requires the actual producer/ALL unlink exit paths to
 * have ALREADY established live, lawful, acyclic registry nodes in this GIL
 * span. No check below authenticates a pointer or repairs a broken lifetime.
 * No callback, release or saved next crosses a callback. FIRST match acquires
 * its real independent owning immediately; further matches only set MULTIPLE.
 * Even on failure the caller owns any reference written to record_owned.
 */
static int
reno_loader_record_query_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *current_value,
    PyObject *candidate_bound, /* independent actual product; NULL means unsupplied */
    PyObject **record_owned, RenoLoaderRecordObservation *observation)
{
    RenoState *state;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *prior = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordObservation seen = {0};
    unsigned char same_loader;
    unsigned char same_dictionary;
    unsigned char same_bound;
    unsigned char same_candidate_bound;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || source->module == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL
            || record_owned == NULL || *record_owned != NULL || observation == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader registry query");
        return 0;
    }
    state = source->state;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader registry sources changed");
        return 0;
    }
    record = state->controls.record_head;
    while (record != NULL) {
        /* Address readability precedes these consistency comparisons. The
         * independently State-held actual type/owner/module are expected.
         */
        if (Py_TYPE((PyObject *)record) != (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type
                || record->linked != 1 || record->registry_owner_state != state
                || record->origin_state != state || record->prev != prior
                || record->module_lifetime != source->module
                || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
                || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
                || record->original_loader == NULL || record->loader_dict == NULL
                || !PyDict_Check(record->loader_dict)
                || record->attribute_key == NULL
                || !exact_ascii_name(record->attribute_key, "exec_module", 11)
                || record->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT
                || record->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || record->previous_present > 1
                || (record->previous_present && record->previous_value == NULL)
                || (!record->previous_present && record->previous_value != NULL)
                || record->restore_cancelled > 1 || record->store_attempted > 1
                || record->store_returned > 1 || record->effect_observed > 1
                || record->restore_attempted > 1 || record->restore_returned > 1
                || record->restore_effect_observed > 1) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader registry consistency changed");
            return 0; /* caller cleans its already acquired owning, no more raw reads */
        }
        same_loader = record->original_loader == actual_loader;
        same_dictionary = record->loader_dict == dictionary;
        same_bound = current_value != NULL && record->installed_bound != NULL
            && current_value == record->installed_bound;
        same_candidate_bound = candidate_bound != NULL && record->installed_bound != NULL
            && candidate_bound == record->installed_bound;
        if (same_loader || same_dictionary || same_bound || same_candidate_bound) {
            if (seen.kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) {
                *record_owned = Py_NewRef((PyObject *)record);
                seen.kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE;
                seen.phase = record->phase;
                seen.same_loader = same_loader;
                seen.same_dictionary = same_dictionary;
                seen.current_is_installed_bound = same_bound;
                seen.candidate_bound_is_installed_bound = same_candidate_bound;
                seen.restore_cancelled = record->restore_cancelled;
                seen.store_attempted = record->store_attempted;
                seen.store_returned = record->store_returned;
                seen.effect_observed = record->effect_observed;
                seen.restore_attempted = record->restore_attempted;
                seen.restore_returned = record->restore_returned;
                seen.restore_effect_observed = record->restore_effect_observed;
            }
            else {
                seen.kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE;
            }
        }
        prior = record;
        record = record->next;
    }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    *observation = seen;
    return 1; /* complete scan, not complete alias/installation handling */
}

/* The same prepared backing and independently held CURRENT value from the
 * parent are still required before registry reads. No getter/GetDict retry,
 * hash/eq or expected-from-current assignment occurs here.
 */
static int
reno_h01_finish_loader_dictionary(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    unsigned char previous_present, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint)
{
    PyObject *record_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordObservation observation = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe domain;
    int status;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (source == NULL || actual_spec == NULL || actual_spec == Py_None
            || actual_loader == NULL || actual_loader == Py_None
            || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)
            || previous_present > 1 || (previous_present && previous == NULL)
            || (!previous_present && previous != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader dictionary inputs");
        return -1;
    }
    /* This full bridge has actual temporary reference effects. Its original
     * normal-primitive/S1/no-external-callout/M/T0 envelope is independent.
     */
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, actual_loader)) { goto changed; }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20], dictionary);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { goto failed; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "exec_module", 11) != previous) {
        goto changed;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_record_query_raw(source, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, NULL,
            &record_guard, &observation)) { goto failed; }
    /* A real held first Record (or actual absence) reaches the complete
     * missing selector. No prepare/track/store occurs before this query.
     * NONE/ONE/MULTIPLE and phase/facts do not themselves grant reuse/install.
     */
    status = reno_h01_finish_loader_record_selection(source, mode, actual_fullname,
        actual_spec, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present,
        record_guard, &observation, target_hint);
    if (status != 0 || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto cleanup;

changed:
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader dictionary inputs changed");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* No State/context/payload read after starting final release. The parent
     * independently holds dictionary/current/loader/spec/module/entered, and
     * performs its existing fresh gate after this cleanup has actually run.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Private automatic transport, not an enrollment or a source certificate.
 * module/function/code are borrows from this same caller's independent guards.
 * values[] are the caller's two actual owning slots AFTER a completed binder;
 * the missing dispatch may borrow them, never steal or retain this context.
 * ROOTS_HELD includes changed entry-code/dispatch domains still requiring the
 * same complete dispatch; UNPREPARED includes all other original input domains.
 */
typedef enum RenoLoaderBindingStage {
    RENO_LOADER_BINDING_UNPREPARED = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_BINDING_ROOTS_HELD,
    RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND
} RenoLoaderBindingStage;
typedef enum RenoLoaderValueOrigin {
    RENO_LOADER_VALUE_EMPTY = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_VALUE_POSITIONAL,
    RENO_LOADER_VALUE_KEYWORD,
    RENO_LOADER_VALUE_DEFAULT
} RenoLoaderValueOrigin;
/* Borrowed original F4 co_names/co_consts, NOT lookup results or source grants.
 * The same active caller independently owns entry code across dispatch.
 * A NULL operand is unselected/ambiguous, never actual missing or Python None.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderCodeOperands {
    PyObject *get_code_key;
    PyObject *name_key;
    PyObject *import_error_key;
    PyObject *dict_key;
    PyObject *bootstrap_key;
    PyObject *frames_key;
    PyObject *exec_key;
    PyObject *none_constant;
    PyObject *none_prefix_constant;
    PyObject *none_suffix_constant;
} RenoLoaderCodeOperands;

/* Automatic borrowed ORIGINAL source data, never a current binding grant.
 * Actual module/metadata loan keeps every immutable parent and child live.
 * The same tail may only borrow; no pointer survives leave or owning cleanup.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderFilenameSource {
    PyObject *lookup_key;
    PyObject *wrapper_row;
    PyObject *method;
    PyObject *method_code;
    PyObject *method_globals;
    PyObject *method_builtins;
    vectorcallfunc wrapper_dispatch;
    vectorcallfunc method_dispatch;
    unsigned char nullable_present[3];
} RenoLoaderFilenameSource;

/* This one automatic instance belongs to the actual inner caller. No copy
 * of its owning resume/out slots, and no borrowed address may escape the tail.
 * arguments[] also backs Prepare's real acquired-value ledger until closed.
 */
typedef enum RenoLoaderF3Stage {
    RENO_LOADER_F3_UNTOUCHED = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_F3_ENTRY_CODE_HELD,
    RENO_LOADER_F3_PREPARED,
    RENO_LOADER_F3_INVOKE_RETURNED
} RenoLoaderF3Stage;

/* DRAFT replacement for the native-private input/F3 automatic declarations.
 * Same actual inner activation; the carrier becomes this separately typed
 * new-ABI packet. No published State/Record/known root or TState slot is added.
 */
typedef RenoNativeOwnedInputsV2 RenoLoaderCallInputs;

typedef struct RenoLoaderF3Call {
    RenoLoaderCallInputs inputs;
    PyObject *entry_code;
    PyObject *result;
    PyThreadState *prepare_thread;
    RenoNativeOwnedCallV2 resume;
    RenoNativeOwnedMoveOutV2 moved;
    uint32_t prepare_status;
    uint32_t native_attempted;
    RenoLoaderF3Stage stage;
    unsigned int record_needs_close;
    RenoFinderTargetHint first_name_target_hint;
    unsigned int first_name_classified;
    unsigned int first_name_exact;
} RenoLoaderF3Call;

/* Same actual inner activation owns these two occurrences independently.
 * History is not freshness/caller/source admission and never clears on MOVE.
 * The existing complete dispatch borrows this actual automatic carrier only;
 * later explicit owner transfers must NULL these same live source slots.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderDynamicGetCodeLookup {
    PyObject *receiver_owned;
    PyObject *callee_owned;
    int method_found;
    unsigned char consumer_entered;
    unsigned char receiver_acquired;
    unsigned char getter_called;
    unsigned char getter_returned;
    unsigned char receiver_released;
    unsigned char unadmitted_return;
} RenoLoaderDynamicGetCodeLookup;

typedef struct RenoLoaderCallBinding {
    PyObject *module;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *function;
    PyObject *code;
    PyObject *entry_globals; /* borrows actual entry caller guard, not T0 */
    PyObject *entry_builtins; /* same independent entry occurrence transport */
    RenoLoaderCodeOperands operands;
    RenoLoaderFilenameSource filename_source;
    RenoLoaderF3Call *get_code_call; /* same actual caller's automatic loan */
    RenoLoaderDynamicGetCodeLookup *dynamic_get_code; /* actual caller owns both slots */
    RenoLoader312InstanceProbe get_code_instance;
    PyObject *get_code_callee; /* caller owns until MOVE to call.inputs */
    PyObject *get_code_self; /* independent CALL self, separate from F4 local */
    unsigned int get_code_class_binding_held;
    PyObject *first_name; /* actual first getter NEW; caller owns */
    unsigned int first_name_observed;
    PyObject *values[2];
    RenoLoaderValueOrigin origins[2];
    RenoLoaderBindingStage stage;
    unsigned int metadata_lease_held;
} RenoLoaderCallBinding;

/* Complete missing native execution/domain tail; SAME original outer argv.
 * Native inner keeps the selected removal of the original F4 Python frame.
 * BOUND consumes actual self/module bindings once; unselected/changed/direct/
 * retired/full custom domains remain COMPLETE obligations, not new rejection.
 *
 * dynamic_get_code, when supplied, borrows the SAME actual caller's automatic
 * input producer. Its called/returned and mode are history, not freshness.
 * A completed dynamic method lookup MUST NOT be repeated or reconstructed
 * from current attrs. Mode0 owns actual callable; mode1 also owns receiver.
 * A noncallable is still actual data: first name precedes CALL's TypeError.
 * Unadmitted history owes protocol handling, never default normal success.
 * Only explicit later MOVE may NULL these SAME source slots; no shallow copy
 * or escaped carrier. Existing outer cleanup ends this loan and settles each
 * unconsumed occurrence. No original F4 frame or business handled is implied.
 *
 * get_code_call is the SAME active caller's automatic V2 packet/record/out.
 * ENTRY_CODE_HELD still owns inputs in the packet. A selected PREPARED record
 * owns them in function_owned/arguments_owned; a READY change must preserve
 * this SAME pending and prepared context, never Prepare/ordinary retry.
 * CURRENT_STACK capacity loss returns NULL/attempted=0 without an error and
 * leaves PREPARED/READY/record_needs_close unchanged. That same tail owes its
 * complete lawful continuation; neither stage nor NULL authorizes a retry.
 * CURRENT_STACK has no raw/free debt or after-arena pending sample.
 * After COMMITTED, those input occurrences belong to the real F3 frame/binder
 * and may have been cleared or transferred to a frame object: no packet/argv
 * address can be used to read them. INVOKE_RETURNED never calls F3 again.
 * native_attempted is only actual Consume entry, not Python body/seed success.
 * The actual NEW result/entry-code remain caller-owned and only borrowed here.
 *
 * first_name_observed remains true even after the owning slot becomes NULL.
 * first_name_classified/first_name_exact/first_name_target_hint are observations
 * produced from that actual held getter result BEFORE MOVE. exact+UNPROVEN
 * means exact non-target; nonexact stays UNKNOWN, not silently non-target.
 * These private observations are not source/caller/seed authentication. The
 * full tail owes those independent gates and may not re-get the first name or
 * inspect dead inputs to reconstruct a target decision. None uses the original
 * SECOND name getter and actual native entry G/B ImportError lookup semantics.
 *
 * Classify actual pending before callbacks; use only V2's matching record APIs
 * and update its unique record_needs_close. Do not copy owners or retain any
 * automatic context. Preserve all legal eval_frame/monitoring/tracing/ordinary
 * and remaining source/ABI/build/COMPAT obligations. No fifth missing helper.
 */
static PyObject *reno_h01_loader_exec_dispatch(PyObject *actual_record,
    PyObject *const *actual_args, Py_ssize_t actual_nargs, PyObject *actual_kwnames,
    const RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding);

/* The selected code has two positional-or-keyword parameters and no kwonly.
 * Thus the original missing_arguments/format_missing reachable domain has
 * one or two names; the three-or-more/keyword-only branches are unreachable.
 * Keep original list -> per-name repr -> natural-language join -> TypeError
 * order. qualname was independently acquired at the ORIGINAL call site.
 */
static void
reno_loader_binder_missing(PyCodeObject *code, Py_ssize_t missing,
    Py_ssize_t defcount, PyObject *const *values, PyObject *qualname)
{
    PyObject *missing_names = NULL;
    PyObject *name_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *name_str = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    Py_ssize_t at = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    missing_names = PyList_New(missing);
    if (missing_names == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    for (index = 0; index < 2 - defcount; ++index) {
        if (values[index] == NULL) {
            name_owned = PyObject_Repr(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(code->co_localsplusnames, index));
            if (name_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
            PyList_SET_ITEM(missing_names, at++, name_owned); /* actual owning MOVE */
            name_owned = NULL;
        }
    }
    if (missing == 1) {
        name_str = Py_NewRef(PyList_GET_ITEM(missing_names, 0));
    } else {
        name_str = PyUnicode_FromFormat("%U and %U",
            PyList_GET_ITEM(missing_names, 0), PyList_GET_ITEM(missing_names, 1));
    }
    if (name_str == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError,
        "%U() missing %i required %s argument%s: %U", qualname, (int)missing,
        "positional", missing == 1 ? "" : "s", name_str);
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    /* Actual formatter/repr/OOM first precedes every may-last cleanup. */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&name_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&name_str, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&missing_names, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
}

/* Complete too_many_positional domain of this fixed two-parameter code.
 * The actual defaults length was consumed BEFORE allocation; a long defaults
 * tuple is legal, including a negative lower bound in the original wording.
 * The original empty kwonly_sig construction remains in the same order.
 */
static void
reno_loader_binder_too_many(Py_ssize_t given, Py_ssize_t defcount, PyObject *qualname)
{
    PyObject *sig = NULL;
    PyObject *kwonly_sig = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (defcount != 0) {
        sig = PyUnicode_FromFormat("from %zd to %zd", (Py_ssize_t)2 - defcount,
            (Py_ssize_t)2);
    } else {
        sig = PyUnicode_FromFormat("%zd", (Py_ssize_t)2);
    }
    if (sig == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    kwonly_sig = PyUnicode_FromString("");
    if (kwonly_sig == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError,
        "%U() takes %U positional argument%s but %zd%U %s given",
        qualname, sig, "s", given, kwonly_sig, given == 1 ? "was" : "were");
failed:
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&sig, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&kwonly_sig, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
}

/* No allocation, callout, release or source enrollment. Independent original
 * F4/code roots and matching physical layout precede this finite selector.
 * It selects only this port's domain; a miss delegates the untouched domain
 * to the same missing dispatch, rather than raising a new source error.
 */
static int
reno_loader_original_binding_domain(RenoState *state, PyObject *function,
    PyObject *code)
{
    PyCodeObject *entry;
    PyObject *names;

    if (code == NULL || code != state->arena.known.roots[67]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(code, &PyCode_Type)
            || state->controls.function_dispatch[4].captured != 1
            || state->controls.function_dispatch[4].standard_matched != 1
            || state->controls.function_dispatch[4].expected != &_PyFunction_Vectorcall
            || ((PyFunctionObject *)function)->vectorcall
                != state->controls.function_dispatch[4].expected) { return 0; }
    entry = (PyCodeObject *)code;
    if (entry->co_argcount != 2 || entry->co_posonlyargcount != 0
            || entry->co_kwonlyargcount != 0
            || (entry->co_flags & (CO_VARARGS | CO_VARKEYWORDS | CO_GENERATOR
                | CO_COROUTINE | CO_ASYNC_GENERATOR)) != 0) { return 0; }
    names = entry->co_localsplusnames;
    return names != NULL && PyTuple_CheckExact(names) && PyTuple_GET_SIZE(names) >= 2
        && exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, 0), "self", 4)
        && exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, 1), "module", 6);
}

/* Full original-code two-slot algorithm. Actual argv/kwnames and every
 * operand are continuously rooted by the real caller across all callbacks.
 * The matched normal NewRef/nonlast envelope is independent, not proved by
 * pointer checks. No State/arena/fresh check interrupts keyword/default use.
 * A keyword may change func_code/defaults/qualname or retire the generation;
 * this binder keeps its entry code and reads dynamic fields at their uses.
 */
static int
reno_loader_bind_original_arguments(PyObject *function_owned, PyObject *code_owned,
    PyObject *const *args, Py_ssize_t positional, PyObject *kwnames,
    RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding)
{
    PyFunctionObject *function = (PyFunctionObject *)function_owned;
    PyCodeObject *code = (PyCodeObject *)code_owned;
    PyObject *values[2] = {NULL, NULL};
    RenoLoaderValueOrigin origins[2] = {RENO_LOADER_VALUE_EMPTY, RENO_LOADER_VALUE_EMPTY};
    PyObject *qualname_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *release_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *keyword;
    PyObject **defs;
    Py_ssize_t keyword_count = kwnames == NULL ? 0 : PyTuple_GET_SIZE(kwnames);
    Py_ssize_t positional_acquired = 0;
    Py_ssize_t keyword_acquired = 0;
    Py_ssize_t positional_cursor = 0;
    Py_ssize_t keyword_cursor = 0;
    Py_ssize_t n = positional < 2 ? positional : 2;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    Py_ssize_t slot;
    Py_ssize_t defcount;
    Py_ssize_t m;
    Py_ssize_t missing;
    int cmp;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Each occurrence is a separate owning debt; do not deduplicate or
     * consume the caller's borrowed references. These raw acquisitions do
     * not allocate/call out under the independently matched envelope.
     */
    while (positional_acquired < positional) {
        Py_INCREF(args[positional_acquired]);
        ++positional_acquired;
    }
    while (keyword_acquired < keyword_count) {
        Py_INCREF(args[positional + keyword_acquired]);
        ++keyword_acquired;
    }
    while (positional_cursor < n) {
        slot = positional_cursor++;
        values[slot] = args[slot]; /* MOVE this P occurrence */
        origins[slot] = RENO_LOADER_VALUE_POSITIONAL;
    }
    while (positional_cursor < positional_acquired) {
        release_owned = args[positional_cursor++];
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&release_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (first != NULL) { goto cleanup; }
    }
    while (keyword_cursor < keyword_count) {
        keyword = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(kwnames, keyword_cursor);
        if (keyword == NULL || !PyUnicode_Check(keyword)) {
            qualname_guard = Py_NewRef(function->func_qualname);
            PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError, "%U() keywords must be strings", qualname_guard);
            goto failed;
        }
        for (slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
            if (PyTuple_GET_ITEM(code->co_localsplusnames, slot) == keyword) {
                goto found;
            }
        }
        for (slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
            cmp = PyObject_RichCompareBool(keyword,
                PyTuple_GET_ITEM(code->co_localsplusnames, slot), Py_EQ);
            if (cmp > 0) { goto found; }
            if (cmp < 0) { goto failed; }
        }
        qualname_guard = Py_NewRef(function->func_qualname);
        PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError, "%U() got an unexpected keyword argument '%S'",
            qualname_guard, keyword);
        goto failed;
found:
        if (values[slot] != NULL) {
            qualname_guard = Py_NewRef(function->func_qualname);
            PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError, "%U() got multiple values for argument '%S'",
                qualname_guard, keyword);
            goto failed;
        }
        values[slot] = args[positional + keyword_cursor]; /* MOVE this Q occurrence */
        origins[slot] = RENO_LOADER_VALUE_KEYWORD;
        ++keyword_cursor;
    }
    if (positional > 2) {
        /* Read actual defaults before the first helper allocation. */
        defcount = function->func_defaults == NULL ? 0 : PyTuple_GET_SIZE(function->func_defaults);
        qualname_guard = Py_NewRef(function->func_qualname);
        reno_loader_binder_too_many(positional, defcount, qualname_guard);
        goto failed;
    }
    if (positional < 2) {
        defcount = function->func_defaults == NULL ? 0 : PyTuple_GET_SIZE(function->func_defaults);
        m = 2 - defcount;
        missing = 0;
        for (index = positional; index < m; ++index) {
            if (values[index] == NULL) { ++missing; }
        }
        if (missing != 0) {
            qualname_guard = Py_NewRef(function->func_qualname);
            reno_loader_binder_missing(code, missing, defcount, values, qualname_guard);
            goto failed;
        }
        index = n > m ? n - m : 0;
        if (defcount != 0) {
            /* Original second field read. All tuple reads/NewRef/MOVEs below
             * share the matched no-callback raw span, even for long defaults.
             */
            defs = &PyTuple_GET_ITEM(function->func_defaults, 0);
            for (; index < defcount; ++index) {
                if (values[m + index] == NULL) {
                    values[m + index] = Py_NewRef(defs[index]);
                    origins[m + index] = RENO_LOADER_VALUE_DEFAULT;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    binding->values[0] = values[0];
    values[0] = NULL;
    binding->origins[0] = origins[0];
    binding->values[1] = values[1];
    values[1] = NULL;
    binding->origins[1] = origins[1];
    binding->stage = RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND;
    return 0; /* no P/Q/temp debt remains, two actual owning MOVEs completed */
failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* The extra qualname guard was acquired after P/Q and can be last.
     * Retire each remaining range occurrence before release; Q includes the
     * actual failing keyword, never i+1. Already moved slots are separate.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&qualname_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    while (positional_cursor < positional_acquired) {
        release_owned = args[positional_cursor++];
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&release_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    while (keyword_cursor < keyword_acquired) {
        release_owned = args[positional + keyword_cursor++];
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&release_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&values[0], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&values[1], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return -1;
}

/* Only after the ORIGINAL code binder succeeds. code_owned is this caller's
 * independent entry F4 guard, selected before any keyword callback. Its
 * immutable co_names/str child chain survives current-code changes/retirement.
 * No State/arena/current-function read, NEW, hash, lookup, callout or release.
 * This transports operands only; complete E00, getter/source/ABI and future
 * owning lookup_name_guard/hash preparation remain separate obligations.
 */
static void
reno_loader_select_original_operands(PyObject *code_owned,
    RenoLoaderCodeOperands *operands)
{
    static const char *const labels[4] = {
        "get_code", "__name__", "ImportError", "__dict__"
    };
    static const Py_ssize_t lengths[4] = {8, 8, 11, 8};
    PyObject *selected[4] = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    unsigned char matches[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    PyObject *names;
    PyObject *key;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    unsigned int slot;

    operands->get_code_key = NULL;
    operands->name_key = NULL;
    operands->import_error_key = NULL;
    operands->dict_key = NULL;
    if (code_owned == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(code_owned, &PyCode_Type)) { return; }
    names = ((PyCodeObject *)code_owned)->co_names;
    if (names == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(names)) { return; }
    for (index = 0; index < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(names); ++index) {
        key = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, index);
        if (key == NULL) { continue; }
        for (slot = 0; slot < 4; ++slot) {
            if (exact_ascii_name(key, labels[slot], lengths[slot])) {
                selected[slot] = matches[slot] == 0 ? key : NULL;
                if (matches[slot] < 2) { ++matches[slot]; }
                break; /* saturate ambiguity; a third match cannot resurrect */
            }
        }
    }
    operands->get_code_key = selected[0];
    operands->name_key = selected[1];
    operands->import_error_key = selected[2];
    operands->dict_key = selected[3];
}

/* Same actual inner caller owns entry code across every operand loan.
 * Only immutable code/tuple/exact-str data is read. These are candidate
 * operands, never current bindings, lookup results or source admission.
 */
static void
reno_loader_select_body_operands(PyObject *code_owned,
    RenoLoaderCodeOperands *operands)
{
    static const char *const name_labels[3] = {
        "_bootstrap", "_call_with_frames_removed", "exec"
    };
    static const Py_ssize_t name_lengths[3] = {10, 25, 4};
    static const char *const text_labels[2] = {
        "cannot load module ", " when get_code() returns None"
    };
    static const Py_ssize_t text_lengths[2] = {19, 29};
    PyObject *selected_names[3] = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *selected_texts[2] = {NULL, NULL};
    unsigned char name_matches[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    unsigned char text_matches[2] = {0, 0};
    PyObject *selected_none = NULL;
    unsigned char none_matches = 0;
    PyCodeObject *code;
    PyObject *domain;
    PyObject *value;
    Py_ssize_t index;
    unsigned int slot;

    operands->bootstrap_key = NULL;
    operands->frames_key = NULL;
    operands->exec_key = NULL;
    operands->none_constant = NULL;
    operands->none_prefix_constant = NULL;
    operands->none_suffix_constant = NULL;
    if (code_owned == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(code_owned, &PyCode_Type)) { return; }
    code = (PyCodeObject *)code_owned;
    domain = code->co_names;
    if (domain != NULL && PyTuple_CheckExact(domain)) {
        for (index = 0; index < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(domain); ++index) {
            value = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(domain, index);
            if (value == NULL) { continue; }
