            for (slot = 0; slot < 3; ++slot) {
                if (exact_ascii_name(value, name_labels[slot], name_lengths[slot])) {
                    selected_names[slot] = name_matches[slot] == 0 ? value : NULL;
                    if (name_matches[slot] < 2) { ++name_matches[slot]; }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    domain = code->co_consts;
    if (domain != NULL && PyTuple_CheckExact(domain)) {
        for (index = 0; index < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(domain); ++index) {
            value = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(domain, index);
            if (value == NULL) { continue; }
            if (value == Py_None) {
                selected_none = none_matches == 0 ? value : NULL;
                if (none_matches < 2) { ++none_matches; }
                continue;
            }
            for (slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
                if (exact_ascii_name(value, text_labels[slot], text_lengths[slot])) {
                    selected_texts[slot] = text_matches[slot] == 0 ? value : NULL;
                    if (text_matches[slot] < 2) { ++text_matches[slot]; }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    operands->bootstrap_key = selected_names[0];
    operands->frames_key = selected_names[1];
    operands->exec_key = selected_names[2];
    operands->none_constant = selected_none;
    operands->none_prefix_constant = selected_texts[0];
    operands->none_suffix_constant = selected_texts[1];
}

/* This SAME post-binder raw span has actual Record/module/State/Proxy/lease,
 * original loader/layout and instance-ABSENT qualification. Original T0 roots
 * and private immutable CSW/snapshot provenance precede every read. No public
 * alias or current operand is enrolled as expected; no getter/descriptor runs.
 * This proves a local original class-method relation, not full call admission.
 */
static int
reno_loader_original_get_code_binding_matches(RenoState *state)
{
    static const unsigned char required[] = {11, 14, 15, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22, 57, 107};
    static const unsigned char dict_slots[3] = {21, 15, 18};
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord klass_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord base_record;
    const char *data;
    PyObject **roots;
    PyObject *dicts;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *entry;
    PyObject *expected;
    PyObject *expected_mro[5];
    size_t count;
    size_t base_at;
    Py_ssize_t item;
    unsigned int index;
    unsigned int ordinal;
    unsigned int found;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || state == NULL
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < sizeof(required) / sizeof(required[0]); ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, required[index], 1)) { return 0; }
    }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(roots[20], &PyType_Type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[11], &PyType_Type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[57], &PyFunction_Type)
            || !(PyFunction_Type.tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_METHOD_DESCRIPTOR)
            || state->controls.getters[0].captured != 1
            || state->controls.getters[0].frozen != 1
            || state->controls.getters[0].expected != &PyObject_GenericGetAttr
            || ((PyTypeObject *)roots[20])->tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[0].expected
            || !(((PyTypeObject *)roots[20])->tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_READY)) { return 0; }
    snapshot = roots[107];
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != roots[20]
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1) != roots[22]
            || !reno_csw_open(state->arena.class_source_witness, &layout, &data, &dicts)
            || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 0, 4, &klass_record)
            || klass_record.flag[0] != 4 || klass_record.scalar[1] != 5
            || !reno_csw_range(klass_record.scalar[0], 5, layout.count[1])) { return 0; }
    mro = roots[22];
    bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, 5) || !reno_ws_source_tuple(bases, 5)
            || ((PyTypeObject *)roots[20])->tp_mro != mro) { return 0; }
    expected_mro[0] = roots[20];
    expected_mro[1] = roots[14];
    expected_mro[2] = roots[17];
    expected_mro[3] = roots[11];
    expected_mro[4] = (PyObject *)&PyBaseObject_Type;
    for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < 5; ++ordinal) {
        if (PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, ordinal) != expected_mro[ordinal]) { return 0; }
    }
    /* Only the actually visited prefix before/including the first winner.
     * Current unrelated entries/counts/values and later dictionaries are not
     * frozen. Original snapshot entries are independently held T0 facts.
     */
    for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < 3; ++ordinal) {
        base_at = klass_record.scalar[0] + ordinal;
        if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 1, base_at, &base_record)
                || base_record.scalar[0] != 4 || base_record.scalar[1] != ordinal
                || !reno_csw_range(base_record.scalar[2], base_record.scalar[3], layout.count[2])) { return 0; }
        base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, ordinal);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2)) { return 0; }
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0);
        entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
        dictionary = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)base_at);
        if (base != expected_mro[ordinal] || !Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)
                || dictionary != roots[dict_slots[ordinal]]
                || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base) != dictionary
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(entries, base_record.scalar[3])
                || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return 0; }
        expected = NULL;
        found = 0;
        for (item = 0; item < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entries); ++item) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, item);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                    || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0))) { return 0; }
            if (exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0), "get_code", 8)) {
                if (found) { return 0; }
                found = 1;
                expected = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1);
            }
        }
        if ((ordinal < 2 && found)
                || (ordinal == 2 && (!found || expected != roots[57]))
                || reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "get_code", 8) != expected) { return 0; }
    }
    /* Exactly the selected F3 row. No F4 code/defaults or all-class checker.
     * METHOD_DESCRIPTOR selected the original method branch BEFORE get/set.
     * Saved/current vectorcall is compared, never directly invoked here.
     */
    return reno_state_function_metadata_matches(state, 3)
        && state->controls.function_dispatch[3].standard_matched == 1
        && state->controls.function_dispatch[3].expected == &_PyFunction_Vectorcall
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Post-binder instance observation and original class binding selection.
 * One caller-owned F3 root is acquired only after the complete local witness;
 * this is not full E00 or business-call authorization.
 * The caller still owns actual Record/module/code and both bound operands,
 * with its original metadata debt. Never reuse pre-keyword eligibility.
 * known20 is independently owned by that arena/lease, not captured from obj.
 * Failure/pending adds no rejection and leaves the SAME missing tail in charge.
 */
static void
reno_loader_observe_original_instance(PyObject *record_owned,
    RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)record_owned;
    RenoState *state = binding->state;
    PyObject *loader = binding->values[0];
    PyTypeObject *original_class;

    binding->get_code_instance = RENO_LOADER312_SOURCE_OR_BRIDGE_PENDING;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || binding->stage != RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND
            || binding->module == NULL || state == NULL
            || binding->metadata_lease_held != 1 || loader == NULL
            || binding->operands.get_code_key == NULL
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->module_lifetime != binding->module || record->origin_state != state
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || record->owner_proxy == NULL
            || record->owner_proxy != state->arena.install.proxy
            || ((RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy)->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
            || ((RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy)->module_lifetime != binding->module
            || ((RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy)->origin_state != state
            || record->original_loader == NULL || record->original_loader != loader
            || !reno_loader_layout_original_matches(state)) { return; }
    original_class = (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.known.roots[20];
    if (Py_TYPE(loader) != original_class
            || !(original_class->tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_READY)) { return; }
    /* No callout since the current layout/source-storage qualification. The
     * scalar is valid only for this span, NOT after name or any other callback.
     */
    binding->get_code_instance = _PyReno_Loader312_InstanceProbe(
        loader, original_class, binding->operands.get_code_key);
    if (binding->get_code_instance == RENO_LOADER312_INSTANCE_ABSENT
            && binding->get_code_callee == NULL && binding->get_code_self == NULL
            && reno_loader_original_get_code_binding_matches(state)) {
        /* Independent original CALL self, not the F4 local in values[0].
         * Actual NEW reference cost remains subject to the full source model.
         */
        binding->get_code_self = Py_NewRef(loader);
        binding->get_code_callee = Py_NewRef(state->arena.known.roots[57]);
        binding->get_code_class_binding_held = 1;
    }
}

/* Called immediately after the same original binding observer, with no
 * intervening callout/release under the independently matched normal source,
 * reference/free/CRT/S1 and cache-invariant envelope. The local held fact is
 * not full E00 or next-call admission. All normal builtin type/layout/GIL and
 * original getter implementation/code-lifetime premises precede these reads.
 * Only a present exact-module path is selected here; other domains retain the
 * SAME complete missing dispatch. No current value is enrolled as expected.
 */
static int
reno_loader_observe_first_name(RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding)
{
    RenoState *state = binding->state;
    PyObject *actual_module = binding->values[1];
    PyObject *key = binding->operands.name_key;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *module_dictionary;
    PyObject *base_dictionary;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    size_t count;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (binding->stage != RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND
            || binding->metadata_lease_held != 1 || state == NULL
            || binding->get_code_class_binding_held != 1
            || binding->get_code_callee == NULL
            || binding->first_name_observed != 0 || binding->first_name != NULL
            || actual_module == NULL || !PyModule_CheckExact(actual_module)
            || key == NULL || !exact_ascii_name(key, "__name__", 8)
            || ((PyASCIIObject *)key)->hash == -1
            || state->controls.getters[2].captured != 1
            || state->controls.getters[2].frozen != 1
            || state->controls.getters[2].expected == NULL
            || PyModule_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[2].expected
            || !(PyModule_Type.tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_READY)
            || (PyModule_Type.tp_flags & Py_TPFLAGS_MANAGED_DICT)
            || PyModule_Type.tp_basicsize != (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(PyModuleObject)
            || PyModule_Type.tp_itemsize != 0
            || PyModule_Type.tp_dictoffset != (Py_ssize_t)offsetof(PyModuleObject, md_dict)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* GenericGetAttr must read this same actual md_dict through its normal
     * positive ComputedDictPointer offset. Needed class absence prevents a
     * descriptor, not a claim that all class metadata is immutable/verified.
     */
    mro = PyModule_Type.tp_mro;
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, 2)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, 0) != (PyObject *)&PyModule_Type
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, 1) != (PyObject *)&PyBaseObject_Type) { return 0; }
    module_dictionary = _PyType_GetDict(&PyModule_Type);
    base_dictionary = _PyType_GetDict(&PyBaseObject_Type);
    dictionary = ((PyModuleObject *)actual_module)->md_dict;
    if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(module_dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(module_dictionary, "__name__", 8) != NULL
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(base_dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(base_dictionary, "__name__", 8) != NULL
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "__name__", 8) == NULL) { return 0; }
    /* The NAME key's own cached hash and exact-str domains avoid unknown
     * hash/eq here. Normal _PyType_Lookup may still update its cache and release
     * an old exact Unicode/None name: normal primitive/source/free premises
     * cover those actual operations, not a fabricated zero-effect receipt.
     * Present payload (including Py_None) avoids module __getattr__/missing
     * error/spec operations. Never use the raw pre-read payload as the return.
     * No borrowed mro/dictionary pointer is dereferenced after this call.
     */
    binding->first_name_observed = 1;
    binding->get_code_instance = RENO_LOADER312_SOURCE_OR_BRIDGE_PENDING;
    binding->first_name = PyObject_GetAttr(actual_module, key);
    if (binding->first_name == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    return 1; /* actual NEW, not str/coercion or final F3-call authorization */
}

/* ORIGINAL expected operands only, under this actual caller's continuous
 * module guard/metadata debt and normal matching source/layout/GIL premises.
 * No current lookup, binding probe, func_code/cell-content sample or source
 * grant. Retired-but-loaned roots are not an ordinary NEW entry or busy policy.
 */
static void
reno_loader_select_original_filename_source(const RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding,
    RenoLoaderFilenameSource *output)
{
    static const unsigned char required[] = {14, 15, 20, 22, 57, 58, 107, 110, 111, 112};
    static const unsigned char nullable_at[3] = {2, 3, 5};
    RenoLoaderFilenameSource selected = {0};
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord klass_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord base_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord entry_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord dispatch_record;
    RenoState *state = binding->state;
    PyObject **roots;
    const char *data;
    PyObject *dicts;
    PyObject *names;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *entry;
    PyObject *original_entry = NULL;
    PyObject *rows;
    PyObject *row;
    PyObject *wrapper_code;
    PyObject *closure;
    PyObject *cells;
    PyObject *cell_record;
    PyObject *method;
    size_t base_at;
    size_t entry_at = 0;
    size_t dispatch_at;
    Py_ssize_t item;
    unsigned int field;
    unsigned int matches = 0;

    *output = selected;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || binding->stage != RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND
            || binding->metadata_lease_held != 1 || binding->module == NULL
            || binding->get_code_class_binding_held != 1
            || binding->get_code_callee == NULL || binding->first_name_observed != 1
            || binding->first_name == NULL || state == NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete != 1
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.captured != 1
            || state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.standard_matched > 1) { return; }
    for (field = 0; field < sizeof(required) / sizeof(required[0]); ++field) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, required[field], 1)) { return; }
    }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    if (binding->get_code_callee != roots[57]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[58], &PyCode_Type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[110], &PyCode_Type)) { return; }
    /* Keep the actual original CODE operand, not the class-entry key. */
    names = ((PyCodeObject *)roots[58])->co_names;
    if (names == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(names)) { return; }
    for (item = 0; item < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(names); ++item) {
        if (exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, item), "get_filename", 12)) {
            if (matches == 0) { key = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names, item); }
            if (matches < 2) { ++matches; }
        }
    }
    if (matches != 1) { return; }
    snapshot = roots[107];
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != roots[20]
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1) != roots[22]
            || !reno_csw_open(state->arena.class_source_witness, &layout, &data, &dicts)
            || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 0, 4, &klass_record)
            || klass_record.flag[0] != 4 || klass_record.scalar[1] != 5
            || !reno_csw_range(klass_record.scalar[0], 5, layout.count[1])
            || !reno_csw_range(klass_record.scalar[2], klass_record.scalar[3],
                layout.count[3])) { return; }
    mro = roots[22];
    bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
    rows = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 3);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, 5) || !reno_ws_source_tuple(bases, 5)
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(rows, klass_record.scalar[3])
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, 0) != roots[20]
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, 1) != roots[14]) { return; }
    base_at = klass_record.scalar[0] + 1;
    if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 1, base_at, &base_record)
            || base_record.scalar[0] != 4 || base_record.scalar[1] != 1
            || !reno_csw_range(base_record.scalar[2], base_record.scalar[3], layout.count[2])
            || !reno_csw_range(base_record.scalar[4], base_record.scalar[5], layout.count[3])
            || base_record.scalar[4] < klass_record.scalar[2]
            || !reno_csw_range(base_record.scalar[4] - klass_record.scalar[2],
                base_record.scalar[5], klass_record.scalar[3])
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)base_at) != roots[15]) { return; }
    base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, 1);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2) || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0) != roots[14]) { return; }
    entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entries, base_record.scalar[3])) { return; }
    for (item = 0; item < PyTuple_GET_SIZE(entries); ++item) {
        entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, item);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0))) { return; }
        if (exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0), "get_filename", 12)) {
            if (original_entry != NULL) { return; }
            original_entry = entry;
            entry_at = base_record.scalar[2] + (size_t)item;
        }
    }
    if (original_entry == NULL
            || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 2, entry_at, &entry_record)
            || entry_record.scalar[0] != base_at
            || entry_record.scalar[1] != entry_at - base_record.scalar[2]
            || entry_record.flag[0] != RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
            || entry_record.scalar[3] != 1
            || !reno_csw_range(entry_record.scalar[2], 1, layout.count[3])
            || entry_record.scalar[2] < base_record.scalar[4]
            || !reno_csw_range(entry_record.scalar[2] - base_record.scalar[4],
                1, base_record.scalar[5])) { return; }
    dispatch_at = entry_record.scalar[2];
    if (dispatch_at < klass_record.scalar[2]
            || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_at - klass_record.scalar[2], 1, klass_record.scalar[3])
            || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 3, dispatch_at, &dispatch_record)
            || dispatch_record.scalar[0] != base_at || dispatch_record.scalar[1] != entry_at
            || dispatch_record.flag[0] != RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN) { return; }
    row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(rows, (Py_ssize_t)(dispatch_at - klass_record.scalar[2]));
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(row, 9)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 0) != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(original_entry, 1)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 0), &PyFunction_Type)) { return; }
    for (field = 0; field < 3; ++field) {
        if (dispatch_record.flag[1 + field] > 1
                || (!dispatch_record.flag[1 + field]
                    && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, nullable_at[field]) != Py_None)) { return; }
    }
    wrapper_code = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 1);
    closure = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 5);
    cells = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(row, 6);
    if (dispatch_record.flag[3] != 1 || !Py_IS_TYPE(wrapper_code, &PyCode_Type)
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(closure, 1) || !reno_ws_source_tuple(cells, 1)) { return; }
    names = ((PyCodeObject *)wrapper_code)->co_localsplusnames;
    if (((PyCodeObject *)wrapper_code)->co_nfreevars != 1
            || ((PyCodeObject *)wrapper_code)->co_nlocalsplus <= 0
            || names == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(names)
            || PyTuple_GET_SIZE(names) != ((PyCodeObject *)wrapper_code)->co_nlocalsplus
            || !exact_ascii_name(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(names,
                ((PyCodeObject *)wrapper_code)->co_nlocalsplus - 1), "method", 6)) { return; }
    cell_record = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cells, 0);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(cell_record, 3) || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cell_record, 1) != Py_True
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cell_record, 0) != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(closure, 0)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cell_record, 0), &PyCell_Type)) { return; }
    method = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(cell_record, 2);
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(method, &PyFunction_Type)) { return; }
    /* The immutable captured record holds ORIGINAL method identity. known110
     * came from that method in the real T0 producer; no current-code equality
     * can repair missing history. The future actual consumer still owes its
     * current binding/source/phase gates after every preparation/callback.
     */
    selected.lookup_key = key;
    selected.wrapper_row = row;
    selected.method = method;
    selected.method_code = roots[110];
    selected.method_globals = roots[111];
    selected.method_builtins = roots[112];
    selected.wrapper_dispatch = dispatch_record.vectorcall;
    selected.method_dispatch = state->controls.filename_method_dispatch.expected;
    for (field = 0; field < 3; ++field) {
        selected.nullable_present[field] = dispatch_record.flag[1 + field];
    }
    *output = selected; /* data only, not a certificate or callable selection */
}

/* DRAFT replacement for the existing adopt/close/fresh/try F3 helper section.
 * The existing original instance selection/first getter/filename source and
 * native two-value binder remain their same actual producers.
 */
static void
reno_loader_f3_adopt_pending(RenoLoaderF3Call *call,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    PyObject *later = NULL;

    if (call->moved.pending_owned != NULL) {
        later = *first_owned;
        *first_owned = call->moved.pending_owned;
        call->moved.pending_owned = NULL;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&later, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, cleanup_failed);
}

static void
reno_loader_f3_close(RenoLoaderF3Call *call,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed)
{
    void *free_argument = NULL;
    size_t free_bytes = 0;
    if (call->record_needs_close) {
        RenoNativeOwnedMoveUnconsumedV2(&call->resume, &call->moved);
        call->record_needs_close = 0;
    }
    reno_loader_f3_adopt_pending(call, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    if (call->moved.raw_to_free != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, cleanup_failed);
        free_argument = call->moved.raw_to_free;
        free_bytes = call->moved.raw_bytes;
        call->moved.raw_to_free = NULL;
        call->moved.raw_bytes = 0;
        _PyRuntime.allocators.obj_arena.free(_PyRuntime.allocators.obj_arena.ctx,
            free_argument, free_bytes);
        free_argument = NULL;
        free_bytes = 0;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* Actual owning output slots replace V1's borrowed argv cleanup view.
     * Each mask bit records a real output MOVE and is cleared before release.
     * Only unconsumed prefix inputs arrive here; committed frame inputs do not.
     */
    if (call->moved.argument_owned_mask & 2) {
        call->moved.argument_owned_mask &= ~2U;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&call->moved.arguments_owned[1],
            first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (call->moved.argument_owned_mask & 1) {
        call->moved.argument_owned_mask &= ~1U;
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&call->moved.arguments_owned[0],
            first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&call->moved.locals_owned, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&call->moved.function_owned, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&call->moved.check_callable_owned, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    call->prepare_thread = NULL;
}

/* Consume this actual first getter result while it is still independently
 * packet-owned. Only exact Unicode uses raw characters; no hash/eq/getter.
 * This is a transient observation for the SAME native call, not source,
 * caller, seed or permission. UNKNOWN is not converted into non-target.
 * The full tail must never dereference a consumed name to reconstruct it.
 */
static void
reno_loader_f3_classify_first_name(RenoLoaderF3Call *call)
{
    PyObject *name = call->inputs.first_name;
    call->first_name_target_hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_UNPROVEN;
    call->first_name_exact = 0;
    call->first_name_classified = 0;
    if (name == NULL) { return; }
    if (PyUnicode_CheckExact(name)) {
        call->first_name_exact = 1;
        if (exact_ascii_name(name, "reno.personal_authority_guard_catalog", 37)) {
            call->first_name_target_hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_CATALOG;
        }
        else if (exact_ascii_name(name, "reno.personal_authority_guard_control", 37)) {
            call->first_name_target_hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_CONTROL;
        }
        else if (exact_ascii_name(name, "reno.personal_authority_guard_scope", 35)) {
            call->first_name_target_hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_SCOPE;
        }
        else if (exact_ascii_name(name, "reno.personal_authority_guard_registration", 42)) {
            call->first_name_target_hint = RENO_FINDER_TARGET_REGISTRATION;
        }
    }
    call->first_name_classified = 1;
}

/* Same finite original F3 qualification as before, with a new real owner
 * source on READY. Neither packet NULLs nor phase values create provenance.
 * Full internal source and every legal unselected/changed continuation remain
 * obligations of the same complete loader dispatch.
 */
static int
reno_loader_f3_call_fresh(PyObject *record_owned,
    const RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding, const RenoLoaderF3Call *call)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)record_owned;
    RenoState *state = binding->state;
    RenoProxyObject *proxy;
    PyObject *callee = NULL;
    PyObject *self = NULL;
    PyObject *name = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || binding->stage != RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND
            || binding->module == NULL || state == NULL
            || binding->metadata_lease_held != 1 || binding->get_code_call != call
            || binding->get_code_class_binding_held != 1
            || binding->get_code_callee != NULL || binding->get_code_self != NULL
            || binding->first_name != NULL || binding->first_name_observed != 1
            || call->inputs.callee_moved != 1 || call->inputs.self_moved != 1
            || call->inputs.first_name_moved != 1
            || call->first_name_classified != 1 || call->entry_code == NULL
            || call->prepare_thread == NULL
            || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != call->prepare_thread) { return 0; }
    if (call->stage == RENO_LOADER_F3_ENTRY_CODE_HELD
            && call->resume.phase == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_ZERO_V2) {
        callee = call->inputs.callee;
        self = call->inputs.self;
        name = call->inputs.first_name;
    }
    else if (call->stage == RENO_LOADER_F3_PREPARED
            && call->resume.phase == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_READY_V2
            && call->resume.inputs_taken_mask == 7
            && call->resume.argument_owned_mask == 3
            && call->inputs.callee == NULL && call->inputs.self == NULL
            && call->inputs.first_name == NULL) {
        callee = call->resume.function_owned;
        self = call->resume.arguments_owned[0];
        name = call->resume.arguments_owned[1];
        if (call->resume.frame_code != call->entry_code
                || call->resume.check_callable_owned != callee) { return 0; }
    }
    else { return 0; }
    if (callee == NULL || self == NULL || name == NULL || self != binding->values[0]
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete != 1
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->module_lifetime != binding->module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->original_loader != binding->values[0]
            || record->owner_proxy == NULL
            || record->owner_proxy != state->arena.install.proxy) { return 0; }
    proxy = (RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy;
    if (proxy->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE || proxy->module_lifetime != binding->module
            || proxy->origin_state != state || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 57, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 58, 1)
            || callee != state->arena.known.roots[57]
            || call->entry_code != state->arena.known.roots[58]) { return 0; }
    return reno_state_function_metadata_matches(state, 3)
        && state->controls.function_dispatch[3].standard_matched == 1
        && state->controls.function_dispatch[3].expected == &_PyFunction_Vectorcall
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_loader_try_f3_call(PyObject *record_owned, RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding,
    RenoLoaderF3Call *call, PyObject **first_owned, int *cleanup_failed,
    unsigned int *arena_null)
{
    RenoState *state = binding->state;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (binding->stage != RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND || binding->module == NULL
            || state == NULL || binding->metadata_lease_held != 1
            || binding->get_code_class_binding_held != 1
            || binding->get_code_callee == NULL
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(binding->get_code_callee, &PyFunction_Type)
            || binding->get_code_self == NULL
            || binding->get_code_self != binding->values[0]
            || binding->values[0] == NULL || binding->first_name_observed != 1
            || binding->first_name == NULL
            || call->inputs.callee != NULL || call->inputs.self != NULL
            || call->inputs.first_name != NULL
            || call->inputs.callee_moved != 0 || call->inputs.self_moved != 0
            || call->inputs.first_name_moved != 0
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0) { return 0; }
    call->entry_code = Py_XNewRef(((PyFunctionObject *)binding->get_code_callee)->func_code);
    call->inputs.callee = binding->get_code_callee;
    binding->get_code_callee = NULL;
    call->inputs.callee_moved = 1;
    call->inputs.self = binding->get_code_self;
    binding->get_code_self = NULL;
    call->inputs.self_moved = 1;
    call->inputs.first_name = binding->first_name;
    binding->first_name = NULL;
    call->inputs.first_name_moved = 1;
    reno_loader_f3_classify_first_name(call);
    call->prepare_thread = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    call->stage = RENO_LOADER_F3_ENTRY_CODE_HELD;
    binding->get_code_call = call;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (!reno_loader_f3_call_fresh(record_owned, binding, call)) { return 0; }
    call->prepare_status = RenoNativeOwnedPrepareV2(&call->resume,
        &call->inputs, call->entry_code);
    call->stage = RENO_LOADER_F3_PREPARED;
    if (call->prepare_status == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_PREPARE_NOT_SELECTED_V2) {
        RenoNativeOwnedMoveUnconsumedV2(&call->resume, &call->moved);
        return 0; /* same caller packet still owns all inputs; no retry */
    }
    if (call->prepare_status != RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_PREPARE_READY_V2
            && call->prepare_status != RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_PREPARE_ARENA_NULL_V2
            && call->prepare_status != RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_PREPARE_ERROR_V2) {
        return -1; /* outside real normal producer contract */
    }
    call->record_needs_close = 1;
    if (call->prepare_status == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_PREPARE_ERROR_V2) { return -1; }
    if (call->prepare_status == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_PREPARE_ARENA_NULL_V2) {
        *arena_null = 1;
        return -1;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_f3_call_fresh(record_owned, binding, call)) {
        return 0; /* SAME READY/pending/owners to complete tail; no retry */
    }
    call->result = RenoNativeOwnedInvokeV2(&call->resume, &call->native_attempted);
    if (call->result == NULL && call->native_attempted == 0
            && call->resume.phase == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_READY_V2
            && call->resume.reservation_kind
                == RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_RESERVATION_CURRENT_STACK_V2
            && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        /* Capacity changed before Consume: leave PREPARED/READY and every
         * actual owner/unique close duty with this same complete continuation.
         * No MoveOut, INVOKE_RETURNED mark, re-Prepare or F3 retry here.
         */
        return 0;
    }
    call->stage = RENO_LOADER_F3_INVOKE_RETURNED;
    RenoNativeOwnedMoveUnconsumedV2(&call->resume, &call->moved);
    call->record_needs_close = 0;
    reno_loader_f3_adopt_pending(call, first_owned, cleanup_failed);
    if (*first_owned != NULL || call->result == NULL) { return -1; }
    return 0; /* actual NEW returned to same native tail, not exec success */
}

/* Existing pure source predicate is defined later in this SAME owner TU.
 * No new exported primitive/ABI or current loader-type source enrollment.
 */
static int reno_state_fixed_metadata_match_install_raw(RenoState *state);

/* Real dynamic LOAD_METHOD input producer, never a business terminator.
 * Original entry roots and actual caller source/ABI/GIL/normal reference
 * premises precede these consistency gates. No enum/address authenticates
 * those premises. A miss changes no owner/history/error in the actual caller.
 */
static void
reno_loader_observe_dynamic_get_code_once(PyObject *record_owned,
    RenoLoaderCallBinding *binding, const RenoLoaderF3Call *f3,
    PyObject *actual_first, RenoLoaderDynamicGetCodeLookup *lookup)
{
    RenoLoaderCodeOperands expected = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoProxyObject *proxy;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *lookup_key;
    PyObject *release = NULL;

    if (record_owned == NULL || binding == NULL || f3 == NULL || lookup == NULL
            || actual_first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || lookup->receiver_owned != NULL || lookup->callee_owned != NULL
            || lookup->method_found != 0 || lookup->consumer_entered
            || lookup->receiver_acquired || lookup->getter_called
            || lookup->getter_returned || lookup->receiver_released
            || lookup->unadmitted_return) { return; }
    if (binding->stage != RENO_LOADER_BINDING_BOUND
            || binding->metadata_lease_held != 1 || binding->module == NULL
            || binding->state == NULL || binding->function == NULL || binding->code == NULL
            || binding->entry_globals == NULL || binding->entry_builtins == NULL
            || binding->values[0] == NULL || binding->values[1] == NULL
            || binding->dynamic_get_code != NULL || binding->get_code_call != NULL
            || binding->get_code_callee != NULL || binding->get_code_self != NULL
            || binding->get_code_class_binding_held || binding->first_name != NULL
            || binding->first_name_observed
            || binding->filename_source.lookup_key != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.wrapper_row != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.method != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.method_code != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.method_globals != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.method_builtins != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.wrapper_dispatch != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.method_dispatch != NULL
            || binding->filename_source.nullable_present[0]
            || binding->filename_source.nullable_present[1]
            || binding->filename_source.nullable_present[2]) { return; }
    /* No old V2 packet, result, source-code, raw/free/pending or close duty
     * can be selected through this new input producer. The real caller's
     * aggregate-zero F3 and old class-binding gates establish this shape.
     * A pending instance probe alone never authorizes dynamic source use.
     */
    if (f3->stage != RENO_LOADER_F3_UNTOUCHED || f3->entry_code != NULL
            || f3->result != NULL || f3->prepare_thread != NULL
            || f3->record_needs_close || f3->native_attempted || f3->prepare_status
            || f3->first_name_classified || f3->first_name_exact
            || f3->first_name_target_hint != RENO_FINDER_TARGET_UNPROVEN
            || f3->inputs.callee != NULL || f3->inputs.self != NULL
            || f3->inputs.first_name != NULL || f3->inputs.callee_moved
            || f3->inputs.self_moved || f3->inputs.first_name_moved
            || f3->resume.phase != RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_ZERO_V2
            || f3->resume.inputs_taken_mask || f3->resume.argument_owned_mask
            || f3->resume.function_owned != NULL || f3->resume.locals_owned != NULL
            || f3->resume.arguments_owned[0] != NULL || f3->resume.arguments_owned[1] != NULL
            || f3->resume.check_callable_owned != NULL || f3->resume.pending_owned != NULL
            || f3->resume.raw_owned != NULL || f3->resume.free_debt != NULL
            || f3->resume.raw_bytes || f3->resume.old_chunk != NULL
            || f3->resume.old_top != NULL || f3->resume.old_limit != NULL
            || f3->resume.reserved_frame != NULL || f3->resume.saved_old_top_valid
            || f3->resume.frame_handoff_started || f3->resume.frame_code != NULL
            || f3->resume.actual_tstate != NULL
            || f3->resume.reservation_kind != RENO_NATIVE_OWNED_RESERVATION_NONE_V2
            || f3->moved.function_owned != NULL || f3->moved.locals_owned != NULL
            || f3->moved.arguments_owned[0] != NULL || f3->moved.arguments_owned[1] != NULL
            || f3->moved.argument_owned_mask || f3->moved.check_callable_owned != NULL
            || f3->moved.pending_owned != NULL || f3->moved.raw_to_free != NULL
            || f3->moved.raw_bytes) { return; }

    state = binding->state;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete != 1
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 66, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 67, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 70, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 72, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || binding->function != state->arena.known.roots[66]
            || binding->code != state->arena.known.roots[67]
            || binding->entry_globals != state->arena.known.roots[70]
            || binding->entry_builtins != state->arena.known.roots[72]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(binding->function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(binding->code, &PyCode_Type)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)) { return; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)record_owned;
    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->linked != 1 || record->registry_owner_state != state
            || record->origin_state != state || record->module_lifetime != binding->module
            || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || record->original_loader != binding->values[0]
            || record->owner_proxy == NULL
            || record->owner_proxy != state->arena.install.proxy) { return; }
    proxy = (RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy;
    if (proxy->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE || proxy->origin_state != state
            || proxy->module_lifetime != binding->module
            || !reno_loader_original_binding_domain(state, binding->function, binding->code)
            || !reno_state_fixed_metadata_match_install_raw(state)) { return; }
    /* Select the SAME actual immutable entry-code operand. No literal NEW,
     * current attribute value or new type is enrolled as expected/source.
     * The fixed metadata predicate checks original T0 sources, independently
     * of this loader instance's CURRENT type. The ordinary raw probe enum is
     * retained history only; PRESENT/EQ/HASH/pending do not certify permission.
     */
    reno_loader_select_original_operands(binding->code, &expected);
    if (expected.get_code_key == NULL
            || expected.get_code_key != binding->operands.get_code_key) { return; }
    lookup_key = expected.get_code_key;
    lookup->consumer_entered = 1;
    /* Original LOAD_FAST occurrence, acquired BEFORE the actual getter.
     * binding.values[0] remains a distinct caller-owned occurrence throughout.
     */
    lookup->receiver_owned = Py_NewRef(binding->values[0]);
    lookup->receiver_acquired = 1;
    binding->dynamic_get_code = lookup; /* same automatic carrier loan only */
    record = NULL;
    proxy = NULL;
    state = NULL;
    /* No source/State/Record/binding payload is reread after this callout.
     * Entry code -> co_names independently roots the actual name THROUGH it.
     */
    lookup->getter_called = 1;
    lookup->method_found = _PyObject_GetMethod(lookup->receiver_owned,
        lookup_key, &lookup->callee_owned);
    lookup->getter_returned = 1;
    lookup_key = NULL;
    if (lookup->method_found == 0) {
        release = lookup->receiver_owned;
        lookup->receiver_owned = NULL;
        /* SAME original LOAD_ATTR timing, before NULL/error classification.
         * This occurrence is NONLAST under the continuously owned values[0]
         * root and matching normal-reference premises, not a refcount sample.
         * Keep the actual getter indicator intact through that natural DECREF.
         */
        Py_DECREF(release);
        release = NULL;
        lookup->receiver_released = 1;
    }
    if (lookup->method_found != 0 && lookup->method_found != 1) {
        lookup->unadmitted_return = 1;
    }
    if (lookup->callee_owned == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        lookup->unadmitted_return = 1;
    }
    /* Successful mode0 may hold ANY actual attribute, including a noncallable.
     * Do not get module.__name__, test callable, recheck current source/class,
     * raise an invented first or claim handled. SAME complete dispatch next.
     */
}

/* The standard FASTCALL|KEYWORDS adapter supplies a real Record m_self and
 * plain count. Same argv/kwnames remain unchanged. Only an eligible original
 * code is bound here; all other domains retain the SAME missing dispatch.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_loader_inner_call(PyObject *actual_record, PyObject *const *args,
    Py_ssize_t nargs, PyObject *kwnames)
{
    PyObject *record_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *error_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *function_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *code_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *entry_globals_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *entry_builtins_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *result = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoLoaderCallBinding binding = {0};
    RenoLoaderF3Call f3_call = {0};
    RenoLoaderDynamicGetCodeLookup dynamic_get_code = {0};
    unsigned int f3_arena_null = 0;
    int f3_status = 0;
    RenoState *state = NULL;
    unsigned int entered = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (actual_record == NULL || nargs < 0) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader call transport");
        return NULL;
    }
    record_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_record);
    /* The fixed original NewEx producer supplies this actual Record C self.
     * Its source/layout/GIL and matching normal reference envelope precede
     * this raw read; a phase or pointer check does not authenticate them.
     * These five phases have an already selected preparation rejection.
     * No business argument, cleared source, State or binder root is read.
     * INIT/unknown are not silently added to that selected rejection domain.
     */
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)record_guard;
    if (record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED
            || record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING
            || record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRING
            || record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED
            || record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED) {
        /* This lifetime root survives ordinary retire/tp_clear. Own its
         * actual occurrence before SetString can allocate/call out; then
         * never reload Record/State or manufacture an attempt/seed.
         * Constructor errors, including OOM, escape as the actual first.
         */
        error_guard = Py_NewRef(record->retired_error_class);
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(error_guard, "native loader record is not active");
        }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE) {
        module_guard = Py_NewRef(record->module_lifetime);
        state = prepare_common_state_normal(module_guard);
        if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
        binding.module = module_guard;
        binding.state = state;
        /* Safe root acquisition eligibility, NOT a full metadata/source
         * rejection. Do not freeze actual defaults/qualname or compare
         * current code to T0 before taking its independent entry guard.
         * An ordinary NEW lease requires current ACTIVE State/Record/Proxy
         * source association, even if a retired arena is not yet drained.
         */
        if (record->origin_state == state
                && record->module_lifetime == module_guard
                && record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE
                && !record->restore_cancelled
                && state->bootstrap_marker == RENO_BOOT_TYPED
                && state->controls.phase == RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
                && state->controls.arena_owner == RENO_ARENA_STATE
                && state->controls.published_arena == &state->arena
                && record->owner_proxy != NULL
                && record->owner_proxy == state->arena.install.proxy
                && ((RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy)->phase == RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
                && ((RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy)->module_lifetime == module_guard
                && ((RenoProxyObject *)record->owner_proxy)->origin_state == state
                && state->controls.meta_active_count >= 0
                && reno_ws_known_status(state, 66, 1)
                && reno_ws_known_status(state, 67, 1)
                && Py_IS_TYPE(state->arena.known.roots[66], &PyFunction_Type)) {
            if (state->controls.meta_active_count == PY_SSIZE_T_MAX) {
                PyErr_SetString(PyExc_OverflowError, "native metadata activity capacity exceeded");
                goto failed;
            }
            ++state->controls.meta_active_count;
            entered = 1;
            function_guard = Py_NewRef(state->arena.known.roots[66]);
            code_guard = Py_XNewRef(((PyFunctionObject *)function_guard)->func_code);
            /* Native entry field snapshots, before binder callbacks.
             * Independent NEW guards add cost; no original F4 frame exists.
             * Preserve actual NULL/non-dict values without freezing entries.
             */
            entry_globals_guard = Py_XNewRef(((PyFunctionObject *)function_guard)->func_globals);
            entry_builtins_guard = Py_XNewRef(((PyFunctionObject *)function_guard)->func_builtins);
            binding.entry_globals = entry_globals_guard;
            binding.entry_builtins = entry_builtins_guard;
            binding.function = function_guard;
            binding.code = code_guard;
            binding.metadata_lease_held = 1;
            binding.stage = RENO_LOADER_BINDING_ROOTS_HELD;
            if (reno_loader_original_binding_domain(state, function_guard, code_guard)) {
                if (reno_loader_bind_original_arguments(function_guard, code_guard,
                        args, nargs, kwnames, &binding) != 0
                        || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
                reno_loader_select_original_operands(code_guard, &binding.operands);
                reno_loader_select_body_operands(code_guard, &binding.operands);
                reno_loader_observe_original_instance(record_guard, &binding);
                if (reno_loader_observe_first_name(&binding) < 0
                        || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
                reno_loader_select_original_filename_source(&binding, &binding.filename_source);
                f3_status = reno_loader_try_f3_call(record_guard, &binding, &f3_call,
                    &first, &cleanup_failed, &f3_arena_null);
                if (f3_arena_null || first != NULL) { goto cleanup; }
                if (f3_status < 0) { goto failed; }
                /* Old getter/name/F3 effects stay first. This producer only
                 * selects a qualified BOUND route with all of them untouched.
                 * Its actual getter result goes directly to the SAME tail.
                 */
                reno_loader_observe_dynamic_get_code_once(record_guard, &binding,
                    &f3_call, first, &dynamic_get_code);
                if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
            }
        }
    }
    result = reno_h01_loader_exec_dispatch(record_guard, args, nargs, kwnames, &binding);
    if (result == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto cleanup;
failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* Caller-owned bindings and all guard debts end before last metadata
     * leave; then no State/context read occurs. Record/error debts keep their
     * original order; actual NULL arena adds only the final NoMemory creator.
     * Module lifetime is continuously covered by record_guard.
     */
    /* Scalar borrows end before any owning release or metadata leave. */
    binding.get_code_call = NULL;
    binding.dynamic_get_code = NULL;
    binding.entry_globals = NULL;
    binding.entry_builtins = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.lookup_key = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.wrapper_row = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.method = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.method_code = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.method_globals = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.method_builtins = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.wrapper_dispatch = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.method_dispatch = NULL;
    binding.filename_source.nullable_present[0] = 0;
    binding.filename_source.nullable_present[1] = 0;
    binding.filename_source.nullable_present[2] = 0;
    binding.first_name_observed = 0;
    binding.get_code_class_binding_held = 0;
    binding.get_code_instance = RENO_LOADER312_SOURCE_OR_BRIDGE_PENDING;
    binding.operands.get_code_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.name_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.import_error_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.dict_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.bootstrap_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.frames_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.exec_key = NULL;
    binding.operands.none_constant = NULL;
    binding.operands.none_prefix_constant = NULL;
    binding.operands.none_suffix_constant = NULL;
    /* Original method stack top first, then callable; equal pointers are
     * independent occurrences. Old paths have no new debt and add no extra
     * cleanup/indicator operation. No new input payload is read after drain.
     */
    if (dynamic_get_code.receiver_owned != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dynamic_get_code.receiver_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (dynamic_get_code.callee_owned != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dynamic_get_code.callee_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* Resume argv remains intact until its acquired-value debts are closed. */
    reno_loader_f3_close(&f3_call, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&f3_call.result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&f3_call.entry_code, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* Preserve the V1 caller's prior result/code/name release order. The
     * carrier is released after prefix/out close, not inside that closer.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&f3_call.inputs.first_name, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&f3_call.inputs.callee, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&f3_call.inputs.self, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&binding.first_name, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&binding.get_code_callee, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&binding.get_code_self, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&binding.values[0], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&binding.values[1], &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&code_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&entry_globals_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&entry_builtins_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&function_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (entered) {
        reno_common_metadata_leave(state, &entered, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&module_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (error_guard != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&error_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&result, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        first = NULL;
        if (!f3_arena_null) { return NULL; }
    }
    if (f3_arena_null) {
        return PyErr_NoMemory(); /* one terminal creator, after all actual debts */
    }
    return result; /* SAME actual NEW, no Record/State/payload read after cleanup */
}

/* PyCFunction retains m_ml as a raw pointer: definition/name/code lifetime
 * must cover every late alias. No METH_STATIC/METH_METHOD or runtime writer.
 */
static PyMethodDef reno_loader_inner_method = {
    "exec_module", _PyCFunction_CAST(reno_loader_inner_call),
    METH_FASTCALL | METH_KEYWORDS, NULL
};

/* Pure comparison of THIS Record's actual constructor-return history. Caller
 * independently roots the real Record/loader/inner/bound and knows their lawful
 * spans/layout/source; these pointer/scalar checks cannot create provenance.
 * A captured NULL dispatch is distinct from not captured, and is NOT rejected
 * merely for being NULL. Unchanged creation facts are not standard-adapter,
 * code-image, callable/source, REUSE, ABI, normal-reference or S1 admission.
 */
static int
reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(RenoLoaderRecordObject *record,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *actual_inner, PyObject *actual_bound)
{
    /* Original one-time publish checked NewEx(module=NULL) before
     * inner_dispatch_captured became 1. Writable CURRENT m_module
     * is separate metadata, never this Record's lifetime/source
     * root or a newly enrolled expected. Keep actual creation
     * history, ml/self/type/dispatch and independent caller roots.
     */
    if (record == NULL || actual_loader == NULL
            || record->inner_dispatch_captured > 1 || record->bound_dispatch_captured > 1
            || (!record->inner_dispatch_captured && record->created_inner_vectorcall != NULL)
            || (!record->bound_dispatch_captured && record->created_bound_vectorcall != NULL)
            || (record->bound_dispatch_captured && !record->inner_dispatch_captured)) { return 0; }
    if (actual_inner == NULL) {
        return actual_bound == NULL && !record->inner_dispatch_captured
            && !record->bound_dispatch_captured;
    }
    if (record->inner_dispatch_captured != 1 || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->m_self != (PyObject *)record
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->vectorcall != record->created_inner_vectorcall) { return 0; }
    if (actual_bound == NULL) { return !record->bound_dispatch_captured; }
    return record->bound_dispatch_captured == 1 && Py_IS_TYPE(actual_bound, &PyMethod_Type)
        && PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(actual_bound) == actual_inner
        && PyMethod_GET_SELF(actual_bound) == actual_loader
        && ((PyMethodObject *)actual_bound)->vectorcall == record->created_bound_vectorcall;
}

/* Real producers below precede the raw source helper's definition. All operands
 * are explicit continuously held originals; neither later setup/view types nor
 * INSTALL eligibility with already-published facts authorize first publication.
 */
static int reno_loader_publish_inner_creation_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class, PyObject *actual_loader,
    PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present,
    PyObject *actual_record_key, PyObject *actual_inner, vectorcallfunc creation_dispatch);
static int reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class, PyObject *actual_loader,
    PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present,
    PyObject *actual_record_key, PyObject *actual_inner, PyObject *actual_bound,
    vectorcallfunc creation_dispatch);

/* Caller first completes full source fresh and holds these independent actual
 * operands. Consistency is NOT proof that a type/phase came from prepare/track.
 * Every record was really returned by this generation's prepare then track;
 * actual allocated spans/GC/build/primitive/reference/S1 are prior premises.
 */
static int
reno_loader_prepared_inputs_match(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record, PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary,
    PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoState *state = source->state;
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe domain;

    if (!reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_record, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record;
    if (record->module_lifetime != source->module
            || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || record->origin_state != state || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED || record->linked
            || record->registry_owner_state != NULL || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || record->restore_cancelled || record->installed_bound != NULL
            || record->original_loader != actual_loader || record->loader_dict != dictionary
            || record->previous_value != previous || record->previous_present != previous_present
            || record->attribute_key == NULL
            || !exact_ascii_name(record->attribute_key, "exec_module", 11)
            || record->store_attempted || record->store_returned || record->effect_observed
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned
            || record->restore_effect_observed) { return 0; }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.known.roots[20], dictionary);
    return domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
        && reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "exec_module", 11) == previous
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Actual bound producer, consumed by the native Record setup prefix below.
 * It must run AFTER complete alias/idempotency selection and actual Record
 * prepare->track, never as an idempotency probe. Callback may install another
 * association or retire/clear payloads: the eventual caller must reselect/
 * revalidate after this return BEFORE link/store, without retrying old getters.
 * Returns same bound NEW, whose standard GC edges own inner/loader and whose
 * inner owns this actual Record. It does NOT write installed_bound or Track
 * the Record again; BOTH constructors allocate and GC-track their own product.
 * No new State/type/root-bank owning slot or registry mutation is introduced.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_loader_exec_bound_prepare(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record, PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary,
    PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present)
{
    PyObject *record_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *loader_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *dict_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *previous_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *inner = NULL;
    PyObject *bound = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc inner_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc bound_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return NULL; }
    if (source == NULL || actual_record == NULL || actual_loader == NULL
            || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)
            || previous_present > 1 || (previous_present && previous == NULL)
            || (!previous_present && previous != NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader bound inputs");
        return NULL;
    }
    record_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_record);
    loader_guard = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    dict_guard = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    previous_guard = Py_XNewRef(previous);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, loader_guard)
            || !reno_loader_prepared_inputs_match(source, record_guard, loader_guard,
                dict_guard, previous_guard, previous_present)) { goto changed; }
    /* Hold ORIGINAL class/key before either allocation can call out.
     * Source/prepared match just succeeded in this no-callout span.
     */
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(source->state->arena.known.roots[20]);
    key_guard = Py_NewRef(((RenoLoaderRecordObject *)record_guard)->attribute_key);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw((RenoLoaderRecordObject *)record_guard,
            loader_guard, NULL, NULL)) { goto changed; }
    inner = PyCFunction_NewEx(&reno_loader_inner_method, record_guard, NULL);
    if (inner == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    inner_creation_dispatch = ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->vectorcall;
    /* Save actual constructor return BEFORE full bridge can call out. */
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, loader_guard)
            || !reno_loader_prepared_inputs_match(source, record_guard, loader_guard,
                dict_guard, previous_guard, previous_present)
            || !reno_loader_publish_inner_creation_raw(source, record_guard, class_guard,
                loader_guard, dict_guard, previous_guard, previous_present, key_guard,
                inner, inner_creation_dispatch)) { goto changed; }
    /* Creation history is not standard-adapter/code-image/ABI admission. */
    bound = PyMethod_New(inner, loader_guard);
    if (bound == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    bound_creation_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)bound)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, loader_guard)
            || !reno_loader_prepared_inputs_match(source, record_guard, loader_guard,
                dict_guard, previous_guard, previous_present)
            || !reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(source, record_guard, class_guard,
                loader_guard, dict_guard, previous_guard, previous_present, key_guard,
                inner, bound, bound_creation_dispatch)) { goto changed; }
    goto cleanup;
changed:
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native prepared loader binding changed");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* Parent retains source/module/entered. These independent locals cover
     * payload clear; never reload operands from Record. NO State/context or
     * payload access after final cleanup begins. Returned bound remains own.
     */
    if (first != NULL) { reno_cleanup_release_owned(&bound, &first, &cleanup_failed); }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&inner, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&previous_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dict_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&loader_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&record_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&bound, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return NULL;
    }
    return bound; /* caller must complete selection/fresh before publication */
}

typedef enum RenoLoaderSetupStage {
    RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT,
    RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED,
    RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND,
    RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED,
    RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED
} RenoLoaderSetupStage;

/* Automatic owning slots: no address escapes, no shallow owning copy, and
 * no new State/GC/root-bank field. The complete child must MOVE/settle every
 * slot on ENTRY and settle it on ALL exits, retaining real publication roots
 * as needed. Stage is production history, not a current phase. current is
 * only the LAST COMPLETED query; abort may carry a partial related owning
 * from a failed query without a corresponding fresh scalar observation.
 */
/* Automatic private owning tuple, never State/bank/GC storage. Captured before
 * the setter can call out; retain even if that call clears the actual Record.
 * previous is the Record's HISTORY, not the latest query's current value.
 * The complete child must move/NULL all SIX slots before its first callback
 * and settle them on ALL exits, along with the five actual setup slots.
 * No shallow owning copy, address escape or expected-from-current recovery.
 * captured is capture history only, not fresh source, permission or cleanup.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned {
    PyObject *original_class_owned;
    PyObject *loader_owned;
    PyObject *dictionary_owned;
    PyObject *key_owned;
    PyObject *bound_owned;
    PyObject *previous_owned;
    unsigned char previous_present;
    unsigned char captured;
} RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned;

/* Distinct SAME-child automatic SCALARS. No Setup field/owning, replay of the

 * writer/registration history remains in Setup.absent_install, its real owner.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult {
    unsigned char consumer_entered;
    unsigned char previous_present;
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundOrigin origin;
    RenoLoaderSelectionHistory observation;
    unsigned char actual_current_matched;
    unsigned char actual_association_none;
    unsigned char claim_completed;
    unsigned char install_called, install_returned;
    int install_status;
    RenoLoaderInstallExistingResult installation;
    unsigned char registration_called, registration_returned;
    int registration_status;
    RenoLoaderExistingRegistrationResult registration;
    unsigned char unwatched_called, unwatched_returned;
    int unwatched_status;
    unsigned char conditional_called, conditional_returned;
    int conditional_status;
    unsigned char unwatched_success_checked;
    unsigned char conditional_success_checked;
    unsigned char direct_success_checked;
    unsigned char unadmitted_return;
} RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult;


/* Another actual automatic stage, SCALARS only. Its real registration may

typedef struct RenoLoaderEnteredBoundRegistrationResumeResult {

} RenoLoaderPublicationHistoryKind;

/* NONOWNING loan of a C automatic SCALAR result, not a PyObject/payload loan.

typedef struct RenoLoaderPublicationSourceProfile {

typedef struct RenoLoaderRecordSetup {
    PyObject *prepared_owned;
    PyObject *record_owned;
    PyObject *inner_owned; /* actual station-3 COMPAT NewEx owning, not a snapshot */
    PyObject *bound_owned;
    PyObject *related_owned;
    RenoLoaderRecordObservation current;
    RenoLoaderSetupStage stage;
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned mutation;
    RenoLoaderAbsentInstallResult absent_install; /* scalar history, never owning */
    RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult absent_prepare; /* same activation scalar history */
    RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult present_install; /* same activation scalar history */
    RenoLoaderRetainedInnerResumeResult retained_inner_resume; /* scalar, no owning/address */
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundResumeResult observed_bound_resume; /* scalar, no owning/address */
    RenoLoaderObservedInnerResumeResult observed_inner_resume; /* scalar, no owning/address */
    RenoLoaderClaimedRegistrationResumeResult claimed_registration_resume; /* SCALAR only */
    RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult observed_partial_resume; /* SCALAR only */
} RenoLoaderRecordSetup;

typedef struct RenoLoaderSelectionOwner {
    PyObject *original_class_owned;
    RenoSpecAttr312SelectionOwned output;
    PyObject *candidate_bound_owned;
    PyObject *related_owned;
    RenoLoaderSelectionHistory history;
} RenoLoaderSelectionOwner;

typedef struct RenoLoaderSelectionView {
    PyObject *original_class; /* borrowed from SelectionOwner */
    PyObject *query; /* borrowed from the same parent's lookup_key */
    PyObject *current; /* borrowed from SelectionOwner's actual output NEW */
    PyObject *candidate_bound; /* distinct parent NEW of the actual product */
    PyObject *related; /* fresh query NEW, including partial failure output */
    unsigned char observed;
    unsigned char present;
    RenoLoaderSelectionHistory history; /* scalar-only copy */
} RenoLoaderSelectionView;

/* Both real parents pass this SAME activation's View to the fallback child.
 * api_called=0 / observed=0 never means absence. An OBSERVED current can be
 * absent or present (including Py_None); final API failure may retain output.
 * association_query_completed=0 is UNKNOWN, even with a partial related NEW.
 * The candidate is an independent actual constructor product, not a fabricated
 * dictionary current. Relation bits describe FIRST retained node only; MULTIPLE
 * never merges other nodes' bits. Any later callback invalidates freshness.
 * Parent owns this View's four extra occurrences and independent actual query
 * through the child. Native may additionally retain earlier Owner/key debts;
 * those stay separate, never copied into this View or its owning output.
 * Never release/move these borrows into setup. The child must MOVE/settle the
 * original eleven setup debts, preserve actual first and handle no-first unadmitted
 * without business continuation/default success or an invented abort exception.
 * No observation enrolls source, changes historical previous or authorizes
 * reuse/install/restore. Full alias/foreign/backing/partial duties remain.
 */

/* Additional complete-selection input contract, without changing its native
 * source/ownership obligations below:
 *
 * compat_history == NULL is the original native entry: its dictionary/current
 * and actual completed entry query retain their original requirements.
 *
 * A non-NULL compat_history borrows this same compatibility caller's live
 * history. entry_record and entry_observation are BOTH NULL: no registry scan
 * has been performed here. Do not manufacture QUERY_NONE from these NULLs or
 * from an empty automatic setup. The complete child still owes that scan.
 *
 * prepared_dictionary_received == 0 means dictionary == NULL and GenericGetDict
 * has NOT run. No lookup was attempted, so previous == NULL/present == 0 is
 * UNKNOWN, not observed absence. Perform any required preparation only AFTER
 * the full lawful selection permits it; never force GetDict on foreign loaders.
 *
 * prepared_dictionary_received == 1 transports the SAME actual prepared return,
 * borrowed under the original parent's independent owning, even if backing or
 * type has changed. dictionary_is_dict is only an actual PyDict_Check result.
 * The non-dict case has no lookup; it retains the full lawful storage decision.
 *
 * lookup_value_observed == 1 means the actual single standard dictionary lookup
 * returned and its value occurrence was immediately independently acquired.
 * Only then does previous_present distinguish observed absence from Py_None.
 * The actual query key remains caller-owned and loaned through this complete
 * child. Do not repeat that already completed lookup or substitute GetAttr,
 * mapping __getitem__, a character scan, a finder, or another loader getter.
 * The observation is held HISTORY: callbacks invalidate current backing/value
 * authority, even while that actual result/key still live. Any required fresh
 * comparison is a new explicit stage, not a replay of the old stage.
 *
 * Full source, alias/idempotency, changed backing, selection, real store,
 * conditional restore, external replacement, retirement and all error/owning
 * duties remain here. The actual keys may be arbitrary lawful hash/eq objects.
 * The existing native snapshot/Record factory accepts narrower domains; do
 * not call it for a generic dictionary and claim the complete path is covered.
 * This history cannot authenticate a loader, source, seed, ABI or cleanup grant.
 * No duplicate preparation or default success/rejection replaces those duties.
 */

/* STILL UNDEFINED: COMPLETE alias/idempotency/external-value/INSTALLING and
 * custom selection, then real link/store/returned/effect/ACTIVE or complete
 * rollback/conditional restore/late-call duties. The original entry_record/
 * entry_observation are held HISTORY, not current after callback. setup owns
 * the SAME actual candidate products/related Record, if any, and records which
 * preparation effects ALREADY occurred. It is automatic and cannot escape.
 * CLAIMED records the real bound owning move and UNLINKED INSTALLING.
 * STORED records the actual post-store/source ACTIVE+link commit, even when
 * its subsequent registry observation fails; neither is a live certificate.
 * current retains the LAST completed query, including ONE/MULTIPLE which
 * stop native publication. Only a successful NONE scan permits this commit.
 * A completed post-commit scan retains its actual kind/phase, not a forced
 * ONE/ACTIVE. Failure keeps prior completed scalars plus any partial related
 * owning. The six mutation owning slots
 * retain original payloads even if callback cleared the actual Record.
 * Distinguish this actual claim/effect from races, settle real publication/
 * restore and unlink before dropping its last pre-store root on abort.
 * A raced association/partial candidate must not cause blind second prepare,
 * getter/GetDict/finder retry, false idempotency or external-value overwrite.
 * Move all FIVE setup plus all SIX mutation ownings to private locals
 * and NULL their actual slots BEFORE any callback, on normal AND abort
 * entry. Capture is not cleanup; this actual consumption body is STILL
 * UNDEFINED. Each alias is a separate owning. first_owned is the actual
 * private error owning, NULL for normal entry; non-NULL means abort WITHOUT
 * installing. Preserve/adopt actual first and settle all refs/indicator on ALL
 * exits; return 0 only after COMPLETE handling with empty first/indicator.
 * Never infer unpublished from this prefix's lack of store: a callback may
 * change candidate/association/dict. Resolve real publication/conditional
 * restore/external values before clearing ANY affected candidate payload.
 * Do not cancel a related record just because its guard is owned. GC clear
 * is not a restorer, and Track is not a root. No ownings return to the parent.
 * native_preparation_query borrows the actual native parent's independently
 * owned new present-preparation key, or NULL when not produced. Its loan
 * lasts through this entire call; do not release it, substitute it for an
 * original business-key identity, or replay an already completed lookup.
 */
static int reno_h01_complete_loader_record_selection(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    unsigned char previous_present, PyObject *entry_record,
    const RenoLoaderRecordObservation *entry_observation,
