    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup, PyObject **first_owned, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint,
    const RenoLoaderBindingCompatHistory *compat_history,
    PyObject *native_preparation_query,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection_history);

/* A fresh full bridge may have temporary reference effects. Only AFTER it
 * returns do raw backing/key/current checks and a whole-registry query share
 * the same no-callout span. Query owns its first match, including on failure.
 */
static int
reno_loader_selection_snapshot(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup)
{
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe domain;

    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, actual_loader)) { goto changed; }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20], dictionary);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { return 0; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(dictionary, "exec_module", 11) != previous) {
        goto changed;
    }
    return reno_loader_record_query_raw(source, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, NULL,
        &setup->related_owned, &setup->current);
changed:
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader selection sources changed");
    }
    return 0;
}

/* The SAME actual prepare return is still locally owned and untracked INIT.
 * Full fresh/snapshot has just succeeded, with no callback before these reads
 * and the real track consumer. These comparisons do not invent provenance.
 */
static int
reno_loader_init_record_matches(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record, PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary)
{
    RenoState *state = source->state;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;

    if (!reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_record, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record;
    return record->module_lifetime == source->module
        && record->owner_proxy == (PyObject *)source->owner
        && record->origin_state == state && reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
        && record->retired_error_class == state->arena.known.roots[97]
        && record->original_loader == actual_loader && record->loader_dict == dictionary
        && record->previous_present == 0 && record->previous_value == NULL
        && record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT && !record->linked
        && record->registry_owner_state == NULL && record->prev == NULL && record->next == NULL
        && record->installed_bound == NULL && !record->restore_cancelled
        && record->attribute_key != NULL && exact_ascii_name(record->attribute_key, "exec_module", 11)
        && !record->store_attempted && !record->store_returned && !record->effect_observed
        && !record->restore_attempted && !record->restore_returned && !record->restore_effect_observed
        && reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, actual_loader, NULL, NULL)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* The actual pristine setup caller has JUST completed its full source bridge,
 * prepared backing/key/current checks and the WHOLE registry query. This body
 * adds no callback, allocation, reference acquire/release or setter. Lawful
 * live nodes, acyclic links, actual GIL/build/normal-reference primitives and
 * continuous parent/module/entered plus candidate owning roots are independent
 * premises, not consequences of pointer/type/scalar comparisons below.
 *
 * Only the same real prepare->track->bound products may enter. All failures
 * precede every write. Success MOVES the bound owning to its actual Record,
 * marks INSTALLING while keeping the candidate OUT of the registry. The
 * setup record owning remains held throughout; Track and a cycle are not roots.
 * Only a later actual normal STORE + effect/source check may ACTIVE/link.
 * This is not a dictionary store, effect receipt, publication or full selection.
 * current remains the last PRE-CLAIM query; the child must reselect after any
 * callback and independently hold required payloads before allowing a clear.
 */
static int
reno_loader_record_claim_install_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    unsigned char previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *inner;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || source == NULL || source->state == NULL
            || setup == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL || previous_present || previous != NULL
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
            || setup->bound_owned == NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->current.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_loader_prepared_inputs_match(source, setup->record_owned,
            actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(setup->bound_owned) != actual_loader) { return 0; }
    inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(setup->bound_owned); /* bound keeps it live */
    if (inner == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_self != setup->record_owned) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, actual_loader, inner,
            setup->bound_owned)) { return 0; }
    /* prepared_inputs_match established the actual unlinked candidate and
     * NULL owner/prev/next. Keep those fields and the entire registry untouched
     * until the real store has normally returned and effect/source hold.
     */
    record->installed_bound = setup->bound_owned; /* unique owning MOVE */
    setup->bound_owned = NULL;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING;
    setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED; /* actual no-callout milestone */
    return 1; /* completion child still owes store/abort/restore/unlink */
}

/* The captured-tuple unwatched consumer is defined after the private
 * INSTALL permit, which revalidates its post-preparation entry below.
 */

/* Private immediate borrow, never an owning output. Same normal exact builtin
 * descriptor/member-table/code/full-layout/GIL premises as the retained T0
 * member helpers, now with an explicit fixed-object offset bound. No current
 * value is enrolled as expected. The caller holds the original descriptor and
 * all original snapshot/State/module/lease roots throughout this raw span.
 */
static int
reno_install_member_borrow_raw(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name, PyObject **actual_borrowed)
{
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t object_size;
    int selected_role;

    *actual_borrowed = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || descriptor == NULL || builtin_type == NULL
            || name == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, builtin_type)) { return 0; }
    selected_role = ((builtin_type == &PyClassMethod_Type || builtin_type == &PyStaticMethod_Type)
            && strcmp(name, "__func__") == 0)
        || (builtin_type == &PyProperty_Type
            && (strcmp(name, "fget") == 0 || strcmp(name, "fset") == 0 || strcmp(name, "fdel") == 0));
    if (!selected_role) { return 0; }
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members; member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, name) == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT || member->flags != READONLY) { return 0; }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    object_size = builtin_type->tp_basicsize;
    if (selected == NULL || builtin_type->tp_itemsize != 0
            || object_size < (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(PyObject)
            || selected->offset < (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(PyObject)
            || selected->offset > object_size - (Py_ssize_t)sizeof(value)) { return 0; }
    /* memcpy avoids adding alignment/aliasing assumptions for the field read.
     * Exact normal builtin allocations and the trusted original member table
     * supply the real span; the numerical bounds alone do not authenticate it.
     * Match T_OBJECT's visible NULL -> None representation without NEW/release.
     */
    memcpy(&value, (const char *)descriptor + selected->offset, sizeof(value));
    *actual_borrowed = value != NULL ? value : Py_None;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_install_source_descriptor_raw(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name, PyObject *expected_function)
{
    PyObject *actual = NULL;
    return reno_install_member_borrow_raw(descriptor, builtin_type, name, &actual)
        && actual == expected_function;
}

static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_meta_count_accessor_install_raw(PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type,
    const char *name, RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *counts)
{
    PyObject *actual = NULL;
    if (!reno_install_member_borrow_raw(descriptor, builtin_type, name, &actual)) {
        return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL ? RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE : RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE;
    }
    return reno_spec_meta_count_value(actual, counts);
}

static int
reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches_install_raw(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, unsigned char role,
    PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *name,
    size_t *ledger_at)
{
    PyObject *actual = NULL;
    if (!reno_install_member_borrow_raw(descriptor, builtin_type, name, &actual)) { return 0; }
    return reno_spec_meta_value_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, role, actual, ledger_at);
}

static int
reno_csw_source_accessor_install_raw(const char *data, const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    PyObject *rows, size_t class_start, size_t base, size_t entry,
    PyObject *descriptor, PyTypeObject *builtin_type, const char *name,
    unsigned char role, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    PyObject *actual = NULL;
    if (!reno_install_member_borrow_raw(descriptor, builtin_type, name, &actual)) { return 0; }
    return reno_csw_source_value(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
        role, actual, end, cursor);
}

static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_meta_count_entry_install_raw(PyObject *value, RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *counts)
{
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus status;

    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        status = reno_spec_meta_count_accessor_install_raw(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", counts);
        if (status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT) { return status; }
        status = reno_spec_meta_count_accessor_install_raw(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", counts);
        if (status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT) { return status; }
        return reno_spec_meta_count_accessor_install_raw(value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", counts);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return reno_spec_meta_count_accessor_install_raw(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", counts);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return reno_spec_meta_count_accessor_install_raw(value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", counts);
    }
    return reno_spec_meta_count_value(value, counts);
}

static RenoSpecMroCountStatus
reno_spec_mro_inventory_raw_install_raw(const RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec, RenoSpecMroInventory *out)
{
    RenoSpecMroInventory inventory = {0};
    RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout empty_layout = {0};
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts empty_metadata = {0};
    PyObject *original_mro = spec->mro;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    size_t index;
    size_t entries;
    size_t observed;
    size_t base_edges;
    size_t entry_edges;
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus meta_status;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || original_mro == NULL
            || !PyTuple_CheckExact(original_mro)
            || !reno_ws_from_ssize(PyTuple_GET_SIZE(original_mro), &inventory.mro_length)
            || inventory.mro_length == 0
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(original_mro, 0) != spec->klass) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    for (index = 0; index < inventory.mro_length; ++index) {
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(original_mro, (Py_ssize_t)index);
        if (base == NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)) { goto needs_route; }
        dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base);
        status = reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &entries);
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
        if (status == RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE) { goto needs_route; }
        if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || !reno_ws_add(inventory.base_count, 1, &inventory.base_count)
                || !reno_ws_add(inventory.entry_count, entries, &inventory.entry_count)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
        position = 0;
        observed = 0;
        while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (key == NULL || value == NULL || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(key)) { goto needs_route; }
            meta_status = reno_spec_meta_count_entry_install_raw(value, &inventory.metadata);
            if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || meta_status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
            if (meta_status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) { goto needs_route; }
            if (meta_status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT
                    || !reno_ws_add(observed, 1, &observed)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
        }
        if (observed != entries) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    }
    /* Original base/dict/key/value pointer LOWER BOUND remains separate
     * from the full metadata bank and its nullable ledger capacity.
     */
    if (!reno_ws_multiply(inventory.base_count, 2, &base_edges)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(inventory.entry_count, 2, &entry_edges)
            || !reno_ws_add(base_edges, entry_edges, &inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences)
            || !reno_ws_multiply(inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences, sizeof(PyObject *),
                &inventory.minimum_pointer_bytes)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences)
            || !reno_ws_python_length(inventory.minimum_pointer_bytes)
            || !reno_spec_mro_storage_layout(inventory.base_count, inventory.entry_count,
                &inventory.metadata, &inventory.capture_layout)) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_OVERFLOW; }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    inventory.route = RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT;
    *out = inventory;
    return RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT;

needs_route:
    /* Preserve mro_length only; partial metadata/offsets are not usable. */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return RENO_SPEC_MRO_SHAPE; }
    inventory.base_count = 0;
    inventory.entry_count = 0;
    inventory.minimum_owning_occurrences = 0;
    inventory.minimum_pointer_bytes = 0;
    inventory.metadata = empty_metadata;
    inventory.capture_layout = empty_layout;
    inventory.route = RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE;
    *out = inventory;
    return RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE;
}

static int
reno_spec_mro_inventory_matches_install_raw(const RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec)
{
    RenoSpecMroInventory actual = {0};
    const RenoSpecMroInventory *expected = &spec->inventory;
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus status;

    if (expected->route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT
            && expected->route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) { return 0; }
    status = reno_spec_mro_inventory_raw_install_raw(spec, &actual);
    return (status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT || status == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE)
        && actual.route == expected->route && actual.mro_length == expected->mro_length
        && actual.base_count == expected->base_count && actual.entry_count == expected->entry_count
        && actual.minimum_owning_occurrences == expected->minimum_owning_occurrences
        && actual.minimum_pointer_bytes == expected->minimum_pointer_bytes
        && reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&actual.metadata, &expected->metadata)
        && reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(&actual.capture_layout, &expected->capture_layout)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_spec_source_roots_match_install_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;
    PyThreadState *tstate;
    PyInterpreterState *interp;
    PyTypeObject *klass;
    PyObject **roots;
    size_t count;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || state == NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ROOTS_FROZEN
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_PREPARING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_INSTALLING
                && state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE)) { return 0; }
    spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    if (spec->acquired != 3 || spec->layout_captured != 1
            || spec->klass == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(spec->klass, &PyType_Type)
            || spec->dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(spec->dictionary)
            || spec->mro == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(spec->mro)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 0, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 23, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 24, 1)) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    tstate = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (tstate == NULL) { return 0; }
    interp = tstate->interp;
    if (interp == NULL || interp->imports.modules != roots[0]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib", 17, roots[23])
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(roots[23])
            || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[23])->md_dict != roots[24]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[24], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[24], "ModuleSpec", 10, spec->klass)) { return 0; }
    klass = (PyTypeObject *)spec->klass;
    return _PyType_GetDict(klass) == spec->dictionary && klass->tp_mro == spec->mro
        && klass->tp_getattro == spec->observed_getattro
        && klass->tp_getattr == spec->observed_getattr
        && klass->tp_basicsize == spec->observed_basicsize
        && klass->tp_itemsize == spec->observed_itemsize
        && klass->tp_dictoffset == spec->observed_dictoffset
        && klass->tp_weaklistoffset == spec->observed_weaklistoffset
        && (klass->tp_flags & RENO_SPEC_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK) == spec->observed_flags
        && reno_spec_mro_inventory_matches_install_raw(spec)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_spec_meta_entry_matches_install_raw(RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region,
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *cursor, size_t entry_index, PyObject *value,
    size_t *ledger_at)
{
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *row;
    size_t expected_count = Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type) ? 3 : 1;
    const RenoSpecMroMetaCounts *limit = &region->header->layout.metadata;

    if (entry_index >= region->header->layout.entry_count || cursor->accessors > limit->accessors
            || expected_count > limit->accessors - cursor->accessors) { return 0; }
    row = &region->entry[entry_index];
    if (row->accessor_start != cursor->accessors || row->accessor_count != expected_count) { return 0; }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches_install_raw(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", ledger_at)
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches_install_raw(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", ledger_at)
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches_install_raw(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", ledger_at);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches_install_raw(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC,
                value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", ledger_at);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS
            && reno_spec_meta_accessor_matches_install_raw(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS,
                value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", ledger_at);
    }
    return row->descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
        && reno_spec_meta_value_matches(region, cursor, entry_index, RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN,
            value, ledger_at);
}

static int
reno_spec_source_capture_consistent_install_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;
    RenoSpecMroRegionOwned *region;
    const RenoSpecMroCaptureLayout *layout;
    RenoSpecMroBaseCapture *base_row;
    RenoSpecMroEntryCapture *entry_row;
    PyTypeObject *base_type;
    PyObject *key;
    PyObject *value;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    size_t base_index;
    size_t entry_at = 0;
    size_t ledger_at = 0;
    size_t ordinal;
    RenoSpecMroMetaCounts metadata = {0};

    if (!reno_spec_source_roots_match_install_raw(state)) { return 0; }
    spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    region = &spec->region;
    if (spec->inventory.route == RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) {
        return reno_spec_mro_region_empty(region); /* still-unimplemented route */
    }
    layout = &spec->inventory.capture_layout;
    if (spec->inventory.route != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT || region->initialized != 1
            || region->allocation == NULL || region->header == NULL
            || region->base == NULL || region->ledger == NULL
            || (layout->entry_count != 0 && region->entry == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.accessors != 0 && region->accessor == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.functions != 0 && region->function == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.keywords != 0 && region->kw == NULL)
            || (layout->metadata.cells != 0 && region->cell == NULL)
            || region->allocation_bytes != layout->requested_bytes
            || !reno_spec_mro_layout_equal(&region->header->layout, layout)
            || region->header->phase != RENO_SPEC_BANK_CAPTURED
            || region->header->failed != 0
            || region->header->initialized_bases != layout->base_count
            || region->header->initialized_entries != layout->entry_count
            || region->header->captured_bases != layout->base_count
            || region->header->captured_entries != layout->entry_count
            || !reno_spec_meta_header_matches(region->header, &layout->metadata)
            || region->header->ledger_count != layout->expected_acquired
            || region->header->ledger_count > layout->ledger_capacity) { return 0; }
    for (base_index = 0; base_index < layout->base_count; ++base_index) {
        base_row = &region->base[base_index];
        if (base_row->mro_index != base_index || base_row->entry_start != entry_at
                || base_row->base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(spec->mro, (Py_ssize_t)base_index)
                || base_row->layout_captured != 1
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &base_row->base, &ledger_at)
                || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &base_row->dictionary, &ledger_at)) { return 0; }
        base_type = (PyTypeObject *)base_row->base;
        if (_PyType_GetDict(base_type) != base_row->dictionary
                || base_type->tp_getattro != base_row->observed_getattro
                || base_type->tp_getattr != base_row->observed_getattr
                || base_type->tp_basicsize != base_row->observed_basicsize
                || base_type->tp_itemsize != base_row->observed_itemsize
                || base_type->tp_dictoffset != base_row->observed_dictoffset
                || base_type->tp_weaklistoffset != base_row->observed_weaklistoffset
                || (base_type->tp_flags & RENO_SPEC_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK) != base_row->observed_flags) { return 0; }
        position = 0;
        ordinal = 0;
        key = NULL;
        value = NULL;
        while (PyDict_Next(base_row->dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
            if (entry_at >= layout->entry_count || ordinal >= base_row->entry_count) { return 0; }
            entry_row = &region->entry[entry_at];
            if (entry_row->base_index != base_index || entry_row->entry_ordinal != ordinal
                    || entry_row->key != key || entry_row->value != value
                    || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &entry_row->key, &ledger_at)
                    || !reno_spec_mro_ledger_matches(region, &entry_row->value, &ledger_at)
                    || !reno_spec_entry_protocol_matches(region, entry_at, value, &ledger_at)
                    || !reno_spec_meta_entry_matches_install_raw(region, &metadata, entry_at, value, &ledger_at)) { return 0; }
            ++ordinal;
            ++entry_at;
        }
        if (ordinal != base_row->entry_count) { return 0; }
    }
    return entry_at == layout->entry_count && ledger_at == layout->expected_acquired
        && reno_spec_meta_counts_equal(&metadata, &layout->metadata)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_csw_source_entry_install_raw(const char *data, const RenoClassSourceLayout *layout,
    PyObject *rows, size_t class_start, size_t base, size_t entry,
    unsigned char descriptor_role, PyObject *value, size_t end, size_t *cursor)
{
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyProperty_Type)) {
        return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY
            && reno_csw_source_accessor_install_raw(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fget", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FGET, end, cursor)
            && reno_csw_source_accessor_install_raw(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fset", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FSET, end, cursor)
            && reno_csw_source_accessor_install_raw(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyProperty_Type, "fdel", RENO_WS_ACCESS_FDEL, end, cursor);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyStaticMethod_Type)) {
        return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_STATIC
            && reno_csw_source_accessor_install_raw(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", RENO_WS_ACCESS_STATIC, end, cursor);
    }
    if (Py_IS_TYPE(value, &PyClassMethod_Type)) {
        return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_CLASS
            && reno_csw_source_accessor_install_raw(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
                value, &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", RENO_WS_ACCESS_CLASS, end, cursor);
    }
    return descriptor_role == RENO_WS_DESCRIPTOR_PLAIN
        && reno_csw_source_value(data, layout, rows, class_start, base, entry,
            RENO_WS_ACCESS_PLAIN, value, end, cursor);
}

static int
reno_state_class_sources_match_install_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord klass_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord base_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord entry_record;
    const char *data;
    PyObject *dicts;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *rows;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *entry;
    size_t class_index;
    size_t ordinal;
    size_t item;
    size_t base_cursor = 0;
    size_t entry_cursor = 0;
    size_t dispatch_cursor = 0;
    size_t entry_end;

    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1
            || !reno_csw_open(state->arena.class_source_witness, &layout, &data, &dicts)) { return 0; }
    for (class_index = 0; class_index < 5; ++class_index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 103 + (unsigned int)class_index, 1)
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, classes[class_index], 1)
                || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 0, class_index, &klass_record)
                || klass_record.flag[0] != class_index
                || klass_record.scalar[0] != base_cursor || klass_record.scalar[2] != dispatch_cursor
                || !reno_csw_range(base_cursor, klass_record.scalar[1], layout.count[1])
                || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_cursor, klass_record.scalar[3], layout.count[3])) { return 0; }
        snapshot = state->arena.known.roots[103 + class_index];
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != state->arena.known.roots[classes[class_index]]) { return 0; }
        mro = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
        bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
        rows = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 3);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, klass_record.scalar[1])
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(bases, klass_record.scalar[1])
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(rows, klass_record.scalar[3])) { return 0; }
        for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < klass_record.scalar[1]; ++ordinal) {
            if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 1, base_cursor, &base_record)
                    || base_record.scalar[0] != class_index || base_record.scalar[1] != ordinal
                    || base_record.scalar[2] != entry_cursor || base_record.scalar[4] != dispatch_cursor
                    || !reno_csw_range(entry_cursor, base_record.scalar[3], layout.count[2])
                    || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_cursor, base_record.scalar[5], layout.count[3])) { return 0; }
            base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2)) { return 0; }
            base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0);
            entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
            if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type) || base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal)
                    || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base) != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)base_cursor)
                    || !reno_ws_source_tuple(entries, base_record.scalar[3])) { return 0; }
            for (item = 0; item < base_record.scalar[3]; ++item) {
                if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 2, entry_cursor, &entry_record)
                        || entry_record.scalar[0] != base_cursor || entry_record.scalar[1] != item
                        || entry_record.scalar[2] != dispatch_cursor
                        || !reno_csw_range(dispatch_cursor, entry_record.scalar[3], layout.count[3])) { return 0; }
                entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, (Py_ssize_t)item);
                if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)) { return 0; }
                entry_end = dispatch_cursor + entry_record.scalar[3];
                if (!reno_csw_source_entry_install_raw(data, &layout, rows, klass_record.scalar[2],
                        base_cursor, entry_cursor, entry_record.flag[0], PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1),
                        entry_end, &dispatch_cursor)
                        || dispatch_cursor != entry_end) { return 0; }
                ++entry_cursor;
            }
            if (dispatch_cursor - base_record.scalar[4] != base_record.scalar[5]) { return 0; }
            ++base_cursor;
        }
        if (dispatch_cursor - klass_record.scalar[2] != klass_record.scalar[3]) { return 0; }
    }
    return base_cursor == layout.count[1] && entry_cursor == layout.count[2]
        && dispatch_cursor == layout.count[3] && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_fixed_sources_match_install_raw(RenoState *state, PyObject *const expected_mros[5],
    PyObject *expected_self_borrowed, PyObject *expected_module_borrowed)
{
    static const unsigned char module_slots[4] = {1, 4, 23, 25};
    static const unsigned char dict_slots[4] = {2, 5, 24, 26};
    static const unsigned char class_slots[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char class_dict_slots[5] = {7, 12, 15, 18, 21};
    static const char *const class_names[5] = {
        "PathFinder", "_LoaderBasics", "FileLoader", "SourceLoader", "SourceFileLoader"
    };
    static const Py_ssize_t class_lengths[5] = {10, 13, 10, 12, 16};
    PyThreadState *thread_state;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter;
    PyObject **roots;
    PyObject *runtime_error = NULL; /* actual C data borrows, no acquire */
    PyObject *name_error = NULL;
    PyObject *type_error = NULL;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyCFunctionObject *builtin;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *control;
    size_t count;
    unsigned int index;
    unsigned int slot;

    if (state == NULL || expected_mros == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    control = &state->controls.builtin_exec;
    if (!state->controls.getters[0].captured || !state->controls.getters[0].frozen
            || !state->controls.getters[1].captured || !state->controls.getters[1].frozen
            || !state->controls.getters[2].captured || !state->controls.getters[2].frozen
            || PyBaseObject_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[0].expected
            || PyType_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[1].expected
            || PyModule_Type.tp_getattro != state->controls.getters[2].expected) { return 0; }
    /* Post-capture selected source only. Historical C owning roots are the
     * expected; these are current actual C runtime data, not builtins aliases.
     * No reference acquire/callback, exception-instance or attribute read.
     * Earlier untyped/pre-capture errors cannot use these future known slots.
     */
    runtime_error = PyExc_RuntimeError;
    name_error = PyExc_NameError;
    type_error = PyExc_TypeError;
    if (runtime_error == NULL || name_error == NULL || type_error == NULL
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 98, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 99, 1)
            || roots[97] != runtime_error || roots[98] != name_error
            || roots[99] != type_error) { return 0; }
    /* Original fixed roots only. The early retained caller does not require
     * future anchors/snapshots; the later State wrapper supplies old output
     * roots separately. No current attribute becomes an expected operand.
     */
    for (slot = 0; slot <= 27; ++slot) {
        if (roots[slot] == NULL || !state->arena.known.owned[slot]) { return 0; }
    }
    thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (thread_state == NULL) { return 0; }
    interpreter = thread_state->interp;
    if (interpreter == NULL || interpreter->imports.modules == NULL
            || interpreter->imports.modules != roots[0]
            || interpreter->sysdict == NULL || interpreter->sysdict != roots[2]) { return 0; }
    if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "sys", 3, roots[1])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib_external", 26, roots[4])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib", 17, roots[23])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "builtins", 8, roots[25])) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 4; ++index) {
        if (!PyModule_CheckExact(roots[module_slots[index]])
                || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[module_slots[index]])->md_dict != roots[dict_slots[index]]
                || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[dict_slots[index]], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!PyList_CheckExact(roots[3])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[2], "meta_path", 9, roots[3])) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        klass = roots[class_slots[index]];
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(klass, &PyType_Type)
                || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[5], class_names[index], class_lengths[index], klass)) { return 0; }
        dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)klass);
        mro = expected_mros[index];
        if (dictionary != roots[class_dict_slots[index]]
                || ((PyTypeObject *)klass)->tp_mro != mro || mro == NULL
                || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro)) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], "find_spec", 9, roots[8])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], "invalidate_caches", 17, roots[9])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], "find_distributions", 18, roots[10])
            || !reno_install_source_descriptor_raw(roots[8], &PyClassMethod_Type, "__func__", roots[30])
            || !reno_install_source_descriptor_raw(roots[9], &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", roots[39])
            || !reno_install_source_descriptor_raw(roots[10], &PyStaticMethod_Type, "__func__", roots[48])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[18], "get_code", 8, roots[57])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[12], "exec_module", 11, roots[66])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[24], "_call_with_frames_removed", 25, roots[75])
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[26], "exec", 4, roots[27])
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[27], &PyCFunction_Type)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 4; ++index) {
        if (!control->scalar_captured[index]) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        PyObject *payload = index == 0 ? expected_self_borrowed : expected_module_borrowed;
        if (!control->payload_captured[index] || control->present[index] > 1
                || control->present[index] != (payload != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    builtin = (PyCFunctionObject *)roots[27];
    return builtin->m_ml == control->methoddef && builtin->m_ml != NULL
        && builtin->m_ml->ml_meth == control->function
        && builtin->m_ml->ml_flags == control->flags
        && builtin->vectorcall == control->vectorcall
        && builtin->m_self == expected_self_borrowed
        && builtin->m_module == expected_module_borrowed;
}

static int
reno_state_fixed_sources_match_install_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    static const unsigned char classes[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char mros[5] = {0, 13, 16, 19, 22};
    PyObject *expected_mros[5] = {NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *payloads[2] = {NULL, NULL};
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject **roots;
    unsigned int index;

    /* Includes empty indicator, all scalar/payload captured/ready flags,
     * known27/28/29 ledger, tuple0/1 shape and original raw binding match.
     */
    if (!reno_state_builtin_exec_matches(state)) { return 0; }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 103 + index, 1)
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, classes[index], 1)) { return 0; }
        snapshot = roots[103 + index];
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != roots[classes[index]]) { return 0; }
        expected_mros[index] = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
        if (index != 0 && (!reno_ws_known_status(state, mros[index], 1)
                || expected_mros[index] != roots[mros[index]])) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        if (state->controls.builtin_exec.present[index]) {
            payloads[index] = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(roots[28 + index], 0);
        }
    }
    /* Installation-only descriptor helper borrows the current fixed member;
     * it neither acquires/releases references nor invokes arbitrary getters.
     */
    return reno_fixed_sources_match_install_raw(state, expected_mros, payloads[0], payloads[1])
        && reno_state_class_sources_match_install_raw(state);
}

static int
reno_state_fixed_metadata_match_install_raw(RenoState *state)
{
    unsigned int index;

    if (!reno_state_functions_metadata_match(state)) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_state_module_metadata_matches(state)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_state_class_metadata_matches(state, index)) { return 0; }
    }
    return reno_state_fixed_sources_match_install_raw(state);
}

static int
reno_h01_function_sources_match_install_raw(RenoState *state, PyObject *actual_callee,
    unsigned char role)
{
    unsigned char required[7] = {0, 4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 103};
    unsigned int descriptor_slot;
    unsigned int function_slot;
    const char *source_name;
    Py_ssize_t source_length;
    PyThreadState *thread_state;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter;
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    RenoClassSourceRecord klass_record;
    RenoClassSourceRecord base_record;
    const char *data;
    PyObject **roots;
    PyObject *dicts;
    PyObject *snapshot;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *bases;
    PyObject *base_row;
    PyObject *base;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *entries;
    PyObject *entry;
    size_t count;
    size_t ordinal;
    size_t item;
    size_t entry_cursor = 0;
    unsigned int index;

    if (state == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC
                && role != RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
                && role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_DISTRIBUTIONS)
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1) { return 0; }
    descriptor_slot = 8u + role;
    function_slot = 30u + 9u * role;
    required[5] = (unsigned char)descriptor_slot;
    source_name = role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC ? "find_spec"
        : (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
            ? "invalidate_caches" : "find_distributions");
    source_length = role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC ? 9
        : (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES ? 17 : 18);
    for (index = 0; index < 7; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, required[index], 1)) { return 0; }
    }
    roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, function_slot, 1)
            || actual_callee != roots[function_slot]
            || (role != RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC
                && (role == RENO_PROXY_INVALIDATE_CACHES
                    ? state->arena.install.invalidate_caches
                    : state->arena.install.find_distributions) != actual_callee)) { return 0; }
    thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (thread_state == NULL) { return 0; }
    interpreter = thread_state->interp;
    if (interpreter == NULL || interpreter->imports.modules == NULL
            || interpreter->imports.modules != roots[0]) { return 0; }
    if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[0], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[0], "_frozen_importlib_external", 26, roots[4])
            || !PyModule_CheckExact(roots[4])
            || ((PyModuleObject *)roots[4])->md_dict != roots[5]
            || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(roots[5], &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
            || !reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[5], "PathFinder", 10, roots[6])
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(roots[6], &PyType_Type)
            || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)roots[6]) != roots[7]) { return 0; }
    snapshot = roots[103];
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(snapshot, 4)
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 0) != roots[6]
            || !reno_csw_open(state->arena.class_source_witness, &layout, &data, &dicts)
            || !reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 0, 0, &klass_record)
            || klass_record.flag[0] != 0 || klass_record.scalar[0] != 0
            || klass_record.scalar[1] == 0
            || !reno_csw_range(0, klass_record.scalar[1], layout.count[1])) { return 0; }
    mro = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 1);
    bases = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(snapshot, 2);
    if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, klass_record.scalar[1])
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(bases, klass_record.scalar[1])
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, 0) != roots[6]
            || ((PyTypeObject *)roots[6])->tp_mro != mro) { return 0; }
    for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < klass_record.scalar[1]; ++ordinal) {
        if (!reno_csw_record(data, &layout, 1, ordinal, &base_record)
                || base_record.scalar[0] != 0 || base_record.scalar[1] != ordinal
                || base_record.scalar[2] != entry_cursor
                || !reno_csw_range(entry_cursor, base_record.scalar[3], layout.count[2])) { return 0; }
        base_row = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(bases, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal);
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(base_row, 2)) { return 0; }
        base = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 0);
        entries = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(base_row, 1);
        if (!Py_IS_TYPE(base, &PyType_Type)
                || base != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal)
                || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base)
                    != PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal)
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(entries, base_record.scalar[3])) { return 0; }
        dictionary = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal);
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || count != base_record.scalar[3]) { return 0; }
        for (item = 0; item < base_record.scalar[3]; ++item) {
            entry = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entries, (Py_ssize_t)item);
            if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(entry, 2)
                    || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1) == NULL
                    || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(dictionary, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 0),
                        PyTuple_GET_ITEM(entry, 1))) { return 0; }
        }
        entry_cursor += base_record.scalar[3]; /* bounded by the checked range */
    }
    return reno_ws_source_ascii(roots[7], source_name, source_length, roots[descriptor_slot])
        && reno_install_source_descriptor_raw(roots[descriptor_slot],
            role == RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC ? &PyClassMethod_Type : &PyStaticMethod_Type,
            "__func__", actual_callee)
        && reno_state_function_metadata_matches(state, role)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_h01_f0_source_check_install_raw(void *opaque)
{
    RenoF0SourceContext *source = (RenoF0SourceContext *)opaque;
    if (source == NULL || source->tstate == NULL
            || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != source->tstate
            || !reno_h01_f0_owner_matches(source->owner, source->module, source->state)) {
        return 0;
    }
    RenoState *state = source->state;
    if (state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 30, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 31, 1)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 6, 1)
            || source->method != state->arena.install.find_spec
            || source->function != state->arena.known.roots[30]
            || source->code != state->arena.known.roots[31]
            || source->klass != state->arena.known.roots[6]
            || source->method == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->method, &PyMethod_Type)
            || source->function == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || source->code == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->code, &PyCode_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(source->method) != source->function
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(source->method) != source->klass
            || ((PyFunctionObject *)source->function)->func_code != source->code
            || state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured != 1
            || ((PyMethodObject *)source->method)->vectorcall
                != state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall) { return 0; }
    /* Raw constructor-field identity is only one source fact. Actual method
     * slot selection still belongs to r1401's typeflags/offset dispatch.
     * Installation checks the fixed classmethod member by raw borrow;
     * actual source/layout/normal primitive premises remain independent.
     */
    if (!reno_h01_function_sources_match_install_raw(state, source->function, RENO_PROXY_FIND_SPEC)
            || !reno_h01_f0_owner_matches(source->owner, source->module, state)
            || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != source->tstate
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_spec_loader_source_fresh_install_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source)
{
    RenoF0SourceContext check;
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec;

    if (source == NULL || source->in_method_call != 0) { return 0; }
    check = *source;
    if (!reno_h01_f0_source_check_install_raw(&check)
            || !reno_spec_source_capture_consistent_install_raw(source->state)) { return 0; }
    spec = &source->state->arena.spec_source;
    return spec->loader_key_prepared == 1 && spec->prepared_loader_key != NULL
        && exact_ascii_name(spec->prepared_loader_key, "loader", 6)
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader)
{
    if (!reno_spec_loader_source_fresh_install_raw(source)
            || !reno_loader_layout_original_matches(source->state)
            || actual_loader == NULL
            || Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20]) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (!reno_state_fixed_metadata_match_install_raw(source->state)) { return 0; }
    return reno_spec_loader_source_fresh_install_raw(source)
        && reno_loader_layout_original_matches(source->state)
        && Py_TYPE(actual_loader) == (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Creation bookkeeping ONLY, separate from ordinary INSTALL preparation
 * eligibility. True source/constructor caller/root provenance is a prior
 * premise; checks below only reject changed/inconsistent real products. No
 * full-association permission, phase/source/payload write, capture-mode switch,
 * allocation/release, exception construction or retirement decision is added.
 */
static int
reno_loader_creation_publish_base_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class, PyObject *actual_loader,
    PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present,
    PyObject *actual_record_key)
{
    RenoState *state;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || source == NULL || source->state == NULL
            || actual_record_guard == NULL || original_class == NULL || actual_loader == NULL
            || dictionary == NULL || actual_record_key == NULL || previous_present > 1
            || (previous_present && previous == NULL) || (!previous_present && previous != NULL)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) { return 0; }
    state = source->state;
    if (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.record_draining || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || original_class != state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)original_class
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || !exact_ascii_name(actual_record_key, "exec_module", 11)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_record_guard, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record_guard;
    return record->module_lifetime == source->module && record->origin_state == state
        && record->owner_proxy == (PyObject *)source->owner
        && record->retired_error_class == state->arena.known.roots[97]
        && record->phase == RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED && !record->restore_cancelled
        && !record->linked && record->registry_owner_state == NULL
        && record->prev == NULL && record->next == NULL
        && record->original_loader == actual_loader && record->loader_dict == dictionary
        && record->attribute_key == actual_record_key
        && record->previous_present == previous_present && record->previous_value == previous
        && record->installed_bound == NULL
        && !record->store_attempted && !record->store_returned && !record->effect_observed
        && !record->restore_attempted && !record->restore_returned && !record->restore_effect_observed
        && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* Sole real callers have JUST received this exact NewEx owning result and
 * captured creation_dispatch from it before any later callback. This helper
 * never learns expected from a REUSE/current subject or recaptures on mismatch.
 */
static int
reno_loader_publish_inner_creation_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class, PyObject *actual_loader,
    PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present,
    PyObject *actual_record_key, PyObject *actual_inner, vectorcallfunc creation_dispatch)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;

    if (!reno_loader_creation_publish_base_raw(source, actual_record_guard, original_class,
            actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present, actual_record_key)) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record_guard;
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, actual_loader, NULL, NULL)
            || actual_inner == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->m_self != actual_record_guard
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->m_module != NULL
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)actual_inner)->vectorcall != creation_dispatch) { return 0; }
    record->created_inner_vectorcall = creation_dispatch;
    record->inner_dispatch_captured = 1; /* once, including a real captured NULL */
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class, PyObject *actual_loader,
    PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous, unsigned char previous_present,
    PyObject *actual_record_key, PyObject *actual_inner, PyObject *actual_bound,
    vectorcallfunc creation_dispatch)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;

    if (!reno_loader_creation_publish_base_raw(source, actual_record_guard, original_class,
            actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present, actual_record_key)) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record_guard;
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, actual_loader, actual_inner, NULL)
            || actual_bound == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_bound, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(actual_bound) != actual_inner
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(actual_bound) != actual_loader
            || ((PyMethodObject *)actual_bound)->vectorcall != creation_dispatch) { return 0; }
    record->created_bound_vectorcall = creation_dispatch;
    record->bound_dispatch_captured = 1;
    return 1;
}

/* Independent read-only typed policy. All pointer operands are live borrows
 * from the original parent/module/entered roots and two private extra NEWs.
 * There is no candidate, INSTALLING gate, registry scan, attempted/linked test,
 * installation permit, State write, exception fetch/clear or owning operation.
 */
struct RenoSpecAttr312SelectionContext {
    const RenoF0SourceContext *source;
    PyObject *original_class;
    PyObject *actual_loader;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *query;
    unsigned char cancelled;
};

static int
reno_loader_selection_permit_raw(RenoSpecAttr312SelectionContext *context)
{
    if (context->cancelled) { return 0; }
    /* A transient pending comparison/release error permits mandatory natural
     * settlement ONLY. It is not a source certificate, and must not latch a
     * spurious source failure. Runtime frames prohibit new lookup/capture with
     * pending; after it clears, the full raw source is checked again below.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 1; }
    if (context->source == NULL || context->original_class == NULL
            || context->actual_loader == NULL || context->dictionary == NULL
            || context->query == NULL
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(context->source,
                context->actual_loader)
            || context->original_class != context->source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(context->original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(context->actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)context->original_class
            || !exact_ascii_name(context->query, "exec_module", 11)) {
        context->cancelled = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    /* Backing is checked at each REAL runtime consumption point. Do not put
     * the old PreparedDictDomain/ASCII key-domain gate ahead of GENERAL.
     */
    return 1;
}

/* Sole caller supplies aggregate-zero distinct automatic owner and a real
 * completed lookup's still-owned query. No output or class owning is released
 * here, even on ERROR/CANCELLED. Capture actual first immediately in the parent
 * after return; ERROR without an indicator is only unadmitted history here.
 */
static void
reno_loader_observe_selection_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *query,
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner *owner)
{
    RenoSpecAttr312SelectionContext context;

    if (owner->history.consumer_entered) {
        owner->history.unadmitted_return = 1;
        return;
    }
    owner->history.consumer_entered = 1; /* before the first possible callback */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || source == NULL || actual_loader == NULL
            || dictionary == NULL || query == NULL
            || !exact_ascii_name(query, "exec_module", 11)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) {
        return; /* real uncalled history, including foreign/changed source */
    }
    /* SAME no-callout source span: known20 is the retained original T0 loader
     * class. source->klass is known6/PathFinder and is not this operand.
     * Normal noncalling NEW is a separate build/reference premise.
     */
    owner->original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(source->state->arena.known.roots[20]);
    owner->history.qualified = 1;
    context.source = source;
    context.original_class = owner->original_class_owned;
    context.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    context.dictionary = dictionary;
    context.query = query;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    owner->history.api_called = 1;
    owner->history.outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ObserveSelectionCurrent(
        actual_loader, (PyTypeObject *)owner->original_class_owned, dictionary,
        query, reno_loader_selection_permit_raw, &context,
        &owner->output, &owner->history.progress);
    owner->history.api_returned = 1;
    owner->history.permit_cancelled = context.cancelled;
    if (owner->history.outcome < RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_ERROR
            || owner->history.outcome > RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || owner->output.observed > 1 || owner->output.present > 1
            || (!owner->output.observed
                && (owner->output.present || owner->output.current_owned != NULL))
            || (owner->output.observed
                && ((owner->output.current_owned != NULL) != (owner->output.present != 0)))
            || (owner->history.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
                && (!owner->output.observed || context.cancelled))
            || (owner->history.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_ERROR
                && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL)
            || (owner->history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_ERROR
                && PyErr_Occurred() != NULL)) {
        owner->history.unadmitted_return = 1;
    }
}

/* Project borrowed pointers and scalar history explicitly. Never copy output
 * or Owner: equal original/previous/current pointers remain independent debts.
 */
static void
reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(const RenoLoaderSelectionOwner *owner,
    PyObject *query, RenoLoaderSelectionView *view)
{
    view->original_class = owner->original_class_owned;
    view->query = query;
    view->current = owner->output.current_owned;
    view->candidate_bound = owner->candidate_bound_owned;
    view->related = owner->related_owned;
    view->observed = owner->output.observed;
    view->present = owner->output.present;
    view->history = owner->history; /* no owning fields */
}

/* A NEW whole-association observation in the SAME no-callout span after the
 * actual current API's successful OBSERVED return. The sole real parents own
 * loader/dict/query/module/entered; Owner holds original class/current. These
 * premises do not follow from pointer/scalar shape. Never call this on a saved
 * View after a callback, use INSTALL authority, or overwrite setup.related.
 */
static void
reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *query,
    PyObject *actual_candidate_bound, RenoLoaderSelectionOwner *owner)
{
    RenoSpecAttr312SelectionContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation relation;
    int query_status;

    if (owner->history.association_consumer_entered) {
        owner->history.unadmitted_return = 1;
        return;
    }
    owner->history.association_consumer_entered = 1;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || owner->history.unadmitted_return
            || !owner->history.api_called || !owner->history.api_returned
            || owner->history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED) {
        return; /* actual uncalled query history, never observed NONE */
    }
    if (source == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || query == NULL
            || owner->original_class_owned == NULL || owner->output.observed != 1
            || owner->output.present > 1
            || ((owner->output.current_owned != NULL) != (owner->output.present != 0))
            || owner->candidate_bound_owned != NULL || owner->related_owned != NULL) {
        owner->history.unadmitted_return = 1;
        return;
    }
    context.source = source;
    context.original_class = owner->original_class_owned;
    context.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    context.dictionary = dictionary;
    context.query = query;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_selection_permit_raw(&context)) {
        owner->history.association_before_query_cancelled = 1;
        return;
    }
    relation = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)owner->original_class_owned, dictionary);
    owner->history.association_backing_checked = 1;
    owner->history.association_backing_relation = relation;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || relation == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_ERROR) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { owner->history.unadmitted_return = 1; }
        return;
    }
    if (relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME) {
        owner->history.association_before_query_cancelled = 1;
        return;
    }
    /* Candidate is a DISTINCT original actual owning product, supplied from
     * setup.bound_owned or mutation.bound_owned, never reloaded from Record or
     * dictionary current. Keep a separate parent NEW across child consumption.
     * Normal noncalling NEW preserves this current/source raw span; its real
     * reference/build/GIL/S1/registry-liveness premises remain independent.
     */
    owner->candidate_bound_owned = Py_XNewRef(actual_candidate_bound);
    owner->history.association_candidate_supplied = actual_candidate_bound != NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return; }
    owner->history.association_query_entered = 1;
    query_status = reno_loader_record_query_raw(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
        owner->output.current_owned, owner->candidate_bound_owned,
        &owner->related_owned, &owner->history.association);
    owner->history.association_query_returned = 1;
    owner->history.association_query_status = query_status;
    if (query_status == 1 && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        owner->history.association_query_completed = 1;
    }
    else if (query_status != 0 || PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        owner->history.unadmitted_return = 1;
    }
    /* Failed query may already have produced related_owned NEW. Leave that,
     * candidate/current/class and actual partial history with the SAME parent
     * on ALL returns. No release/fetch/clear, source re-enrollment, candidate/
     * registry write, reuse or success decision happens here. Any later callback
     * invalidates freshness while all held occurrences remain real history.
     */
}


/* Private borrowed view of the SAME prefix activation. No owning field,
 * State/bank slot, cached fresh result or current-derived expected is added.
 * Caller roots actual loader/dict/previous/query; prefix separately roots the
 * historical original class and actual prepared Record key, plus inner NEW.
 */
typedef struct RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView {
    PyObject *original_class;
    PyObject *actual_loader;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *previous;
    unsigned char previous_present;
    PyObject *query;
    PyObject *inner;
    PyObject *bound;
    RenoLoaderSetupStage stage;
} RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView;

struct RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext {
    const RenoF0SourceContext *source;
    PyObject *record_guard;
    const RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *preparation;
    unsigned char absent;
    unsigned char registration;
    unsigned char attempt_started;
    unsigned char cancelled;
};

/* Current source eligibility; pending errors are left untouched. Complete
 * raw source is checked separately by the shared permit when empty. Same
 * lawful live-node/acyclic/unlink-before-callout/GIL prerequisites as STORE.
 * A related association cancels this NEW prefix only; full alias/MULTIPLE
 * handling stays with the complete selector. No raw node escapes the frame.
 */
static int
reno_loader_existing_preparation_eligible_raw(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context)
{
    const RenoF0SourceContext *source = context->source;
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *view = context->preparation;
    RenoState *state = source->state;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)context->record_guard;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *node;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *prior = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordPhase expected_phase;

    if (context->absent > 1 || context->registration != 0 || context->cancelled || context->attempt_started
            || view == NULL || context->mutation != NULL
            || view->previous_present > 1 || context->absent != (view->previous_present ? 0 : 1)
            || (view->previous_present && view->previous == NULL)
            || (!view->previous_present && view->previous != NULL)
            || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || source->owner->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
            || source->owner->module_lifetime != source->module || source->owner->origin_state != state
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || view->original_class != state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(view->original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(view->actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)view->original_class
            || !PyDict_Check(view->dictionary)
            || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(view->query) || !exact_ascii_name(view->query, "exec_module", 11)) { return 0; }
    if (view->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE) {
        if (record != NULL || view->inner != NULL || view->bound != NULL) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (record == NULL || !reno_record_type_effect((PyObject *)Py_TYPE(record))
                || (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(record) != state->arena.install.record_type
                || record->restore_cancelled || record->linked || record->registry_owner_state != NULL
                || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
                || record->module_lifetime != source->module || record->origin_state != state
                || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
                || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
                || record->original_loader != view->actual_loader || record->loader_dict != view->dictionary
                || record->previous_present != view->previous_present || record->previous_value != view->previous
                || record->attribute_key != view->query || record->installed_bound != NULL
                || record->store_attempted || record->store_returned || record->effect_observed
                || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) { return 0; }
        if (view->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT && view->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED
                && view->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND) { return 0; }
        expected_phase = view->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT
            ? RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT : RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED;
        if (record->phase != expected_phase
                || !reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, view->actual_loader,
                    view->inner, view->bound)) { return 0; }
        if (view->inner != NULL && (!Py_IS_TYPE(view->inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
                || ((PyCFunctionObject *)view->inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
                || ((PyCFunctionObject *)view->inner)->m_self != context->record_guard)) { return 0; }
        if (view->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT && (view->inner != NULL || view->bound != NULL)) { return 0; }
        if (view->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED && view->bound != NULL) { return 0; }
        if (view->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND && (view->inner == NULL || view->bound == NULL
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(view->bound, &PyMethod_Type)
                || PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(view->bound) != view->inner
                || PyMethod_GET_SELF(view->bound) != view->actual_loader)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (node = state->controls.record_head; node != NULL; node = node->next) {
        if (node == record || node->prev != prior || !node->linked || node->registry_owner_state != state
                || node->origin_state != state || node->module_lifetime != source->module
                || node->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || node->restore_cancelled) { return 0; }
        if (node->original_loader == view->actual_loader || node->loader_dict == view->dictionary
                || (view->previous_present && node->installed_bound == view->previous)
                || (view->bound != NULL && node->installed_bound == view->bound)) { return 0; }
        prior = node;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Current eligibility only, including a full no-callback registry traversal.
 * Registry live-node/layout/acyclic/first-callout-unlink invariants and current
 * GIL are independent premises. No raw node pointer survives this frame, no
 * related node is acquired/cancelled. A conflict cancels THIS new installation
 * attempt; the complete selector still owes actual ONE/MULTIPLE/alias handling.
 * Pending error is allowed here: this predicate neither steals nor clears it.
 */
static int
reno_loader_install_eligible_effect_raw(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context,
    unsigned char expected_effect)
{
    const RenoF0SourceContext *source = context->source;
    const RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation = context->mutation;
    RenoState *state = source->state;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)context->record_guard;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *node;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *previous_node = NULL;
    PyObject *inner;

    /* E0 is a private validation domain for a NEW current observation,
     * never a runtime INSTALL permit. Existing callers always use E1 below.
     */
    if (expected_effect > 1 || (expected_effect == 0 && context->registration != 1)) { return 0; }
    if (context->absent > 1 || context->registration > 1 || context->preparation != NULL
            || (context->registration && context->attempt_started != 1)
            || context->cancelled || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || source->owner->phase != RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE
            || source->owner->module_lifetime != source->module || source->owner->origin_state != state
            || !reno_record_type_effect((PyObject *)Py_TYPE(record))
            || (PyObject *)Py_TYPE(record) != state->arena.install.record_type
            || record->restore_cancelled || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING
            || record->linked || record->registry_owner_state != NULL
            || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || record->module_lifetime != source->module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || mutation->captured != 1 || mutation->previous_present > 1
            || mutation->previous_present != (context->absent ? 0 : 1)
            || (!context->absent && mutation->previous_owned == NULL)
            || (context->absent && mutation->previous_owned != NULL)
            || mutation->original_class_owned != state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(mutation->original_class_owned, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(mutation->loader_owned) != (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned
            || !PyDict_Check(mutation->dictionary_owned)
            || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(mutation->key_owned)
            || !exact_ascii_name(mutation->key_owned, "exec_module", 11)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(mutation->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(mutation->bound_owned) != mutation->loader_owned
            || record->original_loader != mutation->loader_owned
            || record->loader_dict != mutation->dictionary_owned
            || record->attribute_key != mutation->key_owned
            || record->installed_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || record->previous_present != mutation->previous_present
            || record->previous_value != mutation->previous_owned
            || record->store_attempted != context->attempt_started
            || (!context->registration && (record->store_returned || record->effect_observed))
            || (context->registration && (record->store_returned != 1 || record->effect_observed != expected_effect))
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) { return 0; }
    inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(mutation->bound_owned);
    if (inner == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_self != context->record_guard) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, mutation->loader_owned,
            inner, mutation->bound_owned)) { return 0; }
    for (node = state->controls.record_head; node != NULL; node = node->next) {
        if (node == record || node->prev != previous_node || !node->linked
                || node->registry_owner_state != state || node->origin_state != state
                || node->module_lifetime != source->module
                || node->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || node->restore_cancelled) { return 0; }
        if (node->original_loader == mutation->loader_owned
                || node->loader_dict == mutation->dictionary_owned
                || (mutation->previous_present && node->installed_bound == mutation->previous_owned)
                || node->installed_bound == mutation->bound_owned) { return 0; }
        previous_node = node;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_loader_install_eligible_raw(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context)
{
    return reno_loader_install_eligible_effect_raw(context, 1);
}

/* Empty-indicator calls check CURRENT complete raw source, never a saved
 * result. With a transient pending comparison/watcher reporting error, check
 * same-attempt cancellation/eligibility only, then permit mandatory settlement
 * to finish. This 1 is NOT a source/write certificate while pending. Runtime
 * frames already return ERROR before any lookup/track/value write with pending;
 * after natural reporting clears it, this same body checks full source anew.
 * No exception fetch/clear/NEW/release or generation-mode mutation occurs.
 */
static int
reno_loader_install_permit_raw(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context)
{
    PyObject *actual_loader;
    int eligible;

    if (context->cancelled) { return 0; }
    eligible = context->preparation != NULL
