        ? reno_loader_existing_preparation_eligible_raw(context)
        : reno_loader_install_eligible_raw(context);
    if (!eligible) {
        context->cancelled = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 1; } /* mandatory-settlement-only */
    actual_loader = context->preparation != NULL
        ? context->preparation->actual_loader : context->mutation->loader_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(context->source, actual_loader)) {
        context->cancelled = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Sole native parent calls AFTER actual absent preparation and local guard
 * drain, with the independently captured original tuple continuously owned.
 * Full typed raw source/candidate/whole association and actual backing/absence
 * are checked in the new no-callout store span. Keep original unwatched
 * setter/effect/ACTIVE-link/post-query behavior and all owning/effect history.
 * 1 is that actual complete native result; 0 retains COMPLETE selection,
 * including attempted effects; -1 preserves only ACTUAL first if present.
 * No capture from a callback-cleared Record or scalar-to-first fabrication.
 */
static int
reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *actual_bound,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *head;
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoState *state;
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe domain;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *inner;
    int c_return;
    int observed_here = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || actual_loader == NULL
            || dictionary == NULL || actual_bound == NULL || setup == NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
            || setup->mutation.captured != 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present != 0
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != actual_loader
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != dictionary || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != actual_bound || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL) {
        return -1; /* illegal private entry: unchanged, no cleanup/repair claim */
    }
    state = source->state;
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    /* Independent original tuple was captured BEFORE the producer drained
     * its guards. No expected operand is reloaded from Record payload now.
     * Recheck complete raw source/candidate/phase/whole association, including
     * bound alias, AFTER those releases and BEFORE the real store span.
     */
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = mutation;
    context.preparation = NULL;
    context.absent = 1;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { return 0; }

    if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || setup->related_owned != NULL || mutation->previous_present
            || mutation->previous_owned != NULL
            || ((PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned)->tp_setattro != PyObject_GenericSetAttr
            || ((PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned)->tp_setattr != NULL
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE((PyObject *)record, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)
            || record->module_lifetime != source->module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || record->registry_owner_state != NULL || record->linked
            || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->original_loader != mutation->loader_owned
            || record->loader_dict != mutation->dictionary_owned
            || record->attribute_key != mutation->key_owned
            || !exact_ascii_name(mutation->key_owned, "exec_module", 11)
            || record->installed_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || record->store_attempted || record->store_returned || record->effect_observed
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) {
        return 0; /* complete child retains actual claim and captured tuple */
    }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedUnwatchedDictDomain(mutation->loader_owned,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { goto failed; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(mutation->dictionary_owned, "exec_module", 11) != NULL) {
        return 0; /* no new store; do not uniformly reject watched/external */
    }
    record->store_attempted = 1;
    context.attempt_started = 1;
    c_return = PyDict_SetItem(mutation->dictionary_owned, mutation->key_owned,
        mutation->bound_owned); /* exactly one real setter in this component */
    first = PyErr_GetRaisedException(); /* actual first BEFORE post-call probes */
    if (c_return == 0) { record->store_returned = 1; } /* C zero-return fact only */
    /* Setter/error construction may have called out. Only independent tuple
     * roots plus the continuous Record BODY guard are used for this pure raw
     * observation. Never reload any payload from a possibly cleared Record.
     * These monotone return/effect facts remain facts even after retirement.
     */
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(mutation->loader_owned,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            && reno_t0_ascii_value(mutation->dictionary_owned, "exec_module", 11)
                == mutation->bound_owned) {
        observed_here = 1;
        record->effect_observed = 1;
    }
    if (c_return != 0 || first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK || !observed_here) {
        return 0; /* unknown/current external value is not a false no-effect */
    }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh(source, mutation->loader_owned)) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
        return 0; /* full selection still owes this actual partially stored state */
    }
    domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(mutation->loader_owned,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned);
    if (domain == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_ERROR) { goto failed; }
    if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
            || reno_t0_ascii_value(mutation->dictionary_owned, "exec_module", 11)
                != mutation->bound_owned) { return 0; }
    /* The candidate is STILL unregistered. A real whole-registry NONE scan
     * must precede publication; an unrelated/raced ONE is not this candidate.
     * Successful NONE acquires zero related references. A failed scan may
     * already own a related Record, so immediately preserve it for the child.
     */
    if (!reno_loader_record_query_raw(source, mutation->loader_owned,
            mutation->dictionary_owned, mutation->bound_owned, NULL,
            &setup->related_owned, &setup->current)) { goto failed; }
    if (setup->current.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE || setup->related_owned != NULL) {
        return 0; /* original COMPLETE child owns real race/alias/effect duties */
    }
    /* The full source bridge, current backing/effect and successful NONE
     * traversal above share this no-callout span with every check and the
     * ACTIVE/link commit below. Source/guard/layout premises are independent;
     * these comparisons do not admit arbitrary objects or current-derived roots.
     */
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || state->arena.known.roots[20] != mutation->original_class_owned
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE((PyObject *)record, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(mutation->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(mutation->bound_owned) != mutation->loader_owned
            || record->module_lifetime != source->module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || record->registry_owner_state != NULL || record->linked
            || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->original_loader != mutation->loader_owned
            || record->loader_dict != mutation->dictionary_owned
            || record->attribute_key != mutation->key_owned
            || record->installed_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || record->previous_present != mutation->previous_present
            || record->previous_value != mutation->previous_owned
            || record->store_attempted != 1 || record->store_returned != 1
            || record->effect_observed != 1 || record->restore_attempted
            || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) { return 0; }
    inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(mutation->bound_owned);
    if (inner == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_self != (PyObject *)record) { return 0; }
    /* Setter/full bridge/whole query have returned. Recompare actual
     * creation facts here, in the final ACTIVE/link no-callout span.
     */
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, mutation->loader_owned,
            inner, mutation->bound_owned)) { return 0; }
    head = state->controls.record_head;
    if (head == record || (head != NULL && (head->prev != NULL
            || head->linked != 1 || head->registry_owner_state != state))) { return 0; }
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE;
    record->registry_owner_state = state;
    record->prev = NULL;
    record->next = head;
    if (head != NULL) { head->prev = record; }
    state->controls.record_head = record;
    record->linked = 1;
    setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED; /* actual ACTIVE+link history, never rolled back */

    /* Observe the REAL new node with the existing query. Its normal path is
     * raw plus one matching NEW, replacing the old precommit ONE's occurrence;
     * NONE above acquired none. Error construction may call out: after failure
     * do not inspect old source/Record views or erase publication history.
     */
    if (!reno_loader_record_query_raw(source, mutation->loader_owned,
            mutation->dictionary_owned, mutation->bound_owned, NULL,
            &setup->related_owned, &setup->current)) { goto failed; }
    if (setup->current.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE
            || setup->related_owned != setup->record_owned
            || setup->current.phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE
            || !setup->current.same_loader || !setup->current.same_dictionary
            || !setup->current.current_is_installed_bound || setup->current.restore_cancelled
            || !setup->current.store_attempted || !setup->current.store_returned
            || !setup->current.effect_observed || setup->current.restore_attempted
            || setup->current.restore_returned || setup->current.restore_effect_observed) {
        return 0; /* keep actual ACTIVE/link/STORED and all real owning debts */
    }
    return 1; /* tuple and BOTH Record owning occurrences stay with same child */
failed:
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* No owning release, State/context/payload read or retry after settlement.
     * Parent immediately takes this SAME actual first and hands the SAME setup
     * (including every independent tuple occurrence) to the complete child.
     */
    if (first != NULL) { PyErr_SetRaisedException(first); }
    return -1;
}

/* One real runtime operation from the already MOVED child tuple; not a full
 * selector success/abort handler. The complete child still must prepare/claim
 * the original previous-present candidate, call this only at the next actual
 * stage, handle KEEP/REUSE/conflict/effect/ACTIVE-link and settle all eleven inputs.
 * This body never prepares a second Record, repeats getters/lookups/setters,
 * clears a candidate or restores a dictionary. Its private context/operands
 * are borrows backed by continuous independent roots, not new owning slots.
 * On every legal return both real runtime output occurrences are settled.
 */
static int
reno_loader_install_existing_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, const RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation,
    PyObject **first_owned, RenoLoaderInstallExistingResult *result)
{
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoLoaderInstallExistingResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallOwned output = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_record_guard == NULL || mutation == NULL || first_owned == NULL || result == NULL
            || mutation->original_class_owned == NULL || mutation->loader_owned == NULL
            || mutation->dictionary_owned == NULL || mutation->key_owned == NULL
            || mutation->bound_owned == NULL || mutation->previous_owned == NULL
            || mutation->previous_present != 1 || mutation->captured != 1) { return -1; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record_guard;
    *result = empty_result; /* all scalar outputs; NONE/COMPAT is not an API call */
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = actual_record_guard;
    context.mutation = mutation;
    context.preparation = NULL;
    context.absent = 0;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        result->before_call_cancelled = 1;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        goto settle_outputs;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
        result->before_call_cancelled = 1;
        goto settle_outputs;
    }
    record->store_attempted = 1;
    context.attempt_started = 1; /* same no-callout span as the actual attempt */
    result->primitive_called = 1;
    result->outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ConditionalInstallExisting(mutation->loader_owned,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned,
        mutation->key_owned, mutation->previous_owned, mutation->bound_owned,
        reno_loader_install_permit_raw, &context, &output, &result->notice, &result->progress);
    /* The independent candidate guard permits BODY scalar facts even after
     * callback cancellation/clear. Never reload possibly detached payloads.
     * A conditional skip/no-op is not an actual normal STORE zero return.
     */
    result->tracking_effect_observed = output.tracking_effect_observed;
    if (result->progress.effect_committed) { record->effect_observed = 1; }
    if (result->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        record->store_returned = 1;
    }
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (result->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_ERROR && first == NULL) {
        result->unadmitted_return = 1; /* scalar never invents actual escaping first */
    }
settle_outputs:
    /* These are distinct occurrences, even for equal pointers. Original
     * previous and actual bound stay independently parent-held throughout.
     * Preserve/adopt actual first; no source/payload/current read after drain.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&output.old_value_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&output.extra_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* primitive/scalar history only, never complete selection */
}

/* Called by the SAME real present prefix or absent native consumer AFTER
 * its actual local debts have been settled, with no first/pending. Original
 * source/module/entered and all actual independent tuple roots remain live;
 * the old preparation view is not read. The current candidate may have been
 * cleared/retired by any preceding cleanup: its guard protects body lifetime,
 * never payload presence or source authority. This new observation, complete
 * raw source and whole registry checks must all succeed anew.
 *
 * No constructor/STORE/notify/RESTORE/retry or input owning release occurs here.
 * MATCHED -> final raw permit -> ACTIVE/link is one no-callout span. A source/
 * current/association mismatch retains the actual claim/effect/tuple and is
 * not complete KEEP/REUSE/failure policy. On commit, preserve STORED even if
 * the actual post-commit query fails or obtains a partial related owning.
 * Full child still owns ALL eleven setup debts on EVERY return.
 */
static int
reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *owned_setup, PyObject **first_owned,
    RenoLoaderExistingRegistrationResult *result)
{
    RenoLoaderExistingRegistrationResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *head;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *first;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || owned_setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || result == NULL
            || owned_setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
            || owned_setup->prepared_owned != NULL || owned_setup->record_owned == NULL
            || owned_setup->inner_owned != NULL || owned_setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->related_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.captured != 1 || owned_setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || owned_setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL || owned_setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL || owned_setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
            || (owned_setup->mutation.previous_present && owned_setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
            || (!owned_setup->mutation.previous_present && owned_setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)) { return -1; }
    *result = empty_result;
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    mutation = &owned_setup->mutation;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = owned_setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = mutation;
    context.preparation = NULL;
    context.absent = mutation->previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    context.registration = 1;
    context.attempt_started = 1;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    result->observation_called = 1;
    result->observation_outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ObserveInstallBound(mutation->loader_owned,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned,
        mutation->key_owned, mutation->bound_owned, reno_loader_install_permit_raw,
        &context, &result->observation_progress);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || result->observation_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_ERROR) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
        goto failed;
    }
    if (result->observation_outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED) { goto finish; }
    /* Same no-callout span as the completed MATCHED and natural key release.
     * The permit rereads complete raw source and the WHOLE live registry;
     * pending cannot pass this business commit. No old current is reused.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto finish; }
    state = source->state;
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)owned_setup->record_owned;
    head = state->controls.record_head;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE;
    record->registry_owner_state = state;
    record->prev = NULL;
    record->next = head;
    if (head != NULL) { head->prev = record; }
    state->controls.record_head = record;
    record->linked = 1;
    owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED;
    result->linked_here = 1;

    result->post_commit_query_called = 1;
    if (!reno_loader_record_query_raw(source, mutation->loader_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned,
            mutation->bound_owned, NULL, &owned_setup->related_owned, &owned_setup->current)) { goto failed; }
    result->post_commit_query_completed = 1;
    goto finish;
failed:
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
finish:
    /* Preserve ACTUAL escaping error only. Query failure may have called out;
     * do not read State/Record/payload or manufacture first from scalar history.
     * No input owning returns to the original parent: same child retains it.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

/* Actual native parent calls only after its original store helper returned 0.
 * That scalar alone is NOT a retry grant: full private slot/capture shape and
 * this continuously owned candidate's actual never-attempted facts must match.
 * Unmatched leaves all input owning/error/history unchanged. Matched consumes
 * only this component's first loan and scalar result; ALL eleven setup owning
 * slots stay with the same live caller until its real success/abort/full child.
 * Original source/module/entered and tuple/candidate guards remain independent
 * premises, not authenticated by pointer/phase checks below.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderAbsentInstallResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderAbsentInstallResult *result;
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312AbsentInstallOwned output = {0};
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int registration_status;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
    if (*first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured != 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present != 0
            || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
            || setup->absent_install.consumer_entered) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->store_attempted || record->store_returned || record->effect_observed
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) {
        return 0; /* NEVER repeat an attempted store, even after no visible effect */
    }
    result = &setup->absent_install;
    *result = empty_result; /* scalar-only, no owning occurrence is copied */
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = mutation;
    context.preparation = NULL;
    context.absent = 1;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
        result->before_call_cancelled = 1;
        goto settle_outputs;
    }
    record->store_attempted = 1;
    context.attempt_started = 1;
    result->primitive_called = 1;
    result->outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ConditionalInstallAbsent(mutation->loader_owned,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned,
        mutation->key_owned, mutation->bound_owned, reno_loader_install_permit_raw,
        &context, &output, &result->notice, &result->progress);
    /* Candidate guard covers BODY history even if callback cleared sources.
     * Do not reload a source payload to recover original inputs or expected.
     */
    result->tracking_effect_observed = output.tracking_effect_observed;
    if (result->progress.effect_committed) { record->effect_observed = 1; }
    if (result->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        record->store_returned = 1;
    }
    if (result->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_ERROR && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        result->unadmitted_return = 1; /* no scalar -> fabricated first */
    }
settle_outputs:
    /* Finish the actual escaping indicator and BOTH output occurrences in
     * reverse acquisition order. For split fill the unused extra key is real.
     * Continuous independent tuple roots remain; no old context/view/payload
     * is reused after these releases. Their own cleanup failure blocks commit.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&output.extra_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&output.extra_key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return
            && result->primitive_called && result->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && result->progress.effect_committed) {
        registration_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup,
            &first, &result->registration);
        if (registration_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            result->unadmitted_return = 1;
        }
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    /* Only scalar history/error transport after the NEW registration stage.
     * Setup stage/related/tuple, including actual ACTIVE/link, remain owned by
     * this SAME native parent until its existing final success/abort/full child.
     */
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

/* Each ordinal is a NEW actual preparation stage. Never reset/replay a
 * completed observation, enroll returned current as expected, or hide compare
 * effects. first is still selected by the enclosing prefix before any drain.
 */
static int
reno_loader_existing_observe_stage(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context,
    unsigned int ordinal, RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult *result)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *view = context->preparation;
    RenoSpecAttr312ObserveOutcome outcome;

    result->observation_called[ordinal] = 1;
    outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ObserveInstallPrevious(view->actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)view->original_class, view->dictionary, view->query, view->previous,
        reno_loader_install_permit_raw, context, &result->observation_progress[ordinal]);
    result->observation_outcome[ordinal] = outcome;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_ERROR) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
        return 0;
    }
    if (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED) { return 1; }
    result->disposition = outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT
        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
        : (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED
            ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED);
    return 0;
}

/* Only this real prefix calls, immediately after its bound-stage observation
 * returned MATCHED, with no intervening callback/ref acquire/release. All
 * source/backing/expected-previous/whole-registry checks share that span.
 * This is a real bound owning MOVE, never a setter, link or success receipt.
 */
static int
reno_loader_existing_claim_raw(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *owned_setup)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *view = context->preparation;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || view == NULL || view->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND
            || owned_setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND || owned_setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->record_owned != context->record_guard || owned_setup->bound_owned != view->bound
            || owned_setup->inner_owned != NULL || owned_setup->related_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(context)) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)context->record_guard;
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, view->actual_loader,
            view->inner, view->bound)) { return 0; }
    record->installed_bound = owned_setup->bound_owned;
    owned_setup->bound_owned = NULL;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING;
    owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED;
    return 1;
}

/* Two actual pre-claim observation pause pairs, never freshness or INSTALL authority.
 * Keep disposition/outcome causally paired; a CHANGED stop is not renamed COMPAT.
 */
static int
reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(RenoLoaderExistingPrefixDisposition disposition,
    RenoSpecAttr312ObserveOutcome outcome)
{
    return (disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
            && outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT)
        || (disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED
            && outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED);
}

/* Real present-value preparation producer and actual once-consumer caller.
 * The actual native parent supplies its same new empty NONE setup; a complete
 * child may call only after its entry owning MOVE. The result is this setup's
 * embedded, initially-zero present_install, entered once before any callout.
 * An existing partial candidate resumes elsewhere, never via new preparation.
 * Parent continuously owns original source/module/entered/loader/dict/previous
 * and actual_lookup_key. This key is the actual caller-held preparation query,
 * not proof of the original business key's identity. After Record preparation,
 * fresh stages use the SAME factory-created attribute key, independently held.
 * These NEW observations do not replay old finder/getter/GetDict/original
 * completed lookup. Source/layout/normal-reference/allocator/GC/S1/ABI and real
 * caller provenance precede every input read; comparisons cannot supply them.
 *
 * Every real constructor return goes directly to an owning slot. Extra class/
 * key guards and inner NEW are private local debts; all are settled here.
 * Candidate/bound plus six captured mutation ownings stay with the SAME child's
 * owned_setup on EVERY return, never given back to the original parent.
 * INSTALLED first leaves CLAIMED/unlinked. After local cleanup, a NEW
 * actual-bound observation and raw current source/whole-registry permit
 * may commit ACTIVE/link; incomplete/mismatched paths remain CLAIMED.
 * Complete child still owes full selection and all eleven setup debts.
 */
static int
reno_loader_existing_prepare_install(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous, PyObject *actual_lookup_key,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *owned_setup, PyObject **first_owned, RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult *result)
{
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordInputs inputs = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *inner_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_bound;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc inner_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc bound_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int operation_status;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || previous == NULL || actual_lookup_key == NULL || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(actual_lookup_key)
            || !exact_ascii_name(actual_lookup_key, "exec_module", 11)
            || owned_setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || result == NULL
            || owned_setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE || owned_setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->record_owned != NULL || owned_setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || owned_setup->bound_owned != NULL || owned_setup->related_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.captured || owned_setup->mutation.previous_present
            || owned_setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || owned_setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || owned_setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || owned_setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || result != &owned_setup->present_install || result->consumer_entered) { return -1; }
    *result = empty_result;
    result->consumer_entered = 1; /* same activation; not owning consumption */
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(source->state->arena.known.roots[20]);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.original_class = class_guard;
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = previous;
    view.previous_present = 1;
    view.query = actual_lookup_key;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = NULL;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    context.preparation = &view;
    context.absent = 0;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_observe_stage(&context, 0, result)) { goto drain; }

    inputs.record_type = source->state->arena.install.record_type;
    inputs.actual_module = source->module;
    inputs.retired_error_class = source->state->arena.known.roots[97];
    inputs.owner_proxy = (PyObject *)source->owner;
    inputs.original_loader = actual_loader;
    inputs.loader_dict = dictionary;
    inputs.previous_value = previous;
    inputs.origin_state = source->state;
    inputs.previous_present = 1;
    result->prepare_called = 1;
    owned_setup->prepared_owned = reno_record_prepare(&inputs);
    if (owned_setup->prepared_owned != NULL) { owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT; }
    if (owned_setup->prepared_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)owned_setup->prepared_owned;
    if (!reno_record_type_effect((PyObject *)Py_TYPE(record)) || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || record->attribute_key == NULL) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    key_guard = Py_NewRef(record->attribute_key);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.query = key_guard;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT;
    context.record_guard = owned_setup->prepared_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_observe_stage(&context, 1, result)) { goto drain; }
    result->track_called = 1;
    owned_setup->record_owned = reno_record_track_prepared(&owned_setup->prepared_owned);
    if (owned_setup->record_owned != NULL) { owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED; }
    if (owned_setup->record_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED;
    context.record_guard = owned_setup->record_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_observe_stage(&context, 2, result)) { goto drain; }

    result->inner_called = 1;
    inner_owned = PyCFunction_NewEx(&reno_loader_inner_method, owned_setup->record_owned, NULL);
    if (inner_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    inner_creation_dispatch = ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_inner_creation_raw(source, owned_setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, 1, key_guard,
            inner_owned, inner_creation_dispatch)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    view.inner = inner_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_observe_stage(&context, 3, result)) { goto drain; }
    /* Recompare after observer key cleanup, before next constructor. */
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw((RenoLoaderRecordObject *)owned_setup->record_owned,
            actual_loader, inner_owned, NULL)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->bound_called = 1;
    owned_setup->bound_owned = PyMethod_New(inner_owned, actual_loader);
    if (owned_setup->bound_owned != NULL) { owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND; }
    if (owned_setup->bound_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    bound_creation_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)owned_setup->bound_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(source, owned_setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, 1, key_guard,
            inner_owned, owned_setup->bound_owned, bound_creation_dispatch)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    view.bound = owned_setup->bound_owned;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_observe_stage(&context, 4, result)) { goto drain; }
    actual_bound = owned_setup->bound_owned; /* SAME real product, not read back from dict */
    if (!reno_loader_existing_claim_raw(&context, owned_setup)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    /* No callback between actual claim and these six direct owning captures
     * under the independently matched full-reference envelope. Original roots
     * and the claimed candidate's own bound cover every acquisition. Preserve
     * distinct occurrences even for equal pointers; no payload reload later.
     */
    owned_setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(class_guard);
    owned_setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    owned_setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    owned_setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(key_guard);
    owned_setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    owned_setup->mutation.previous_owned = Py_NewRef(previous);
    owned_setup->mutation.previous_present = 1;
    owned_setup->mutation.captured = 1;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    result->install_called = 1;
    operation_status = reno_loader_install_existing_once(source, owned_setup->record_owned,
        &owned_setup->mutation, &first, &result->installation);
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (operation_status < 0) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto failed; }
    result->disposition = result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED
        : (result->installation.before_call_cancelled
            || result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_CANCELLED
            ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED
            : (result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_UNCHANGED
                ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT));
    goto drain;
failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
drain:
    /* Select only ACTUAL escaping indicator before these releases. A negative
     * primitive without first/pending remains an explicit unadmitted return;
     * never manufacture first from a scalar. Actual candidate and all setup
     * products stay under this child's owning slots for its later resolution.
     * Do not reuse the preparation view after this local-only drain.
     * A successful actual install with empty first may then start the NEW
     * registration stage using only the independently retained tuple and
     * continuous source/module/entered roots, never these released locals.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(result->disposition,
                result->observation_outcome[3])
            && owned_setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED
            && owned_setup->inner_owned == NULL && owned_setup->bound_owned == NULL
            && result->inner_called == 1 && !result->bound_called
            && result->observation_called[3] == 1
            && inner_owned != NULL) {
        /* Preserve the SAME actual NEW for the full child. A dispatch scalar
         * cannot recover it, and another NewEx would repeat the constructor.
         * Later key/class cleanup may still clear the candidate or raise.
         */
        owned_setup->inner_owned = inner_owned;
        inner_owned = NULL;
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return
            && result->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED) {
        operation_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, owned_setup,
            &first, &result->registration);
        if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || operation_status < 0) {
            result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
            if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
    }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* scalar history only; complete selector still required */
}

/* Five distinct NEW observations of true absence under INSTALL preparation
 * policy. This does not feed NULL to the present-previous observer. Whole
 * comparison/release effects and output history remain with this activation.
 */
static int
reno_loader_absent_observe_stage(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context,
    unsigned int ordinal, RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult *result)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *view = context->preparation;
    RenoSpecAttr312ObserveOutcome outcome;

    result->observation_called[ordinal] = 1;
    outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ObserveInstallAbsent(view->actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)view->original_class, view->dictionary, view->query,
        reno_loader_install_permit_raw, context, &result->observation_progress[ordinal]);
    result->observation_outcome[ordinal] = outcome;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_ERROR) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
        return 0;
    }
    if (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED) { return 1; }
    result->disposition = outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT
        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
        : (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED
            ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED);
    return 0;
}

/* Real absent prepare->track->inner->bound->claim producer, entered ONCE with
 * the same pristine owned setup, including after the complete child's entry
 * MOVE. A partial setup resumes elsewhere and is never reconstructed here.
 * Parent continuously owns source/module/entered/loader/dict/actual query;
 * original class and actual Record key have independent local guards. The
 * real inner NEW remains held at station 3, before Method_New can run.
 * All constructors write directly to their real owning slot. Ten setup debts
 * remain with this same caller; local guards are settled before any store or
 * registration. No source/context/view/payload is read after local drain.
 */
static int
reno_loader_absent_prepare(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *actual_lookup_key,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *owned_setup, PyObject **first_owned,
    RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult *result)
{
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordInputs inputs = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *inner_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_bound;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc inner_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc bound_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || actual_lookup_key == NULL || !exact_ascii_name(actual_lookup_key, "exec_module", 11)
            || owned_setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || result == NULL
            || owned_setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE || owned_setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->record_owned != NULL || owned_setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || owned_setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || owned_setup->bound_owned != NULL || owned_setup->related_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.captured || owned_setup->mutation.previous_present
            || owned_setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || owned_setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || owned_setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || owned_setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || owned_setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || result != &owned_setup->absent_prepare || result->consumer_entered
            || owned_setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
            || owned_setup->present_install.consumer_entered) { return -1; }
    *result = empty_result;
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(source->state->arena.known.roots[20]);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.original_class = class_guard;
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = NULL;
    view.previous_present = 0;
    view.query = actual_lookup_key;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = NULL;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    context.preparation = &view;
    context.absent = 1;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_absent_observe_stage(&context, 0, result)) { goto drain; }

    inputs.record_type = source->state->arena.install.record_type;
    inputs.actual_module = source->module;
    inputs.retired_error_class = source->state->arena.known.roots[97];
    inputs.owner_proxy = (PyObject *)source->owner;
    inputs.original_loader = actual_loader;
    inputs.loader_dict = dictionary;
    inputs.previous_value = NULL;
    inputs.origin_state = source->state;
    inputs.previous_present = 0;
    result->prepare_called = 1;
    owned_setup->prepared_owned = reno_record_prepare(&inputs);
    if (owned_setup->prepared_owned != NULL) { owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT; }
    if (owned_setup->prepared_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)owned_setup->prepared_owned;
    if (!reno_record_type_effect((PyObject *)Py_TYPE(record)) || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || record->attribute_key == NULL) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    key_guard = Py_NewRef(record->attribute_key);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.query = key_guard;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT;
    context.record_guard = owned_setup->prepared_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_absent_observe_stage(&context, 1, result)) { goto drain; }
    result->track_called = 1;
    owned_setup->record_owned = reno_record_track_prepared(&owned_setup->prepared_owned);
    if (owned_setup->record_owned != NULL) { owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED; }
    if (owned_setup->record_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED;
    context.record_guard = owned_setup->record_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_absent_observe_stage(&context, 2, result)) { goto drain; }

    result->inner_called = 1;
    inner_owned = PyCFunction_NewEx(&reno_loader_inner_method, owned_setup->record_owned, NULL);
    if (inner_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    inner_creation_dispatch = ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_inner_creation_raw(source, owned_setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, NULL, 0, key_guard,
            inner_owned, inner_creation_dispatch)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    view.inner = inner_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_absent_observe_stage(&context, 3, result)) { goto drain; }
    /* Recompare after observer key cleanup, before next constructor. */
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw((RenoLoaderRecordObject *)owned_setup->record_owned,
            actual_loader, inner_owned, NULL)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->bound_called = 1;
    owned_setup->bound_owned = PyMethod_New(inner_owned, actual_loader);
    if (owned_setup->bound_owned != NULL) { owned_setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND; }
    if (owned_setup->bound_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    bound_creation_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)owned_setup->bound_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(source, owned_setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, NULL, 0, key_guard,
            inner_owned, owned_setup->bound_owned, bound_creation_dispatch)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    view.bound = owned_setup->bound_owned;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    if (!reno_loader_absent_observe_stage(&context, 4, result)) { goto drain; }
    actual_bound = owned_setup->bound_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_claim_raw(&context, owned_setup)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    /* SAME no-callout raw span as real claim. Capture independently retained
     * original operands, not reloaded current/clearable Record payloads.
     * previous is genuinely absent: zero debt, no invented Py_None or NEW.
     */
    owned_setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(class_guard);
    owned_setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    owned_setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    owned_setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(key_guard);
    owned_setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    owned_setup->mutation.previous_present = 0;
    owned_setup->mutation.captured = 1;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto drain;
failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
drain:
    /* Only ACTUAL escaping first before release. Keep all eleven setup debts;
     * do not replay a partial constructor, restore, store or register here.
     * After these natural releases, the parent must use a fresh typed raw
     * source/whole-association gate before any next actual value write.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(result->disposition,
                result->observation_outcome[3])
            && owned_setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED
            && owned_setup->inner_owned == NULL && owned_setup->bound_owned == NULL
            && result->inner_called == 1 && !result->bound_called
            && result->observation_called[3] == 1
            && inner_owned != NULL) {
        /* Preserve the SAME actual NEW for the full child. A dispatch scalar
         * cannot recover it, and another NewEx would repeat the constructor.
         * Later key/class cleanup may still clear the candidate or raise.
         */
        owned_setup->inner_owned = inner_owned;
        inner_owned = NULL;
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* CLAIMED is history; not installed, linked or success */
}

/* Distinct live private automatic input/output; output is aggregate-zero.
 * The real caller owns every input occurrence. This MOVE has no callback,
 * allocation, acquire/release or shallow owning copy. Observation/stage and
 * mutation scalars are history only. Emptying slots is not business success.
 */
static void
reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(RenoLoaderRecordSetup *input,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *owned)
{
    owned->prepared_owned = input->prepared_owned;
    input->prepared_owned = NULL;
    owned->record_owned = input->record_owned;
    input->record_owned = NULL;
    owned->inner_owned = input->inner_owned;
    input->inner_owned = NULL;
    owned->bound_owned = input->bound_owned;
    input->bound_owned = NULL;
    owned->related_owned = input->related_owned;
    input->related_owned = NULL;
    owned->mutation.original_class_owned = input->mutation.original_class_owned;
    input->mutation.original_class_owned = NULL;
    owned->mutation.loader_owned = input->mutation.loader_owned;
    input->mutation.loader_owned = NULL;
    owned->mutation.dictionary_owned = input->mutation.dictionary_owned;
    input->mutation.dictionary_owned = NULL;
    owned->mutation.key_owned = input->mutation.key_owned;
    input->mutation.key_owned = NULL;
    owned->mutation.bound_owned = input->mutation.bound_owned;
    input->mutation.bound_owned = NULL;
    owned->mutation.previous_owned = input->mutation.previous_owned;
    input->mutation.previous_owned = NULL;
    /* The current observation contains only scalars, as do the following
     * history fields. No owning structure or reference occurrence is copied.
     */
    owned->current = input->current;
    owned->stage = input->stage;
    owned->mutation.previous_present = input->mutation.previous_present;
    owned->mutation.captured = input->mutation.captured;
    owned->absent_install = input->absent_install; /* entire SCALAR history only */
    owned->absent_prepare = input->absent_prepare; /* entire SCALAR history only */
    owned->present_install = input->present_install; /* entire SCALAR history only */
    owned->retained_inner_resume = input->retained_inner_resume; /* SCALAR only */
    owned->observed_bound_resume = input->observed_bound_resume; /* SCALAR only */
    owned->observed_inner_resume = input->observed_inner_resume; /* SCALAR only */
    owned->claimed_registration_resume = input->claimed_registration_resume; /* SCALAR only */
    owned->observed_partial_resume = input->observed_partial_resume; /* SCALAR only */
}

/* Shape of the actual retained station-3 constructor debt ONLY.
 * This SAME private producer directly MOVED its actual NewEx local; metadata
 * cannot establish that provenance and writable __module__ may have changed.
 * No product/Record/source metadata is consulted to authorize debt settlement.
 * actual_first borrows the caller's real private escaping exception occurrence;
 * it is never invented from a scalar, acquired, released or returned here.
 */
/* Only the original prefix's completed scalar history is read here. This is
 * not a source/layout/cleanup certificate and does not inspect current payloads.
 * entry_stage is the original milestone, not the later setup stage. It is
 * therefore also usable for identifying an actual new retained-inner debt.
 */
static int
reno_loader_partial_prefix_origin_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    unsigned char previous_present, RenoLoaderSetupStage entry_stage,
    unsigned int *station_out)
{
    unsigned int station;
    unsigned int i;
    const RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult *present;
    const RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult *absent;

    if (setup == NULL || station_out == NULL || previous_present > 1) { return 0; }
    switch (entry_stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE: station = 0; break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT: station = 1; break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED: station = 2; break;
    default: return 0;
    }
    present = &setup->present_install;
    absent = &setup->absent_prepare;
    if (previous_present) {
        if (present->consumer_entered != 1 || absent->consumer_entered
                || present->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
                || present->prepare_called != (station > 0) || present->track_called != (station > 1)
                || present->inner_called || present->bound_called || present->claim_completed
                || present->install_called || present->installation.primitive_called
                || present->registration.observation_called || present->unadmitted_return
                || present->installation.unadmitted_return || present->registration.unadmitted_return) { return 0; }
        for (i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            if (present->observation_called[i] != (i <= station)) { return 0; }
            if (i <= station && present->observation_outcome[i] != (i == station
                    ? RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT : RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED)) { return 0; }
        }
    } else {
        if (absent->consumer_entered != 1 || present->consumer_entered
                || absent->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
                || absent->prepare_called != (station > 0) || absent->track_called != (station > 1)
                || absent->inner_called || absent->bound_called || absent->claim_completed
                || absent->unwatched_called || absent->conditional_called || absent->unadmitted_return) { return 0; }
        for (i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            if (absent->observation_called[i] != (i <= station)) { return 0; }
            if (i <= station && absent->observation_outcome[i] != (i == station
                    ? RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT : RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED)) { return 0; }
        }
    }
    *station_out = station;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    PyObject *actual_first)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult *present;
    const RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult *absent;
    int present_path;
    int absent_path;

    if (setup == NULL) { return 0; }
    if (setup->inner_owned == NULL) { return 1; }
    if (setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
    if (setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
        const RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult *resume = &setup->observed_partial_resume;
        unsigned int original_station = 0;
        /* Actual NEW -> MOVE provenance, never current payload/metadata trust.
         * It must remain settleable after local cleanup first or GC clear.
         */
        if (resume->consumer_entered != 1 || resume->previous_present > 1
                || resume->inner_called != 1 || resume->inner_returned != 1
                || resume->inner_created != 1 || resume->inner_retained != 1
                || resume->bound_called || resume->bound_created) { return 0; }
        if (resume->entry_stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE) {
            if (resume->prepare_called != 1 || resume->prepare_returned != 1 || resume->prepare_created != 1) { return 0; }
        } else if (resume->prepare_called || resume->prepare_returned || resume->prepare_created) { return 0; }
        if (resume->entry_stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED) {
            if (resume->track_called != 1 || resume->track_returned != 1 || resume->track_moved != 1) { return 0; }
        } else if (resume->track_called || resume->track_returned || resume->track_moved) { return 0; }
        return reno_loader_partial_prefix_origin_raw(setup, resume->previous_present,
            resume->entry_stage, &original_station) && original_station == resume->entry_station;
    }
    present = &setup->present_install;
    absent = &setup->absent_prepare;
    present_path = present->consumer_entered == 1
        && !absent->consumer_entered && !setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
        && (reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(present->disposition, present->observation_outcome[3])
            || (actual_first != NULL && present->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR
                && (present->observation_outcome[3] == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT
                    || present->observation_outcome[3] == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED)))
        && present->prepare_called == 1 && present->track_called == 1
        && present->inner_called == 1 && !present->bound_called
        && present->observation_called[3] == 1
        && !present->claim_completed && !present->install_called && !present->unadmitted_return
        && !present->installation.primitive_called && !present->installation.unadmitted_return
        && !present->registration.observation_called && !present->registration.unadmitted_return;
    absent_path = absent->consumer_entered == 1
        && !present->consumer_entered && !setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
        && (reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(absent->disposition, absent->observation_outcome[3])
            || (actual_first != NULL && absent->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR
                && (absent->observation_outcome[3] == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT
                    || absent->observation_outcome[3] == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED)))
        && absent->prepare_called == 1 && absent->track_called == 1
        && absent->inner_called == 1 && !absent->bound_called
        && absent->observation_called[3] == 1
        && !absent->claim_completed && !absent->unwatched_called
        && !absent->conditional_called && !absent->unadmitted_return;
    return present_path != absent_path;
}

/* Two NEW resume observations; never overwrite the original prefix stations. */
static int
reno_loader_retained_inner_observe_stage(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context,
    unsigned int ordinal, RenoLoaderRetainedInnerResumeResult *result)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *view = context->preparation;
    RenoSpecAttr312ObserveOutcome outcome;

    if (ordinal >= 2 || result->observation_called[ordinal]) {
        result->unadmitted_return = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    result->observation_called[ordinal] = 1;
    if (context->absent) {
        outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ObserveInstallAbsent(view->actual_loader,
            (PyTypeObject *)view->original_class, view->dictionary, view->query,
            reno_loader_install_permit_raw, context, &result->observation_progress[ordinal]);
    } else {
        outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ObserveInstallPrevious(view->actual_loader,
            (PyTypeObject *)view->original_class, view->dictionary, view->query, view->previous,
            reno_loader_install_permit_raw, context, &result->observation_progress[ordinal]);
    }
    result->observation_outcome[ordinal] = outcome;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_ERROR) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
        return 0;
    }
    if (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED) { return 1; }
    if (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_NEEDS_COMPAT) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT;
    } else if (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED;
    } else if (outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_CANCELLED) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
    } else {
        result->unadmitted_return = 1;
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* A real producer on the SAME native parent's still-owned automatic setup,
 * like the original preparation prefixes, NOT the complete ownership child.
 * Original module/entered/loader/dict/previous roots stay parent-held. Entry
 * mismatch changes no history/owning/first and performs no callout; in
 * particular old STORED -> success remains a continuous no-callout span.
 * Once entered, this producer owns its local class/key and actual first loan.
 * The retained inner occurrence is MOVED to a local and settled exactly once;
 * actual bound/tuple products fill their real setup slots as stages progress.
 * Remaining setup debts stay in the SAME parent's actual slots on every return
 * for success/abort/cancel/full-child consumption. No slot loan escapes; no
 * copied raw view/Record payload is used after the local final drain.
 */
static int
reno_loader_resume_retained_inner_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderRetainedInnerResumeResult *result;
    RenoLoaderRetainedInnerResumeResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *inner_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_bound;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc bound_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int operation_status;
    int stored;
    int status;

    if (setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED
            || setup->inner_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
            || setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || setup->related_owned != NULL || setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, NULL)) { return 0; }
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || original_previous_present > 1
            || (original_previous_present && original_previous == NULL)
            || (!original_previous_present && original_previous != NULL)) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->restore_cancelled || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED
            || record->attribute_key == NULL) { return 0; }
    result = &setup->retained_inner_resume;
    *result = empty_result; /* SCALAR history only; no owning copy */
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    result->previous_present = original_previous_present;
