    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) {
        result->before_observation_cancelled = 1;
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    view.original_class = source->state->arena.known.roots[20];
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous;
    view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = record->attribute_key;
    view.inner = setup->inner_owned;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    context.preparation = &view;
    context.absent = original_previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
        result->before_observation_cancelled = 1;
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    /* Actual original class/key, acquired only after this same raw permit.
     * Record/source may be cleared by either new observation; these independent
     * guards and parent operands remain real. Never reload lost inputs later.
     */
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(view.original_class);
    key_guard = Py_NewRef(view.query);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    view.original_class = class_guard;
    view.query = key_guard;
    if (!reno_loader_retained_inner_observe_stage(&context, 0, result)) { goto drain; }
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    /* The SAME actual NewEx owning, not another constructor or a pointer
     * reconstructed from Record dispatch scalars. Stage 0 COMPAT never moves it.
     */
    inner_owned = setup->inner_owned;
    setup->inner_owned = NULL;
    result->inner_moved = 1;
    view.inner = inner_owned;
    result->bound_called = 1;
    setup->bound_owned = PyMethod_New(inner_owned, actual_loader);
    if (setup->bound_owned != NULL) { setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND; }
    if (setup->bound_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    bound_creation_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)setup->bound_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(source, setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, original_previous,
            original_previous_present, key_guard, inner_owned, setup->bound_owned,
            bound_creation_dispatch)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->bound_published = 1;
    view.bound = setup->bound_owned;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    /* Method allocation may call out. Creation/source checks cannot replace
     * this NEW actual expected-value/absence observation before claim.
     */
    if (!reno_loader_retained_inner_observe_stage(&context, 1, result)) { goto drain; }
    actual_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_existing_claim_raw(&context, setup)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    /* Same original operands as the two completed new stations, no callback
     * between claim and these ordinary full-reference acquisitions. Distinct
     * equal-pointer occurrences remain independent debts, not current pins.
     */
    setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(class_guard);
    setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(key_guard);
    setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    setup->mutation.previous_owned = Py_XNewRef(original_previous);
    setup->mutation.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    setup->mutation.captured = 1;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (!original_previous_present) { goto drain; }
    result->install_called = 1;
    operation_status = reno_loader_install_existing_once(source, setup->record_owned,
        &setup->mutation, &first, &result->installation);
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (operation_status < 0) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto failed; }
    result->disposition = result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED
        : (result->installation.before_call_cancelled
            || result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_CANCELLED
            ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED
            : (result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_UNCHANGED
                ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT));
    goto drain;
failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
drain:
    /* Stage 0 COMPAT keeps the real inner slot; stage 1 COMPAT keeps BOUND.
     * These local releases may clear the candidate or produce actual first.
     * All later business uses independently captured tuple/source, not view.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return
            && result->claim_completed) {
        if (result->previous_present && result->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED) {
            operation_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup,
                &first, &result->registration);
            if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                result->unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        } else if (!result->previous_present) {
            result->unwatched_called = 1;
            stored = reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(source, actual_loader,
                dictionary, setup->mutation.bound_owned, setup);
            result->unwatched_returned = 1;
            result->unwatched_status = stored;
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (stored < 0 && first == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            if (stored == 0 && first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return) {
                result->conditional_called = 1;
                operation_status = reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(source, setup, &first);
                if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                    result->unadmitted_return = 1;
                }
                reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            }
        }
    }
    /* Registration is LAST: no owning release, new observation or metadata
     * callout follows its successful postquery. Only scalar/error transport
     * returns to the native parent's immediate success gate. These histories
     * are not freshness certificates after any later callback.
     */
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return
        || result->installation.unadmitted_return || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* prefix outcome, never complete selector/default success */
}

/* The real native parent calls success immediately after a producer's final
 * post-cleanup registration, without any callback/owning release in between.
 * These SCALAR receipts only select that actual continuous route; they cannot
 * restore freshness after a callback or authenticate source/product provenance.
 */
/* Same-activation actual constructor histories ONLY. This does not certify
 * current source/backing/candidate/value or borrow any SelectionView authority.
 */
static int
reno_loader_observed_bound_origin_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderObservedBoundOrigin *origin)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPrefixResult *present;
    const RenoLoaderAbsentPreparationResult *absent;
    const RenoLoaderRetainedInnerResumeResult *resume;
    const RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult *partial;
    const RenoLoaderObservedInnerResumeResult *inner;
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundOrigin seen = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NONE;
    unsigned int original_station = 0;
    int partial_prepared = 0;
    int station;
    int present_origin;
    int absent_origin;
    int matches = 0;

    if (setup == NULL || origin == NULL || original_previous_present > 1) { return 0; }
    *origin = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NONE;
    partial = &setup->observed_partial_resume;
    inner = &setup->observed_inner_resume;
    if (!partial->consumer_entered && !inner->consumer_entered) {
        present = &setup->present_install;
        absent = &setup->absent_prepare;
        resume = &setup->retained_inner_resume;
        if (resume->consumer_entered > 1) { return 0; }
        station = resume->consumer_entered ? 3 : 4;
        present_origin = original_previous_present == 1
            && present->consumer_entered == 1 && !absent->consumer_entered
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(present->disposition,
                present->observation_outcome[station])
            && present->prepare_called == 1 && present->track_called == 1 && present->inner_called == 1
            && present->bound_called == (station == 4)
            && present->observation_called[station] == 1
            && !present->claim_completed && !present->install_called
            && !present->installation.primitive_called && !present->registration.observation_called;
        absent_origin = original_previous_present == 0
            && absent->consumer_entered == 1 && !present->consumer_entered
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(absent->disposition,
                absent->observation_outcome[station])
            && absent->prepare_called == 1 && absent->track_called == 1 && absent->inner_called == 1
            && absent->bound_called == (station == 4)
            && absent->observation_called[station] == 1
            && !absent->claim_completed && !absent->unwatched_called && !absent->conditional_called;
        if (present_origin == absent_origin) { return 0; }
        if (resume->consumer_entered
                && (resume->previous_present != original_previous_present
                    || !reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(resume->disposition,
                        resume->observation_outcome[1])
                    || resume->inner_moved != 1 || resume->bound_called != 1 || resume->bound_published != 1
                    || resume->observation_called[0] != 1
                    || resume->observation_outcome[0] != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED
                    || resume->observation_called[1] != 1
                    || resume->claim_completed || resume->install_called
                    || resume->installation.primitive_called || resume->registration.observation_called
                    || resume->unwatched_called || resume->conditional_called)) { return 0; }

        seen = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT; ++matches;
    }
    if (partial->consumer_entered == 1
            && partial->previous_present == original_previous_present
            && partial->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
            && partial->parent_current_matched == 1 && partial->parent_association_none == 1
            && partial->inner_called == 1 && partial->inner_returned == 1
            && partial->inner_created == 1 && partial->inner_published == 1
            && !partial->claim_completed && !partial->install_called
            && !partial->installation.primitive_called && !partial->registration.observation_called
            && !partial->unwatched_called && !partial->unwatched_returned && !partial->conditional_called
            && !setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            && reno_loader_partial_prefix_origin_raw(setup, original_previous_present,
                partial->entry_stage, &original_station)
            && original_station == partial->entry_station) {
        if (partial->entry_stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE) {
            partial_prepared = partial->prepare_called == 1
                && partial->prepare_returned == 1 && partial->prepare_created == 1;
        } else {
            partial_prepared = !partial->prepare_called && !partial->prepare_returned && !partial->prepare_created;
        }
        if (partial->entry_stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED) {
            partial_prepared = partial_prepared && partial->track_called == 1
                && partial->track_returned == 1 && partial->track_moved == 1;
        } else {
            partial_prepared = partial_prepared && !partial->track_called
                && !partial->track_returned && !partial->track_moved;
        }
    }
    if (partial_prepared && !inner->consumer_entered
            && !partial->inner_retained && partial->bound_called == 1
            && partial->bound_returned == 1 && partial->bound_created == 1 && partial->bound_published == 1
            && partial->matched[2] == 1 && partial->observation[3].consumer_entered == 1
            && !partial->matched[3]) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_PARTIAL; ++matches;
    }
    if (inner->consumer_entered == 1 && inner->previous_present == original_previous_present
            && (inner->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
                || (inner->disposition == RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED
                    && inner->observation.consumer_entered == 1
                    && inner->observation.qualified == 1
                    && inner->observation.api_called == 1 && inner->observation.api_returned == 1
                    && inner->observation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
                    && inner->actual_current_matched == 0 && inner->actual_association_none == 0))
            && inner->inner_moved == 1 && inner->bound_called == 1
            && inner->bound_returned == 1 && inner->bound_created == 1 && inner->bound_published == 1
            && inner->observation.consumer_entered == 1
            && !inner->claim_completed && !inner->install_called
            && !inner->installation.primitive_called && !inner->registration.observation_called
            && !inner->unwatched_called && !inner->unwatched_returned && !inner->conditional_called) {
        int original_retained = 0;
        int partial_retained = 0;
        present = &setup->present_install;
        absent = &setup->absent_prepare;
        resume = &setup->retained_inner_resume;
        present_origin = original_previous_present == 1
            && present->consumer_entered == 1 && !absent->consumer_entered
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(present->disposition, present->observation_outcome[3])
            && present->prepare_called == 1 && present->track_called == 1 && present->inner_called == 1
            && !present->bound_called && present->observation_called[3] == 1
            && !present->claim_completed && !present->install_called
            && !present->installation.primitive_called && !present->registration.observation_called;
        absent_origin = original_previous_present == 0
            && absent->consumer_entered == 1 && !present->consumer_entered
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(absent->disposition, absent->observation_outcome[3])
            && absent->prepare_called == 1 && absent->track_called == 1 && absent->inner_called == 1
            && !absent->bound_called && absent->observation_called[3] == 1
            && !absent->claim_completed && !absent->unwatched_called && !absent->conditional_called;
        original_retained = inner->from_partial == 0 && !partial->consumer_entered
            && inner->parent_current_matched == 1 && inner->parent_association_none == 1
            && present_origin != absent_origin && resume->consumer_entered == 1
            && resume->previous_present == original_previous_present
            && reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(resume->disposition, resume->observation_outcome[0])
            && !resume->before_observation_cancelled
            && resume->observation_called[0] == 1
            && !resume->observation_called[1] && !resume->inner_moved && !resume->bound_called
            && !resume->bound_published && !resume->claim_completed && !resume->install_called
            && !resume->installation.primitive_called && !resume->registration.observation_called
            && !resume->unwatched_called && !resume->conditional_called;
        partial_retained = inner->from_partial == 1 && partial_prepared
            && inner->parent_current_matched == 0 && inner->parent_association_none == 0
            && inner->before_method_current_matched == 1 && inner->before_method_association_none == 1
            && partial->inner_retained == 1 && !partial->bound_called && !partial->bound_returned
            && !partial->bound_created && !partial->bound_published
            && partial->observation[2].consumer_entered == 1 && !partial->matched[2]
            && !partial->observation[3].consumer_entered && !partial->matched[3];
        if (original_retained != partial_retained) {
            seen = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER; ++matches;
        }
    }
    if (matches != 1) { return 0; }
    *origin = seen;
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_loader_resume_observed_bound_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundResumeResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundResumeResult *result;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundOrigin origin = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NONE;
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner observed = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView actual = {0};
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *actual_bound;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL, *key_guard = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int operation_status;
    int stored;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || setup == NULL || selection == NULL || first_owned == NULL
            || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || original_previous_present > 1
            || (original_previous_present && original_previous == NULL)
            || (!original_previous_present && original_previous != NULL)
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->bound_owned == NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
            || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_loader_observed_bound_origin_raw(setup, original_previous_present, &origin)) { return 0; }
    if (origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT) {
        if (selection->original_class == NULL || selection->query == NULL
                || selection->observed != 1 || selection->present != original_previous_present
                || selection->current != original_previous || selection->related != NULL
                || selection->candidate_bound != setup->bound_owned) { return 0; }
        history = &selection->history;
        if (history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
                || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
                || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
                || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
                || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
                || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
                || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
                || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
                || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
                || history->association_candidate_supplied != 1
                || history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
                || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
                || selection->original_class != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
                || !exact_ascii_name(selection->query, "exec_module", 11)
                || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)) { return 0; }

    } else {
        /* Old parent current/association is history after a producer callback. */
        if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
                || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)) { return 0; }
    }

    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->attribute_key == NULL) { return 0; }
    actual_bound = setup->bound_owned; /* real constructor product, never current-derived */
    view.original_class = origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT
        ? selection->original_class : source->state->arena.known.roots[20];
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous;
    view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = record->attribute_key; /* actual factory key, NOT parent query identity */
    view.inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(actual_bound);
    if (view.inner == NULL) { return 0; }
    view.bound = actual_bound;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    context.preparation = &view;
    context.absent = original_previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)view.original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { return 0; }

    /* Old-origin parent observation is fresh in this raw span. New origins
     * instead acquire their own actual-key current/whole NONE below. Neither
     * route forges an ObserveInstall MATCHED receipt. The conditional primitive
     * still compares/writes with its independently captured actual factory key.
     */
    result = &setup->observed_bound_resume;
    *result = empty_result; /* SCALAR only, not a shallow owning copy */
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    result->previous_present = original_previous_present;
    result->origin = origin;
    result->parent_current_matched = origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT ? 1 : 0;
    result->parent_query_is_factory_key = origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT
        ? selection->query == view.query : 0;
    result->association_none = origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT ? 1 : 0;
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NATIVE_PARENT) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT;
        class_guard = Py_NewRef(view.original_class);
        key_guard = Py_NewRef(view.query);
        view.original_class = class_guard; view.query = key_guard;
        record = NULL; actual_bound = NULL;
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
        reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary, key_guard, &observed);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (first != NULL) { goto failed; }
        if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto drain; }
        reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
            key_guard, setup->bound_owned, &observed);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (first != NULL) { goto failed; }
        if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto drain; }
        reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&observed, key_guard, &actual);
        if (actual.observed != 1 || actual.history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED) { goto drain; }
        if (actual.present != original_previous_present || actual.current != original_previous) {
            result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED;
            goto drain;
        }
        result->actual_current_matched = 1;
        if (actual.history.association_consumer_entered != 1
                || actual.history.association_query_entered != 1 || actual.history.association_query_returned != 1
                || actual.history.association_query_completed != 1 || actual.history.association_query_status != 1
                || actual.history.association_before_query_cancelled || actual.history.association_backing_checked != 1
                || actual.history.association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
                || actual.history.association_candidate_supplied != 1
                || actual.history.association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
                || actual.related != NULL || actual.candidate_bound != setup->bound_owned
                || actual.original_class != class_guard || actual.query != key_guard) { goto drain; }
        result->actual_association_none = 1;
        backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
            (PyTypeObject *)class_guard, dictionary);
        if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
                || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
            result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
            goto drain;
        }
        record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
        actual_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    }
    record->installed_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    setup->bound_owned = NULL;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING;
    setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED;
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    /* NO callback between source/creation/key validation, actual bound MOVE,
     * and capture. Parent holds class/loader/dict/previous and candidate NEW;
     * candidate covers BODY, not clearable key. Save ACTUAL factory key now.
     */
    setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(view.original_class);
    setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(view.query);
    setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    setup->mutation.previous_owned = Py_XNewRef(original_previous);
    setup->mutation.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    setup->mutation.captured = 1;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto drain;
failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
drain:
    result->observation = observed.history; /* complete independent SCALARS */
    if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
    /* End local Record-payload/View loans BEFORE potentially LAST cleanup.
     * All later business consumes independently captured actual tuple only.
     */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL;
    record = NULL; actual_bound = NULL;
    actual.original_class = NULL; actual.query = NULL; actual.current = NULL;
    actual.candidate_bound = NULL; actual.related = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    if (first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return || !result->claim_completed) { goto finish; }
    if (!original_previous_present) {
        result->unwatched_called = 1;
        stored = reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(source, actual_loader,
            dictionary, setup->mutation.bound_owned, setup);
        result->unwatched_returned = 1;
        result->unwatched_status = stored;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (stored < 0 || first != NULL) {
            if (first == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            goto finish;
        }
        if (stored == 0) {
            result->conditional_called = 1;
            operation_status = reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(source, setup, &first);
            if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                result->unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
        }
        goto finish;
    }
    result->install_called = 1;
    operation_status = reno_loader_install_existing_once(source, setup->record_owned,
        &setup->mutation, &first, &result->installation);
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto install_failed; }
    if (operation_status < 0) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto install_failed; }
    result->disposition = result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED
        : (result->installation.before_call_cancelled
            || result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_CANCELLED
            ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED
            : (result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_UNCHANGED
                ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT));
    if (result->installation.primitive_called
            && result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && result->installation.progress.effect_committed
            && !result->installation.unadmitted_return) {
        /* install_existing_once already settled both output occurrences.
         * No producer-owned local reference remains to release after register.
         */
        operation_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup, &first,
            &result->registration);
        if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            result->unadmitted_return = 1;
        }
    }
    goto finish;
install_failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
finish:
    /* Registration is the last business stage. There is NO owning release,
     * new observation, View/Record read or error construction after it. Only
     * actual indicator adoption and scalar/error transport reach Native success.
     * COMPAT/changed/failed keep real stage/tuple/effect under the SAME parent.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return
        || result->installation.unadmitted_return || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* actual producer transport; full child still owns remaining duties */
}

/* SAME native parent: original station-3 retained COMPAT, or the actual
 * inner published and retained by the partial producer. Only the uncalled
 * Method stage may run. The latter branch obtains its OWN fresh before-Method
 * actual-key current/whole association; no old parent View is trusted there.
 * After Method, a separate Owner observes that independent key anew. Both
 * Owners' actual debts settle before installation and final registration.
 * Original histories remain immutable; full child duties are still separate.
 */
static int
reno_loader_resume_observed_inner_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderObservedInnerResumeResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderObservedInnerResumeResult *result;
    const RenoLoaderRetainedInnerResumeResult *retained;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner observed = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner before_method = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView before_actual = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView actual = {0};
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *key_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *inner_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_bound;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc bound_creation_dispatch = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int from_partial = 0;
    int operation_status;
    int stored;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || setup == NULL || selection == NULL || first_owned == NULL
            || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || original_previous_present > 1
            || (original_previous_present && original_previous == NULL)
            || (!original_previous_present && original_previous != NULL)
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned == NULL
            || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.consumer_entered || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, NULL)) { return 0; }
    from_partial = setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered != 0;
    if (from_partial) {
        const RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult *partial = &setup->observed_partial_resume;
        /* Actual NEW -> MOVE provenance is necessary, never a business permit.
         * A new actual-key observation and full preparation permit follow.
         * The old parent SelectionView is intentionally not read on this branch.
         */
        if (partial->consumer_entered != 1 || partial->previous_present != original_previous_present
                || partial->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
                || partial->parent_current_matched != 1 || partial->parent_association_none != 1
                || partial->inner_called != 1 || partial->inner_returned != 1
                || partial->inner_created != 1 || partial->inner_published != 1
                || partial->inner_retained != 1 || partial->bound_called
                || partial->bound_returned || partial->bound_created || partial->bound_published
                || partial->observation[2].consumer_entered != 1 || partial->matched[2]
                || partial->observation[3].consumer_entered || partial->matched[3]
                || partial->claim_completed || partial->install_called
                || partial->installation.primitive_called || partial->registration.observation_called
                || partial->unwatched_called || partial->unwatched_returned || partial->conditional_called
                || setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
                || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (selection->original_class == NULL || selection->query == NULL
                || selection->observed != 1 || selection->present != original_previous_present
                || selection->current != original_previous || selection->related != NULL
                || selection->candidate_bound != NULL) { return 0; }
        retained = &setup->retained_inner_resume;
        if (retained->consumer_entered != 1 || retained->previous_present != original_previous_present
                || !reno_loader_inner_pause_pair_raw(retained->disposition,
                    retained->observation_outcome[0])
                || retained->before_observation_cancelled
                || retained->observation_called[0] != 1
                || retained->observation_called[1] || retained->inner_moved || retained->bound_called
                || retained->bound_published || retained->claim_completed || retained->install_called
                || retained->installation.primitive_called || retained->registration.observation_called
                || retained->unwatched_called || retained->conditional_called) { return 0; }
        history = &selection->history;
        if (history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
                || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
                || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
                || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
                || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
                || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
                || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
                || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
                || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
                || history->association_candidate_supplied
                || history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
                || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
                || selection->original_class != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
                || !exact_ascii_name(selection->query, "exec_module", 11)
                || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }

    }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->attribute_key == NULL) { return 0; }
    view.original_class = from_partial ? source->state->arena.known.roots[20] : selection->original_class;
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader;
    view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous;
    view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = record->attribute_key;
    view.inner = setup->inner_owned;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED;
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    context.preparation = &view;
    context.absent = original_previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    context.registration = 0;
    context.attempt_started = 0;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)view.original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { return 0; }

    result = &setup->observed_inner_resume;
    *result = empty_result; /* SCALAR history only; no owning copy */
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    result->previous_present = original_previous_present;
    result->from_partial = from_partial ? 1 : 0;
    result->parent_current_matched = from_partial ? 0 : 1;
    result->parent_association_none = from_partial ? 0 : 1;
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT;
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    /* First callback has not happened. Independently retain ACTUAL factory
     * key now; Record BODY guards do not keep clearable payload slots intact.
     */
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(view.original_class);
    key_guard = Py_NewRef(view.query);
    view.original_class = class_guard;
    view.query = key_guard;
    record = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (from_partial) {
        /* Independently hold the current Record's actual factory key and
         * observe it NOW; never borrow the preceding producer's old
         * current/association or the native parent's stale SelectionView.
         * Keep all before-method Owner debts until the final local drain.
         */
        reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary, key_guard, &before_method);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (first != NULL) { goto failed; }
        if (before_method.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto drain; }
        reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
            key_guard, NULL, &before_method);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (first != NULL) { goto failed; }
        if (before_method.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto drain; }
        reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&before_method, key_guard, &before_actual);
        if (before_actual.observed != 1
                || before_actual.history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED) { goto drain; }
        if (before_actual.present != original_previous_present || before_actual.current != original_previous) {
            result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED;
            goto drain;
        }
        result->before_method_current_matched = 1;
        if (before_actual.history.association_consumer_entered != 1
                || before_actual.history.association_query_entered != 1
                || before_actual.history.association_query_returned != 1
                || before_actual.history.association_query_completed != 1
                || before_actual.history.association_query_status != 1
                || before_actual.history.association_before_query_cancelled
                || before_actual.history.association_backing_checked != 1
                || before_actual.history.association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
                || before_actual.history.association_candidate_supplied
                || before_actual.history.association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
                || before_actual.related != NULL || before_actual.candidate_bound != NULL
                || before_actual.original_class != class_guard || before_actual.query != key_guard) { goto drain; }
        result->before_method_association_none = 1;
        backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
            (PyTypeObject *)class_guard, dictionary);
        if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
                || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
            result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
            goto drain;
        }
    }
    inner_owned = setup->inner_owned;
    setup->inner_owned = NULL;
    result->inner_moved = 1;
    view.inner = inner_owned;
    result->bound_called = 1;
    setup->bound_owned = PyMethod_New(inner_owned, actual_loader);
    result->bound_returned = 1;
    if (setup->bound_owned != NULL) {
        setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
        result->bound_created = 1;
    }
    if (setup->bound_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    bound_creation_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)setup->bound_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(source, setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, original_previous,
            original_previous_present, key_guard, inner_owned, setup->bound_owned,
            bound_creation_dispatch)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->bound_published = 1;
    /* NEW GENERIC current stage with that same independent factory key.
     * Never replay the original lookup, GetDict, getter, finder or NewEx.
     * Its owning outputs stay local through claim and tuple capture.
     */
    reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary, key_guard, &observed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto drain; }
    reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
        key_guard, setup->bound_owned, &observed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; goto drain; }
    reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&observed, key_guard, &actual);
    if (actual.observed != 1
            || actual.history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED) { goto drain; }
    if (actual.present != original_previous_present || actual.current != original_previous) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED;
        goto drain;
    }
    result->actual_current_matched = 1;
    if (actual.history.association_consumer_entered != 1
            || actual.history.association_query_entered != 1
            || actual.history.association_query_returned != 1
            || actual.history.association_query_completed != 1
            || actual.history.association_query_status != 1
            || actual.history.association_before_query_cancelled
            || actual.history.association_backing_checked != 1
            || actual.history.association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || actual.history.association_candidate_supplied != 1
            || actual.history.association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            || actual.related != NULL || actual.candidate_bound != setup->bound_owned
            || actual.original_class != class_guard || actual.query != key_guard) { goto drain; }
    result->actual_association_none = 1;
    view.bound = setup->bound_owned;
    view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    actual_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    /* New observed current/whole NONE share this exact raw source/creation
     * span. This is a provisional claim, not a forged ObserveInstall receipt.
     * The real conditional primitive later rechecks the independent tuple key.
     */
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)class_guard, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto drain;
    }
    /* Do not borrow existing_claim_raw's ObserveInstall-MATCHED contract.
     * This independent producer consumes its OWN actual GENERIC observation.
     */
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    record->installed_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    setup->bound_owned = NULL;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING;
    setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED;
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(class_guard);
    setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(key_guard);
    setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    setup->mutation.previous_owned = Py_XNewRef(original_previous);
    setup->mutation.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    setup->mutation.captured = 1;
    record = NULL;
    actual_bound = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto drain;
failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
drain:
    result->before_method_observation = before_method.history; /* independent SCALARS only */
    result->observation = observed.history; /* entire actual SCALAR history */
    if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
    /* End all local loans before potentially LAST natural releases. An
     * actual tuple, if captured, independently owns every later input.
     * Record payloads and either parent/local View are never reloaded later.
     */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL;
    actual.original_class = NULL; actual.query = NULL; actual.current = NULL;
    actual.candidate_bound = NULL; actual.related = NULL;
    before_actual.original_class = NULL; before_actual.query = NULL; before_actual.current = NULL;
    before_actual.candidate_bound = NULL; before_actual.related = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&before_method.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&before_method.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&before_method.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&before_method.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
            && !result->unadmitted_return && result->claim_completed) {
        if (!original_previous_present) {
            result->unwatched_called = 1;
            stored = reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(source, actual_loader,
                dictionary, setup->mutation.bound_owned, setup);
            result->unwatched_returned = 1;
            result->unwatched_status = stored;
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (stored < 0 && first == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            if (stored == 0 && first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return) {
                result->conditional_called = 1;
                operation_status = reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(source, setup, &first);
                if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                    result->unadmitted_return = 1;
                }
                reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            }
        } else {
            result->install_called = 1;
            operation_status = reno_loader_install_existing_once(source, setup->record_owned,
                &setup->mutation, &first, &result->installation);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            if (first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return && !result->installation.unadmitted_return
                    && result->installation.primitive_called
                    && result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
                    && result->installation.progress.effect_committed) {
                result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED;
                operation_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup, &first,
                    &result->registration);
                if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                    result->unadmitted_return = 1;
                }
            } else if (first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return) {
                result->disposition = result->installation.before_call_cancelled
                    || result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_CANCELLED
                    ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED
                    : (result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_UNCHANGED
                        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT);
            }
        }
    }
    /* Registration LAST: no owning release/new observation/error creation
     * follows it. Scalar/actual-first transport reaches Native immediately.
     * Legitimate COMPAT/changed/partial results keep their true setup history.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return
        || result->installation.unadmitted_return || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* actual normal-stage continuation, not the complete child */
}

/* Same activation's real writer receipts only. This pure scalar classifier
 * neither authenticates sources nor observes current backing/value. The caller
 * additionally requires the actual candidate's original attempted/returned/
 * effect facts and a complete fresh INSTALL registration permit. Preserve all
 * original receipts, including unsuccessful old registration observations.
 */
static int
reno_loader_claimed_effect_origin_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    RenoLoaderClaimedEffectOrigin *origin)
{
    RenoLoaderClaimedEffectOrigin seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_NONE;
    int matches = 0;

    if (setup == NULL || origin == NULL || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED) { return 0; }
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 1
            && setup->present_install.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->present_install.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->present_install.install_called == 1
            && setup->present_install.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->present_install.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->present_install.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_PRESENT; ++matches;
    }
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 0
            && setup->absent_install.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->absent_install.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->absent_install.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->absent_install.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_ABSENT_CONDITIONAL; ++matches;
    }
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 1
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.previous_present == 1
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_RETAINED_PRESENT; ++matches;
    }
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.previous_present == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_BOUND_PRESENT; ++matches;
    }
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.previous_present == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER_PRESENT; ++matches;
    }
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.previous_present == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_PARTIAL_PRESENT; ++matches;
    }
    /* Status zero alone never proves a STORE. Actual Record facts are checked
     * by the caller. A later real conditional writer has consumer_entered==1
     * and is classified above, even though its caller earlier saw unwatched 0.
     * If unwatched really wrote, try_install_claimed_absent sees attempted and
     * exits BEFORE its consumer_entered write. conditional_called may still be
     * 1 in the original caller; do not erase that real dispatch history.
     */
    if (setup->mutation.previous_present == 0 && !setup->absent_install.consumer_entered) {
        if (setup->absent_prepare.consumer_entered == 1
                && setup->absent_prepare.claim_completed == 1
                && setup->absent_prepare.unwatched_called == 1
                && setup->absent_prepare.unwatched_returned == 1
                && setup->absent_prepare.unwatched_status == 0) {
            seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_ABSENT_UNWATCHED; ++matches;
        }
        if (setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered == 1
                && setup->retained_inner_resume.previous_present == 0
                && setup->retained_inner_resume.claim_completed == 1
                && setup->retained_inner_resume.unwatched_called == 1
                && setup->retained_inner_resume.unwatched_returned == 1
                && setup->retained_inner_resume.unwatched_status == 0) {
            seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_RETAINED_UNWATCHED; ++matches;
        }
        if (setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered == 1
                && setup->observed_bound_resume.previous_present == 0
                && setup->observed_bound_resume.claim_completed == 1
                && setup->observed_bound_resume.unwatched_called == 1
                && setup->observed_bound_resume.unwatched_returned == 1
                && setup->observed_bound_resume.unwatched_status == 0) {
            seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_BOUND_UNWATCHED; ++matches;
        }
        if (setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered == 1
                && setup->observed_inner_resume.previous_present == 0
                && setup->observed_inner_resume.claim_completed == 1
                && setup->observed_inner_resume.unwatched_called == 1
                && setup->observed_inner_resume.unwatched_returned == 1
                && setup->observed_inner_resume.unwatched_status == 0) {
            seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER_UNWATCHED; ++matches;
        }
        if (setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered == 1
                && setup->observed_partial_resume.previous_present == 0
                && setup->observed_partial_resume.claim_completed == 1
                && setup->observed_partial_resume.unwatched_called == 1
                && setup->observed_partial_resume.unwatched_returned == 1
                && setup->observed_partial_resume.unwatched_status == 0) {
            seen = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_PARTIAL_UNWATCHED; ++matches;
        }
    }
    if (matches != 1) { return 0; } /* no guessed/default or ambiguous origin */
    *origin = seen;
    return 1;
}

/* Actual SAME-child new-claim history only. No Record/payload/source/current
 * read, API callout, owning operation, origin fabrication or fresh permission.
 */
static int
reno_loader_entered_bound_claim_history_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult *continuation)
{
    const RenoLoaderObservedBoundResumeResult *old;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *h;

    if (setup == NULL || continuation == NULL || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
            || setup->mutation.captured != 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || continuation->consumer_entered != 1 || continuation->claim_completed != 1
            || continuation->previous_present != setup->mutation.previous_present
            || (continuation->origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_PARTIAL
                && continuation->origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER)
            || continuation->actual_current_matched != 1 || continuation->actual_association_none != 1
            || continuation->unadmitted_return || continuation->observation.unadmitted_return
            || continuation->installation.unadmitted_return || continuation->registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered) { return 0; }
    old = &setup->observed_bound_resume;
    if (old->consumer_entered != 1 || old->previous_present != continuation->previous_present
            || old->origin != continuation->origin || old->claim_completed || old->install_called
            || old->installation.primitive_called || old->unwatched_called || old->unwatched_returned
            || old->conditional_called || old->registration.observation_called
            || old->unadmitted_return || old->observation.unadmitted_return
            || old->installation.unadmitted_return || old->registration.unadmitted_return) { return 0; }
    h = &continuation->observation;
    return h->consumer_entered == 1 && h->qualified == 1 && h->api_called == 1 && h->api_returned == 1
        && !h->permit_cancelled && !h->unadmitted_return && h->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
        && h->association_consumer_entered == 1 && h->association_query_entered == 1
        && h->association_query_returned == 1 && h->association_query_completed == 1
        && h->association_query_status == 1 && !h->association_before_query_cancelled
        && h->association_backing_checked == 1 && h->association_backing_relation == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
        && h->association_candidate_supplied == 1 && h->association.kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE;
}

/* Wrapper status0 is NOT evidence of a STORE. Actual A1/R1/E1 and all
 * source/product/tuple/backing/registry gates must be checked by the caller.
 */
static int
reno_loader_entered_bound_unwatched_history_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult *continuation)
{
    return reno_loader_entered_bound_claim_history_raw(setup, continuation)
        && continuation->previous_present == 0
        && continuation->unwatched_called == 1 && continuation->unwatched_returned == 1
        && continuation->unwatched_status == 0
        && continuation->conditional_called == 1 && continuation->conditional_returned == 1
        && continuation->conditional_status == 0 && !setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
        && !continuation->install_called && !continuation->install_returned
        && !continuation->registration_called && !continuation->registration_returned
        && !continuation->unwatched_success_checked && !continuation->conditional_success_checked
        && !continuation->direct_success_checked;
}

static int
reno_loader_registration_unchanged_history_raw(const RenoLoaderExistingRegistrationResult *registration)
{
    return registration != NULL && registration->observation_called == 1
        && registration->observation_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_UNCHANGED
        && !registration->linked_here && !registration->post_commit_query_called
        && !registration->post_commit_query_completed && !registration->unadmitted_return;
}

/* Project exactly one REAL historical writer/registration source. The input
 * C automatic results have their SAME-child private producer provenance.
 * These scalar checks neither certify that provenance nor current authority.
 * Every following publication still needs its complete fresh real gates.
 */
static int
reno_loader_publication_source_history_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult *continuation,
    const RenoLoaderEnteredBoundRegistrationResumeResult *resumed,
    RenoLoaderPublicationSourceProfile *profile)
{
    RenoLoaderPublicationSourceProfile empty = {0};
    RenoLoaderPublicationSourceProfile seen = {0};
    RenoLoaderClaimedEffectOrigin legacy_origin = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_NONE;
    const RenoLoaderClaimedRegistrationResumeResult *legacy;
    const RenoLoaderAbsentInstallResult *conditional;
    int claimed;
    int matches = 0;

    if (profile == NULL) { return 0; }
    *profile = empty; /* C SCALAR/pointer loan only, never an owning copy */
    if (setup == NULL || continuation == NULL || resumed == NULL) { return 0; }
    legacy = &setup->claimed_registration_resume;
    if (legacy->consumer_entered == 1 && legacy->actual_effect_verified == 1
            && legacy->registration_called == 1 && legacy->registration_returned == 1
            && !legacy->unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_unchanged_history_raw(&legacy->registration)
            && reno_loader_claimed_effect_origin_raw(setup, &legacy_origin)
            && legacy_origin == legacy->effect_origin) {
        seen.kind = RENO_LOADER_PUBLICATION_HISTORY_LEGACY;
        seen.registration = &legacy->registration; ++matches;
    }
    claimed = reno_loader_entered_bound_claim_history_raw(setup, continuation);
    if (claimed && continuation->previous_present == 1
            && continuation->install_called == 1 && continuation->install_returned == 1
            && continuation->install_status == 0 && continuation->installation.primitive_called == 1
            && continuation->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && continuation->installation.progress.effect_committed == 1
            && continuation->registration_called == 1 && continuation->registration_returned == 1
            && continuation->registration_status == 0 && continuation->direct_success_checked == 1
            && !continuation->unwatched_called && !continuation->conditional_called
            && !resumed->consumer_entered
            && reno_loader_registration_unchanged_history_raw(&continuation->registration)) {
        seen.kind = RENO_LOADER_PUBLICATION_HISTORY_ENTERED_PRESENT;
        seen.registration = &continuation->registration; ++matches;
    }
    conditional = &setup->absent_install;
    if (claimed && continuation->previous_present == 0
            && continuation->unwatched_called == 1 && continuation->unwatched_returned == 1
            && continuation->unwatched_status == 0
            && continuation->conditional_called == 1 && continuation->conditional_returned == 1
            && continuation->conditional_status == 0
            && !continuation->install_called && !continuation->registration_called
            && !continuation->unwatched_success_checked && !continuation->conditional_success_checked
            && !continuation->direct_success_checked && !resumed->consumer_entered
            && conditional->consumer_entered == 1 && conditional->primitive_called == 1
            && conditional->outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && conditional->progress.effect_committed == 1 && !conditional->unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_unchanged_history_raw(&conditional->registration)) {
        seen.kind = RENO_LOADER_PUBLICATION_HISTORY_ENTERED_CONDITIONAL;
        seen.registration = &conditional->registration; ++matches;
    }
    if (reno_loader_entered_bound_unwatched_history_raw(setup, continuation)
            && resumed->consumer_entered == 1 && resumed->actual_effect_verified == 1
            && resumed->backing_checked == 1 && resumed->backing_relation == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            && resumed->registration_called == 1 && resumed->registration_returned == 1
            && resumed->registration_status == 0 && resumed->direct_success_checked == 1
            && !resumed->unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_unchanged_history_raw(&resumed->registration)) {
        seen.kind = RENO_LOADER_PUBLICATION_HISTORY_ENTERED_UNWATCHED;
        seen.registration = &resumed->registration; ++matches;
    }
    if (matches != 1) { return 0; }
    profile->kind = seen.kind; profile->registration = seen.registration;
    return 1;
}


/* A NEW normal registration stage for an actually written but unlinked claim.
 * It does not retry any constructor/STORE/notification or overwrite an earlier
 * registration receipt. Parent View may already be HISTORY; only its protocol
 * flag is consulted, never its current/query/association as fresh authority.
 * Existing typed Bound observer and full INSTALL permit do all NEW current/
 * source/backing/candidate/registry checks using the SAME independent tuple.
 * This producer has no extra object owning debts and registration is LAST.
 */
static int
reno_loader_resume_claimed_registration_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderClaimedRegistrationResumeResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderClaimedRegistrationResumeResult *result;
    RenoLoaderClaimedEffectOrigin origin = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_NONE;
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int operation_status;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || setup == NULL || selection == NULL
            || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || selection->history.unadmitted_return
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured != 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != actual_loader
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != dictionary || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
            || (setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
            || (!setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
