    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->linked || record->registry_owner_state != NULL || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || record->store_attempted != 1 || record->store_returned != 1 || record->effect_observed != 1
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed
            || !reno_loader_claimed_effect_origin_raw(setup, &origin)) { return 0; }
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = mutation;
    context.preparation = NULL;
    context.absent = mutation->previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    context.registration = 1;
    context.attempt_started = 1;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { return 0; }

    result = &setup->claimed_registration_resume;
    *result = empty_result; /* new SCALAR history only; original receipts intact */
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    result->actual_effect_verified = 1; /* actual old facts; NOT a current certificate */
    result->effect_origin = origin;
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    record = NULL;
    context.record_guard = NULL;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    mutation = NULL;
    result->registration_called = 1;
    operation_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup, &first, &result->registration);
    result->registration_returned = 1;
    if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        result->unadmitted_return = 1;
    }
    /* Registration's own current/source/full NONE permit, ACTIVE/link and real
     * postquery are the final business operation. No release, fresh observation,
     * error creation or old View/Record/payload read before Native success.
     * COMPAT/mismatch/cancel/query-partial retains the actual stage/tuple/history
     * for original consumers/full child; no false completion is returned here.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

/* Each real preparation station has its OWN initially-zero Owner. Earlier
 * output references remain debts, not fresh evidence after another callback.
 * The live private preparation View independently borrows parent inputs and
 * actual local class/key/constructor roots. No Owner/owning struct is copied.
 */
static int
reno_loader_observed_partial_observe_stage(RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext *context,
    unsigned int ordinal, RenoLoaderSelectionOwner *owner,
    RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult *result, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    const RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView *view = context->preparation;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int matched = 0;

    if (ordinal >= 4 || owner->history.consumer_entered
            || result->observation[ordinal].consumer_entered) {
        result->unadmitted_return = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    reno_loader_observe_selection_once(context->source, view->actual_loader,
        view->dictionary, view->query, owner);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    if (*first_owned != NULL || owner->history.unadmitted_return) { goto done; }
    reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(context->source, view->actual_loader,
        view->dictionary, view->query, view->bound, owner);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    if (*first_owned != NULL || owner->history.unadmitted_return) { goto done; }
    if (owner->history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || owner->output.observed != 1) { goto done; }
    if (owner->output.present != view->previous_present || owner->output.current_owned != view->previous) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED;
        goto done;
    }
    if (owner->original_class_owned != view->original_class || owner->related_owned != NULL
            || owner->candidate_bound_owned != view->bound
            || owner->history.association_consumer_entered != 1
            || owner->history.association_query_entered != 1
            || owner->history.association_query_returned != 1
            || owner->history.association_query_completed != 1
            || owner->history.association_query_status != 1
            || owner->history.association_before_query_cancelled
            || owner->history.association_backing_checked != 1
            || owner->history.association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || owner->history.association_candidate_supplied != (view->bound != NULL)
            || owner->history.association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) { goto done; }
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(view->actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)view->original_class, view->dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(context)) {
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
        goto done;
    }
    matched = 1;
    result->matched[ordinal] = 1;
done:
    result->observation[ordinal] = owner->history; /* SCALARS only */
    if (owner->history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
    if (*first_owned != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    return matched;
}

/* Unified continuation of the three actual original COMPAT preparation stops.
 * SAME parent retains its eleven setup positions and its own extras/query.
 * Only missing constructors execute; all original prefix history stays intact.
 */
static int
reno_loader_resume_observed_partial_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderObservedPartialResumeResult *result;
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner observed[4] = {0};
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordInputs inputs = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    PyObject *actual_candidate;
    PyObject *class_guard = NULL, *key_guard = NULL, *inner_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_bound;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc inner_dispatch = NULL, bound_dispatch = NULL;
    unsigned int station = 0;
    unsigned int i;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int operation_status;
    int stored;
    int status;

    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || setup == NULL || selection == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || original_previous_present > 1
            || (original_previous_present && original_previous == NULL)
            || (!original_previous_present && original_previous != NULL)
            || setup->inner_owned != NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered || setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
            || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || selection->original_class == NULL || selection->query == NULL
            || selection->observed != 1 || selection->present != original_previous_present
            || selection->current != original_previous || selection->related != NULL
            || selection->candidate_bound != NULL || selection->history.unadmitted_return
            || selection->history.consumer_entered != 1 || selection->history.qualified != 1
            || selection->history.api_called != 1 || selection->history.api_returned != 1
            || selection->history.permit_cancelled
            || selection->history.outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || selection->history.association_consumer_entered != 1
            || selection->history.association_query_entered != 1
            || selection->history.association_query_returned != 1
            || selection->history.association_query_completed != 1
            || selection->history.association_query_status != 1
            || selection->history.association_before_query_cancelled
            || selection->history.association_backing_checked != 1
            || selection->history.association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || selection->history.association_candidate_supplied
            || selection->history.association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            || !reno_loader_partial_prefix_origin_raw(setup, original_previous_present, setup->stage, &station)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || selection->original_class != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !exact_ascii_name(selection->query, "exec_module", 11)) { return 0; }
    switch (setup->stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT:
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    default: return 0;
    }
    actual_candidate = setup->record_owned != NULL ? setup->record_owned : setup->prepared_owned;
    view.original_class = selection->original_class;
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader; view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous; view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = selection->query; view.stage = setup->stage;
    if (actual_candidate != NULL) {
        if (!reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual_candidate, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
        record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_candidate;
        if (record->attribute_key == NULL) { return 0; }
        view.query = record->attribute_key;
    }
    context.source = source; context.record_guard = actual_candidate;
    context.mutation = NULL; context.preparation = &view;
    context.absent = original_previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    context.registration = 0; context.attempt_started = 0; context.cancelled = 0;
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)view.original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { return 0; }

    result = &setup->observed_partial_resume;
    *result = empty_result;
    result->consumer_entered = 1; result->previous_present = original_previous_present;
    result->entry_stage = setup->stage; result->entry_station = station;
    result->parent_current_matched = 1; result->parent_association_none = 1;
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT;
    first = *first_owned; *first_owned = NULL;
    class_guard = Py_NewRef(view.original_class);
    view.original_class = class_guard;
    if (actual_candidate != NULL) {
        key_guard = Py_NewRef(view.query); /* actual existing factory key BEFORE callback */
        view.query = key_guard;
    }
    record = NULL; actual_candidate = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    if (setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE) {
        inputs.record_type = source->state->arena.install.record_type;
        inputs.actual_module = source->module;
        inputs.retired_error_class = source->state->arena.known.roots[97];
        inputs.owner_proxy = (PyObject *)source->owner;
        inputs.original_loader = actual_loader; inputs.loader_dict = dictionary;
        inputs.previous_value = original_previous; inputs.previous_present = original_previous_present;
        inputs.origin_state = source->state;
        result->prepare_called = 1;
        setup->prepared_owned = reno_record_prepare(&inputs);
        result->prepare_returned = 1;
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL) {
            setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT; result->prepare_created = 1;
        }
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
        /* New factory key did not exist before prepare. Validate fresh original
         * source/type/INIT BODY before reading it; do not enroll parent query.
         */
        if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
                || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->prepared_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { goto cancelled; }
        record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->prepared_owned;
        if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || record->restore_cancelled || record->attribute_key == NULL) { goto cancelled; }
        view.query = record->attribute_key; view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT;
        context.record_guard = setup->prepared_owned;
        if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto cancelled; }
        key_guard = Py_NewRef(view.query);
        view.query = key_guard; record = NULL;
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    }
    if (setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT) {
        if (!reno_loader_observed_partial_observe_stage(&context, 0, &observed[0], result, &first)) { goto drain; }
        result->track_called = 1;
        setup->record_owned = reno_record_track_prepared(&setup->prepared_owned);
        result->track_returned = 1;
        if (setup->record_owned != NULL) {
            setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED; result->track_moved = 1;
        }
        if (setup->record_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
        view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED;
        context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_observed_partial_observe_stage(&context, 1, &observed[1], result, &first)) { goto drain; }
    result->inner_called = 1;
    inner_owned = PyCFunction_NewEx(&reno_loader_inner_method, setup->record_owned, NULL);
    result->inner_returned = 1;
    if (inner_owned != NULL) { result->inner_created = 1; }
    if (inner_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    inner_dispatch = ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_inner_creation_raw(source, setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, original_previous, original_previous_present,
            key_guard, inner_owned, inner_dispatch)) { goto cancelled; }
    result->inner_published = 1; view.inner = inner_owned;
    if (!reno_loader_observed_partial_observe_stage(&context, 2, &observed[2], result, &first)) { goto drain; }
    result->bound_called = 1;
    setup->bound_owned = PyMethod_New(inner_owned, actual_loader);
    result->bound_returned = 1;
    if (setup->bound_owned != NULL) { setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND; result->bound_created = 1; }
    if (setup->bound_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    bound_dispatch = ((PyMethodObject *)setup->bound_owned)->vectorcall;
    if (!reno_loader_publish_bound_creation_raw(source, setup->record_owned,
            class_guard, actual_loader, dictionary, original_previous, original_previous_present,
            key_guard, inner_owned, setup->bound_owned, bound_dispatch)) { goto cancelled; }
    result->bound_published = 1; view.bound = setup->bound_owned; view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    if (!reno_loader_observed_partial_observe_stage(&context, 3, &observed[3], result, &first)) { goto drain; }
    /* This producer consumes its own fresh GENERIC current/NONE plus actual
     * INSTALL preparation permit; it does not forge ObserveInstall MATCHED.
     */
    actual_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    record->installed_bound = setup->bound_owned; setup->bound_owned = NULL;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING; setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED;
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(class_guard);
    setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(key_guard);
    setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    setup->mutation.previous_owned = Py_XNewRef(original_previous);
    setup->mutation.previous_present = original_previous_present; setup->mutation.captured = 1;
    record = NULL; actual_bound = NULL;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    goto drain;
cancelled:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED;
    goto drain;
failed:
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR;
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
drain:
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (inner_owned != NULL && setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED && !result->bound_called) {
        setup->inner_owned = inner_owned; inner_owned = NULL;
        result->inner_retained = 1; /* actual NEW -> MOVE, before any local release */
    }
    /* End private source/payload loans. Four Owners are local debts, never
     * shallow owning copies in result; result holds their scalar histories only.
     */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.record_guard = NULL; context.preparation = NULL;
    record = NULL; actual_candidate = NULL;
    for (i = 4; i > 0; --i) {
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed[i-1].related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed[i-1].candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed[i-1].output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
        reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed[i-1].original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&class_guard, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    if (first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return && result->claim_completed) {
        if (!original_previous_present) {
            result->unwatched_called = 1;
            stored = reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(source, actual_loader, dictionary, setup->mutation.bound_owned, setup);
            result->unwatched_returned = 1; result->unwatched_status = stored;
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (stored < 0 && first == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            if (stored == 0 && first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return) {
                result->conditional_called = 1;
                operation_status = reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(source, setup, &first);
                if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
                reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            }
        } else {
            result->install_called = 1;
            operation_status = reno_loader_install_existing_once(source, setup->record_owned, &setup->mutation, &first, &result->installation);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            if (first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return && !result->installation.unadmitted_return
                    && result->installation.primitive_called && result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
                    && result->installation.progress.effect_committed) {
                result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_STORED;
                operation_status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup, &first, &result->registration);
                if (operation_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
            } else if (first == NULL && !result->unadmitted_return) {
                result->disposition = result->installation.before_call_cancelled
                    || result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_CANCELLED
                    ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED
                    : (result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_UNCHANGED
                        ? RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED : RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT);
            }
        }
    }
    /* Registration LAST. No owning release, observation or error construction
     * follows; Native immediately tries actual success before any other stage.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_ERROR; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return || result->installation.unadmitted_return
        || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first; first = NULL;
    return status;
}

static int
reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(const RenoLoaderExistingRegistrationResult *result)
{
    return result->observation_called == 1
        && result->observation_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_OBSERVE_MATCHED
        && result->linked_here == 1 && result->post_commit_query_called == 1
        && result->post_commit_query_completed == 1 && !result->unadmitted_return;
}

static int
reno_loader_post_registration_route_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup)
{
    int routes = 0;

    if (setup->absent_install.consumer_entered == 1 && setup->absent_install.primitive_called == 1

            && setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1
            && !setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            && !setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(&setup->retained_inner_resume.registration)) { ++routes; }
    if (setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered == 1

                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.parent_current_matched == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.association_none == 1)
                || ((setup->observed_bound_resume.origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_PARTIAL
                        || setup->observed_bound_resume.origin == RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER)
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.parent_current_matched == 0
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.parent_query_is_factory_key == 0
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.association_none == 0
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.actual_current_matched == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.actual_association_none == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.consumer_entered == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.qualified == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.api_called == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.api_returned == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
                    && !setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.permit_cancelled
                    && !setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.unadmitted_return
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_consumer_entered == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_query_entered == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_query_returned == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_query_completed == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_query_status == 1
                    && !setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_before_query_cancelled
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_backing_checked == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_backing_relation == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association_candidate_supplied == 1
                    && setup->observed_bound_resume.observation.association.kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE))
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1
            && !setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            && !setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(&setup->observed_bound_resume.registration)) { ++routes; }
    if (setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.previous_present == 1
            && ((setup->observed_inner_resume.from_partial == 0
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.parent_current_matched == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.parent_association_none == 1)
                || (setup->observed_inner_resume.from_partial == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.parent_current_matched == 0
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.parent_association_none == 0
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_current_matched == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_association_none == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.consumer_entered == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.qualified == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.api_called == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.api_returned == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
                    && !setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.permit_cancelled
                    && !setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.unadmitted_return
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_consumer_entered == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_query_entered == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_query_returned == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_query_completed == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_query_status == 1
                    && !setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_before_query_cancelled
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_backing_checked == 1
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_backing_relation == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
                    && !setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association_candidate_supplied
                    && setup->observed_inner_resume.before_method_observation.association.kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE))
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.inner_moved == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.bound_called == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.bound_returned == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.bound_created == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.bound_published == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.api_called == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.api_returned == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            && !setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.permit_cancelled
            && !setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.unadmitted_return
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.association_query_entered == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.association_query_returned == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.association_query_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.association_query_status == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.observation.association.kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.actual_current_matched == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.actual_association_none == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1
            && !setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            && !setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(&setup->observed_inner_resume.registration)) { ++routes; }
    if (setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->claimed_registration_resume.actual_effect_verified == 1

    if (setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.previous_present == 1

            && setup->observed_partial_resume.matched[1] == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.matched[2] == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.matched[3] == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.inner_called == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.inner_returned == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.inner_created == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.inner_published == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.bound_called == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.bound_returned == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.bound_created == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.bound_published == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.claim_completed == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.install_called == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.primitive_called == 1
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.progress.effect_committed == 1
            && !setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            && !setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            && reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(&setup->observed_partial_resume.registration)) { ++routes; }
    return routes == 1;

/* Two real parents call ONLY in the continuous no-callout span after their
 * new successful current observation AND whole-association query. Parent
 * independently owns source/module/entered/loader/dictionary and all four
 * SelectionOwner occurrences. View borrows are not enrollments or roots.
 *
 * This handles true same-generation idempotency with NO local candidate or
 * preparation/store attempt. Native setup may still own its prior query's
 * related NEW: admit only NULL or the SAME freshly retained actual Record.
 * Original parent previous must be this SAME fresh current, and any outer
 * entry-Record guard must name this SAME fresh related; their later releases
 * are then also NONLAST. Changed old occurrences need the complete child.
 * After SelectionOwner extras drain, outer original_previous STILL roots
 * bound->inner->Record through the outer entry-Record release. Later previous
 * is covered by the actual held dict/Record.installed_bound, and the parent's
 * dictionary by original loader backing/Record.loader_dict. Do not cite an
 * already released fresh related occurrence as that later coverage.
 * An obsolete/different related occurrence might release last and call out;
 * leave it and every partial candidate to the complete child instead.
 *
 * Actual private prepare->track->construct->once-publish->claim owning MOVE
 * and real store->ACTIVE/link producers, with no public constructor/payload
 * writer, establish this Record/product provenance. Compare against those
 * originals below, never capture expected from current. Trusted matching
 * constructor/adapter/code-image/layout/GIL/reference/S1 premises remain
 * independent and unverified on the target build; scalar/type identity cannot
 * authenticate them or defend arbitrary external native memory mutation.
 * No install, getter, lookup replay, registry mutation, related cancellation,
 * dictionary restoration or new owning acquire is performed here.
 */
/* Common no-candidate/no-attempt gate, mechanically preserved from KEEP.
 * related is deliberately outside this predicate; REUSE retains its stricter
 * actual-related identity gate. No source/owning/state operation occurs here.
 */
static int
reno_loader_setup_pristine_raw(const RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup)
{
    if (setup == NULL
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE
            || setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
            || setup->inner_owned != NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->absent_prepare.consumer_entered || setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
            || setup->present_install.consumer_entered
            || setup->absent_prepare.prepare_called || setup->absent_prepare.track_called
            || setup->absent_prepare.inner_called || setup->absent_prepare.bound_called
            || setup->absent_prepare.claim_completed || setup->absent_prepare.unwatched_called
            || setup->absent_prepare.conditional_called || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.primitive_called || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.observation_called
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.prepare_called || setup->present_install.track_called
            || setup->present_install.inner_called || setup->present_install.bound_called
            || setup->present_install.claim_completed || setup->present_install.install_called
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.observation_called
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return) { return 0; }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_loader_try_finish_pristine_reuse(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, PyObject *original_entry_record,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    const RenoLoaderRecordObservation *association;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *inner;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || source == NULL || source->state == NULL || actual_loader == NULL
            || dictionary == NULL || setup == NULL || selection == NULL
            || selection->original_class == NULL || selection->query == NULL
            || selection->current == NULL || selection->related == NULL
            || original_previous_present != 1 || original_previous != selection->current
            || (original_entry_record != NULL && original_entry_record != selection->related)
            || selection->candidate_bound != NULL || selection->observed != 1
            || selection->present != 1
            || !reno_loader_setup_pristine_raw(setup)
            || (setup->related_owned != NULL && setup->related_owned != selection->related)) { return 0; }
    history = &selection->history;
    association = &history->association;
    if (history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied
            || association->kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE
            || association->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE
            || association->same_loader != 1 || association->same_dictionary != 1
            || association->current_is_installed_bound != 1 || association->candidate_bound_is_installed_bound
            || association->restore_cancelled || association->store_attempted != 1
            || association->store_returned != 1 || association->effect_observed != 1
            || association->restore_attempted || association->restore_returned
            || association->restore_effect_observed
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) { return 0; }
    state = source->state;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || selection->original_class != state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(selection->original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)selection->original_class
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || !exact_ascii_name(selection->query, "exec_module", 11)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(selection->related, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(selection->current, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(selection->current) != actual_loader) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)selection->related;
    inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(selection->current);
    if (record->module_lifetime != source->module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || record->registry_owner_state != state || record->linked != 1
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->original_loader != actual_loader || record->loader_dict != dictionary
            || record->attribute_key == NULL || !exact_ascii_name(record->attribute_key, "exec_module", 11)
            || record->installed_bound != selection->current || record->previous_present > 1
            || (record->previous_present && record->previous_value == NULL)
            || (!record->previous_present && record->previous_value != NULL)
            || record->store_attempted != 1 || record->store_returned != 1 || record->effect_observed != 1
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed
            || !reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, actual_loader, inner,
                selection->current)) { return 0; }
    /* No PreparedDictDomain/ASCII snapshot prerequisite: GENERAL observation
     * has already run its lawful hash/eq and natural releases. Recheck actual
     * original backing without another value lookup in this same raw span.
     */
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)selection->original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    first = *first_owned; /* actual private first MOVE; NULL on this route */
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned); /* all ELEVEN slots MOVE/NULL */
    *handled = 1; /* no unhandled exit exists after the first owning MOVE */
    /* Only related can be nonNULL. Its SAME actual Record remains separately
     * rooted by parent's fresh related NEW and current->inner.m_self. This
     * occurrence is NONLAST under normal reference primitives, not a cycle or
     * sampled refcount argument. Ten NULL slots incur no owning release.
     * Parent extra owning occurrences are borrowed, never moved/settled here.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* No Record/source/State/setup/View reads after final drain starts. */
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

/* The same actual native parent calls after absent STORE or its present
 * preparation/registration prefix, with NO intervening callout after the
 * actual ACTIVE/link commit and successful post-commit ONE/ACTIVE query.
 * Parent's actual module/spec/loader/dictionary roots and entered interval
 * continuously cover this call, not merely the Record/bound/loader cycle.
 * Matching lawful full/nondebug reference and pending-cleanup primitives,
 * allocated layouts/GIL/code lifetime remain independent unadmitted premises.
 * Raw comparisons below do not authenticate source, pointers or M/S1/build.
 *
 * Unmatched: handled=0, ALL input ownings/first unchanged, original COMPLETE
 * child still required. Matched: MOVE eleven slots and actual first, handled=1
 * on EVERY later exit; settle here and never pass emptied inputs to the child.
 * This closes only native STORED success settlement, NOT abort/restore/COMPAT.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_registered_success(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled,
    const RenoLoaderExistingRegistrationResult *direct_registration)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *inner;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312Probe domain;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    /* Actual caller supplies a distinct live int output. Private misuse has
     * no invented cleanup/repair grant. No owning write precedes the full gate.
     */
    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    /* NonNULL is supplied ONLY by the two typed immediate registration
     * callers. This scalar receipt is not reusable freshness.
     * NULL wrapper keeps every original gate and fallback below.
     */
    if (direct_registration != NULL
            && !reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(direct_registration)) { return 0; }
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || setup == NULL
            || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED
            || setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->related_owned != setup->record_owned
            || setup->current.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE
            || setup->current.phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE
            || !setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || (setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
            || (!setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
    state = source->state;
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || state->arena.known.roots[20] != mutation->original_class_owned
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(mutation->original_class_owned, &PyType_Type)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !PyDict_Check(mutation->dictionary_owned)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(mutation->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(mutation->bound_owned) != mutation->loader_owned) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(mutation->bound_owned);
    if (inner == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_self != setup->record_owned
            || record->module_lifetime != source->module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || record->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || record->registry_owner_state != state || record->linked != 1
            || record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->original_loader != mutation->loader_owned
            || record->loader_dict != mutation->dictionary_owned
            || record->attribute_key != mutation->key_owned
            || !exact_ascii_name(mutation->key_owned, "exec_module", 11)
            || record->installed_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || record->previous_present != mutation->previous_present
            || record->previous_value != mutation->previous_owned
            || record->store_attempted != 1 || record->store_returned != 1
            || record->effect_observed != 1 || record->restore_attempted
            || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) { return 0; }
    if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(record, mutation->loader_owned,
            inner, mutation->bound_owned)) { return 0; }
    if (direct_registration != NULL || reno_loader_post_registration_route_raw(setup)) {
        /* ONLY the real immediate post-registration caller route: bound was
         * freshly observed before link, whole ONE query completed and every
         * producer local/output was settled BEFORE that final registration.
         * No raw receipt is reusable after any callback. General keys require
         * neither another lookup/hash/eq nor an ASCII-only table snapshot here.
         */
        if (!reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, mutation->loader_owned)) { return 0; }
        backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(mutation->loader_owned,
            (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned);
        if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }
    } else {
        /* Original unwatched actual success keeps its original current gate. */
        domain = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_PreparedDictDomain(mutation->loader_owned,
            (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, mutation->dictionary_owned);
        if (domain != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_KEY_DOMAIN_OK
                || reno_t0_ascii_value(mutation->dictionary_owned, "exec_module", 11)
                    != mutation->bound_owned) { return 0; }
    }
    /* The actual ACTIVE/link commit, post-commit query's ONE and original
     * source are continuous through caller and gate; no callback invalidated
     * them. The actual held loader/backing dict owns the SAME standard bound,
     * whose function owns this Record. This is an external caller-root proof,
     * not Track, a current-refcount sample or a self-cycle/root equivalence.
     */
    first = *first_owned; /* actual private first MOVE; NULL on this route */
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1; /* no unhandled/child exit exists after ANY owning move */

    /* Seven absent or eight present real nonNULL local occurrences, even
     * though record and related name the same object. Actual acquisition
     * reverse: query guard, tuple previous/bound/key/dict/loader/class, then
     * original record. The actual NULL slots acquire/release no reference.
     * Present previous (including Py_None) has the SAME intact Record field
     * and original parent previous owning as independent NONLAST coverage.
     * Related and record: caller-held actual dict -> bound -> inner.m_self.
     * Bound/key/dict/loader tuple refs: SAME intact Record owning fields; bound
     * also dict-held and loader remains parent-held. Class: actual State
     * known20 owning + live loader's implicit type, not a borrowed slot flag.
     * Each release is NONLAST under these real producer/reference premises;
     * none can run a destructor/callback that would invalidate later coverage.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* No State/context/Record/payload/input slot read after final drain starts.
     * Existing helper preserves/adopts actual first. Return only its owning
     * to the parent, with empty indicator; no old input is reselected/reused.
     */
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

static int
reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    /* Original private interface: only NULL enters the shared success body. */
    return reno_loader_try_finish_registered_success(source, setup, first_owned, handled, NULL);
}

/* Private AUTOMATIC borrow view for the future actual normal-retirement
 * consumer. It adds no State/GC/bank owning slot. The real caller must hold
 * its original module/entered interval, SAME Record guard and independent
 * detached loader/class/dict/key/bound roots throughout the runtime call.
 * These raw pointers are not enrollment, roots or layout/source certificates.
 */
struct RenoSpecAttr312RestoreContext {
    RenoState *state;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
};

static int
reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(RenoSpecAttr312RestoreContext *context)
{
    /* Called only with that live private view and actual continuous guards.
     * No arena/proxy/source fresh or generic retirement callback is used.
     * A normal restoration helper observing its SAME Record cancelled must
     * lock the SAME generation CLEAR; NONE is never upgraded to RESTORE.
     */
    if (context->record->restore_cancelled) {
        context->state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR;
        return 0;
    }
    return context->state->controls.record_exit_mode == RENO_RECORD_EXIT_RESTORE;
}

/* All fields are private SCALARS, not owning storage or Record history.
 * Only the selected operation's raw enum is a primitive return when called.
 * Before-call cancellation is separate, never an invented API return value.
 */
typedef enum RenoLoaderRestoreOperation {
    RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_NONE = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_DELETE = 1,
    RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_REPLACE = 2
} RenoLoaderRestoreOperation;

typedef struct RenoLoaderRestoreResult {
    unsigned char primitive_called;
    unsigned char before_call_cancelled;
    RenoLoaderRestoreOperation operation;
    RenoSpecAttr312DeleteOutcome delete_outcome;
    RenoSpecAttr312ReplaceOutcome replace_outcome;
    RenoSpecAttr312DeleteNotice notice;
    unsigned char gc_tracking_effect_observed;
    unsigned char replace_notification_pass_completed;
    RenoSpecAttr312GenericReplaceProgress replace_progress;
    unsigned char delete_notification_pass_entered;
    unsigned char delete_notification_pass_completed;
    unsigned char delete_comparison_started;
} RenoLoaderRestoreResult;

/* Actual parent continuously owns module, SAME Record, independent original
 * class and all six detached source occurrences. It normally unlinks/marks
 * RETIRING/detaches without cancellation, or has already legally chosen CLEAR.
 * detached is a const BORROW of actual parent owning slots, never a shallow
 * owning copy, current-derived expected or reattached Record payload.
 * first_owned/result are distinct live private outputs, disjoint from input,
 * ctx and owning storage. Matching layouts/GIL/build/normal primitives/S1 and
 * actual caller/guard provenance precede these consistency comparisons.
 */
static int
reno_loader_restore_detached(PyObject *actual_module, RenoState *state,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class_guard,
    const RenoRecordDetachedSources *detached, PyObject **first_owned,
    RenoLoaderRestoreResult *result)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoSpecAttr312RestoreContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312DeletedOwned removed = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312ReplaceOwned replaced = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312GenericDeleteProgress generic_delete = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312GenericReplaceProgress generic_replace = {0};
    RenoLoaderRestoreResult empty_result = {0};
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int operation_error = 0;
    int status;

    if (actual_module == NULL || state == NULL || actual_record_guard == NULL
            || original_class_guard == NULL || !PyType_Check(original_class_guard)
            || detached == NULL || first_owned == NULL || result == NULL) { return -1; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record_guard;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || (state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_RESTORE
                && state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR)
            || (state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRING
                && !(state->controls.record_exit_mode == RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR
                    && state->controls.phase == RENO_MODULE_RETIRED))
            || record->module_lifetime != actual_module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->linked || record->registry_owner_state != NULL
            || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRING
                && record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED
                && record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED)
            || record->attribute_key != NULL || record->owner_proxy != NULL
            || record->original_loader != NULL || record->loader_dict != NULL
            || record->previous_value != NULL || record->installed_bound != NULL) { return -1; }

    context.state = state;
    context.record = record;
    *result = empty_result; /* scalars only; both NEEDS_COMPAT enums are zero */
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR;
        result->before_call_cancelled = 1;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        goto settle_outputs;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context)) {
        result->before_call_cancelled = 1;
        goto settle_outputs;
    }
    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRING || record->previous_present > 1
            || (record->previous_present && detached->previous_value == NULL)
            || (!record->previous_present && detached->previous_value != NULL)
            || detached->attribute_key == NULL || detached->owner_proxy == NULL
            || detached->original_loader == NULL || detached->loader_dict == NULL
            || detached->installed_bound == NULL) { goto settle_outputs; }

    record->restore_attempted = 1;
    result->primitive_called = 1;
    if (record->previous_present) {
        result->operation = RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_REPLACE;
        result->replace_outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ConditionalGenericNotifyingReplace(
            detached->original_loader, (PyTypeObject *)original_class_guard,
            detached->loader_dict, detached->attribute_key, detached->installed_bound,
            detached->previous_value, reno_loader_restore_permit_raw, &context,
            &replaced, &result->notice, &generic_replace);
        result->replace_progress = generic_replace; /* scalar route and phase; RAW new facts unknown */
        result->gc_tracking_effect_observed = replaced.tracking_effect_observed;
        result->replace_notification_pass_completed = replaced.notification_pass_completed;
        if (result->replace_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_REPLACE_REPLACED) {
            record->restore_effect_observed = 1;
        }
        operation_error = result->replace_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_REPLACE_ERROR;
    }
    else {
        result->operation = RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_DELETE;
        result->delete_outcome = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_ConditionalGenericNotifyingDelete(
            detached->original_loader, (PyTypeObject *)original_class_guard,
            detached->loader_dict, detached->attribute_key, detached->installed_bound,
            reno_loader_restore_permit_raw, &context, &removed, &result->notice, &generic_delete);
        result->delete_notification_pass_entered = generic_delete.notification_pass_entered;
        result->delete_notification_pass_completed = generic_delete.notification_pass_completed;
        result->delete_comparison_started = generic_delete.comparison_started;
        if (result->delete_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_DELETE_DELETED) {
            record->restore_effect_observed = 1;
        }
        operation_error = result->delete_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_DELETE_ERROR;
    }
    /* Real value effect is recorded BEFORE ANY release. GC tracking and
     * notification facts are separate, may precede a non-effect return and
     * are not rolled back. restore_returned keeps its original meaning and
     * value: the actual outer return consumer remains a separate missing body.
     */
    if (operation_error || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        operation_error = 1;
        state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        /* ERROR without pending/actual first is an unadmitted API violation;
         * transport failure, never fabricate an exception from an enum.
         */
    }

settle_outputs:
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    /* New generic DELETE can retire a foreign key with a visible destructor.
     * Match delitem_common's original key -> value order. The value remains
     * an independent removed owning during key cleanup; do not drop it early.
     * REPLACE has neither removed occurrence; all six inputs stay parent-held.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&removed.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&removed.value_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&replaced.old_value_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&replaced.extra_previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    /* All API outputs settled, including unused extra after COMPAT/UNCHANGED/
     * CANCELLED/ERROR; equal pointers remain independent reference debts.
     * ALL original six inputs/guards remain held by the same actual parent.
     * It must consume operation/raw enum, phase/notice/GC facts and mode/first,
     * complete unsupported on this C stack and never retry notification blindly.
     */
    status = first != NULL || operation_error ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* no further State/Record/input read or object release */
}

/* Per-record parent, not the missing public normal-retirement control/drain.
 * A private continuation is carried ONLY within the SAME continuously active
 * caller C stack. It grants no public return with outstanding input/guard
 * debts, no pending lease, retry, reattachment or invented generic fallback.
 */
typedef enum RenoLoaderRetirementRoundDisposition {
    RENO_LOADER_ROUND_NOT_ENTERED = 0,
    RENO_LOADER_ROUND_CONTINUE_STILL_LINKED = 1,
    RENO_LOADER_ROUND_CONTINUE_COMPAT = 2,
    RENO_LOADER_ROUND_UNADMITTED_RETURN = 3,
    RENO_LOADER_ROUND_SETTLED = 4
} RenoLoaderRetirementRoundDisposition;

typedef struct RenoLoaderRetirementRoundResult {
    RenoLoaderRetirementRoundDisposition disposition;
    unsigned char restore_consumer_called;
    RenoLoaderRestoreResult restoration; /* scalar transport, never owning */
} RenoLoaderRetirementRoundResult;

/* The real caller ALREADY owns the actual original module, this actual live
 * current-head Record and the independently captured original class. It owns
 * the real record_draining interval and has legally selected RETIRING and
 * RESTORE/CLEAR; this body neither selects normal retirement nor decides the
 * still-open busy/entered/INSTALLING policy. The registry's lawful producer/
 * unlink/liveness invariants precede ALL raw reads/acquisitions by that caller.
 * The original class must not be rebuilt from current Py_TYPE(loader).
 *
 * detached_owned is the caller's actual EMPTY six-owning automatic storage,
 * NOT a copied struct or Record view. first_owned/result are distinct live
 * private outputs, disjoint from all input/guard/owning storage. The caller
 * keeps module/Record/class guards through every callback and every private
 * continuation; this body never acquires/releases those guards. Matching
 * normal primitives/GIL/build/layout/spans/S1 remain independent premises.
 * A zero C status means no escaping first, never RESTORED or a completed drain.
 */
static int
reno_loader_retire_current_record_round(PyObject *actual_module, RenoState *state,
    PyObject *actual_record_guard, PyObject *original_class_guard,
    RenoRecordDetachedSources *detached_owned, PyObject **first_owned,
    RenoLoaderRetirementRoundResult *result)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoSpecAttr312RestoreContext context;
    RenoLoaderRestoreResult empty_restore = {0};
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int consumer_status;
    int status;

    if (actual_module == NULL || state == NULL || actual_record_guard == NULL
            || original_class_guard == NULL || !PyType_Check(original_class_guard)
            || detached_owned == NULL || first_owned == NULL || result == NULL
            || detached_owned->attribute_key != NULL || detached_owned->owner_proxy != NULL
            || detached_owned->original_loader != NULL || detached_owned->loader_dict != NULL
            || detached_owned->previous_value != NULL || detached_owned->installed_bound != NULL) {
        return -1; /* private misuse: no adoption, cleanup or fabricated error */
    }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_record_guard;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_RETIRING
            || !state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || (state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_RESTORE
                && state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR)
            || state->controls.record_head != record
            || record->module_lifetime != actual_module || record->origin_state != state
            || record->linked != 1 || record->registry_owner_state != state
            || record->prev != NULL) { return -1; }

    context.state = state;
    context.record = record;
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_ROUND_NOT_ENTERED;
    result->restore_consumer_called = 0;
    result->restoration = empty_restore; /* scalar-only initialization */
    /* Actual first/pending and this Record's actual cancellation have the
     * already selected CLEAR contract; they are not a policy invented for
     * INSTALLING. No callout has occurred and all Record inputs remain held.
     */
    if (*first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR;
    }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    if (state->controls.record_exit_mode == RENO_RECORD_EXIT_RESTORE
            && record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE) {
        /* No source/phase/history/detach write. Current INSTALLING producers
         * and other lifecycle domains remain for this SAME guarded caller.
         * It may not silently skip this head, loop it or claim public success.
         */
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_ROUND_CONTINUE_STILL_LINKED;
        return 0;
    }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    if (state->controls.record_exit_mode == RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR) {
        reno_record_take_sources_raw(record, detached_owned);
    }
    else {
        /* Normal ACTIVE own-head: UNLINK and real six-owning MOVE before
         * any callback. Unlike the CLEAR helper, do NOT set cancelled here.
         * Lifetime fields, previous presence and all actual history survive.
         */
        reno_record_unlink_raw(record);
        record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRING;
        detached_owned->attribute_key = record->attribute_key;
        detached_owned->owner_proxy = record->owner_proxy;
        detached_owned->original_loader = record->original_loader;
        detached_owned->loader_dict = record->loader_dict;
        detached_owned->previous_value = record->previous_value;
        detached_owned->installed_bound = record->installed_bound;
        record->attribute_key = NULL;
        record->owner_proxy = NULL;
        record->original_loader = NULL;
        record->loader_dict = NULL;
        record->previous_value = NULL;
        record->installed_bound = NULL;
    }
    result->restore_consumer_called = 1;
    consumer_status = reno_loader_restore_detached(actual_module, state,
        actual_record_guard, original_class_guard, detached_owned, &first, &result->restoration);
    if (first != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    if (consumer_status < 0 && first == NULL) {
        /* Error-without-first/pending is an unadmitted child contract
         * violation, even if that child already locked CLEAR. Never make an
         * exception or use its enum alone to erase the actual input debts.
         */
        result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_ROUND_UNADMITTED_RETURN;
        goto return_to_same_caller;
    }
    if (state->controls.record_exit_mode == RENO_RECORD_EXIT_RESTORE) {
        if (result->restoration.operation == RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_NONE
                || (result->restoration.operation == RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_DELETE
                    && result->restoration.delete_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_DELETE_NEEDS_COMPAT)
                || (result->restoration.operation == RENO_LOADER_RESTORE_REPLACE
                    && result->restoration.replace_outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_REPLACE_NEEDS_COMPAT)) {
            result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_ROUND_CONTINUE_COMPAT;
            goto return_to_same_caller;
        }
    }

    /* Complete this round's SIX input debts, including equal-pointer distinct
     * occurrences, in the established CLEAR order. The old helper NULLs each
     * actual slot before release and preserves/adopts the actual first. A
     * DELETED+C0 child may already have locked CLEAR; never call it RESTORED.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached_owned->installed_bound, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached_owned->previous_value, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached_owned->loader_dict, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached_owned->original_loader, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached_owned->owner_proxy, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&detached_owned->attribute_key, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { state->controls.record_exit_mode = RENO_RECORD_EXIT_CLEAR; }
    (void)reno_loader_restore_permit_raw(&context);
    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED) {
        record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED;
    }
    result->disposition = RENO_LOADER_ROUND_SETTLED;
    /* restore_returned is still not redefined by this private parent. The
     * actual outer restoration return consumer has a separate missing body.
     * Caller STILL owns module/Record/class guards and the drain interval.
     */
return_to_same_caller:
    status = first != NULL || consumer_status < 0 ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* no further State/Record/input read or object release */
}

/* Same actual selector activation and prepare/Track/bound/store producer.
