 * An existing escaping first selects candidate failure, NOT business restore.
 * r1151's partial/install-failure path cancels only this actual candidate;
 * normal unload/retirement is the separate conditional-RESTORE entry.
 * Source/layout/GIL/normal-reference/cleanup contracts precede these reads.
 * Slot/stage checks only reject private inconsistency, never prove provenance,
 * secrecy, no dictionary effect, source freshness or runtime admission.
 *
 * Unmatched: every input owning and first stays with the original full child.
 * Matched: MOVE first and all eleven slots before any callback; this activation
 * alone settles them. No State/source pointer or generation policy is needed.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_setup_abort(RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_candidate;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned == NULL
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (setup->prepared_owned != NULL && setup->record_owned != NULL)
            || setup->mutation.captured > 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, *first_owned)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* These are the real producer's owning-slot milestones, not the current
     * Record phase. Callbacks may already have cleared/retired the candidate.
     * A failed query may own related without committing its scalar current.
     */
    switch (setup->stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT:
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED:
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
    if (!setup->mutation.captured) {
        if (setup->mutation.previous_present
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
                || setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (setup->stage < RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
                || (setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
                || (!setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    actual_candidate = setup->record_owned != NULL
        ? setup->record_owned : setup->prepared_owned;
    if (actual_candidate != NULL) {
        candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_candidate;
        /* Permanent lifetime fields survive source detach. The actual local
         * owning covers the BODY, including clear_sources' final phase read;
         * it does not keep payloads present or prevent a reentrant clear.
         */
        if (candidate->module_lifetime == NULL || candidate->retired_error_class == NULL
                || candidate->origin_state == NULL
                || candidate->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT
                || candidate->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || (candidate->linked
                    && candidate->registry_owner_state != candidate->origin_state)
                || (!candidate->linked && (candidate->registry_owner_state != NULL
                    || candidate->prev != NULL || candidate->next != NULL))) { return 0; }
    }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    if (candidate != NULL) {
        /* Preserve an already RETIRED terminal state, otherwise fail this
         * candidate. Existing clear cancels/unlinks/detaches before release,
         * breaks the installed-bound cycle and keeps actual store/restore
         * attempted/returned/effect facts. It performs no dictionary restore.
         * A dictionary or external alias may still retain the failed method.
         */
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED) {
            candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
        }
        reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    candidate = NULL;
    actual_candidate = NULL;
    /* No further setup/source/State/Record/payload reads. related is ONLY
     * this activation's independent query guard, even when it aliases this
     * candidate. Never explicitly cancel a different queried Record. Every
     * equal-pointer occurrence remains a separate debt; releases may be LAST.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return -1; /* SAME escaping first, never RESTORED or installation success */
}

static int
reno_loader_try_finish_unadmitted_setup(RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_candidate;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (setup == NULL || selection == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || !(selection->history.unadmitted_return
                || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return
                || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
                || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
                || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return)
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (setup->prepared_owned != NULL && setup->record_owned != NULL)
            || setup->mutation.captured > 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, *first_owned)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* These are the real producer's owning-slot milestones, not the current
     * Record phase. Callbacks may already have cleared/retired the candidate.
     * A failed query may own related without committing its scalar current.
     */
    switch (setup->stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT:
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED:
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
    if (!setup->mutation.captured) {
        if (setup->mutation.previous_present
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
                || setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (setup->stage < RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
                || (setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
                || (!setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    actual_candidate = setup->record_owned != NULL
        ? setup->record_owned : setup->prepared_owned;
    if (actual_candidate != NULL) {
        candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_candidate;
        /* Permanent lifetime fields survive source detach. The actual local
         * owning covers the BODY, including clear_sources' final phase read;
         * it does not keep payloads present or prevent a reentrant clear.
         */
        if (candidate->module_lifetime == NULL || candidate->retired_error_class == NULL
                || candidate->origin_state == NULL
                || candidate->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT
                || candidate->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || (candidate->linked
                    && candidate->registry_owner_state != candidate->origin_state)
                || (!candidate->linked && (candidate->registry_owner_state != NULL
                    || candidate->prev != NULL || candidate->next != NULL))) { return 0; }
    }

    /* A real no-indicator protocol failure, never a COMPAT/change/cancel
     * disposition alone. Borrowed history is not read after this MOVE.
     * No exception is manufactured to borrow the actual-first abort path.
     */
    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    if (candidate != NULL) {
        /* Preserve an already RETIRED terminal state, otherwise fail this
         * candidate. Existing clear cancels/unlinks/detaches before release,
         * breaks the installed-bound cycle and keeps actual store/restore
         * attempted/returned/effect facts. It performs no dictionary restore.
         * A dictionary or external alias may still retain the failed method.
         */
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED) {
            candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
        }
        reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    candidate = NULL;
    actual_candidate = NULL;
    /* No further setup/source/State/Record/payload reads. related is ONLY
     * this activation's independent query guard, even when it aliases this
     * candidate. Never explicitly cancel a different queried Record. Every
     * equal-pointer occurrence remains a separate debt; releases may be LAST.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    /* Negative remains negative even when every release leaves no first.
     * The parent drains its separate selection/query guards first, then
     * reports SystemError only if no ACTUAL cleanup exception escaped.
     */
    return -1; /* protocol failure; actual cleanup first, if any, is owned */
}

/* Normal preservation, NOT source/REUSE/seed admission. Real parents retain
 * actual spec/loader/module/entered plus any original prepared dictionary.
 * No current getter/GetDict/lookup is repeated to manufacture a native input.
 * This component has no local candidate/attempt to resolve. A query-related
 * owning may exist and may release LAST; owning that guard does not authorize
 * explicit cancellation of its Record. Its ordinary destructor can still run.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_normal_keep(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *original_class;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int keep = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL
            || source->owner == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || actual_loader == Py_None
            || setup == NULL || selection == NULL || selection->history.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_setup_pristine_raw(setup)
            || !reno_spec_loader_source_fresh_install_raw(source)) { return 0; }
    state = source->state;
    if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(state->arena.known.roots[20], &PyType_Type)) { return 0; }
    original_class = state->arena.known.roots[20]; /* original T0 root, not current enrollment */
    if ((PyObject *)Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != original_class) {
        keep = 1; /* lawful foreign loader: preserve actual spec/loader choice */
    } else if (dictionary != NULL && PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            && reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) {
        /* Pure original-layout classification; does not obtain/materialize a
         * new dictionary, inspect keys/current, or authenticate a new backing.
         */
        backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
            (PyTypeObject *)original_class, dictionary);
        if (backing == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_DIFFERENT && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            keep = 1; /* external new backing stays intact, old dict is not restored */
        }
    }
    if (!keep || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    /* related is the only possible nonNULL setup debt. Unlike strict REUSE,
     * it need not match a fresh node and may call out on release. This KEEP
     * does not authorize later installation or treat history as fresh after
     * cleanup. No source/State/Record/View read follows the first release.
     * Source/lease validation in the existing outer caller remains separate.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* preservation completed, never INSTALLED/RESTORED/seeded */
}

/* SAME live backing, freshly OBSERVED current and completed whole query only.
 * Registry address/liveness, actual source provenance, original image/GIL and
 * noncalling raw/reference primitives remain premises, not pointer proofs.
 * No owning operation/callback occurs between fresh View and completed scan.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_external_alias_keep(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *node;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *prior = NULL;
    PyObject *first_related = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordQueryKind kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *inner;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int witness = 0;
    int own_current = 0;
    int same_loader;
    int same_dictionary;
    int same_bound;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL
            || source->owner == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL
            || selection == NULL || selection->original_class == NULL
            || selection->query == NULL || selection->related == NULL
            || selection->candidate_bound != NULL || selection->observed != 1
            || selection->present > 1
            || ((selection->current != NULL) != (selection->present != 0))
            || !reno_loader_setup_pristine_raw(setup)) { return 0; }
    history = &selection->history;
    if (history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied
            || (history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE
                && history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) { return 0; }
    state = source->state;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || selection->original_class != state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(selection->original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)selection->original_class
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || !exact_ascii_name(selection->query, "exec_module", 11)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)selection->original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    /* Pure rescan, not record_query_raw: no NEW, error construction or release.
     * FIRST relation bits never stand for other nodes. A positive witness does
     * not terminate the scan: a later own-current or unknown node vetoes KEEP.
     */
    node = state->controls.record_head;
    while (node != NULL) {
        if (Py_TYPE((PyObject *)node) != (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type
                || node->linked != 1 || node->registry_owner_state != state
                || node->origin_state != state || node->prev != prior
                || node->module_lifetime != source->module
                || node->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
                || node->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
                || node->original_loader == NULL || node->loader_dict == NULL
                || !PyDict_Check(node->loader_dict)
                || node->attribute_key == NULL || !exact_ascii_name(node->attribute_key, "exec_module", 11)
                || node->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || node->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || node->previous_present > 1
                || (node->previous_present && node->previous_value == NULL)
                || (!node->previous_present && node->previous_value != NULL)
                || node->restore_cancelled > 1 || node->store_attempted > 1
                || node->store_returned > 1 || node->effect_observed > 1
                || node->restore_attempted > 1 || node->restore_returned > 1
                || node->restore_effect_observed > 1) { return 0; }
        same_loader = node->original_loader == actual_loader;
        same_dictionary = node->loader_dict == dictionary;
        same_bound = selection->current != NULL && node->installed_bound != NULL
            && selection->current == node->installed_bound;
        if (same_loader || same_dictionary || same_bound) {
            if (kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) {
                first_related = (PyObject *)node;
                kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE;
            } else {
                kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE;
            }
            if (node->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || node->restore_cancelled
                    || node->store_attempted != 1 || node->store_returned != 1
                    || node->effect_observed != 1 || node->restore_attempted
                    || node->restore_returned || node->restore_effect_observed
                    || node->installed_bound == NULL
                    || !Py_IS_TYPE(node->installed_bound, &PyMethod_Type)
                    || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, node->original_loader)) { return 0; }
            inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(node->installed_bound);
            if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(node, node->original_loader,
                    inner, node->installed_bound)) { return 0; }
            if (same_loader && same_dictionary && same_bound) {
                own_current = 1; /* must reach full child, including MULTIPLE */
            } else if (same_loader || same_dictionary || same_bound) {
                /* same loader: observed replacement/deletion or older dict;
                 * other loader: shared dict or a true bound identity alias.
                 */
                witness = 1;
            }
        }
        prior = node;
        node = node->next;
    }
    if (!witness || own_current || kind != history->association.kind
            || first_related != selection->related || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    /* related may be LAST. This is final settlement, not REUSE/seed/RESTORE.
     * No node/next/source/State/setup/View read follows the first release.
     * Parent's independent extra/query occurrences remain parent's debts.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

static int
reno_loader_try_finish_own_current_multiple_keep(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, PyObject *original_entry_record,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *node;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *prior = NULL;
    PyObject *first_related = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordQueryKind kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE;
    RenoState *state;
    PyObject *inner;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int witness = 0;
    int own_current = 0;
    int same_loader;
    int same_dictionary;
    int same_bound;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL
            || source->owner == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL
            || selection == NULL || selection->original_class == NULL
            || selection->query == NULL || selection->related == NULL
            || selection->candidate_bound != NULL || selection->observed != 1
            || selection->present != 1 || selection->current == NULL
            || original_previous_present != 1 || original_previous != selection->current
            || (original_entry_record != NULL && original_entry_record != selection->related)
            || !reno_loader_setup_pristine_raw(setup)
            || (setup->related_owned != NULL && setup->related_owned != selection->related)) { return 0; }
    history = &selection->history;
    if (history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied
            || history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) { return 0; }
    state = source->state;
    if (state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0 || state->controls.record_draining
            || state->controls.record_exit_mode != RENO_RECORD_EXIT_NONE
            || state->arena.install.proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 20, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
            || selection->original_class != state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(selection->original_class, &PyType_Type)
            || Py_TYPE(actual_loader) != (PyTypeObject *)selection->original_class
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || !exact_ascii_name(selection->query, "exec_module", 11)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(selection->current, &PyMethod_Type)
            || PyMethod_GET_SELF(selection->current) != actual_loader) { return 0; }
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)selection->original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    /* COMPLETE raw scan, no NEW/callout/release and no saved next across one.
     * FIRST bits describe FIRST only. Require exactly ONE actual own-current
     * Record and recognized alias witnesses; keep scanning after either.
     * Unknown/cancelled/invalid later related nodes must veto this consumer.
     */
    node = state->controls.record_head;
    while (node != NULL) {
        if (Py_TYPE((PyObject *)node) != (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.record_type
                || node->linked != 1 || node->registry_owner_state != state
                || node->origin_state != state || node->prev != prior
                || node->module_lifetime != source->module
                || node->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
                || node->retired_error_class != state->arena.known.roots[97]
                || node->original_loader == NULL || node->loader_dict == NULL
                || !PyDict_Check(node->loader_dict)
                || node->attribute_key == NULL || !exact_ascii_name(node->attribute_key, "exec_module", 11)
                || node->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || node->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || node->previous_present > 1
                || (node->previous_present && node->previous_value == NULL)
                || (!node->previous_present && node->previous_value != NULL)
                || node->restore_cancelled > 1 || node->store_attempted > 1
                || node->store_returned > 1 || node->effect_observed > 1
                || node->restore_attempted > 1 || node->restore_returned > 1
                || node->restore_effect_observed > 1) { return 0; }
        same_loader = node->original_loader == actual_loader;
        same_dictionary = node->loader_dict == dictionary;
        same_bound = selection->current != NULL && node->installed_bound != NULL
            && selection->current == node->installed_bound;
        if (same_loader || same_dictionary || same_bound) {
            if (kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) {
                first_related = (PyObject *)node;
                kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE;
            } else {
                kind = RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE;
            }
            if (node->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || node->restore_cancelled
                    || node->store_attempted != 1 || node->store_returned != 1
                    || node->effect_observed != 1 || node->restore_attempted
                    || node->restore_returned || node->restore_effect_observed
                    || node->installed_bound == NULL
                    || !Py_IS_TYPE(node->installed_bound, &PyMethod_Type)
                    || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, node->original_loader)) { return 0; }
            inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(node->installed_bound);
            if (!reno_loader_created_dispatch_matches_raw(node, node->original_loader,
                    inner, node->installed_bound)) { return 0; }
            if (same_loader && same_dictionary && same_bound) {
                if (own_current || !Py_IS_TYPE(inner, &PyCFunction_Type)
                        || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_self != (PyObject *)node
                        || ((PyCFunctionObject *)inner)->m_ml != &reno_loader_inner_method) { return 0; }
                own_current = 1; /* no positive early return; all remaining nodes still checked */
            } else if (same_loader || same_dictionary || same_bound) {
                /* same loader: observed replacement/deletion or older dict;
                 * other loader: shared dict or a true bound identity alias.
                 */
                witness = 1;
            }
        }
        prior = node;
        node = node->next;
    }
    if (!witness || !own_current || kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE
            || kind != history->association.kind
            || first_related != selection->related || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    /* Normal preservation of an already real current binding, not a new
     * source/seed/RESTORE grant. Only setup.related can be nonNULL; its SAME
     * occurrence has the parent's independent fresh FIRST related NEW.
     * That covers this NONLAST release under normal reference primitives.
     * Parent extras remain parent debts and may be LAST at their own drain.
     * No node/next/source/State/setup/View reads follow the first release.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status;
}

/* Normal cancellation of THIS actual already-cancelled/terminal candidate.
 * Initial first is NULL; unadmitted API errors are NOT cancellation and cannot
 * enter. No exception is manufactured to borrow the escaping-first abort.
 * All real stage/tuple/body guards precede any owning MOVE. This does not
 * resolve an arbitrary changed-but-still-live candidate or resume a setter.
 * The actual independent candidate guard covers clear_sources' final phase
 * read. No State/mode/arena authentication is attempted from detached payloads.
 * Actual cleanup errors are adopted, later cleanup cannot replace that first.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_cancelled_setup(RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_candidate;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || selection == NULL || selection->history.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (setup->prepared_owned != NULL && setup->record_owned != NULL)
            || setup->mutation.captured > 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, *first_owned)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* These are the real producer's owning-slot milestones, not the current
     * Record phase. Callbacks may already have cleared/retired the candidate.
     * A failed query may own related without committing its scalar current.
     */
    switch (setup->stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT:
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED:
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
    if (!setup->mutation.captured) {
        if (setup->mutation.previous_present
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
                || setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (setup->stage < RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
                || (setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
                || (!setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    actual_candidate = setup->record_owned != NULL
        ? setup->record_owned : setup->prepared_owned;
    if (actual_candidate == NULL) { return 0; }
    if (actual_candidate != NULL) {
        candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_candidate;
        /* Permanent lifetime fields survive source detach. The actual local
         * owning covers the BODY, including clear_sources' final phase read;
         * it does not keep payloads present or prevent a reentrant clear.
         */
        if (candidate->module_lifetime == NULL || candidate->retired_error_class == NULL
                || candidate->origin_state == NULL
                || candidate->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT
                || candidate->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || candidate->restore_cancelled > 1
                || (!candidate->restore_cancelled
                    && candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED
                    && candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED)
                || (candidate->linked
                    && candidate->registry_owner_state != candidate->origin_state)
                || (!candidate->linked && (candidate->registry_owner_state != NULL
                    || candidate->prev != NULL || candidate->next != NULL))) { return 0; }
    }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    if (candidate != NULL) {
        /* Preserve an already RETIRED terminal state, otherwise fail this
         * candidate. Existing clear cancels/unlinks/detaches before release,
         * breaks the installed-bound cycle and keeps actual store/restore
         * attempted/returned/effect facts. It performs no dictionary restore.
         * A dictionary or external alias may still retain the failed method.
         */
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED) {
            candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
        }
        reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    candidate = NULL;
    actual_candidate = NULL;
    /* No further setup/source/State/Record/payload reads. related is ONLY
     * this activation's independent query guard, even when it aliases this
     * candidate. Never explicitly cancel a different queried Record. Every
     * equal-pointer occurrence remains a separate debt; releases may be LAST.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* genuine CANCELLED/CLEAR_ONLY; cleanup error stays actual */
}

/* Actual absent and once-only present preparation on the native route.
 * Every other entry/current association retains complete selection; it
 * is never uniformly rejected/succeeded or rewrapped as an original value.
 * Parent owns all borrowed operands/context and the entry Record throughout.
 */
/* Candidate-local mismatch settlement on the SAME native activation. The
 * actual loader has a DIFFERENT backing NOW; no key/current observation or
 * association receipt is needed or promoted to factory-key authority. Actual
 * original source/layout/GIL/registry liveness and reference/cleanup contracts
 * precede these raw reads. Pointer/scalar checks only reject inconsistency.
 * No dictionary is written: external aliases may retain this failed method.
 * This is not normal retirement/RESTORE, install/reuse success or full selection.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_rebacked_setup(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate;
    PyObject *actual_candidate;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL
            || source->owner == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || setup == NULL || selection == NULL
            || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || selection->history.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || (setup->prepared_owned != NULL && setup->record_owned != NULL)
            || setup->mutation.captured > 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, NULL)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || !reno_ws_known_status(source->state, 97, 1)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }

    /* Milestones describe actual constructor/owning history, never a promise
     * that callbacks left the Record payload intact. NONE has no local product
     * to fail and remains with the existing pristine KEEP/full child.
     */
    switch (setup->stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT:
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED:
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.captured != 1) { return 0; }
        break;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
    if (!setup->mutation.captured) {
        if (setup->mutation.previous_present
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (setup->stage < RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned != actual_loader
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != dictionary
                || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
                || (setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
                || (!setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    actual_candidate = setup->record_owned != NULL ? setup->record_owned : setup->prepared_owned;
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(actual_candidate, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_candidate;
    if (candidate->module_lifetime != source->module || candidate->origin_state != source->state
            || candidate->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || candidate->retired_error_class != source->state->arena.known.roots[97]
            || candidate->original_loader != actual_loader || candidate->loader_dict != dictionary
            || candidate->attribute_key == NULL || candidate->restore_cancelled
            || candidate->previous_present > 1
            || (candidate->previous_present && candidate->previous_value == NULL)
            || (!candidate->previous_present && candidate->previous_value != NULL)
            || candidate->linked > 1
            || (candidate->linked && candidate->registry_owner_state != candidate->origin_state)
            || (!candidate->linked && (candidate->registry_owner_state != NULL
                || candidate->prev != NULL || candidate->next != NULL))) { return 0; }
    if (setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT) {
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT || candidate->linked
                || candidate->installed_bound != NULL) { return 0; }
    } else if (setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED || setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND) {
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_PREPARED || candidate->linked
                || candidate->installed_bound != NULL) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (candidate->attribute_key != setup->mutation.key_owned
                || candidate->previous_present != setup->mutation.previous_present
                || candidate->previous_value != setup->mutation.previous_owned
                || candidate->installed_bound != setup->mutation.bound_owned) { return 0; }
        if (setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED) {
            if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING || candidate->linked) { return 0; }
        } else if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || candidate->linked != 1) { return 0; }
    }

    /* A NEW raw backing observation in this continuous no-callout span, even
     * when an earlier producer entered and invalidated the parent's View.
     * NEEDS_COMPAT/ERROR/SAME are unmatched, not proof of external replacement.
     * No old current/query/related pointer is read as selection authority.
     */
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.known.roots[20], dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_DIFFERENT || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned); /* ELEVEN occurrences MOVE/NULL */
    *handled = 1; /* no unhandled exit after any owning MOVE */
    candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
    /* Original ADR candidate-local mismatch: cancel/unlink/detach before
     * first release. No RESTORE, second setter or history reset. The actual
     * candidate guard remains in owned throughout this potentially reentrant
     * clear, including its final phase read. External old/new dicts and aliases
     * are not edited; natural releases may run arbitrary callbacks.
     */
    reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    candidate = NULL;
    actual_candidate = NULL;
    /* No source/State/Record/View/setup read after this point. A different
     * related Record is only a query guard: never explicitly cancel it. Every
     * alias occurrence is settled separately; the parent's four extras/query
     * remain borrowed and parent-owned through this entire consumer.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* local mismatch settled; never INSTALLED/REUSED/RESTORED */
}

/* NEW actual current fact after an actual normal unwatched STORE return.
 * Original writer receipts, actual returned bit and every input owning stay
 * intact. This private SAME-parent producer has no local owning debt. Only
 * the reused registration consumer may call out; its actual consumer_entered
 * history, not an old View, governs all later raw/complete-selector duties.
 */
static int
reno_loader_resume_returned_effect_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned,
    int *registration_dispatched)
{
    const RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoLoaderClaimedEffectOrigin origin = RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_NONE;
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;

    if (registration_dispatched == NULL) { return 0; }
    *registration_dispatched = 0;
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || setup == NULL || selection == NULL
            || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || selection->history.unadmitted_return
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured != 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != actual_loader
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != dictionary || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
            || (setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
            || (!setup->mutation.previous_present && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    history = &selection->history;
    if (mutation->previous_present != 0 || mutation->previous_owned != NULL
            || selection->original_class != mutation->original_class_owned
            || selection->query != mutation->key_owned
            || selection->candidate_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || selection->observed != 1 || selection->present != 1
            || selection->current != mutation->bound_owned || selection->related != NULL
            || history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied != 1
            || history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->store_attempted != 1 || record->store_returned != 1 || record->effect_observed != 0
            || !reno_loader_claimed_effect_origin_raw(setup, &origin)
            || (origin != RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_ABSENT_UNWATCHED
                && origin != RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_RETAINED_UNWATCHED
                && origin != RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_BOUND_UNWATCHED
                && origin != RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER_UNWATCHED
                && origin != RENO_LOADER_EFFECT_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_PARTIAL_UNWATCHED)) { return 0; }
    context.source = source;
    context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.mutation = mutation;
    context.preparation = NULL;
    context.absent = 1;
    context.registration = 1;
    context.attempt_started = 1;
    context.cancelled = 0;
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_install_eligible_effect_raw(&context, 0)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)) { return 0; }

    /* This is a NEW real current observation with the independent actual
     * factory key and constructor product, not a rewritten writer receipt.
     * Normal STORE return is separately already true. No callback occurred
     * since the current/NONE/source span; never set returned from this value.
     */
    record->effect_observed = 1;
    *registration_dispatched = 1;
    record = NULL;
    mutation = NULL;
    history = NULL;
    context.source = NULL;
    context.record_guard = NULL;
    context.mutation = NULL;
    /* The E0 attempt at the earlier registration gate was pure/unentered.
     * This actual E1 call can enter only the original once consumer, which
     * performs its OWN ObserveInstallBound and typed permit. No owning release,
     * observation or error construction follows its final registration here.
     */
    return reno_loader_resume_claimed_registration_once(source, actual_loader,
        dictionary, setup, selection, first_owned);
}

/* Actual attempted candidate, SAME backing, freshly OBSERVED current displaced.
 * This is candidate-local CLEAR_ONLY. No dictionary restore or other Record
 * cancellation is authorized by current/query/related ownership. Caller keeps
 * the View's four actual roots and actual key alive through this whole call.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_displaced_attempt_setup(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderSelectionView *selection, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    const RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL
            || source->owner == NULL || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL
            || !PyDict_Check(dictionary) || setup == NULL || selection == NULL
            || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED && setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED)
            || setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL || setup->bound_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.captured != 1
            || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return) { return 0; }
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    history = &selection->history;
    if (mutation->original_class_owned == NULL || mutation->loader_owned != actual_loader
            || mutation->dictionary_owned != dictionary || mutation->key_owned == NULL
            || mutation->bound_owned == NULL
            || (mutation->previous_present && mutation->previous_owned == NULL)
            || (!mutation->previous_present && mutation->previous_owned != NULL)
            || selection->original_class != mutation->original_class_owned
            || selection->query != mutation->key_owned
            || selection->candidate_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || selection->observed != 1 || selection->present > 1
            || ((selection->current != NULL) != (selection->present != 0))
            || (selection->present && selection->current == mutation->bound_owned)
            || history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied != 1
            || (history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
                && history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE
                && history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || mutation->original_class_owned != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !PyUnicode_CheckExact(mutation->key_owned)
            || !exact_ascii_name(mutation->key_owned, "exec_module", 11)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }

    candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (candidate->module_lifetime != source->module || candidate->origin_state != source->state
            || candidate->retired_error_class == NULL || candidate->restore_cancelled
            || candidate->owner_proxy != (PyObject *)source->owner
            || candidate->original_loader != actual_loader || candidate->loader_dict != dictionary
            || candidate->attribute_key != mutation->key_owned
            || candidate->installed_bound != mutation->bound_owned
            || candidate->previous_present != mutation->previous_present
            || candidate->previous_value != mutation->previous_owned
            || candidate->store_attempted != 1 || candidate->store_returned > 1
            || candidate->effect_observed > 1
            || candidate->linked > 1
            || (candidate->linked && candidate->registry_owner_state != candidate->origin_state)
            || (!candidate->linked && (candidate->registry_owner_state != NULL
                || candidate->prev != NULL || candidate->next != NULL))) { return 0; }
    if (setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED) {
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING || candidate->linked) { return 0; }
    } else if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_ACTIVE || candidate->linked != 1
            || candidate->store_returned != 1 || candidate->effect_observed != 1) { return 0; }
    /* Reconfirm SAME backing in this raw span. An old effect bit, including
     * zero, never decides current displacement or authorizes another STORE.
     * No current inner __module__/dispatch check authenticates this cleanup.
     */
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return 0; }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned); /* ELEVEN positions MOVE/NULL */
    *handled = 1; /* no owning can return to an unhandled parent */
    candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
    reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    candidate = NULL;
    mutation = NULL;
    history = NULL;
    /* No setup/source/State/Record/View read after this drain begins. A
     * related guard may refer to another Record; only release that occurrence.
     * Installed external aliases may retain our failed bound legitimately.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first == NULL ? 0 : -1;
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return status; /* CLEAR_ONLY, never INSTALLED/REUSED/RESTORED */
}

/* Explicit normal policy for an entered, still-BOUND receiver. Historical
 * COMPAT/CHANGED/CANCELLED is not completion. This SAME child may abandon only
 * after its OWN actual-key Current, whole NONE, preparation and SAME span.
 * All five local owning occurrences settle on every return. Caller retains
 * its original input roots and proves all earlier extras drained/not entered.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_displaced_bound_setup(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *observation, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner observed = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView actual = {0};
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionHistory empty_history = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context = {0};
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundOrigin origin = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NONE;
    const RenoLoaderObservedBoundResumeResult *resume;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    PyObject *key_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (observation == NULL || observation->consumer_entered) { return 0; }
    *observation = empty_history; /* distinct caller-zero SCALAR output only */
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || original_previous_present > 1
            || (original_previous_present && original_previous == NULL)
            || (!original_previous_present && original_previous != NULL)
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->bound_owned == NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_observed_bound_origin_raw(setup, original_previous_present, &origin)
            || (origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_PARTIAL
                && origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)) { return 0; }
    resume = &setup->observed_bound_resume;
    if (resume->consumer_entered != 1 || resume->previous_present != original_previous_present
            || resume->origin != origin || resume->observation.unadmitted_return
            || (resume->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
                && resume->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED
                && resume->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED)
            || resume->claim_completed || resume->install_called || resume->installation.primitive_called
            || resume->unwatched_called || resume->unwatched_returned || resume->conditional_called
            || resume->registration.observation_called) { return 0; }

    candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (candidate->attribute_key == NULL) { return 0; }
    view.original_class = source->state->arena.known.roots[20];
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader; view.dictionary = dictionary;
