    view.previous = original_previous; view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = candidate->attribute_key;
    view.inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(setup->bound_owned);
    view.bound = setup->bound_owned; view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    context.source = source; context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.preparation = &view; context.absent = original_previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    first = *first_owned; *first_owned = NULL;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto drain; }
    key_owned = Py_NewRef(view.query); /* independent actual factory-key root */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { goto drain; }
    /* No payload/class loan crosses the new potentially reentrant observation.
     * Original inputs remain independently parent-owned; bound has its slot.
     */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL;
    candidate = NULL; resume = NULL;
    reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary, key_owned, &observed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL || observed.history.unadmitted_return) { goto drain; }
    reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
        key_owned, setup->bound_owned, &observed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL || observed.history.unadmitted_return) { goto drain; }
    reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&observed, key_owned, &actual);
    history = &actual.history;
    if (actual.observed != 1 || actual.present > 1
            || ((actual.current != NULL) != (actual.present != 0))
            || (actual.present == original_previous_present && actual.current == original_previous)
            || (actual.present && actual.current == setup->bound_owned)
            || actual.query != key_owned || actual.related != NULL
            || actual.candidate_bound != setup->bound_owned
            || history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied != 1 || history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || actual.original_class != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)) { goto drain; }
    /* Rebuild solely from independent inputs and this NEW Owner. Preparation
     * separately excludes historical previous/bound aliases; NONE above is the
     * whole association for actual fresh Current and actual candidate product.
     * A callback-cleared key/payload is never restored from these roots.
     */
    view.original_class = actual.original_class;
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader; view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous; view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = key_owned; view.inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(setup->bound_owned);
    view.bound = setup->bound_owned; view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    context.source = source; context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.preparation = &view; context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto drain; }
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)actual.original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto drain; }
    /* Decision point: genuine new mismatching Current, full NONE, original
     * source/products/tuple and PREPARED unlinked A0/R0/E0/restore0 all hold.
     * This attempt abandons only its own candidate; no dictionary write or
     * restore. Any later cleanup callback is after the decision, never retry.
     */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL; context.source = NULL;
    actual.original_class = NULL; actual.query = NULL; actual.current = NULL;
    actual.candidate_bound = NULL; actual.related = NULL;
    history = NULL; resume = NULL;
    candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    *handled = 1;
    candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
    reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    candidate = NULL;
drain:
    /* Full SCALAR history survives every local cleanup and every return.
     * All view/context loans end before the first possibly-LAST local release.
     * After handled, no source/State/setup/Record/payload read remains here.
     */
    *observation = observed.history;
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL; context.source = NULL;
    actual.original_class = NULL; actual.query = NULL; actual.current = NULL;
    actual.candidate_bound = NULL; actual.related = NULL;
    history = NULL; resume = NULL; candidate = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    status = first != NULL || observation->unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first; first = NULL;
    return status; /* handled 0 is unmatched; handled 1 is this explicit policy */
}


/* A distinct actual stage AFTER the old bound receiver has entered. Only
 * fresh Current==historical previous/presence plus whole NONE permits claim.
 * Old receipts remain immutable. All FIVE local roots drain before ANY writer;
 * true CLAIMED/STORED and the new scalar receipt survive every unmatched exit.
 */
static int
reno_loader_continue_entered_bound_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *original_previous,
    unsigned char original_previous_present, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult *result, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult empty_result = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner observed = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView actual = {0};
    RenoLoaderExistingPreparationView view = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context = {0};
    RenoLoaderObservedBoundOrigin origin = RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_NONE;
    const RenoLoaderObservedBoundResumeResult *resume;
    const RenoLoaderSelectionHistory *history;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record = NULL;
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    PyObject *key_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_bound = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status = 0;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (result == NULL || result->consumer_entered) { return 0; }
    *result = empty_result; /* caller's distinct aggregate-zero SCALARS only */
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_Check(dictionary)
            || setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || original_previous_present > 1
            || (original_previous_present && original_previous == NULL)
            || (!original_previous_present && original_previous != NULL)
            || setup->stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND || setup->prepared_owned != NULL
            || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->bound_owned == NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.captured || setup->mutation.previous_present
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.consumer_entered
            || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_observed_bound_origin_raw(setup, original_previous_present, &origin)
            || (origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_PARTIAL
                && origin != RENO_LOADER_BOUND_ORIGIN_OBSERVED_INNER)
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)) { return 0; }
    resume = &setup->observed_bound_resume;
    if (resume->consumer_entered != 1 || resume->previous_present != original_previous_present
            || resume->origin != origin || resume->observation.unadmitted_return
            || (resume->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_COMPAT
                && resume->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CHANGED
                && resume->disposition != RENO_LOADER_EXISTING_PREFIX_CANCELLED)
            || resume->claim_completed || resume->install_called || resume->installation.primitive_called
            || resume->unwatched_called || resume->unwatched_returned || resume->conditional_called
            || resume->registration.observation_called) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->attribute_key == NULL) { return 0; }
    view.original_class = source->state->arena.known.roots[20];
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader; view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous; view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = record->attribute_key; view.inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(setup->bound_owned);
    view.bound = setup->bound_owned; view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    context.source = source; context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.preparation = &view; context.absent = original_previous_present ? 0 : 1;
    first = *first_owned; *first_owned = NULL;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto drain; }
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    result->previous_present = original_previous_present; result->origin = origin;
    key_owned = Py_NewRef(view.query); /* actual factory-key independent root */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL) { goto drain; }
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL;
    record = NULL; resume = NULL;
    reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary, key_owned, &observed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL || observed.history.unadmitted_return) { goto drain; }
    reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
        key_owned, setup->bound_owned, &observed);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first != NULL || observed.history.unadmitted_return) { goto drain; }
    reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&observed, key_owned, &actual);
    if (actual.observed != 1 || actual.present != original_previous_present
            || actual.current != original_previous) { goto drain; }
    result->actual_current_matched = 1;
    history = &actual.history;
    if (actual.query != key_owned || actual.related != NULL
            || actual.candidate_bound != setup->bound_owned
            || history->consumer_entered != 1 || history->qualified != 1
            || history->api_called != 1 || history->api_returned != 1
            || history->permit_cancelled || history->unadmitted_return
            || history->outcome != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_SELECTION_OBSERVED
            || history->association_consumer_entered != 1
            || history->association_query_entered != 1 || history->association_query_returned != 1
            || history->association_query_completed != 1 || history->association_query_status != 1
            || history->association_before_query_cancelled || history->association_backing_checked != 1
            || history->association_backing_relation != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME
            || history->association_candidate_supplied != 1 || history->association.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || actual.original_class != source->state->arena.known.roots[20]
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->bound_owned, &PyMethod_Type)) { goto drain; }
    result->actual_association_none = 1;
    view.original_class = actual.original_class;
    view.actual_loader = actual_loader; view.dictionary = dictionary;
    view.previous = original_previous; view.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    view.query = key_owned; view.inner = PyMethod_GET_FUNCTION(setup->bound_owned);
    view.bound = setup->bound_owned; view.stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND;
    context.source = source; context.record_guard = setup->record_owned;
    context.preparation = &view; context.cancelled = 0;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto drain; }
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)actual.original_class, dictionary);
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto drain; }
    /* Full fresh source/products/previous/NONE/preparation is continuous.
     * End loans, MOVE the actual bound, and capture original tuple BEFORE
     * releasing even one observer/key root. No old receipt is rewritten.
     */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL; context.source = NULL;
    actual.original_class = NULL; actual.query = NULL; actual.current = NULL;
    actual.candidate_bound = NULL; actual.related = NULL;
    history = NULL;
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    actual_bound = setup->bound_owned;
    record->installed_bound = setup->bound_owned; setup->bound_owned = NULL;
    record->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING; setup->stage = RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED;
    result->claim_completed = 1;
    setup->mutation.original_class_owned = Py_NewRef(observed.original_class_owned);
    setup->mutation.loader_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_loader);
    setup->mutation.dictionary_owned = Py_NewRef(dictionary);
    setup->mutation.key_owned = Py_NewRef(key_owned);
    setup->mutation.bound_owned = Py_NewRef(actual_bound);
    setup->mutation.previous_owned = Py_XNewRef(original_previous);
    setup->mutation.previous_present = original_previous_present;
    setup->mutation.captured = 1;
drain:
    result->observation = observed.history; /* complete independent SCALARS */
    view.original_class = NULL; view.actual_loader = NULL; view.dictionary = NULL;
    view.previous = NULL; view.query = NULL; view.inner = NULL; view.bound = NULL;
    context.preparation = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL; context.source = NULL;
    actual.original_class = NULL; actual.query = NULL; actual.current = NULL;
    actual.candidate_bound = NULL; actual.related = NULL;
    history = NULL; resume = NULL; record = NULL; actual_bound = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* All local FIVE settle on every owning path, BEFORE writer/registration.
     * On the fresh claim path, captured original tuple/parent roots separately
     * cover class/current/candidate/key and related is NULL: NONLAST premises.
     * On unmatched paths LAST/callback/new first remains fully possible.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&observed.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (observed.history.unadmitted_return) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
    if (first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return || !result->claim_completed) { goto finish; }
    if (!original_previous_present) {
        result->unwatched_called = 1;
        status = reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(source, actual_loader,
            dictionary, setup->mutation.bound_owned, setup);
        result->unwatched_returned = 1; result->unwatched_status = status;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (status < 0 || first != NULL) { goto finish; }
        if (status == 1) {
            result->unwatched_success_checked = 1;
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, setup, &first, handled);
            goto finish; /* actual handled -> scalar/error transport ONLY */
        }
        if (status == 0) {
            result->conditional_called = 1;
            status = reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(source, setup, &first);
            result->conditional_returned = 1; result->conditional_status = status;
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (status < 0 || first != NULL || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
                    || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return) { goto finish; }
            if (setup->absent_install.consumer_entered == 1
                    && setup->absent_install.primitive_called == 1
                    && setup->absent_install.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
                    && setup->absent_install.progress.effect_committed == 1
                    && reno_loader_registration_finished_raw(&setup->absent_install.registration)) {
                result->conditional_success_checked = 1;
                status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, setup, &first, handled);
            }
        }
        goto finish;
    }
    result->install_called = 1;
    status = reno_loader_install_existing_once(source, setup->record_owned,
        &setup->mutation, &first, &result->installation);
    result->install_returned = 1; result->install_status = status;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (status < 0 || first != NULL || result->installation.unadmitted_return) { goto finish; }
    if (result->installation.primitive_called == 1
            && result->installation.outcome == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_INSTALL_INSTALLED
            && result->installation.progress.effect_committed == 1) {
        result->registration_called = 1;
        status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup, &first, &result->registration);
        result->registration_returned = 1; result->registration_status = status;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (status < 0 || first != NULL || result->registration.unadmitted_return) { goto finish; }
        /* FIRST typed nonNULL core chain: THIS real present writer -> registration
         * -> success, with no owning release/new observation/callback between.
         * The receipt is not reusable at any later child continuation.
         */
        result->direct_success_checked = 1;
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_registered_success(source, setup, &first, handled,
            &result->registration);
    }
finish:
    /* In particular after core handled, no source/setup/Record/payload/View
     * access or owning cleanup remains. Actual scalar/first transport only.
     * Unmatched keeps the true CLAIMED/STORED stage, ELEVEN and tuple in child.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return || result->observation.unadmitted_return
        || result->installation.unadmitted_return || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first; first = NULL;
    return status; /* status0 alone is never complete: caller must check handled */
}


/* A separate real once-stage for actual r1515 unwatched A1/R1/E1, never a
 * replay of its STORE/conditional/registration. No NEW or local object debt.
 * Original module/entered/input and ELEVEN tuple/body roots cover this call.
 */
static int
reno_loader_resume_entered_bound_registration_once(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup,
    const RenoLoaderEnteredBoundContinuationResult *continuation,
    RenoLoaderEnteredBoundRegistrationResumeResult *result, PyObject **first_owned, int *handled)
{
    RenoLoaderEnteredBoundRegistrationResumeResult empty = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordMutationOwned *mutation;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *record;
    RenoSpecAttr312InstallContext context = {0};
    RenoSpecAttr312BackingRelation backing;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    int status = 0;

    if (handled == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    if (result == NULL || result->consumer_entered) { return 0; }
    *result = empty; /* distinct caller-zero SCALARS only */
    if (source == NULL || source->state == NULL || source->module == NULL || source->owner == NULL
            || actual_loader == NULL || dictionary == NULL || setup == NULL || continuation == NULL
            || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || !reno_loader_entered_bound_unwatched_history_raw(setup, continuation)
            || setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL || setup->inner_owned != NULL
            || setup->bound_owned != NULL || setup->related_owned != NULL
            || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.loader_owned != actual_loader
            || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != dictionary || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
            || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || !reno_loader_binding_source_fresh_install_raw(source, actual_loader)
            || !reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(setup->record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)) { return 0; }
    record = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup->record_owned;
    if (record->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INSTALLING || record->restore_cancelled
            || record->linked || record->registry_owner_state != NULL || record->prev != NULL || record->next != NULL
            || record->store_attempted != 1 || record->store_returned != 1 || record->effect_observed != 1
            || record->restore_attempted || record->restore_returned || record->restore_effect_observed) { return 0; }
    mutation = &setup->mutation;
    context.source = source; context.record_guard = setup->record_owned; context.mutation = mutation;
    context.registration = 1; context.attempt_started = 1; context.absent = 1;
    first = *first_owned; *first_owned = NULL;
    if (!reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto finish; }
    result->backing_checked = 1;
    backing = _PyReno_SpecAttr312_OriginalBackingRelation(actual_loader,
        (PyTypeObject *)mutation->original_class_owned, dictionary);
    result->backing_relation = backing;
    if (backing == RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_ERROR || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
        goto finish;
    }
    if (backing != RENO_SPEC_ATTR312_BACKING_SAME || !reno_loader_install_permit_raw(&context)) { goto finish; }
    result->consumer_entered = 1;
    result->actual_effect_verified = 1; /* real old write facts, NOT current data */
    record = NULL; mutation = NULL;
    context.source = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL; context.mutation = NULL;
    result->registration_called = 1;
    status = reno_loader_register_after_cleanup(source, setup, &first, &result->registration);
    result->registration_returned = 1; result->registration_status = status;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (status < 0 || first != NULL || result->registration.unadmitted_return) { goto finish; }
    /* SECOND actual nonNULL core chain: this distinct real registration
     * returns directly into success, no NEW/release/observation in between.
     */
    result->direct_success_checked = 1;
    status = reno_loader_try_finish_registered_success(source, setup, &first, handled,
        &result->registration);
finish:
    /* End all automatic loans before indicator settlement. After core handled
     * these are pointer writes ONLY: no setup/source/Record/payload reads and
     * no local owning cleanup. Unhandled retains actual stage/related/tuple.
     */
    record = NULL; mutation = NULL;
    context.source = NULL; context.record_guard = NULL; context.mutation = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) { result->unadmitted_return = 1; }
    status = first != NULL || result->unadmitted_return || result->registration.unadmitted_return ? -1 : 0;
    *first_owned = first; first = NULL;
    return status; /* handled is completion; status0 alone is NEVER completion */
}


/* S1 tail rejection ONLY for the actual protected F0 function code mismatch.
 * Parent independently owns the original function/code through this child.
 * No CANCELLED receipt or full-source=false is a rejection certificate.
 * All stage/slot/body checks are consistency gates on the real producer.
 * Unmatched retains every input; matched consumes all SIXTEEN occurrences.
 */
static int
reno_loader_try_finish_source_code_rejection(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup *setup, RenoLoaderSelectionOwner *publication,
    RenoLoaderSelectionView *publication_view, PyObject **query_owned,
    RenoLoaderPublicationSourceProfile *profile, unsigned char extra_unadmitted,
    PyObject **first_owned, int *handled, unsigned char *unadmitted_return)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup owned = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner extra = {0};
    PyObject *query = NULL;
    RenoLoaderRecordObject *candidate = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_candidate;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (handled == NULL || unadmitted_return == NULL) { return 0; }
    *handled = 0;
    *unadmitted_return = 0;
    if (setup == NULL || first_owned == NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || extra_unadmitted
            || source == NULL || source->tstate == NULL
            || _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet() != source->tstate || source->in_method_call != 0
            || source->function == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->function, &PyFunction_Type)
            || source->code == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(source->code, &PyCode_Type)
            || ((PyFunctionObject *)source->function)->func_code == source->code
            || publication == NULL || publication_view == NULL
            || query_owned == NULL || profile == NULL
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_prepare.unadmitted_return || setup->absent_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
            || setup->present_install.registration.unadmitted_return
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL
            || (setup->prepared_owned != NULL && setup->record_owned != NULL)
            || setup->mutation.captured > 1 || setup->mutation.previous_present > 1
            || !reno_loader_setup_inner_debt_matches_raw(setup, *first_owned)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* These are the real producer's owning-slot milestones, not the current
     * Record phase. Callbacks may already have cleared/retired the candidate.
     * A failed query may own related without committing its scalar current.
     */
    switch (setup->stage) {
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_NONE:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_INIT:
        if (setup->prepared_owned == NULL || setup->record_owned != NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_TRACKED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_BOUND:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned == NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED:
    case RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED:
        if (setup->prepared_owned != NULL || setup->record_owned == NULL
                || setup->bound_owned != NULL) { return 0; }
        break;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
    if (!setup->mutation.captured) {
        if (setup->mutation.previous_present
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                || setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL
                || setup->stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED) { return 0; }
    } else {
        if (setup->stage < RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED
                || setup->mutation.original_class_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.loader_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.dictionary_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.key_owned == NULL
                || setup->mutation.bound_owned == NULL
                || (setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned == NULL)
                || (!setup->mutation.previous_present
                    && setup->mutation.previous_owned != NULL)) { return 0; }
    }
    actual_candidate = setup->record_owned != NULL
        ? setup->record_owned : setup->prepared_owned;
    if (actual_candidate != NULL) {
        candidate = (RenoLoaderRecordObject *)actual_candidate;
        /* Permanent lifetime fields survive source detach. The actual local
         * owning covers the BODY, including clear_sources' final phase read;
         * it does not keep payloads present or prevent a reentrant clear.
         */
        if (candidate->module_lifetime == NULL || candidate->retired_error_class == NULL
                || candidate->origin_state == NULL
                || candidate->phase < RENO_LOADER_RECORD_INIT
                || candidate->phase > RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED
                || candidate->restore_cancelled > 1 || candidate->linked > 1
                || (candidate->linked
                    && candidate->registry_owner_state != candidate->origin_state)
                || (!candidate->linked && (candidate->registry_owner_state != NULL
                    || candidate->prev != NULL || candidate->next != NULL))) { return 0; }
    }

    first = *first_owned;
    *first_owned = NULL;
    reno_loader_record_setup_take_raw(setup, &owned);
    /* Independent occurrences MOVE, never a shallow owner copy. End every
     * child publication loan BEFORE the first potentially calling operation.
     */
    extra.related_owned = publication->related_owned; publication->related_owned = NULL;
    extra.candidate_bound_owned = publication->candidate_bound_owned; publication->candidate_bound_owned = NULL;
    extra.output.current_owned = publication->output.current_owned; publication->output.current_owned = NULL;
    extra.original_class_owned = publication->original_class_owned; publication->original_class_owned = NULL;
    query = *query_owned; *query_owned = NULL;
    publication_view->original_class = NULL;
    publication_view->query = NULL;
    publication_view->current = NULL;
    publication_view->candidate_bound = NULL;
    publication_view->related = NULL;
    profile->registration = NULL;
    *handled = 1; /* no unmatched exit after MOVE16 */

    /* Close only THIS candidate before exception construction can call out.
     * unlink precedes FAILED, including a real STORED/linked entry. Payloads
     * stay independently owned until the real source-rejection first exists.
     */
    if (candidate != NULL) {
        candidate->restore_cancelled = 1;
        reno_record_unlink_raw(candidate);
        if (candidate->phase != RENO_LOADER_RECORD_RETIRED) {
            candidate->phase = RENO_LOADER_RECORD_FAILED;
        }
    }
    /* Parent function_guard/code_guard proved the raw code mismatch above.
     * End all source/State/payload authority; no such input is reread below.
     * Constructor OOM or another ACTUAL escaping error takes precedence over
     * subsequent cleanup. A missing indicator is protocol failure, not first.
     */
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder source unavailable");
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (first == NULL) { *unadmitted_return = 1; }
    if (candidate != NULL) {
        /* The moved prepared/record occurrence continuously owns the BODY.
         * Constructor callbacks may already have cleared it. Original clear
         * consumes current fields and preserves actual A/R/E/restore facts.
         */
        reno_record_clear_sources(candidate, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    candidate = NULL;
    actual_candidate = NULL;
    /* No further setup/source/State/Record/payload reads. related is ONLY
     * this activation's independent query guard, even when it aliases this
     * candidate. Never explicitly cancel a different queried Record. Every
     * equal-pointer occurrence remains a separate debt; releases may be LAST.
     */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.previous_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.key_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.dictionary_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.loader_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.mutation.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.inner_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.record_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&owned.prepared_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&extra.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&extra.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&extra.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&extra.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&query, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    *first_owned = first;
    first = NULL;
    return -1; /* source rejection/protocol failure, never business success */
}

static int
reno_h01_finish_loader_record_selection(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *dictionary, PyObject *previous,
    unsigned char previous_present, PyObject *entry_record,
    const RenoLoaderRecordObservation *entry_observation, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint)
{
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup setup = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner selection = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner attempted_selection = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView selection_view = {0};
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *preparation_query_owned = NULL;
    PyObject *attempted_query_owned = NULL;
    int status;
    int handled = 0;
    int preparation_unadmitted = 0;
    int selection_unadmitted = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (source == NULL || actual_spec == NULL || actual_spec == Py_None
            || actual_loader == NULL || actual_loader == Py_None
            || dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)
            || previous_present > 1 || (previous_present && previous == NULL)
            || (!previous_present && previous != NULL) || entry_observation == NULL
            || (entry_observation->kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
                && entry_observation->kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_ONE
                && entry_observation->kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_MULTIPLE)
            || ((entry_observation->kind == RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) != (entry_record == NULL))
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader selection inputs");
        return -1;
    }
    if (!reno_loader_selection_snapshot(source, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, &setup)) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (entry_record != NULL || entry_observation->kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE
            || setup.current.kind != RENO_LOADER_QUERY_NONE) {
        goto complete; /* BEFORE any new Record/key/inner/bound preparation */
    }
    if (previous_present) {
        int present_status;
        /* NEW preparation query, not a replay of the original completed
         * lookup or proof of its key identity. Keep this real NEW through
         * success/abort/full child; no release may stale final registration.
         */
        preparation_query_owned = PyUnicode_FromString("exec_module");
        if (preparation_query_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
        present_status = reno_loader_existing_prepare_install(source, actual_loader,
            dictionary, previous, preparation_query_owned, &setup, &first, &setup.present_install);
        if (present_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            setup.present_install.unadmitted_return = 1;
        }
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        goto complete; /* actual first/history; never overwrite via failed */
    }
    /* Same actual absence history, now with all five real preparation stations.
     * Keep the original unwatched -> conditional ordering after local drain.
     * No second prepare or callback-derived expected is introduced on a race.
     */
    preparation_query_owned = PyUnicode_FromString("exec_module");
    if (preparation_query_owned == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
    {
        int absent_status;
        int stored;
        absent_status = reno_loader_absent_prepare(source, actual_loader,
            dictionary, preparation_query_owned, &setup, &first, &setup.absent_prepare);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (absent_status < 0 && first == NULL) { setup.absent_prepare.unadmitted_return = 1; }
        if (first != NULL || setup.absent_prepare.unadmitted_return
                || !setup.absent_prepare.claim_completed || setup.stage != RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED) {
            goto complete;
        }
        setup.absent_prepare.unwatched_called = 1;
        stored = reno_loader_record_store_unwatched(source, actual_loader,
            dictionary, setup.mutation.bound_owned, &setup);
        setup.absent_prepare.unwatched_returned = 1;
        setup.absent_prepare.unwatched_status = stored;
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (stored < 0 || first != NULL) {
            if (first == NULL) { setup.absent_prepare.unadmitted_return = 1; }
            goto complete;
        }
        if (stored == 0) {
            setup.absent_prepare.conditional_called = 1;
            absent_status = reno_loader_try_install_claimed_absent(source, &setup, &first);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (absent_status < 0 && first == NULL) { setup.absent_prepare.unadmitted_return = 1; }
        }
    }
    /* Same actual products, mutation tuple and query guard reach the SAME
     * complete child, including store failure/race/clear. No tuple release,
     * duplicate store, false idempotency or cleanup claim occurs here.
     */
    goto complete;
changed:
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native prepared loader sources changed");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
complete:
    {
        int resume_status;
        /* Only a real retained TRACKED inner can enter. All other original
         * success/abort paths pass this pure unmatched gate without callout.
         */
        resume_status = reno_loader_resume_retained_inner_once(source, actual_loader,
            dictionary, previous, previous_present, &setup, &first);
        if (resume_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
            setup.retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return = 1;
        }
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    preparation_unadmitted = setup.absent_prepare.unadmitted_return
        || setup.retained_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
        || setup.retained_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
        || setup.retained_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
        || setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
        || setup.claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
        || setup.observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return;
    /* Success and escaping-first failure have separate real consumers.
     * A normal/no-first change still requires the full selector continuation.
     */
    status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, &setup, &first, &handled);
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_setup_abort(&setup, &first, &handled);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_unadmitted_setup(&setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        /* An already cancelled candidate does not enter a new lookup stage. */
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_cancelled_setup(&setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_rebacked_setup(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
            &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        /* ONLY after original success/actual-first abort were unhandled.
         * This new Observe can call out; never put it before the continuous
         * old post-commit-query -> success gate or reuse old setup.current.
         */
        if (first == NULL && !preparation_unadmitted
                && !setup.absent_install.unadmitted_return
                && !setup.absent_install.registration.unadmitted_return
                && !setup.present_install.unadmitted_return
                && !setup.present_install.installation.unadmitted_return
                && !setup.present_install.registration.unadmitted_return) {
            if (preparation_query_owned == NULL) {
                preparation_query_owned = PyUnicode_FromString("exec_module");
                reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
                if (preparation_query_owned == NULL && first == NULL) {
                    selection.history.unadmitted_return = 1;
                }
            }
            if (first == NULL && !selection.history.unadmitted_return) {
                reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                    preparation_query_owned, &selection);
                reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
                if (first == NULL && !selection.history.unadmitted_return) {
                    /* SAME actual private owning products, never Record/current
                     * reloading after the callback-capable Observe returned.
                     */
                    reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source,
                        actual_loader, dictionary, preparation_query_owned,
                        setup.mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                            ? setup.mutation.bound_owned : setup.bound_owned, &selection);
                    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
                }
            }
        }
        reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&selection, preparation_query_owned, &selection_view);
        selection_unadmitted = selection.history.unadmitted_return;
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
            int partial_resume_status;
            partial_resume_status = reno_loader_resume_observed_partial_once(source,
                actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present, &setup, &selection_view, &first);
            if (partial_resume_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                setup.observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            preparation_unadmitted = preparation_unadmitted
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return;
            if (setup.observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
                status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, &setup, &first, &handled);
            }
        }
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered) {
            int observed_inner_status;
            observed_inner_status = reno_loader_resume_observed_inner_once(source,
                actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first);
            if (observed_inner_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                setup.observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            preparation_unadmitted = preparation_unadmitted
                || setup.observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return;
            /* All local debts preceded final registration inside producer. */
            if (setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered) {
                status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, &setup, &first, &handled);
            }
        }
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered) {
            int observed_bound_status;
            observed_bound_status = reno_loader_resume_observed_bound_once(source,
                actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first);
            if (observed_bound_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                setup.observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            preparation_unadmitted = preparation_unadmitted
                || setup.observed_bound_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_bound_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_bound_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_inner_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_inner_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_inner_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return;
            /* New producer's final registration -> success stays continuous.
             * Never grant freshness from this scalar after a later callback.
             */
            if (setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered) {
                status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, &setup, &first, &handled);
            }
        }
        if (!handled) {
            int registration_resume_status;
            registration_resume_status = reno_loader_resume_claimed_registration_once(source,
                actual_loader, dictionary, &setup, &selection_view, &first);
            if (registration_resume_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            preparation_unadmitted = preparation_unadmitted
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.installation.unadmitted_return
                || setup.observed_partial_resume.registration.unadmitted_return;
            /* New actual registration -> immediate success, with no local debt. */
            if (setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered) {
                status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, &setup, &first, &handled);
            }
        }
        /* All actual producer registration -> immediate success spans have
         * ended before this NEW stage. Original Owner/key remain separate
         * parent debts; the new actual-key View borrows only this new Owner.
         * Observe only an actual already-attempted candidate, never replay an
         * original getter/GetDict/lookup/finder/constructor/STORE.
         */
        if (!handled && first == NULL && !preparation_unadmitted && !selection_unadmitted
                && (setup.stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_CLAIMED || setup.stage == RENO_LOADER_SETUP_STORED)
                && setup.prepared_owned == NULL && setup.inner_owned == NULL && setup.bound_owned == NULL
                && setup.record_owned != NULL && setup.mutation.captured == 1
                && setup.mutation.key_owned != NULL && setup.mutation.bound_owned != NULL
                && source != NULL && source->state != NULL
                && source->state->arena.install.record_type != NULL
                && reno_record_type_effect(source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                && Py_IS_TYPE(setup.record_owned, (PyTypeObject *)source->state->arena.install.record_type)
                && ((RenoLoaderRecordObject *)setup.record_owned)->store_attempted == 1) {
            attempted_query_owned = Py_NewRef(setup.mutation.key_owned);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (first == NULL) {
                reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                    attempted_query_owned, &attempted_selection);
                reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
                if (first == NULL && !attempted_selection.history.unadmitted_return) {
                    reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                        attempted_query_owned, setup.mutation.bound_owned, &attempted_selection);
                    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
                }
            }
            reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&attempted_selection, attempted_query_owned, &selection_view);
            selection_unadmitted = selection_unadmitted || attempted_selection.history.unadmitted_return;
        }
        /* Only this native parent's NEW actual-key Owner/View may dispatch
         * the returned-but-unobserved-effect continuation. Old successful E1
         * registration paths have already handled before this extra stage.
         */
        if (!handled && attempted_query_owned != NULL
                && attempted_selection.history.consumer_entered == 1
                && selection_view.query == attempted_query_owned) {
            int registration_dispatched = 0;
            int effect_resume_status = reno_loader_resume_returned_effect_once(source,
                actual_loader, dictionary, &setup, &selection_view, &first, &registration_dispatched);
            if (effect_resume_status < 0 && first == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
                setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return = 1;
            }
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
            preparation_unadmitted = preparation_unadmitted
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.unadmitted_return
                || setup.claimed_registration_resume.registration.unadmitted_return;
            if (registration_dispatched && setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered) {
                status = reno_loader_try_finish_native_success(source, &setup, &first, &handled);
            }
        }
        /* Any entered normal producer may have called out. The
         * original View is then HISTORY, never fresh KEEP authority.
         * Unentered original consumers retain their fresh raw route;
         * unresolved stage/effect goes to the ORIGINAL complete child.
         */
        /* New observation may produce actual first or cancel the candidate. */
        if (!handled) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_setup_abort(&setup, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_unadmitted_setup(&setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_cancelled_setup(&setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_rebacked_setup(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_displaced_attempt_setup(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_pristine_reuse(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                previous, previous_present, entry_record, &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_normal_keep(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_external_alias_keep(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled && !setup.observed_bound_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_inner_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.claimed_registration_resume.consumer_entered
                && !setup.observed_partial_resume.consumer_entered) {
            status = reno_loader_try_finish_own_current_multiple_keep(source, actual_loader, dictionary,
                previous, previous_present, entry_record,
                &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
        if (!handled) {
            status = reno_h01_complete_loader_record_selection(source, mode, actual_fullname,
                actual_spec, actual_loader, dictionary, previous, previous_present,
                entry_record, entry_observation, &setup, &first, target_hint, NULL,
                preparation_query_owned, &selection_view);
        }
    }
    /* End the child query loan. No further State/context/setup/candidate/
     * payload access; settle this independent actual query and error only.
     * No stale raw candidate survives child moves or this final release.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    selection_view.original_class = NULL;
    selection_view.query = NULL;
    selection_view.current = NULL;
    selection_view.candidate_bound = NULL;
    selection_view.related = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&attempted_selection.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&attempted_selection.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&attempted_selection.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&attempted_selection.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&attempted_query_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&preparation_query_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if ((preparation_unadmitted || selection_unadmitted) && status == 0) { status = -1; }
    if (status != 0 && first == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "loader selection failed without an exception");
        first = take_failure();
    }
    if (first != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return -1;
    }
    return 0; /* ONLY after COMPLETE handling; NULL slots alone are no proof */
}

/* Definition at the existing binding-compatibility handoff, after the setup
 * type and complete selector declaration. This standard lookup stage does
 * not implement the still-missing complete selection/installation body.
 */
static int
reno_h01_finish_loader_binding_compat(const RenoF0SourceContext *source,
    RenoFinderFullnameMode mode, PyObject *actual_fullname, PyObject *actual_spec,
    PyObject *actual_loader, PyObject *prepared_dict, RenoFinderTargetHint target_hint)
{
    RenoLoaderBindingCompatHistory history = {0};
    RenoLoaderRecordSetup setup = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionOwner selection = {0};
    RenoLoaderSelectionView selection_view = {0};
    PyObject *lookup_key = NULL;
    PyObject *previous = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    int status = -1; /* early changed/failed routes also reach final reporting */
    int handled = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (source == NULL || actual_spec == NULL || actual_spec == Py_None
            || actual_loader == NULL || actual_loader == Py_None
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U
                && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_P && mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_K)
            || (mode == RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname != NULL)
            || (mode != RENO_FINDER_FULLNAME_U && actual_fullname == NULL)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "invalid private loader compatibility inputs");
        return -1;
    }
    /* This is the existing ORIGINAL F0/spec source gate, without requiring
     * actual_loader's class/layout to belong to the finite native loader domain.
     * It does not certify all getters/hash/eq/reference/S1 or future source use.
     */
    if (!reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) { goto changed; }
    history.prepared_dictionary_received = prepared_dict != NULL;
    if (prepared_dict != NULL) {
        history.dictionary_is_dict = PyDict_Check(prepared_dict) ? 1U : 0U;
        if (history.dictionary_is_dict) {
            /* This added C stage constructs its OWN actual query operand.
             * It is not a captured old co_names/Record key and has a separately
             * visible allocation/reference cost. Complete compatibility and
             * identity-sensitive callbacks still require their own proof.
             */
            lookup_key = PyUnicode_FromString("exec_module");
            if (lookup_key == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
            if (!reno_spec_loader_source_fresh(source)) { goto changed; }
            history.lookup_key = lookup_key;
            history.lookup_entered = 1;
            /* Standard dict storage lookup accepts lawful dict subclasses and
             * general entry keys. The original hash/eq and natural comparison
             * releases run inside it; no intermediate error is sampled here.
             * Acquire the returned borrowed value immediately, before any
             * caller gate/release/callback. Py_None is an actual present value.
             */
            previous = Py_XNewRef(PyDict_GetItemWithError(prepared_dict, lookup_key));
            history.lookup_returned = 1;
            if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto failed; }
            history.lookup_value_observed = 1;
        }
    }
    /* New explicit current observation AFTER the completed original lookup.
     * This also reaches GENERAL: there is no ASCII snapshot prerequisite.
     * Foreign/no-GetDict/non-dict paths retain real uncalled history; do not
     * force preparation/getter/lookup merely to populate this extra View.
     */
    if (history.lookup_value_observed) {
        reno_loader_observe_selection_once(source, actual_loader, prepared_dict,
            lookup_key, &selection);
        /* Preserve the ACTUAL first, if any, without take_failure fabricating
         * one for an unadmitted ERROR/no-indicator return. Keep all output NEWs
         * until the complete child has ended its borrowed view on every path.
         */
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        if (first == NULL && !selection.history.unadmitted_return) {
            reno_loader_observe_selection_associations_once(source, actual_loader,
                prepared_dict, lookup_key, NULL, &selection);
            reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
        }
    }
    reno_loader_selection_borrow_view(&selection, lookup_key, &selection_view);
    /* No fake NONE query or call to the restricted native selector. The full
     * child sees the same prepared occurrence and actual lookup phase/result,
     * plus a separate current history. Neither replaces historical previous.
     * NULL dictionary/no observed value leaves preparation and lookup UNRUN.
     * An actual first enters abort; unadmitted no-first enters its dedicated
     * setup cleanup, never installation or default success. Other legal
     * domains still need the complete child. Each handled setup consumer
     * or full child takes the same eleven actual slots, not the extras.
     */
    status = reno_loader_try_finish_setup_abort(&setup, &first, &handled);
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_unadmitted_setup(&setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_cancelled_setup(&setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_pristine_reuse(source, actual_loader, prepared_dict,
            previous, history.lookup_value_observed && previous != NULL, NULL,
            &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_normal_keep(source, actual_loader, prepared_dict,
            &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_external_alias_keep(source, actual_loader, prepared_dict,
            &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_loader_try_finish_own_current_multiple_keep(source, actual_loader, prepared_dict,
            previous, history.lookup_value_observed && previous != NULL, NULL,
            &setup, &selection_view, &first, &handled);
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    }
    if (!handled) {
        status = reno_h01_complete_loader_record_selection(source, mode, actual_fullname,
            actual_spec, actual_loader, prepared_dict, previous,
            history.lookup_value_observed && previous != NULL,
            NULL, NULL, &setup, &first, target_hint, &history, NULL, &selection_view);
    }
    /* A handled setup consumer or the complete child settled all setup.
     * Do not inspect setup/State/context/payloads after this handoff returns.
     * Only private scalar history and caller-owned pointer/error debts remain.
     */
    reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (selection.history.unadmitted_return && status == 0) { status = -1; }
    goto cleanup;

changed:
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native loader compatibility sources changed");
    }
failed:
    first = take_failure();
cleanup:
    /* End BOTH automatic loans before the first potentially LAST release.
     * Dictionary/spec/loader/fullname/module/lease ownings belong to the parent.
     * Final release never reads source/State/setup/candidate/payloads again.
     * Each owning occurrence settles separately even when pointer-equal.
     */
    history.lookup_key = NULL;
    selection_view.original_class = NULL;
    selection_view.query = NULL;
    selection_view.current = NULL;
    selection_view.candidate_bound = NULL;
    selection_view.related = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.related_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.candidate_bound_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.output.current_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&selection.original_class_owned, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&previous, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&lookup_key, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    if (status != 0 && first == NULL) {
        /* Both setup and every parent-owned extra are now settled. Prefer
         * any ACTUAL cleanup first; create this protocol error only last.
         * No source/State/View/candidate access follows these releases.
         */
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_SystemError, "loader compatibility failed without an exception");
        first = take_failure();
    }
    if (first != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
        return -1;
    }
    return 0; /* ONLY actual success/normal handling; protocol failure stays negative */
}

/* Actual retained C roots, never output/current values, are the expected
 * inputs. Exact-dict class domain only, matching the selected raw capture.
 * Entire full-API raw/no-callback/source/lifetime envelope remains required.
 */
static int
reno_ws_source_metadata(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source)
{
    static const unsigned char raw_offsets[7] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8};
    size_t index;
    size_t ordinal;
    size_t count;
    size_t kw_cursor = 0;
    size_t cell_cursor = 0;
    size_t base_cursor = 0;
    size_t dispatch_cursor = 0;
    size_t entry_cursor = 0;
    unsigned int field;
    unsigned int fixed_slot;
    PyObject **roots = state->arena.known.roots;
    PyObject *mro;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    RenoNamedRanges *named;
    RenoDispatchCapture *dispatch;
    RenoBaseCapture *base;
    RenoClassCapture *klass;
    RenoClassEntryCapture *entry;

    if (view->header->C != 5 || !reno_ws_source_fixed(state, source)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        named = &source->named_ranges[index];
        fixed_slot = 30 + 9 * (unsigned int)index;
        if (named->function_role != index || named->kw_start != kw_cursor
                || named->cell_start != cell_cursor) { return 0; }
        for (field = 0; field < 7; ++field) {
            unsigned int at = fixed_slot + raw_offsets[field];
            int present = field >= 2 && field <= 4
                ? state->controls.function_rows[index].present[field - 2] : 1;
            if (!state->controls.function_rows[index].raw_captured[field]
                    || present < 0 || present > 1
                    || state->arena.known.owned[at] != present
                    || (roots[at] != NULL) != present) { return 0; }
        }
        if (!state->controls.function_dispatch[index].captured
                || !reno_ws_source_function(view, roots[fixed_slot], roots[fixed_slot + 1],
                    roots[fixed_slot + 2], roots[fixed_slot + 3], roots[fixed_slot + 5],
                    roots[fixed_slot + 7], roots[fixed_slot + 8],
                    state->controls.function_dispatch[index].expected, RENO_WS_FUNCTION_NAMED,
                    index, named->kw_start, named->kw_count, named->cell_start, named->cell_count)) { return 0; }
        kw_cursor += named->kw_count; /* bounded by the validated range above */
        cell_cursor += named->cell_count;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->D; ++index) {
        dispatch = &view->dispatch[index];
        if (dispatch->kw_start != kw_cursor || dispatch->cell_start != cell_cursor
                || dispatch->defaults_present > 1 || dispatch->kw_present > 1
                || dispatch->closure_present > 1) { return 0; }
        for (field = 0; field < 7; ++field) {
            int present = field == 2 ? dispatch->defaults_present
                : (field == 3 ? dispatch->kw_present : (field == 4 ? dispatch->closure_present : 1));
            if (!reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, field, present)) { return 0; }
