        }
        if (!reno_ws_source_function(view, dispatch->function, dispatch->code,
                dispatch->defaults, dispatch->kwdefaults, dispatch->closure,
                dispatch->globals, dispatch->builtins, dispatch->original_vectorcall,
                RENO_WS_FUNCTION_DISPATCH, index, dispatch->kw_start, dispatch->kw_count,
                dispatch->cell_start, dispatch->cell_count)) { return 0; }
        kw_cursor += dispatch->kw_count;
        cell_cursor += dispatch->cell_count;
    }
    if (kw_cursor != view->header->K || cell_cursor != view->header->Z) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        klass = &view->klass[index];
        mro = *source->class_roots[index].mro_slot;
        if (klass->class_role != index || klass->base_start != base_cursor
                || klass->dispatch_start != dispatch_cursor
                || klass->base_start > view->header->B
                || klass->base_count > view->header->B - klass->base_start
                || klass->dispatch_start > view->header->D
                || klass->dispatch_count > view->header->D - klass->dispatch_start
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(mro, klass->base_count)) { return 0; }
        for (ordinal = 0; ordinal < klass->base_count; ++ordinal) {
            base = &view->base[base_cursor];
            if (base->class_index != index || base->mro_index != ordinal
                    || base->entry_start != entry_cursor || base->dispatch_start != dispatch_cursor
                    || base->entry_start > view->header->E
                    || base->entry_count > view->header->E - base->entry_start
                    || base->dispatch_start > view->header->D
                    || base->dispatch_count > view->header->D - base->dispatch_start
                    || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_BASE, base_cursor, 0, 1)
                    || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_BASE, base_cursor, 3, 1)
                    || !Py_IS_TYPE(base->base_identity, &PyType_Type)
                    || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(mro, (Py_ssize_t)ordinal) != base->base_identity) { return 0; }
            dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base->base_identity);
            if (dictionary != base->dict_guard
                    || reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                    || count != base->entry_count) { return 0; }
            for (count = 0; count < base->entry_count; ++count) {
                entry = &view->entry[entry_cursor];
                if (entry->base_index != base_cursor || entry->entry_ordinal != count
                        || entry->dispatch_start != dispatch_cursor
                        || entry->dispatch_start > view->header->D
                        || entry->dispatch_count > view->header->D - entry->dispatch_start
                        || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, entry_cursor, 0, 1)
                        || !reno_ws_source_root(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, entry_cursor, 1, 1)
                        || !reno_t0_source_dict_value(dictionary, entry->key, entry->value)
                        || !reno_ws_source_dispatch_entry(view, entry_cursor)) { return 0; }
                dispatch_cursor += entry->dispatch_count;
                ++entry_cursor;
            }
            if (dispatch_cursor - base->dispatch_start != base->dispatch_count) { return 0; }
            ++base_cursor;
        }
        if (dispatch_cursor - klass->dispatch_start != klass->dispatch_count) { return 0; }
    }
    return base_cursor == view->header->B && entry_cursor == view->header->E
        && dispatch_cursor == view->header->D && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

/* All expected values below come from continuously retained private C roots.
 * Actual completed/pending tuples are read only in this single raw span.
 * No child pointer or borrowed tuple element survives a preparation callback.
 * Fixed-depth typed walkers, not recursion over an untrusted object graph.
 */
static int
reno_ws_product_pair(PyObject *actual, PyObject *key, PyObject *value)
{
    return reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 2)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) == key && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 1) == value;
}

static int
reno_ws_product_cell(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    size_t index, PyObject *actual)
{
    RenoCellCapture *cell = &view->cell[index];

    (void)source; /* T0 context has no business missing operand. */
    return cell->populated <= 1
        && reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, cell->populated ? 3 : 2)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) == cell->cell_identity
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 1) == (cell->populated ? Py_True : Py_False)
        && (!cell->populated
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 2) == cell->populated_contents);
}

static int
reno_ws_product_leaves(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    RenoWorkspaceDomain domain, size_t start, size_t count, PyObject *actual)
{
    size_t total;
    size_t index;
    PyObject *item;

    switch (domain) {
    case RENO_WS_KW: total = view->header->K; break;
    case RENO_WS_CELL: total = view->header->Z; break;
    case RENO_WS_ENTRY: total = view->header->E; break;
    default: return 0;
    }
    if (start > total || count > total - start || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, count)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        item = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, (Py_ssize_t)index);
        if (domain == RENO_WS_KW) {
            if (!reno_ws_product_pair(item, view->kw[start + index].key,
                    view->kw[start + index].value)) { return 0; }
        } else if (domain == RENO_WS_CELL) {
            if (!reno_ws_product_cell(view, source, start + index, item)) { return 0; }
        } else if (!reno_ws_product_pair(item, view->entry[start + index].key,
                view->entry[start + index].value)) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_product_dispatch(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    size_t index, PyObject *actual)
{
    RenoDispatchCapture *row = &view->dispatch[index];

    return reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 9)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) == row->function
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 1) == row->code
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 2) == (row->defaults != NULL ? row->defaults : Py_None)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 3) == (row->kwdefaults != NULL ? row->kwdefaults : Py_None)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 5) == (row->closure != NULL ? row->closure : Py_None)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 7) == row->globals
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 8) == row->builtins
        && reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_KW, row->kw_start,
            row->kw_count, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 4))
        && reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_CELL, row->cell_start,
            row->cell_count, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 6));
}

static int
reno_ws_product_base(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    size_t index, PyObject *actual)
{
    RenoBaseCapture *base = &view->base[index];

    return reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 2)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) == base->base_identity
        && reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_ENTRY, base->entry_start,
            base->entry_count, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 1));
}

static int
reno_ws_product_rows(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    int functions, size_t start, size_t count, PyObject *actual)
{
    size_t total = functions ? view->header->D : view->header->B;
    size_t index;
    PyObject *item;

    if (start > total || count > total - start || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, count)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        item = PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, (Py_ssize_t)index);
        if (functions) {
            if (!reno_ws_product_dispatch(view, source, start + index, item)) { return 0; }
        } else if (!reno_ws_product_base(view, source, start + index, item)) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_product_class(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    size_t index, PyObject *actual)
{
    RenoClassCapture *klass = &view->klass[index];

    return reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 4)
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) == *source->class_roots[index].class_slot
        && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 1) == *source->class_roots[index].mro_slot
        && reno_ws_product_rows(view, source, 0, klass->base_start,
            klass->base_count, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 2))
        && reno_ws_product_rows(view, source, 1, klass->dispatch_start,
            klass->dispatch_count, PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 3));
}

/* These are actual State products, never the source expected. Original raw
 * region/outer roots remain independently held throughout this stage.
 */
static int
reno_ws_product_fixed(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind,
    size_t index, PyObject *actual)
{
    PyObject *payload;
    RenoNamedRanges *named;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *builtin = &state->controls.builtin_exec;

    switch (kind) {
    case RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW:
    case RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS:
        if (index >= 6) { return 0; }
        named = &source->named_ranges[index];
        return kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW
            ? reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_KW,
                named->kw_start, named->kw_count, actual)
            : reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_CELL,
                named->cell_start, named->cell_count, actual);
    case RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS:
        return index < 5 && view->klass[index].row_ready
            && actual == view->klass[index].class_row_tuple
            && reno_ws_product_class(view, source, index, actual);
    case RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR:
        if (index >= 2 || !builtin->payload_captured[index] || builtin->present[index] > 1) { return 0; }
        payload = index == 0 ? source->locals_owned->builtin_self : source->locals_owned->builtin_module;
        return builtin->present[index] == (payload != NULL)
            && reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, builtin->present[index])
            && (!builtin->present[index] || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) == payload);
    default: return 0;
    }
}

static int
reno_ws_product_fixed_known(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind,
    size_t index, int ready)
{
    unsigned int slot;

    if (ready < 0 || ready > 1 || !reno_ws_known_destination(kind, index, &slot)) { return 0; }
    if (!ready) { return reno_ws_known_status(state, slot, 0); }
    return reno_ws_known_status(state, slot, 1)
        && reno_ws_product_fixed(state, view, source, kind, index, state->arena.known.roots[slot]);
}

static int
reno_ws_product_all_fixed(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source)
{
    size_t index;
    unsigned int slot;
    RenoFunctionRowControl *row;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *builtin = &state->controls.builtin_exec;

    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        row = &state->controls.function_rows[index];
        if (row->representation_ready[0] > 1 || row->representation_ready[1] > 1
                || row->row_ready != (row->representation_ready[0] && row->representation_ready[1])
                || !reno_ws_product_fixed_known(state, view, source, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW,
                    index, row->representation_ready[0])
                || !reno_ws_product_fixed_known(state, view, source, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS,
                    index, row->representation_ready[1])
                || (row->row_ready
                    && !reno_state_function_metadata_matches(state, (unsigned int)index))) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        slot = 103 + (unsigned int)index;
        if (!reno_ws_product_fixed_known(state, view, source, RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS,
                index, state->arena.known.roots[slot] != NULL)
                || (state->arena.known.roots[slot] != NULL
                    && !reno_state_class_metadata_matches(state, (unsigned int)index))) { return 0; }
    }
    if (builtin->anchor_ready[0] > 1 || builtin->anchor_ready[1] > 1
            || builtin->ready != (builtin->anchor_ready[0] && builtin->anchor_ready[1])) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_product_fixed_known(state, view, source, RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR,
                index, builtin->anchor_ready[index])) { return 0; }
    }
    return !builtin->ready || reno_state_builtin_exec_matches(state);
}

/* The actual named parent site is explicit, including EMPTY collections.
 * start/count, shared empty identity or the last tuple never choose a role.
 */
static int
reno_ws_product_pending(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    const RenoWorkspacePending *pending, int require_empty_destination)
{
    RenoWorkspaceDomain domain;
    unsigned int field;
    size_t index = pending->index;
    PyObject *actual = pending->actual_complete_borrowed;
    int matches;

    switch (pending->kind) {
    case RENO_PENDING_KW_PAIR:
        if (index >= view->header->K) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_KW; field = 2;
        matches = reno_ws_product_pair(actual, view->kw[index].key, view->kw[index].value);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_CELL_ROW:
        if (index >= view->header->Z) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_CELL; field = 1;
        matches = reno_ws_product_cell(view, source, index, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_ENTRY_PAIR:
        if (index >= view->header->E) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_ENTRY; field = 2;
        matches = reno_ws_product_pair(actual, view->entry[index].key, view->entry[index].value);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_KW:
    case RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_CELLS:
        if (index >= view->header->D) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_DISPATCH;
        field = pending->kind == RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_KW ? 7 : 8;
        matches = field == 7
            ? reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_KW,
                view->dispatch[index].kw_start, view->dispatch[index].kw_count, actual)
            : reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_CELL,
                view->dispatch[index].cell_start, view->dispatch[index].cell_count, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_ROW:
        if (index >= view->header->D) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_DISPATCH; field = 9;
        matches = reno_ws_product_dispatch(view, source, index, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_BASE_ENTRIES:
        if (index >= view->header->B) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_BASE; field = 1;
        matches = reno_ws_product_leaves(view, source, RENO_WS_ENTRY,
            view->base[index].entry_start, view->base[index].entry_count, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_BASE_ROW:
        if (index >= view->header->B) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_BASE; field = 2;
        matches = reno_ws_product_base(view, source, index, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_CLASS_BASES:
    case RENO_PENDING_CLASS_FUNCTIONS:
        if (index >= view->header->C) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_CLASS;
        field = pending->kind == RENO_PENDING_CLASS_BASES ? 0 : 1;
        matches = field == 0
            ? reno_ws_product_rows(view, source, 0,
                view->klass[index].base_start, view->klass[index].base_count, actual)
            : reno_ws_product_rows(view, source, 1,
                view->klass[index].dispatch_start, view->klass[index].dispatch_count, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_CLASS_ROW:
        if (index >= view->header->C) { return 0; }
        domain = RENO_WS_CLASS; field = 2;
        matches = reno_ws_product_class(view, source, index, actual);
        break;
    case RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW:
    case RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS:
    case RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS:
    case RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR:
        {
            unsigned int slot;
            return reno_ws_known_destination(pending->kind, index, &slot)
                && reno_ws_product_fixed(state, view, source, pending->kind, index, actual)
                && (!require_empty_destination || reno_ws_known_empty(state, slot));
        }
    default: return 0;
    }
    return matches && (!require_empty_destination
        || reno_ws_source_root(view, domain, index, field, 0));
}

static int
reno_ws_product_slot(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    RenoWorkspaceDomain domain, size_t index, unsigned int field,
    RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind)
{
    PyObject **slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, domain, index, field);
    RenoWorkspacePending product;

    if (slot == NULL) { return 0; }
    if (*slot == NULL) { return !reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot); }
    if (!reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot)) { return 0; }
    product.kind = kind;
    product.index = index;
    product.actual_complete_borrowed = *slot;
    return reno_ws_product_pending(state, view, source, &product, 0);
}

static int
reno_ws_source_products(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source,
    const RenoWorkspacePending *pending)
{
    size_t index;

    for (index = 0; index < view->header->K; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_KW, index, 2, RENO_PENDING_KW_PAIR)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->Z; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 1, RENO_PENDING_CELL_ROW)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->E; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 2, RENO_PENDING_ENTRY_PAIR)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->D; ++index) {
        if (view->dispatch[index].row_ready != (view->dispatch[index].row_tuple != NULL)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 7, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_KW)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 8, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_CELLS)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 9, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_ROW)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->B; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 1, RENO_PENDING_BASE_ENTRIES)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 2, RENO_PENDING_BASE_ROW)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->C; ++index) {
        if (view->klass[index].row_ready != (view->klass[index].class_row_tuple != NULL)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 0, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_BASES)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 1, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_FUNCTIONS)
                || !reno_ws_product_slot(state, view, source, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 2, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_ROW)) { return 0; }
    }
    return reno_ws_product_all_fixed(state, view, source)
        && (pending == NULL || reno_ws_product_pending(state, view, source, pending, 1));
}

/* This predicate only permits another private preparation step. It does not
 * authenticate original source, replace the final joint metadata check, or
 * prove allocation/capacity. Actual module guard, this entered lease, live
 * original State/region and the selected no-native-rebind domain precede it.
 */
static int
reno_ws_repr_can_continue(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view)
{
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        && reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(module) == state
        && state->bootstrap_marker == RENO_BOOT_TYPED
        && *bootstrap_entered && state->controls.meta_active_count > 0
        && state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete
        && (state->controls.phase == RENO_MODULE_ROOTS_FROZEN
            || state->controls.phase == RENO_MODULE_PREPARING)
        && state->controls.arena_owner == RENO_ARENA_STATE
        && state->controls.published_arena == &state->arena
        && view->header->workspace_phase == RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED
        && !view->header->capture_failed
        && reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state);
}

static int
reno_ws_repr_ready(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field)
{
    PyObject **slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, domain, index, field);

    return slot != NULL && *slot != NULL && reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot);
}

/* Each tuple element receives a distinct NEW reference. The original C
 * expected and completed child slots remain continuously owned until the
 * actual final transfer/drain; no early take or address re-registration.
 * Full/nondebug reference operations and the actual private owner precede
 * this raw fill operation. It neither allocates nor checks fresh source.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_ws_repr_copy(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t index, unsigned int field)
{
    PyObject **slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, domain, index, field);

    if (slot == NULL || *slot == NULL || !reno_ws_slot_registered(view, slot)) { return NULL; }
    return Py_NewRef(*slot);
}

/* All fill inputs are already independently rooted and preflighted. This
 * only starts one actual operation; 1 means ATTEMPTED, even for NULL result.
 * For non-NULL the caller MUST immediately fill every item without callout,
 * even when allocation has left an error or retired the original source.
 * No result/error/source classification is allowed before that fill.
 */
static int
reno_ws_repr_allocate(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view, size_t length,
    PyObject **tuple_owned, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    if (*tuple_owned != NULL || *first_owned != NULL
            || !reno_ws_python_length(length)
            || !reno_ws_repr_can_continue(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view)) {
        return 0;
    }
    *tuple_owned = PyTuple_New((Py_ssize_t)length);
    return 1;
}

/* Only called after a non-NULL result was completely filled (zero length
 * needs no writes). NEW tuple and actual API error are separate debts.
 * GetRaised is the selected 3.12 raw ownership transport, not introspection.
 * Classification precedes any post-callback preparation eligibility check.
 */
static int
reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind, size_t index,
    PyObject *tuple_owned, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoWorkspacePending pending = {kind, index, NULL};
    int matches;

    *first_owned = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    if (*first_owned != NULL || tuple_owned == NULL) {
        return 0; /* NULL/NULL is a rejected API outcome, not fake NoMemory */
    }
    pending.actual_complete_borrowed = tuple_owned;
    matches = reno_ws_repr_can_continue(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view)
        && reno_ws_source_metadata(state, view, source)
        && reno_ws_source_products(state, view, source, &pending);
    pending.actual_complete_borrowed = NULL; /* no carrier survives this raw call */
    return matches;
}

/* Child nodes are all COMPLETE before allocating their parent. No callback
 * lies between an actual non-NULL allocation return and the full fill. A
 * nonempty new tuple is not published while it has NULL elements. The zero
 * length result may be the shared empty tuple: there is no slot write.
 */
static int
reno_ws_repr_collect(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind, size_t parent_index,
    RenoWorkspaceDomain domain, unsigned int field, size_t start, size_t count,
    size_t total, PyObject **tuple_owned, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    size_t index;

    if (start > total || count > total - start) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, domain, start + index, field)) { return 0; }
    }
    if (!reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
            count, tuple_owned, first_owned)) { return 0; }
    /* Actual private records are inaccessible to reentrant Python; original
     * active-owner invariants preserve them. The same selector/history checks
     * therefore cannot change during this no-callout copy/fill segment.
     */
    if (*tuple_owned != NULL) {
        for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(*tuple_owned, (Py_ssize_t)index,
                reno_ws_repr_copy(view, domain, start + index, field));
        }
    }
    return reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
        source, kind, parent_index, *tuple_owned, first_owned);
}

/* Called immediately after the actual pending product passed source and
 * product checks. Recheck the fixed destination before a no-callout move;
 * there is no fallible branch once the first owning field is written.
 */
static int
reno_ws_fixed_move_new(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspacePendingKind kind,
    size_t index, PyObject **actual_owned)
{
    unsigned int slot;
    unsigned char at;
    unsigned int fact = 0;
    int ready;
    RenoFunctionRowControl *row = NULL;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *builtin;

    if (*actual_owned == NULL || !reno_ws_known_destination(kind, index, &slot)
            || !reno_ws_known_empty(state, slot)) { return 0; }
    if (kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW || kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS) {
        row = &state->controls.function_rows[index];
        fact = kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW ? 0 : 1;
        if (row->representation_ready[fact] != 0) { return 0; }
    } else if (kind == RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR
            && state->controls.builtin_exec.anchor_ready[index] != 0) { return 0; }
    at = state->arena.known.order_count;
    state->arena.known.roots[slot] = *actual_owned;
    *actual_owned = NULL;
    state->arena.known.owned[slot] = 1;
    state->arena.known.order[at] = (unsigned char)slot;
    state->arena.known.order_count = (unsigned char)(at + 1);
    if (kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW || kind == RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS) {
        row->representation_ready[fact] = 1;
        ready = row->representation_ready[0] && row->representation_ready[1]
            && state->controls.function_dispatch[index].captured;
        for (fact = 0; fact < 7; ++fact) { ready = ready && row->raw_captured[fact]; }
        row->row_ready = (unsigned char)ready;
    } else if (kind == RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR) {
        builtin = &state->controls.builtin_exec;
        builtin->anchor_ready[index] = 1;
        ready = builtin->anchor_ready[0] && builtin->anchor_ready[1];
        for (fact = 0; fact < 4; ++fact) { ready = ready && builtin->scalar_captured[fact]; }
        for (fact = 0; fact < 2; ++fact) { ready = ready && builtin->payload_captured[fact]; }
        builtin->ready = (unsigned char)ready;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* This stage only commits nineteen representation roots. It deliberately
 * retains all region and outer original roots; it is not full finish, does
 * not leave/free, and cannot satisfy the outer three-locals-NULL contract.
 */
static int
reno_workspace_commit_fixed_outputs(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    PyObject *temporary = NULL;
    PyObject *payload = NULL; /* original outer-owned operand, not current */
    size_t index;
    unsigned int slot;
    unsigned int fact;
    unsigned char present;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;
    RenoNamedRanges *named;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *builtin = &state->controls.builtin_exec;

    if (*first_owned != NULL || !reno_ws_repr_can_continue(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view)
            || !reno_ws_fixed_targets_empty(state)) { goto failed; }
    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        named = &source->named_ranges[index];
        if (!reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                source, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW, index, RENO_WS_KW, 2,
                named->kw_start, named->kw_count, view->header->K, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_fixed_move_new(state, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_KW, index, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                source, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS, index, RENO_WS_CELL, 1,
                named->cell_start, named->cell_count, view->header->Z, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_fixed_move_new(state, RENO_PENDING_NAMED_CELLS, index, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_destination(RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS, index, &slot)
                || !reno_ws_known_empty(state, slot) || !view->klass[index].row_ready
                || !reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 2)) { goto failed; }
        temporary = reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 2);
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                source, RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS, index, temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_fixed_move_new(state, RENO_PENDING_FIXED_CLASS, index, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_destination(RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR, index, &slot)
                || !reno_ws_known_empty(state, slot) || builtin->present[index] > 1
                || !builtin->payload_captured[index]) { goto failed; }
        payload = index == 0 ? source->locals_owned->builtin_self : source->locals_owned->builtin_module;
        present = builtin->present[index];
        if (present != (payload != NULL)
                || !reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                    present, &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL && present) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, Py_NewRef(payload));
        }
        payload = NULL;
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                source, RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR, index, temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_fixed_move_new(state, RENO_PENDING_BUILTIN_ANCHOR, index, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
    }
    /* The loop performed all nineteen commits; check their actual facts
     * without callback. Full products/source is checked again by the parent.
     */
    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        if (!state->controls.function_rows[index].row_ready) { goto failed; }
        for (fact = 0; fact < 2; ++fact) {
            if (!state->controls.function_rows[index].representation_ready[fact]
                    || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 30 + 9 * (unsigned int)index + (fact == 0 ? 4 : 6), 1)) { goto failed; }
        }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_known_status(state, 103 + (unsigned int)index, 1)) { goto failed; }
    }
    if (!builtin->ready || !builtin->anchor_ready[0] || !builtin->anchor_ready[1]
            || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 28, 1) || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 29, 1)) { goto failed; }
    return 1;

failed:
    reno_common_request_retirement(state);
    payload = NULL;
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&temporary, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    /* Fixed partials stay in known113; region partials stay in R. No rollback
     * or outer-root consumption. All are settled by their real arena/owner.
     */
    return 0;
}

/* Called only after actual source_metadata and source_products passed in
 * this SAME raw span. Product equality alone is not derived-root coverage:
 * compare the exact child occurrences with retained private C slots too.
 * No expected is acquired from the fixed output graph; no callback here.
 */
static int
reno_ws_release_leaf_edges(RenoWorkspaceView *view, RenoWorkspaceDomain domain,
    size_t start, size_t count, PyObject *actual_parent)
{
    size_t total;
    size_t index;
    PyObject *expected;

    switch (domain) {
    case RENO_WS_KW: total = view->header->K; break;
    case RENO_WS_CELL: total = view->header->Z; break;
    case RENO_WS_ENTRY: total = view->header->E; break;
    default: return 0;
    }
    if (start > total || count > total - start
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual_parent, count)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        expected = domain == RENO_WS_KW ? view->kw[start + index].pair_tuple
            : (domain == RENO_WS_CELL ? view->cell[start + index].cell_record_tuple
                : view->entry[start + index].entry_pair);
        if (expected == NULL || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual_parent, (Py_ssize_t)index) != expected) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_ws_release_row_edges(RenoWorkspaceView *view, int functions,
    size_t start, size_t count, PyObject *actual_parent)
{
    size_t total = functions ? view->header->D : view->header->B;
    size_t index;
    PyObject *expected;

    if (start > total || count > total - start
            || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual_parent, count)) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        expected = functions ? view->dispatch[start + index].row_tuple
            : view->base[start + index].base_row_tuple;
        if (expected == NULL || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual_parent, (Py_ssize_t)index) != expected) { return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* All nineteen fixed destinations must be COMPLETE, unlike the legitimate
 * partial states accepted by source_products during construction. Together
 * with its raw-element checks and metadata's full occurrence partitions,
 * the following identity edges cover every acquired region occurrence.
 * This is not initial provenance, allocation/capacity or ABI authentication.
 */
static int
reno_ws_release_coverage(RenoState *state, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source)
{
    size_t index;
    unsigned int slot;
    PyObject *actual;
    RenoNamedRanges *named;
    RenoDispatchCapture *dispatch;
    RenoBaseCapture *base;
    RenoClassCapture *klass;
    RenoFunctionRowControl *row;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *builtin = &state->controls.builtin_exec;

    if (view->header->C != 5 || !view->header->representation_started
            || view->header->workspace_phase != RENO_WS_PHASE_CAPTURED) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        row = &state->controls.function_rows[index];
        named = &source->named_ranges[index];
        slot = 30 + 9 * (unsigned int)index;
        if (row->row_ready != 1 || row->representation_ready[0] != 1
                || row->representation_ready[1] != 1
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, slot + 4, 1)
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, slot + 6, 1)
                || !reno_ws_release_leaf_edges(view, RENO_WS_KW,
                    named->kw_start, named->kw_count, state->arena.known.roots[slot + 4])
                || !reno_ws_release_leaf_edges(view, RENO_WS_CELL,
                    named->cell_start, named->cell_count, state->arena.known.roots[slot + 6])) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        klass = &view->klass[index];
        slot = 103 + (unsigned int)index;
        if (klass->row_ready != 1 || !reno_ws_known_status(state, slot, 1)) { return 0; }
        actual = state->arena.known.roots[slot];
        if (actual != klass->class_row_tuple || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 4)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 2) != klass->base_rows_tuple
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 3) != klass->functions_tuple
                || !reno_ws_release_row_edges(view, 0, klass->base_start,
                    klass->base_count, klass->base_rows_tuple)
                || !reno_ws_release_row_edges(view, 1, klass->dispatch_start,
                    klass->dispatch_count, klass->functions_tuple)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->D; ++index) {
        dispatch = &view->dispatch[index];
        actual = dispatch->row_tuple;
        if (dispatch->row_ready != 1 || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 9)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 4) != dispatch->kw_entries
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 6) != dispatch->cells
                || !reno_ws_release_leaf_edges(view, RENO_WS_KW,
                    dispatch->kw_start, dispatch->kw_count, dispatch->kw_entries)
                || !reno_ws_release_leaf_edges(view, RENO_WS_CELL,
                    dispatch->cell_start, dispatch->cell_count, dispatch->cells)) { return 0; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->B; ++index) {
        base = &view->base[index];
        actual = base->base_row_tuple;
        if (!reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, 2)
                || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 1) != base->entries_tuple
                || !reno_ws_release_leaf_edges(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY,
                    base->entry_start, base->entry_count, base->entries_tuple)
                || base->base_identity == NULL || base->dict_guard == NULL
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(base->base_identity, &PyType_Type)
                || _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)base->base_identity) != base->dict_guard) { return 0; }
        /* Ordinary type owns its actual dict; static builtin uses this
         * interpreter's owning static state. The latter requires the SAME
         * initialized active interpreter, not just a retained type object.
         */
    }
    if (source->locals_owned->pathfinder_mro == NULL
            || PyTuple_GET_ITEM(state->arena.known.roots[103], 1)
                != source->locals_owned->pathfinder_mro
            || builtin->ready != 1) { return 0; }
    for (index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
        PyObject *payload = index == 0 ? source->locals_owned->builtin_self
            : source->locals_owned->builtin_module;
        if (builtin->anchor_ready[index] != 1
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 28 + (unsigned int)index, 1)) { return 0; }
        actual = state->arena.known.roots[28 + index];
        if (builtin->present[index] > 1 || builtin->present[index] != (payload != NULL)
                || !reno_ws_source_tuple(actual, builtin->present[index])
                || (builtin->present[index] && PyTuple_GET_ITEM(actual, 0) != payload)) { return 0; }
    }
    return PyErr_Occurred() == NULL;
}

static int
reno_csw_prepare_fresh(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source)
{
    return reno_ws_repr_can_continue(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view)
        && state->arena.class_source_witness == NULL
        && state->controls.class_source_witness_ready == 0
        && reno_ws_source_metadata(state, view, source)
        && reno_ws_source_products(state, view, source, NULL)
        && reno_ws_release_coverage(state, view, source);
}

/* Original capture remains owned and the entered lease/module guard remains
 * live across all three potentially-callback allocation calls. Each returned
 * NEW and actual first is a distinct local obligation. Tuples are completely
 * filled before any later allocation or source predicate may be entered.
 */
static int
reno_workspace_prepare_class_source_witness(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoClassSourceLayout layout;
    PyObject *bytes = NULL;
    PyObject *dicts = NULL;
    PyObject *package = NULL;
    size_t index;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (*first_owned != NULL || !reno_csw_prepare_fresh(module, state,
            bootstrap_entered, view, source)
            || !reno_csw_layout(view->header->B, view->header->E, view->header->D, &layout)) { goto failed; }
    bytes = PyBytes_FromStringAndSize(NULL, (Py_ssize_t)layout.bytes);
    *first_owned = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    if (*first_owned != NULL || bytes == NULL || !PyBytes_CheckExact(bytes)
            || (size_t)PyBytes_GET_SIZE(bytes) != layout.bytes
            || !reno_csw_prepare_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view, source)) { goto failed; }

    dicts = PyTuple_New((Py_ssize_t)layout.count[1]);
    if (dicts != NULL) {
        /* Only original owned region fields, not current base getters.
         * Retirement cannot drain the region while this actual lease lives.
         */
        for (index = 0; index < layout.count[1]; ++index) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(dicts, (Py_ssize_t)index, Py_NewRef(view->base[index].dict_guard));
        }
    }
    *first_owned = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    if (*first_owned != NULL || dicts == NULL
            || !reno_csw_prepare_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view, source)) { goto failed; }

    package = PyTuple_New(2);
    if (package != NULL) {
        PyTuple_SET_ITEM(package, 0, bytes);
        bytes = NULL;
        PyTuple_SET_ITEM(package, 1, dicts);
        dicts = NULL;
    }
    *first_owned = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    if (*first_owned != NULL || package == NULL
            || !reno_csw_prepare_fresh(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view, source)) { goto failed; }
    /* No callback from the last fresh check through complete fieldwise fill,
     * real region comparison, single root move and final ready publication.
     * Child borrows are acquired here, not transported across allocations.
     */
    if (!reno_csw_encode(PyTuple_GET_ITEM(package, 0), PyTuple_GET_ITEM(package, 1), &layout, view)
            || !reno_csw_region_matches(package, view)) { goto failed; }
    state->arena.class_source_witness = package;
    package = NULL;
    state->controls.class_source_witness_ready = 1;
    return 1;

failed:
    reno_common_request_retirement(state); /* raw before any release callback */
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&package, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&dicts, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&bytes, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    /* NULL/NULL rejects without inventing NoMemory; pending API first is
     * already transported. No region/State access after the last release.
     * The real caller retains all drain/free/leave responsibility.
     */
    return 0;
}


/* Selected SUCCESS tail only. Actual continuous module/lease/State/region,
 * matching full nondebug references, same active interpreter and the original
 * no-native-rebind domain precede this call. No wrapper/type/flag grants them.
 * On preflight failure all original roots still belong to their prior owners.
 */
static int
reno_workspace_release_success_roots(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext *source, PyObject **first_owned)
{
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (*first_owned != NULL
            || !reno_ws_repr_can_continue(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view)
            || !reno_ws_source_metadata(state, view, source)
            || !reno_ws_source_products(state, view, source, NULL)
            || !reno_ws_release_coverage(state, view, source)
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1
            || !reno_csw_region_matches(state->arena.class_source_witness, view)) { return 0; }
    /* Last source check is above, before clearing any C expected. Every
     * release below is immortal/nonlast under the actual coverage graph.
     * The fixed roots and tuple/type/interpreter owning edges are unchanged,
     * so no deallocator/callback/GIL release can invalidate that same check.
     * Empty indicator is preserved inductively; settle_indicator's callout
     * branch is never entered on this selected successful path.
     */
    reno_workspace_drain_live(view, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&source->locals_owned->builtin_module, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&source->locals_owned->builtin_self, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&source->locals_owned->pathfinder_mro, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    /* Retained-region source/product checkers are inapplicable after drain.
     * First require the original scalar/indicator/outer postconditions, then
     * consume State-owned metadata/fixed-source and class witness records. Allocation stays LIVE;
     * lease stays held; only the retained T0 source records are consumed
     * here, with no future business missing operand. The selected
     * source descriptor helpers settle actual nonlast/immortal NEWs; no full-source or
     * original getter/effect/D1/D2 certificate is inferred from the predicate.
     */
    return !cleanup_failed && *first_owned == NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        && view->header->workspace_phase == RENO_WS_PHASE_DRAINED
        && view->header->ledger_count == 0
        && source->locals_owned->builtin_module == NULL
        && source->locals_owned->builtin_self == NULL
        && source->locals_owned->pathfinder_mro == NULL
        && reno_state_fixed_metadata_match(state);
}

/* PRIVATE S1 T0 PREPARATION, not the missing full finish body. All expected
 * operands come from actual historical roots. Source dictionaries use exact
 * recorded key/value facts; private empty cells contain no business M.
 * The original catalog business tuple3/get(key,SAME M) contract is unchanged.
 *
 * This body builds all nineteen fixed representations, then performs the
 * original coverage and State-only post-drain checks. Actual full owner,
 * class-dict domain, physical free/W42 and final installation remain open.
 * No positive raw-ready flag or PREPARING/ACTIVE transition is made here.
 *
 * first_owned is the caller's empty private owning output. Invalid entry
 * returns without beginning. A begun failure retires this attempt, retains
 * an actual first or pending indicator, or constructs the new generic
 * preparation rejection BEFORE local temporary cleanup. The real constructor
 * outcome is transported; prior effects/first and cleanup debts stay owned.
 * The synchronous owner still settles region/outer/free/leave and restores
 * first after all its debts. This body does not restore the indicator.
 */
static int
reno_workspace_prepare_region_rows(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoWorkspaceView *view,
    RenoNamedRanges named_ranges[6], RenoClassRootMap class_roots[5],
    RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned,
    PyObject **first_owned)
{
    RenoWorkspaceSourceContext source;
    PyObject *temporary = NULL;
    /* Only actual original class/MRO OBJECTS are copied from continuously
     * held fixed owning slots. No outgoing container item is read to derive
     * cell/base identity here; those have their own region owning endpoints.
     */
    PyObject *identity = NULL;
    PyObject *mro_identity = NULL;
    PyObject **payload_slot;
    RenoDispatchCapture *dispatch;
    RenoBaseCapture *base;
    RenoClassCapture *klass;
    size_t index;
    unsigned int field;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (*first_owned != NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return -1; /* invalid empty-entry contract; no new object or mutation */
    }
    source.locals_owned = locals_owned;
    source.named_ranges = named_ranges;
    source.class_roots = class_roots;
    if (view->header->C != 5
            || view->header->representation_started
            || !reno_ws_repr_can_continue(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view)
            || !reno_ws_fixed_targets_empty(state)
            || state->arena.class_source_witness != NULL
            || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 0
            || !reno_ws_source_metadata(state, view, &source)
            || !reno_ws_source_products(state, view, &source, NULL)) {
        goto failed;
    }
    view->header->representation_started = 1; /* one shot, including failure */

    /* Complete all leaf pairs before any parent allocation. Named function
     * occurrences share the K/Z storage, but retain their own domain/index.
     * Their fixed-arena aggregates are committed after the region rows.
     */
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->K; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_KW, index, 0)
                || !reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_KW, index, 1)
                || reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_KW, index, 2) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                    view, 2, &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_KW, index, 0));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 1, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_KW, index, 1));
        }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                &source, RENO_PENDING_KW_PAIR, index, temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_KW, index, 2, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->Z; ++index) {
        if (view->cell[index].populated > 1
                || !reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 2)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(view->cell[index].cell_identity, &PyCell_Type)
                || reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 1) == NULL) { goto failed; }
        payload_slot = &view->cell[index].populated_contents;
        if (view->cell[index].populated) {
            if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 0)) { goto failed; }
        } else if (*payload_slot != NULL || reno_ws_slot_registered(view, payload_slot)) {
            goto failed;
        }
        payload_slot = NULL; /* discard segment-only pointer before allocation */
        if (!reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                view, view->cell[index].populated ? 3 : 2,
                &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 2));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 1,
                Py_NewRef(view->cell[index].populated ? Py_True : Py_False));
            if (view->cell[index].populated) {
                PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 2,
                    reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 0));
            }
        }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                &source, RENO_PENDING_CELL_ROW, index, temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_CELL, index, 1, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
    }
    for (index = 0; index < view->header->E; ++index) {
        if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 0)
                || !reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 1)
                || reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 2) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                    view, 2, &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 0));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 1, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 1));
        }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                &source, RENO_PENDING_ENTRY_PAIR, index, temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_ENTRY, index, 2, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
    }

    for (index = 0; index < view->header->D; ++index) {
        dispatch = &view->dispatch[index];
        if (dispatch->row_ready || dispatch->defaults_present > 1
                || dispatch->kw_present > 1 || dispatch->closure_present > 1) { goto failed; }
        for (field = 0; field < 7; ++field) {
            if (field >= 2 && field <= 4) {
                unsigned char present = field == 2 ? dispatch->defaults_present
                    : (field == 3 ? dispatch->kw_present : dispatch->closure_present);
                payload_slot = reno_workspace_owned_slot(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, field);
                if (present) {
                    if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, field)) { goto failed; }
                } else if (*payload_slot != NULL || reno_ws_slot_registered(view, payload_slot)) {
                    goto failed;
                }
            } else if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, field)) {
                goto failed;
            }
        }
        payload_slot = NULL;
        if (reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 7) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                    &source, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_KW, index,
                    RENO_WS_KW, 2, dispatch->kw_start, dispatch->kw_count,
                    view->header->K, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 7, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        if (reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 8) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                    &source, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_CELLS, index,
                    RENO_WS_CELL, 1, dispatch->cell_start, dispatch->cell_count,
                    view->header->Z, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 8, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        if (reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 9) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                    view, 9, &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 0));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 1, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 1));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 2, dispatch->defaults_present
                ? reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 2) : Py_NewRef(Py_None));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 3, dispatch->kw_present
                ? reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 3) : Py_NewRef(Py_None));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 4, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 7));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 5, dispatch->closure_present
                ? reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 4) : Py_NewRef(Py_None));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 6, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 8));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 7, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 5));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 8, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 6));
        }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                &source, RENO_PENDING_DISPATCH_ROW, index, temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_DISPATCH, index, 9, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        dispatch->row_ready = 1; /* actual complete private row, not global ready */
    }

    for (index = 0; index < view->header->B; ++index) {
        base = &view->base[index];
        if (reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 1) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                    &source, RENO_PENDING_BASE_ENTRIES, index,
                    RENO_WS_ENTRY, 2, base->entry_start, base->entry_count,
                    view->header->E, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 1, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_ready(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 3)
                || !Py_IS_TYPE(base->base_identity, &PyType_Type)
                || reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 2) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                    view, 2, &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 3));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 1, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 1));
        }
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                &source, RENO_PENDING_BASE_ROW, index, temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_BASE, index, 2, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        /* Actual captured dict_guard remains ledger-owned until owner drain. */
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        klass = &view->klass[index];
        if (klass->row_ready || klass->class_role != index
                || class_roots[index].class_role != index
                || reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 0) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                    &source, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_BASES, index,
                    RENO_WS_BASE, 2, klass->base_start, klass->base_count,
                    view->header->B, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 0, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        if (reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 1) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_collect(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                    &source, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_FUNCTIONS, index,
                    RENO_WS_DISPATCH, 9, klass->dispatch_start, klass->dispatch_count,
                    view->header->D, &temporary, first_owned)
                || !reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 1, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        identity = *class_roots[index].class_slot;
        mro_identity = *class_roots[index].mro_slot;
        if (identity == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(identity, &PyType_Type)
                || mro_identity == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro_identity)
                || reno_ws_acquire_slot(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 2) == NULL
                || !reno_ws_repr_allocate(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                    view, 4, &temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (temporary != NULL) {
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 0, Py_NewRef(identity));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 1, Py_NewRef(mro_identity));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 2, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 0));
            PyTuple_SET_ITEM(temporary, 3, reno_ws_repr_copy(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 1));
        }
        identity = NULL;
        mro_identity = NULL;
        if (!reno_ws_repr_classify_tuple(module, state, bootstrap_entered, view,
                &source, RENO_PENDING_CLASS_ROW, index, temporary, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
        if (!reno_ws_move_new(view, RENO_WS_CLASS, index, 2, &temporary)) { goto failed; }
        klass->row_ready = 1;
    }
    if (!reno_workspace_commit_fixed_outputs(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
            view, &source, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
    if (!reno_workspace_prepare_class_source_witness(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
            view, &source, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
    /* Nineteen fixed roots now cover the selected complete products. The
     * real success body performs last source/product/coverage checks, drains
     * region roots and consumes the three outer roots. Allocation stays LIVE;
     * no free/leave, PREPARING/ACTIVE or full-finish success is claimed here.
     */
    if (!reno_workspace_release_success_roots(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
            view, &source, first_owned)) { goto failed; }
    return 0;

failed:
    reno_common_request_retirement(state); /* raw, before any release callback */
    identity = NULL;
    mro_identity = NULL;
    payload_slot = NULL;
    if (*first_owned == NULL) {
        *first_owned = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
        if (*first_owned == NULL) {
            /* New S1 preparation rejection, not a claim about a later
             * original binder/callee error. Keep the actual constructor
             * outcome, including its OOM, before releasing any temporary.
             */
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native T0 preparation rejected");
            *first_owned = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
        }
    }
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&temporary, first_owned, &cleanup_failed);
    /* Private actual first/output and all remaining region ownership go back
     * to the STILL LIVE synchronous owner. No region access after this final
     * possible release callback, no drain/leave/free or error restoration.
     */
    return -1;
}

static int
reno_h01_capture_workspace_and_prepare(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned)
{
    static const unsigned char class_slots[5] = {6, 11, 14, 17, 20};
    static const unsigned char mro_slots[5] = {0, 13, 16, 19, 22};
    RenoWorkspaceHeader layout = {0}; /* every member is an integer scalar */
    RenoNamedRanges named_ranges[6];
    RenoClassRootMap class_roots[5];
    RenoWorkspaceCountStatus status;
    unsigned int index;

    /* Fixed automatic mapping only, no D/B/E-sized hidden index arrays. */
    for (index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
        named_ranges[index].kw_start = 0;
        named_ranges[index].kw_count = 0;
        named_ranges[index].cell_start = 0;
        named_ranges[index].cell_count = 0;
        named_ranges[index].function_role = (unsigned char)index;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        class_roots[index].class_slot = NULL;
        class_roots[index].mro_slot = NULL;
        class_roots[index].class_role = (unsigned char)index;
    }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        reno_common_request_retirement(state);
        return -1; /* preserve actual API error; no new local object debt */
    }
    if (state == NULL || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || !*bootstrap_entered || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || locals_owned->pathfinder_mro == NULL
            || !reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state)) {
        status = RENO_WS_COUNT_SHAPE;
        goto failed;
    }
    for (index = 0; index < 5; ++index) {
        class_roots[index].class_slot = &state->arena.known.roots[class_slots[index]];
        class_roots[index].mro_slot = index == 0 ? &locals_owned->pathfinder_mro
            : &state->arena.known.roots[mro_slots[index]];
    }
    status = reno_workspace_count_raw(state, &layout, named_ranges, class_roots);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        reno_common_request_retirement(state);
        return -1;
    }
    if (status == RENO_WS_COUNT_OK) {
        if (!reno_workspace_layout_raw(&layout)) {
            status = RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW;
            goto failed;
        }
    } else if (status != RENO_WS_COUNT_NEEDS_CLASS_DICT_ROUTE) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* The still-missing real continuation receives no borrowed dict/value/
     * iterator cursor, only these continuously live original owning slots
     * and private scalar records. Partial status forbids consuming offsets
     * or allocating by requested_bytes. No complete-capture flag is set.
     * This synchronous call must not retain these automatic record addresses.
     */
    return reno_h01_finish_workspace_capture_prepare(module, state,
        bootstrap_entered, locals_owned, status, &layout, named_ranges, class_roots,
        &reno_workspace_private_ops);

failed:
    layout.capture_failed = 1;
    reno_common_request_retirement(state);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        if (status == RENO_WS_COUNT_OVERFLOW) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_OverflowError, "native metadata workspace capacity exceeded");
        } else {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native T0 capture unavailable");
        }
    }
    /* No PyObject was left owned by this counter/layout frame. The outer
     * fixed-capture frame still owns all three actual local roots and takes
     * escaping first before clearing them and letting parent abandon leave.
     */
    return -1;
}


static int
reno_t0_known_empty(RenoState *state, unsigned int slot)
{
    return slot < 113 && state->arena.known.order_count < 113
        && !state->arena.known.owned[slot]
        && state->arena.known.roots[slot] == NULL;
}

/* Preconditions include legal actual borrowed value, actual live State and
 * matching reference/ABI envelope. Slot checks do not establish provenance.
 * No callback between the empty/capacity check, actual NewRef and ledger move.
 */
static int
reno_t0_own_borrowed(RenoState *state, unsigned int slot, PyObject *value)
{
    unsigned char at;

    if (value == NULL || !reno_t0_known_empty(state, slot)) {
        return 0;
    }
    at = state->arena.known.order_count;
    state->arena.known.roots[slot] = Py_NewRef(value);
    state->arena.known.owned[slot] = 1;
    state->arena.known.order[at] = (unsigned char)slot;
    state->arena.known.order_count = (unsigned char)(at + 1);
    return 1;
}

/* Only exact-str keys are inspected; other keys are skipped without hash/eq.
 * A dictionary later used for ordinary lookup still needs its complete key
 * preflight in the real workspace/source consumer. This scan does not do it.
 */
static PyObject *
reno_t0_ascii_value(PyObject *dictionary, const char *name, Py_ssize_t length)
{
    Py_ssize_t position = 0;
    PyObject *key = NULL;
    PyObject *value = NULL;
    PyObject *found = NULL;

    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) {
        return NULL;
    }
    while (PyDict_Next(dictionary, &position, &key, &value)) {
        if (exact_ascii_name(key, name, length)) {
            if (found != NULL) {
                return NULL;
            }
            found = value;
        }
    }
    return found; /* borrowed, consumed immediately in this same raw span */
}

/* The trusted T0 caller already owns original module23/dict24 in this same
 * no-callout interval. Never called at finder return or from actualspec type.
 * Every acquired occurrence goes into State immediately, including partials.
 */
static int
reno_t0_capture_spec_source(RenoState *state)
{
    RenoSpecSourceOwned *spec = &state->arena.spec_source;
    PyObject *actual;
    PyTypeObject *klass;
    RenoSpecMroInventory inventory = {0};
    RenoSpecMroCountStatus inventory_status;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || spec->klass != NULL || spec->dictionary != NULL
            || spec->mro != NULL || spec->prepared_loader_key != NULL
            || spec->loader_key_prepared != 0
            || spec->acquired != 0 || spec->layout_captured != 0
            || spec->observed_getattro != NULL || spec->observed_getattr != NULL
            || spec->observed_basicsize != 0
            || spec->observed_itemsize != 0 || spec->observed_dictoffset != 0
            || spec->observed_weaklistoffset != 0 || spec->observed_flags != 0
            || !reno_spec_mro_inventory_empty(&spec->inventory)
            || !reno_spec_mro_region_empty(&spec->region)) { return 0; }
    actual = reno_t0_ascii_value(state->arena.known.roots[24], "ModuleSpec", 10);
    if (actual == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual, &PyType_Type)) { return 0; }
    spec->klass = Py_NewRef(actual);
    spec->acquired = 1;
    klass = (PyTypeObject *)spec->klass;
    actual = _PyType_GetDict(klass);
    if (actual == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(actual)) { return 0; }
    spec->dictionary = Py_NewRef(actual);
    spec->acquired = 2;
    actual = klass->tp_mro;
    if (actual == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(actual)) { return 0; }
    spec->mro = Py_NewRef(actual);
    spec->acquired = 3;
    spec->observed_getattro = klass->tp_getattro;
    spec->observed_getattr = klass->tp_getattr;
    spec->observed_basicsize = klass->tp_basicsize;
    spec->observed_itemsize = klass->tp_itemsize;
    spec->observed_dictoffset = klass->tp_dictoffset;
    spec->observed_weaklistoffset = klass->tp_weaklistoffset;
    spec->observed_flags = klass->tp_flags & RENO_SPEC_SOURCE_FLAGS_MASK;
    inventory_status = reno_spec_mro_inventory_raw(spec, &inventory);
    if (inventory_status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_EXACT
            && inventory_status != RENO_SPEC_MRO_NEEDS_ROUTE) { return 0; }
    spec->inventory = inventory; /* integers only; no content captured */
    spec->layout_captured = 1; /* captured-only, NOT source/getter/witness ready */
    if (!reno_spec_mro_region_capture(state)) { return 0; }
    return reno_spec_prepare_loader_key(state);
}


static int
reno_t0_dict_value(RenoState *state, unsigned int dictionary_slot,
    const char *name, Py_ssize_t length, unsigned int value_slot)
{
    PyObject *value = reno_t0_ascii_value(
        state->arena.known.roots[dictionary_slot], name, length);

    return reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, value_slot, value);
}

static int
reno_t0_module_dict(RenoState *state, unsigned int module_slot,
    unsigned int dict_slot)
{
    PyObject *module = state->arena.known.roots[module_slot];
    PyObject *dictionary;

    if (module == NULL || !PyModule_CheckExact(module)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* Actual matching internal declaration already included by this unit;
     * no mirrored module struct. Unlike the assert-based inline, explicitly
     * classify NULL before using the dictionary. This does not claim that
     * the original successful public GetDict allocates or invokes Python.
     */
    dictionary = ((PyModuleObject *)module)->md_dict;
    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)) {
        return 0;
    }
    return reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, dict_slot, dictionary);
}

static int
reno_t0_class(RenoState *state, const char *name, Py_ssize_t length,
    unsigned int class_slot, unsigned int dict_slot, unsigned int mro_slot,
    PyObject **pathfinder_mro_owned)
{
    PyObject *klass;
    PyObject *dictionary;
    PyObject *mro;

    if (!reno_t0_dict_value(state, 5, name, length, class_slot)) {
        return 0;
    }
    klass = state->arena.known.roots[class_slot];
    if (!Py_IS_TYPE(klass, &PyType_Type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* Borrowed actual per-interpreter dict, including static builtin branch;
     * independent ownership below is explicit. Do not read tp_dict as a
     * universal replacement for this original runtime lookup.
     */
    dictionary = _PyType_GetDict((PyTypeObject *)klass);
    if (dictionary == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(dictionary)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, dict_slot, dictionary)) {
        return 0;
    }
    mro = ((PyTypeObject *)klass)->tp_mro;
    if (mro == NULL || !PyTuple_CheckExact(mro)) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (pathfinder_mro_owned != NULL) {
        if (*pathfinder_mro_owned != NULL) {
            return 0;
        }
        *pathfinder_mro_owned = Py_NewRef(mro);
        return 1;
    }
    return reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, mro_slot, mro);
}

static int
reno_t0_descriptor_function(RenoState *state, unsigned int descriptor_slot,
    PyTypeObject *builtin_type, unsigned int function_slot)
{
    PyObject *descriptor = state->arena.known.roots[descriptor_slot];
    PyMemberDef *member;
    PyMemberDef *selected = NULL;
    PyObject *actual_new;
    unsigned char at;

    if (descriptor == NULL || !Py_IS_TYPE(descriptor, builtin_type)
            || !reno_t0_known_empty(state, function_slot)) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* Only the original builtin's static C table is searched. These are C
     * strings, not unknown Python keys. No current class dict/getattr/binding.
     */
    for (member = builtin_type->tp_members;
            member != NULL && member->name != NULL; ++member) {
        if (strcmp(member->name, "__func__") == 0) {
            if (selected != NULL || member->type != T_OBJECT
                    || member->flags != READONLY) {
                return 0;
            }
            selected = member;
        }
    }
    if (selected == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    /* Matching exact T_OBJECT/READONLY branch only: direct payload load,
     * NULL -> actual NEW Py_None, otherwise actual NEW payload. No audit,
     * allocation, arbitrary release or callback in that selected branch.
     * The prechecked slot/ledger cannot change during this finite raw span.
     */
    actual_new = PyMember_GetOne((const char *)descriptor, selected);
    if (actual_new != NULL) {
        at = state->arena.known.order_count;
        state->arena.known.roots[function_slot] = actual_new;
        state->arena.known.owned[function_slot] = 1;
        state->arena.known.order[at] = (unsigned char)function_slot;
        state->arena.known.order_count = (unsigned char)(at + 1);
    }
    /* Ledger records only actual NEW responsibility. raw_captured[0] is not
     * published until the mandatory function and indicator classify normally.
     */
    return actual_new != NULL && PyErr_Occurred() == NULL
        && Py_IS_TYPE(actual_new, &PyFunction_Type);
}

static int
reno_t0_function_row(RenoState *state, unsigned int row, vectorcallfunc standard_local)
{
    static const unsigned char offsets[6] = {1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8};
    unsigned int base;
    unsigned int i;
    PyObject *actual;
    PyFunctionObject *function;
    PyObject *fields[6];

    if (row >= 6) {
        return 0;
    }
    base = 30 + 9 * row;
    actual = state->arena.known.roots[base];
    if (actual == NULL || !state->arena.known.owned[base]
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(actual, &PyFunction_Type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    function = (PyFunctionObject *)actual;
    state->controls.function_rows[row].raw_captured[0] = 1;
    fields[0] = function->func_code;
    fields[1] = function->func_defaults;
    fields[2] = function->func_kwdefaults;
    fields[3] = function->func_closure;
    fields[4] = function->func_globals;
    fields[5] = function->func_builtins;
    for (i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        if (fields[i] == NULL) {
            if (i == 0 || i >= 4) {
                return 0; /* mandatory original field, never fake absence */
            }
        } else if (!reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, base + offsets[i], fields[i])) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (i >= 1 && i <= 3) {
            state->controls.function_rows[row].present[i - 1] = fields[i] != NULL;
        }
        state->controls.function_rows[row].raw_captured[i + 1] = 1;
    }
    state->controls.function_dispatch[row].expected = function->vectorcall;
    state->controls.function_dispatch[row].captured = 1;
    state->controls.function_dispatch[row].standard_matched =
        function->vectorcall == standard_local;
    /* Offsets4/6 are actual kw_entries/cells representation destinations;
     * they remain NULL, representation_ready/row_ready remain false.
     * Capturing does not yet validate all original metadata/source consumers.
     * The standard comparison records an address observation only. Actual
     * dispatch/code lifetime and D1/D2 are not certified by this capture.
     */
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_t0_builtin_exec(RenoState *state, RenoT0LocalRoots *locals_owned)
{
    PyCFunctionObject *function;
    RenoBuiltinExecControl *control = &state->controls.builtin_exec;

    if (!reno_t0_dict_value(state, 26, "exec", 4, 27)
            || !Py_IS_TYPE(state->arena.known.roots[27], &PyCFunction_Type)) {
        return 0;
    }
    function = (PyCFunctionObject *)state->arena.known.roots[27];
    if (function->m_ml == NULL || locals_owned->builtin_self != NULL
            || locals_owned->builtin_module != NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    control->methoddef = function->m_ml;
    control->function = function->m_ml->ml_meth;
    control->flags = function->m_ml->ml_flags;
    control->vectorcall = function->vectorcall;
    control->scalar_captured[0] = 1;
    control->scalar_captured[1] = 1;
    control->scalar_captured[2] = 1;
    control->scalar_captured[3] = 1;
    locals_owned->builtin_self = Py_XNewRef(function->m_self);
    control->present[0] = function->m_self != NULL;
    control->payload_captured[0] = 1;
    locals_owned->builtin_module = Py_XNewRef(function->m_module);
    control->present[1] = function->m_module != NULL;
    control->payload_captured[1] = 1;
    /* No tuple allocation and no anchor_ready/ready publication here. */
    return 1;
}

static int
reno_h01_capture_before_legacy(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered)
{
    RenoT0LocalRoots locals_owned = {NULL, NULL, NULL};
    PyThreadState *thread_state = NULL;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    PyObject *modules;
    vectorcallfunc standard_local = NULL;
    unsigned int row;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    /* Actual module argument/continuous creation_module_guard, matching
     * allocation/current-pointer/capacity/source/GIL/full API precede this.
     * Marker/def/pointer comparisons cannot supply those premises.
     */
    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state == NULL || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
            || *bootstrap_entered || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_CAPTURING
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
            || state->controls.meta_active_count < 0) {
        goto raw_failed;
    }
    if (state->controls.meta_active_count == PY_SSIZE_T_MAX) {
        reno_common_request_retirement(state);
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_OverflowError, "native metadata activity capacity exceeded");
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Independent original standard, after the parent's three getter samples;
     * matching import/alias/build and no-callout address acquisition remain
     * explicit prerequisites. Never derive it from a captured current F.
     */
    standard_local = &_PyFunction_Vectorcall;
    ++state->controls.meta_active_count;
    *bootstrap_entered = 1; /* this real debt stays with parent until leave */

    thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
    if (thread_state == NULL) { goto raw_failed; }
    interpreter = thread_state->interp;
    if (interpreter == NULL) { goto raw_failed; }
    modules = interpreter->imports.modules;
    if (modules == NULL || !PyDict_CheckExact(modules)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 0, modules)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 0, "sys", 3, 1)
            || !reno_t0_module_dict(state, 1, 2)
            || interpreter->sysdict == NULL
            || interpreter->sysdict != state->arena.known.roots[2]
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 2, "meta_path", 9, 3)
            || !PyList_CheckExact(state->arena.known.roots[3])
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 0, "_frozen_importlib_external", 26, 4)
            || !reno_t0_module_dict(state, 4, 5)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 0, "_frozen_importlib", 17, 23)
            || !reno_t0_module_dict(state, 23, 24)
