            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 0, "builtins", 8, 25)
            || !reno_t0_module_dict(state, 25, 26)) {
        goto raw_failed;
    }
    if (!reno_t0_class(state, "PathFinder", 10, 6, 7, 0, &locals_owned.pathfinder_mro)
            || !reno_t0_class(state, "_LoaderBasics", 13, 11, 12, 13, NULL)
            || !reno_t0_class(state, "FileLoader", 10, 14, 15, 16, NULL)
            || !reno_t0_class(state, "SourceLoader", 12, 17, 18, 19, NULL)
            || !reno_t0_class(state, "SourceFileLoader", 16, 20, 21, 22, NULL)
            || !reno_t0_capture_loader_layout(state)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 7, "find_spec", 9, 8)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 7, "invalidate_caches", 17, 9)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 7, "find_distributions", 18, 10)
            || !reno_t0_descriptor_function(state, 8, &PyClassMethod_Type, 30)
            || !reno_t0_descriptor_function(state, 9, &PyStaticMethod_Type, 39)
            || !reno_t0_descriptor_function(state, 10, &PyStaticMethod_Type, 48)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 18, "get_code", 8, 57)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 12, "exec_module", 11, 66)
            || !reno_t0_dict_value(state, 24, "_call_with_frames_removed", 25, 75)) {
        goto raw_failed;
    }
    for (row = 0; row < 6; ++row) {
        if (!reno_t0_function_row(state, row, standard_local)) {
            goto raw_failed;
        }
    }
    if (!reno_t0_builtin_exec(state, &locals_owned)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 97, PyExc_RuntimeError)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 98, PyExc_NameError)
            || !reno_t0_own_borrowed(state, 99, PyExc_TypeError)) {
        goto raw_failed;
    }

    if (!reno_t0_capture_spec_source(state)) { goto raw_failed; }
    modules = NULL;
    thread_state = NULL;
    interpreter = NULL;
    /* All fixed raw captures exist; variable mutable occurrences do NOT.
     * No capture_complete/ROOTS_FROZEN is set by this prefix. The real next
     * body must start in the same proven callback-free T0 interval, finish
     * full originals and representation/cleanup, then consume these locals.
     */
    if (reno_h01_capture_workspace_and_prepare(module, state, bootstrap_entered,
                                              &locals_owned) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (locals_owned.pathfinder_mro != NULL || locals_owned.builtin_self != NULL
            || locals_owned.builtin_module != NULL
            || !state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete
            || !reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state)
            || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_PREPARING
            || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
            || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena) {
        goto raw_failed;
    }
    return 0;

raw_failed:
    /* Stop this claimed bootstrap before error construction can call out. */
    reno_common_request_retirement(state);
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native T0 capture unavailable");
    }
failed:
    reno_common_request_retirement(state);
    first = take_failure();
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&locals_owned.builtin_module, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&locals_owned.builtin_self, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    reno_cleanup_release_owned(&locals_owned.pathfinder_mro, &first, &cleanup_failed);
    /* No metadata leave here: these call-local debts are now closed; parent
     * still owns the actual module guard and entered debt, and its abandon
     * handles Record CLEAR/arena handoff. No local payload survives return.
     */
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return -1;
}

static PyObject *
owner_factory_call(PyObject *module, PyObject *Py_UNUSED(ignored))
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *factory_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *kernel_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoOwnerFactoryState *state = NULL;
    RenoWindowsHandleOwner *owner = NULL;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    /* Actual normal PyCFunction invocation keeps the callable and m_self
     * alive. Acquire our separate module root before preparing anything.
     */
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(module);
    state = prepare_state(module_guard);
    if (state == NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->phase != RENO_FACTORY_READY || state->factory == NULL
            || state->kernel == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory is not ready");
        goto failed;
    }
    factory_guard = Py_NewRef(state->factory);
    kernel_guard = Py_NewRef(state->kernel);
    if (verify_public_sources(module_guard, state, factory_guard, kernel_guard,
                              RENO_FACTORY_READY) < 0) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* This is the real r1196 producer, with type/GC allocation and tracking.
     * No current export, owner parameter, raw resource or prior result.
     */
    owner = reno_windows_cpython312_handle_owner_new_empty();
    if (owner == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Allocation may have called out. Neither the pre-call phase check nor
     * a type check proves that private source state is still current.
     */
    if (verify_public_sources(module_guard, state, factory_guard, kernel_guard,
                              RENO_FACTORY_READY) < 0) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Nonlast: READY state independently retains both functions; their
     * actual m_self edges retain module. No further fallible preparation.
     */
    Py_DECREF(kernel_guard);
    Py_DECREF(factory_guard);
    Py_DECREF(module_guard);
    return (PyObject *)owner; /* transfer this invocation's actual NEW */

failed:
    first = take_failure();
    /* A tracked EMPTY owner may already be retained by a GC observer.
     * Release only this invocation's root; do not claim dealloc/close ran.
     */
    Py_XDECREF(owner);
    Py_XDECREF(kernel_guard);
    Py_XDECREF(factory_guard);
    Py_XDECREF(module_guard);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

/* Static lifetime is required: a PyCFunction retains m_ml as a raw pointer. */
static PyMethodDef owner_factory_method = {
    "new_empty_owner", owner_factory_call, METH_NOARGS,
    "Create a new empty private HANDLE owner; grants no holder authority."
};

static PyMethodDef owner_kernel_method = {
    "owner_kernel_new_empty", owner_kernel_call, METH_NOARGS,
    "Capture and invoke the original empty-owner factory; grants no authority."
};

PyObject *
reno_windows_cpython312_owner_factory_capture(PyObject *module)
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *captured = NULL;
    PyObject *kernel_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoOwnerFactoryState *state = NULL;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(module);
    state = prepare_state(module_guard);
    if (state == NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->phase != RENO_FACTORY_READY || state->factory == NULL
            || state->kernel == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory capture unavailable");
        goto failed;
    }
    captured = Py_NewRef(state->factory);
    kernel_guard = Py_NewRef(state->kernel);
    if (verify_public_sources(module_guard, state, captured, kernel_guard,
                              RENO_FACTORY_READY) < 0) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Last fresh succeeded: state independently owns kernel and captured's
     * actual m_self owns module. Neither release uses a public alias root.
     */
    Py_DECREF(kernel_guard);
    Py_DECREF(module_guard);
    return captured;

failed:
    first = take_failure();
    Py_XDECREF(kernel_guard);
    Py_XDECREF(captured);
    Py_XDECREF(module_guard);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

/* This is a new, actual C consumer, not an implementation of the old
 * Python bootstrap. It consumes capture's real NEW function and the real
 * dispatch result; no receipt, dummy owner or second direct producer call.
 */
RenoWindowsHandleOwner *
reno_windows_cpython312_owner_factory_new_empty(PyObject *module)
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *factory_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *kernel_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *captured = NULL;
    PyObject *result = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoOwnerFactoryState *state = NULL;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(module);
    state = prepare_state(module_guard);
    if (state == NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->phase != RENO_FACTORY_READY || state->factory == NULL
            || state->kernel == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner kernel is not ready");
        goto failed;
    }
    factory_guard = Py_NewRef(state->factory);
    kernel_guard = Py_NewRef(state->kernel);
    captured = reno_windows_cpython312_owner_factory_capture(module_guard);
    if (captured == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (captured != factory_guard) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner kernel captured another source");
        goto failed;
    }
    if (verify_public_sources(module_guard, state, factory_guard, kernel_guard,
                              RENO_FACTORY_READY) < 0) {
        goto failed;
    }
    result = PyObject_CallNoArgs(captured); /* actual original factory, once */
    if (result == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (verify_public_sources(module_guard, state, factory_guard, kernel_guard,
                              RENO_FACTORY_READY) < 0) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* State owns both source functions; captured has an independent local
     * plus factory_guard. Their m_self edges own actual module throughout.
     */
    Py_DECREF(captured);
    Py_DECREF(kernel_guard);
    Py_DECREF(factory_guard);
    Py_DECREF(module_guard);
    return (RenoWindowsHandleOwner *)result; /* move this invocation's actual NEW */

failed:
    first = take_failure();
    /* Dispatch may already have created a tracked EMPTY owner. Release only
     * our actual NEW; no attempt-zero, last-alias or destroyed-object claim.
     */
    Py_XDECREF(result);
    Py_XDECREF(captured);
    Py_XDECREF(kernel_guard);
    Py_XDECREF(factory_guard);
    Py_XDECREF(module_guard);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return NULL;
}

static PyObject *
owner_kernel_call(PyObject *module, PyObject *Py_UNUSED(ignored))
{
    return (PyObject *)reno_windows_cpython312_owner_factory_new_empty(module);
}

/* Existing exec's actual prepared inputs and continuous module/State roots
 * provide provenance. Missing finish/provider/class-domain/W42 and dispatch
 * are not implemented here. Only actual final install/reversal is added.
 */
static int
reno_h01_complete_bootstrap(PyObject *module, RenoState *state,
    unsigned int *bootstrap_entered, PyObject **factory_owned,
    PyObject **kernel_owned, const RenoProxyBindingOps *binding_ops,
    const RenoLoaderRecordOps *record_ops)
{
    PyThreadState *thread_state = NULL;
    PyInterpreterState *interpreter = NULL;
    RenoOwnerFactoryState *legacy = NULL;
    RenoProxyObject *proxy = NULL;
    PyObject **roots = NULL;
    PyObject *dictionary = NULL;
    PyObject *list = NULL;
    PyObject *detached = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    Py_ssize_t index = -1;
    Py_ssize_t length;
    Py_ssize_t position;
    Py_ssize_t original_count;
    Py_ssize_t proxy_count;
    size_t entry_count;
    unsigned int pass;
    unsigned int claimed = 0;
    int cleanup_failed = 0;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { return -1; }
    if (module == NULL || state == NULL || bootstrap_entered == NULL
            || factory_owned == NULL || kernel_owned == NULL
            || factory_owned == kernel_owned
            || binding_ops != &reno_proxy_binding_ops
            || record_ops != &reno_loader_record_ops) { goto rejected; }
    for (pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
        if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL || !PyModule_CheckExact(module)
                || _PyModule_GetDef(module) != &owner_factory_definition
                || reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(module) != state
                || state->bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED
                || state->controls.phase != RENO_MODULE_PREPARING
                || state->controls.install_phase != RENO_INSTALL_PREPARED
                || state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE
                || state->controls.published_arena != &state->arena
                || !state->controls.t0_raw_capture_complete
                || state->controls.class_source_witness_ready != 1
                || state->arena.class_source_witness == NULL
                || state->controls.finder_slot_armed
                || state->arena.install.finder_before != NULL
                || state->arena.install.finder_after != NULL
                || state->controls.record_head != NULL || state->controls.record_draining
                || (pass == 0 ? (!*bootstrap_entered || state->controls.meta_active_count <= 0)
                    : (*bootstrap_entered || state->controls.meta_active_count < 0))) { goto rejected; }
        if (pass == 0) { claimed = 1; }
        legacy = &state->arena.legacy_owner_factory;
        if ((pass == 0 ? (*factory_owned == NULL || *kernel_owned == NULL
                    || *factory_owned != legacy->factory || *kernel_owned != legacy->kernel)
                : (*factory_owned != NULL || *kernel_owned != NULL))
                || !source_fields_match(module, legacy, legacy->factory, legacy->kernel,
                    RENO_FACTORY_READY)) { goto rejected; }
        dictionary = ((PyModuleObject *)module)->md_dict;
        if (reno_ws_exact_dict_keys(dictionary, &entry_count) != RENO_WS_COUNT_OK
                || !reno_ws_source_ascii(dictionary, "new_empty_owner", 15, legacy->factory)
                || !reno_ws_source_ascii(dictionary, "owner_kernel_new_empty", 22, legacy->kernel)) { goto rejected; }
        roots = state->arena.known.roots;
        thread_state = _PyThreadState_UncheckedGet();
        if (thread_state == NULL) { goto rejected; }
        interpreter = thread_state->interp;
        if (interpreter == NULL || interpreter->imports.modules == NULL
                || interpreter->imports.modules != roots[0]
                || interpreter->sysdict == NULL || interpreter->sysdict != roots[2]) { goto rejected; }
        /* This consumer and the source helpers match actual live runtime
         * data. No callback/GIL-release lies between this gate and those
         * exact selected source reads; no old strong root proves liveness.
         */
        if (!reno_spec_source_capture_consistent(state)
                || !reno_state_fixed_metadata_match(state)
                || !reno_state_class_sources_match(state)
                || !reno_proxy_bound_type_effect(state->arena.install.bound_type)
                || !reno_record_type_effect(state->arena.install.record_type)
                || !reno_proxy_type_effect(state->arena.install.proxy_type)
                || !reno_catalog_product_type_effect(state->arena.install.catalog_product_type)
                || state->arena.install.proxy == NULL
                || Py_TYPE(state->arena.install.proxy) != (PyTypeObject *)state->arena.install.proxy_type
                || !reno_ws_known_status(state, 97, 1)
                || state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall_captured != 1
                || !reno_finder_products_match(state, state->arena.install.find_spec,
                    state->arena.install.invalidate_caches, state->arena.install.find_distributions,
                    state->controls.finder_method_vectorcall)) { goto rejected; }
        proxy = (RenoProxyObject *)state->arena.install.proxy;
        if (proxy->module_lifetime != module || proxy->origin_state != state
                || proxy->retired_error_class != roots[97]
                || proxy->phase != RENO_PROXY_PREPARED
                || !PyList_CheckExact(roots[3])) { goto rejected; }
        list = roots[3];
        length = PyList_GET_SIZE(list);
        original_count = 0;
        proxy_count = 0;
        index = -1;
        for (position = 0; position < length; ++position) {
            if (PyList_GET_ITEM(list, position) == roots[6]) { ++original_count; index = position; }
            proxy_count += PyList_GET_ITEM(list, position) == (PyObject *)proxy;
        }
        if (original_count != 1 || proxy_count != 0 || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto rejected; }
        if (pass == 0) {
            /* Independent State legacy roots were just matched. These two
             * real parent occurrences are nonlast in the selected full
             * reference envelope; no parent owning temp survives leave.
             */
            detached = *kernel_owned;
            *kernel_owned = NULL;
            Py_DECREF(detached);
            detached = *factory_owned;
            *factory_owned = NULL;
            Py_DECREF(detached);
            detached = NULL;
            roots = NULL;
            dictionary = NULL;
            list = NULL;
            proxy = NULL;
            legacy = NULL;
            thread_state = NULL;
            interpreter = NULL;
            index = -1;
            reno_common_metadata_leave(state, bootstrap_entered, &first, &cleanup_failed);
            if (first != NULL) {
                reno_common_request_retirement(state);
                PyErr_SetRaisedException(first); /* move actual first to caller */
                return -1;
            }
            if (cleanup_failed || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) { goto rejected; }
            continue; /* fresh actual State roots/borrow/index in pass 1 */
        }
        /* Last full check passed. Each neighbor occurrence is independently
         * acquired in order, even when both refer to the same object. State
         * traversal/drain owns them before armed becomes visible. No callout
         * lies in this final exact/full-reference segment.
         */
        state->arena.install.finder_before = index > 0
            ? Py_NewRef(PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index - 1)) : NULL;
        state->arena.install.finder_after = index + 1 < length
            ? Py_NewRef(PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index + 1)) : NULL;
        state->controls.finder_slot_index = index;
        detached = PyList_GET_ITEM(list, index);
        PyList_SET_ITEM(list, index, Py_NewRef((PyObject *)proxy));
        Py_DECREF(detached); /* known6 independently owns actual PathFinder */
        state->controls.finder_slot_armed = 1;
        proxy->phase = RENO_PROXY_ACTIVE;
        state->controls.install_phase = RENO_INSTALL_ACTIVE;
        state->controls.phase = RENO_MODULE_ACTIVE;
        return 0;
    }
rejected:
    if (claimed) { reno_common_request_retirement(state); }
    if (PyErr_Occurred() == NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "native finder installation rejected");
    }
    return -1;
}

/* Only the original legacy conflict expression. Caller has independently
 * valid actual typed State/capacity/source and a continuous module guard.
 * A TYPED marker permits payload access; it does not prove those premises.
 * No common-phase restriction, claim, reference operation or callback here.
 */
static int
reno_h01_existing_legacy_conflict_raw(const RenoState *state)
{
    const RenoOwnerFactoryState *legacy = &state->arena.legacy_owner_factory;

    return legacy->phase != RENO_FACTORY_NEW || legacy->factory != NULL
        || legacy->kernel != NULL || legacy->factory_vectorcall != NULL
        || legacy->kernel_vectorcall != NULL;
}

static int
owner_factory_exec(PyObject *module)
{
    PyObject *module_guard = NULL;
    PyObject *factory = NULL;
    PyObject *kernel = NULL;
    PyObject *first = NULL;
    RenoState *common = NULL;
    RenoOwnerFactoryState *state = NULL;
    getattrofunc object_getter = NULL;
    getattrofunc type_getter = NULL;
    getattrofunc module_getter = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc factory_vectorcall = NULL;
    vectorcallfunc kernel_vectorcall = NULL;
    unsigned int common_claimed = 0;
    unsigned int bootstrap_entered = 0;
    unsigned int creation_claimed = 0;
    unsigned char bootstrap_marker = RENO_BOOT_RAW_UNENTERED;

    if (PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    /* Legal Py_mod_exec argument is the independent initial source root.
     * No future type/instance/factory edge is used to justify this acquire.
     */
    module_guard = Py_NewRef(module);
    object_getter = PyBaseObject_Type.tp_getattro;
    type_getter = PyType_Type.tp_getattro;
    module_getter = PyModule_Type.tp_getattro;
    /* Preserve the original exec caller's exact-module error priority.
     * The shared raw selector itself still accepts its general module domain.
     * No State, marker or claim has been read/acquired in this failure branch.
     */
    if (!PyModule_CheckExact(module_guard)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory module mismatch");
        goto failed;
    }
    common = reno_h01_bootstrap_state_raw(module_guard);
    if (common == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Initial scalar zero is not a sample. This actual read follows the
     * original nonNULL/no-error State classification, before any callout.
     */
    bootstrap_marker = *(const unsigned char *)common;
    if (bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_RAW_UNENTERED) {
        if (bootstrap_marker == RENO_BOOT_RAW_RETIRED) {
            /* Terminal raw state: no typed payload read or new claim.
             * Parent keeps its guard and preserves the actual SetString
             * error, including OOM, before its existing failure cleanup.
             */
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
            goto failed;
        }
        if (bootstrap_marker == RENO_BOOT_TYPED
                && reno_h01_existing_legacy_conflict_raw(common)) {
            /* Original legacy conflict, not a blanket marker rejection.
             * Parent still owns its guard, all claims/entered remain zero.
             * SetString may fail: the parent preserves the actual first.
             */
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory exec is single-attempt");
            goto failed; /* never retire another attempt from this branch */
        }
        if (bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_RAW_INITIALIZING
                && bootstrap_marker != RENO_BOOT_TYPED) {
            /* RAW0 never entered here and RAW2 already failed above.
             * Unknown raw value is not adopted, repaired or read as payload.
             */
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
            goto failed;
        }
        /* Remaining RAW_INITIALIZING and TYPED/NEW domains still need the
         * actual missing body. Do not substitute default success/rejection,
         * recapture T0, clear old State or acquire another attempt's claim.
         * That body consumes/NULLs this real module_guard on BOTH exits after
         * its own last access/actual-first settlement. This scalar is not
         * used after that potentially callable preparation boundary.
         */
        if (reno_h01_bootstrap_existing(&module_guard, common) < 0
                || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
            goto failed;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    common_claimed = 1;
    reno_common_state_initialize_raw(common);
    common->controls.getters[0].expected = object_getter;
    common->controls.getters[0].captured = 1;
    common->controls.getters[0].frozen = 1;
    common->controls.getters[1].expected = type_getter;
    common->controls.getters[1].captured = 1;
    common->controls.getters[1].frozen = 1;
    common->controls.getters[2].expected = module_getter;
    common->controls.getters[2].captured = 1;
    common->controls.getters[2].frozen = 1;
    if (reno_h01_capture_before_legacy(module_guard, common,
                                      &bootstrap_entered) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* Real T0/representation/lease dependency has completed its original
     * boundary before ANY legacy NewEx. No captured/current backfill here.
     */
    state = &common->arena.legacy_owner_factory;
    if (state->phase != RENO_FACTORY_NEW || state->factory != NULL
            || state->kernel != NULL || state->factory_vectorcall != NULL
            || state->kernel_vectorcall != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory exec is single-attempt");
        goto failed; /* do not reset or retire another completed attempt */
    }
    state->phase = RENO_FACTORY_CREATING;
    creation_claimed = 1;
    factory = PyCFunction_NewEx(&owner_factory_method, module_guard, NULL);
    if (factory == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->phase != RENO_FACTORY_CREATING || state->factory != NULL
            || state->kernel != NULL || state->factory_vectorcall != NULL
            || state->kernel_vectorcall != NULL
            || !created_function_shape(factory, module_guard,
                                       &owner_factory_method, owner_factory_call)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory retired before publication");
        goto failed;
    }
    factory_vectorcall = ((PyCFunctionObject *)factory)->vectorcall;
    kernel = PyCFunction_NewEx(&owner_kernel_method, module_guard, NULL);
    if (kernel == NULL || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (state->phase != RENO_FACTORY_CREATING || state->factory != NULL
            || state->kernel != NULL || state->factory_vectorcall != NULL
            || state->kernel_vectorcall != NULL
            || !created_function_shape(factory, module_guard,
                                       &owner_factory_method, owner_factory_call)
            || ((PyCFunctionObject *)factory)->vectorcall != factory_vectorcall
            || !created_function_shape(kernel, module_guard,
                                       &owner_kernel_method, owner_kernel_call)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner kernel retired before publication");
        goto failed;
    }
    kernel_vectorcall = ((PyCFunctionObject *)kernel)->vectorcall;
    /* Independent private edges plus creation locals. Capture native scalar
     * facts from the actual NEW products before any public publication.
     */
    state->factory = Py_NewRef(factory);
    state->kernel = Py_NewRef(kernel);
    state->factory_vectorcall = factory_vectorcall;
    state->kernel_vectorcall = kernel_vectorcall;
    state->phase = RENO_FACTORY_PUBLISHING;
    if (PyModule_AddObjectRef(module_guard, "new_empty_owner", factory) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (!source_fields_match(module_guard, state, factory, kernel,
                              RENO_FACTORY_PUBLISHING)) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory retired during publication");
        goto failed;
    }
    if (PyModule_AddObjectRef(module_guard, "owner_kernel_new_empty", kernel) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (verify_public_sources(module_guard, state, factory, kernel,
                              RENO_FACTORY_PUBLISHING) < 0) {
        goto failed;
    }
    state->phase = RENO_FACTORY_READY;
    if (reno_h01_prepare_install_objects(module_guard, common, &bootstrap_entered,
                                        &reno_proxy_binding_ops,
                                        &reno_loader_record_ops) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    if (reno_h01_complete_bootstrap(module_guard, common, &bootstrap_entered,
                                    &factory, &kernel,
                                    &reno_proxy_binding_ops,
                                    &reno_loader_record_ops) < 0
            || PyErr_Occurred() != NULL) {
        goto failed;
    }
    /* The real completer must settle/NULL both parent owning slots BEFORE
     * bootstrap leave and its original final raw install/effect/ACTIVE segment.
     * Those actual functions remain independently State-owned on success;
     * their m_self edges cover this final nonlast module envelope release.
     * No parent function temporary remains to be released after last leave.
     */
    Py_DECREF(module_guard);
    return 0;

failed:
    first = take_failure();
    if (creation_claimed) {
        state->phase = RENO_FACTORY_RETIRED; /* stop only this claimed legacy */
    }
    if (common_claimed) {
        reno_common_request_retirement(common);
        /* Parent privately owns first across this whole call. Empty indicator
         * does not mean no first; the helper may borrow but never consume or
         * replace this parent occurrence. No exception introspection/history.
         */
        reno_h01_abandon_bootstrap(module_guard, common, &bootstrap_entered,
                                   &factory, &kernel, first);
    }
    /* Abandon already consumed/NULLed both parent owning slots before leave;
     * an unclaimed branch never acquired them. Public aliases may retain the
     * actual functions and are not overwritten/deleted here. Keep the original
     * module guard through the last State access, then finish actual first.
     */
    Py_XDECREF(module_guard);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return -1;
}

/* Actual lifecycle callers supply this native module/allocation. Their raw
 * view dependency has no normal accessor/error-preparation semantics and must
 * preserve the entry indicator. No new module reference at last m_free.
 */
static int
owner_factory_traverse(PyObject *module, visitproc visit, void *arg)
{
    RenoState *state = reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(module);
    size_t i;
    int status;

    if (state == NULL || *(const unsigned char *)state != RENO_BOOT_TYPED) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (state->controls.arena_owner != RENO_ARENA_STATE) {
        return 0; /* LOCAL_DRAIN roots are private drainer owning occurrences */
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 113; ++i) {
        if (state->arena.known.owned[i]) {
            Py_VISIT(state->arena.known.roots[i]);
        }
    }
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.bound_type);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.record_type);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.proxy_type);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.catalog_product_type);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.proxy);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.find_spec);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.invalidate_caches);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.find_distributions);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.finder_before);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.install.finder_after);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.class_source_witness);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.spec_source.klass);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.spec_source.dictionary);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.spec_source.mro);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.spec_source.prepared_loader_key);
    status = reno_spec_mro_region_traverse(&state->arena.spec_source.region, visit, arg);
    if (status != 0) { return status; }
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.factory);
    Py_VISIT(state->arena.legacy_owner_factory.kernel);
    return 0;
}

static int
owner_factory_clear(PyObject *module)
{
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    RenoState *state = reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw(module);
    int status;

    reno_common_request_retirement(state); /* latch CLEAR before any busy test */
    /* This real dependency must honor raw/typed/unknown domains, request the
     * Record cancellation/drain, settle or defer actual entered debts and
     * select the joint owner/release protocol. It may adopt a new actual
     * cleanup first into an empty first slot and MUST then return failure.
     * Never restore a hardcoded empty entry indicator over that failure.
     */
    status = reno_h01_clear_common_state(module, state, &first);
    PyErr_SetRaisedException(first);
    return status;
}

static void
owner_factory_free(void *module)
{
    RenoState *state = reno_h01_lifecycle_state_raw((PyObject *)module);

    reno_common_request_retirement(state);
    /* Legal lifecycle/allocation/source/full-ABI premises still precede this
     * view. The current raw initializer acquires no State-owned objects;
     * only raw0/raw1 may become raw2, never an already typed owner. NULL
     * short-circuits before the sole char read. These exits neither touch
     * typed payload/indicator nor acquire/resurrect module or free md_state.
     * No payload is not a no-reader proof: the original module guard, legal
     * dealloc caller and same-GIL/no-callout raw span must exclude that case.
     * Reaudit if a raw writer, acquire or callout is added before TYPED.
     */
    if (state == NULL
            || *(const unsigned char *)state == RENO_BOOT_RAW_RETIRED) {
        return;
    }
    /* Raw selector/request/gate above preserve the actual entry indicator.
     * Sample only here; freeze its original presence BEFORE cleanup can adopt
     * a new actual E2 into first. This is private C ownership, not State data.
     */
    PyObject *first = PyErr_GetRaisedException();
    const unsigned int had_entry_first = (first != NULL);
    PyObject *out = NULL;

    /* Fresh raw classification follows the actual entry-error sample.
     * Unknown rejects without typed payload/repair/ownership adoption; this
     * error route does not settle unknown owning/N4 responsibility.
     * TYPED-to-call has no callback; final error policy remains below.
     */
    if (*(const unsigned char *)state != RENO_BOOT_TYPED) {
        int cleanup_failed = 0;
        if (first == NULL) {
            PyErr_SetString(PyExc_RuntimeError, "owner factory state unavailable");
        }
        reno_cleanup_settle_indicator(&first, &cleanup_failed);
    } else {
        reno_h01_finish_free((PyObject *)module, state, &first);
    }
    out = first;
    first = NULL; /* move this one owning occurrence out of the callee slot */
    if (had_entry_first) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out); /* steals actual original nonNULL first */
        return;
    }
    if (out != NULL) {
        PyErr_SetRaisedException(out); /* steals actual adopted cleanup first */
    }
    /* Independent matching public Clear contract, not a claim that every
     * release is NULL-to-NULL or that this call cannot run Python. All owned
     * debts/State accesses ended above; no resource action follows this call.
     */
    PyErr_Clear();
    return;
}

static PyModuleDef_Slot owner_factory_module_slots[] = {
    {Py_mod_exec, (void *)owner_factory_exec},
    {0, NULL}
};

static PyModuleDef owner_factory_definition = {
    PyModuleDef_HEAD_INIT,
    "_reno_handle_owner312",
    "Incomplete shared-State source work; not an installable native module.",
    sizeof(RenoState),
    NULL, /* create both real functions explicitly in Py_mod_exec */
    owner_factory_module_slots,
    owner_factory_traverse,
    owner_factory_clear,
    owner_factory_free
};

PyMODINIT_FUNC
PyInit__reno_handle_owner312(void)
{
    return PyModuleDef_Init(&owner_factory_definition);
}
